To address these problems, we propose Artemis: a geometry-grounded multi-agent world model with explicit memory sharing. An explicit 3D world map is reconstructed from multi-agent observations to enforce a unified 3D state across agents, offering high cross-view consistency. Specifically, an action-guided geometric injection module is developed to simultaneously render decomposed foreground-background control maps, which are then injected into a diffusion transformer through a designed GeoAdapter block. Compared to previous methods assuming static-only background, our GeoAdapter can also distinguish uncontrolled non-agent dynamics, which are conditioned on their own multi-frame history positions to provide consistent motion cues. Keyframes selected from progressive video rollouts are used to progressively update the reconstructed 3D world maps. To effectively capture complex dynamic patterns, we curate a novel dataset sampled from the CARLA simulator called MA-CARLA. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our proposed method in terms of visual fidelity and cross-view consistency in the generated videos. In addition, our Artemis can support simultaneous multi-modal rollouts with both 2D video and 3D point map maintenance, scale to scenarios beyond two agents and multi-camera setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Artemis，一种基于几何锚定、具有显式记忆共享的多智能体世界模型，通过重建显式3D世界地图实现多智能体的统一3D状态与高跨视角一致性，并可建模非智能体的无控背景动态。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型从单智能体扩展到多智能体，能揭示更复杂的动力学与跨智能体交互，但多数方法依赖跨注意力进行隐式智能体间通信，缺乏显式几何约束与统一3D状态，导致多视角一致性差、难以恢复视野外智能体；同时多数假设静态背景，无法表示无控的背景动态。
AI.method: 提出Artemis：1）从多智能体观测重建显式3D世界地图，强制跨智能体共享统一3D状态；2）设计动作引导的几何注入模块，同时渲染分解的前景-背景控制图，并通过GeoAdapter块注入扩散Transformer；3）GeoAdapter可区分无控的非智能体动态，并以多帧历史位置为条件提供一致运动线索；4）利用渐进式视频推演中选取的关键帧逐步更新重建的3D世界地图；5）构建MA-CARLA数据集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提方法在生成视频的视觉保真度与跨视角一致性上优于现有方法；Artemis支持同时进行2D视频与3D点图维护的多模态推演，可扩展到两个以上智能体及多相机场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式3D世界地图、几何注入与显式记忆共享，Artemis有效解决了多智能体世界模型中跨视角一致性差、视野外智能体恢复困难及背景动态建模缺失的问题，拓展了多智能体多模态视频世界模型的能力边界。

title: Learning to Decide, Not to Reason: Parameter-Efficient Decision Operators via Low-Rank Activation Steering
summary: Injecting skills into a frozen language model currently costs a million parameters and a reinforcement-learning pipeline. We introduce \method{}, a System-1 decision operator trained by behavior cloning that lowers this cost by roughly two orders of magnitude. The default operator uses 330K parameters to match a 1.33M-parameter operator trained with reinforcement learning, exceeds or achieve comparable performance, while collapsing 3,685-token deliberation into a 6-token decision with no loss in accuracy. A rank-4 variant with 23K parameters, 1/58 of the strongest published skill operator, suffices for SearchQA and near-suffices for LiveMath, where higher rank still helps; the same recipe transfers across five tasks and three backbones, with out-of-distribution gains persisting on LiveMath problems released months after training. The gap to prior work is trainability, and it is set jointly by initialization and architecture: the initialization of prior operators zeroes the gradient of both large factor matrices at the first optimization step, whereas our zero-initialized output projection inside a shared low-rank backbone receives a gradient immediately, which a gradient-flow probe confirms directly. The gain isn't chain-of-thought compression: 23 of 57 LiveMath points beat the base model's best-of-8 sampling, and a logit-lens probe shows the operator amplifies the answer along the model's existing late-layer pathway, not writing it earlier. Gains track the base model's headroom across 13 base--task pairs, and skills compose as approximately linear operators that can be added, interpolated, and hot-swapped at inference time. Code on https://github.com/rlisml/decisionsteer.

AI.tldr: 提出 \method{}，一种用行为克隆训练的 System-1 决策算子，以大压缩的参数规模和计算量匹配甚至超过强化学习训练的同类算子，并具备跨任务、跨骨干的迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有为冻结语言模型注入技能需要百万级参数和强化学习流程，成本高昂；论文旨在大幅降低这一成本并揭示先前方法难以训练的根本原因。
AI.method: 采用行为克隆训练决策算子；默认算子 330K 参数，共享低秩骨干内使用零初始化输出投影；用梯度流探针分析初始化与架构对可训练性影响；使用 logit-lens 探针分析其作用路径。
AI.result: 默认 330K 算子匹配 1.33M 强化学习算子，将 3,685 token  deliberation 压缩为 6 token 决策且无精度损失；rank-4 变体仅 23K 参数（为最强公开算子的 1/58），在 SearchQA 足够、LiveMath 接近足够；跨五任务三骨干迁移，且对训练数月后发布的 LiveMath 问题仍有 OOD 收益；23/57 LiveMath 得分点超过基模型 best-of-8 采样。
AI.conclusion: 与先前工作的差距源于可训练性，由初始化和架构共同决定；技能可近似线性组合，支持相加、插值与推理时热插拔，收益随基模型 headroom 变化。

title: Topology-Consistent Task Planning over Cellular Workflow Complexes for LLM-based Agents
summary: Task planning for LLM agents requires workflows that satisfy both user intent and complex sub-task dependencies. While existing planners work well for sequential or directed acyclic graph (DAG)-like structures, they struggle with workflow patterns such as verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states that arise naturally in real-world tool orchestration. We present TopoPlanner, a topology-consistent planning framework that lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and uses them as topologyaware context for LLM tool planning. TopoPlanner retrieves a request-relevant closed subcomplex through cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval, performs multidimensional structural reasoning over the retrieved topology, and interfaces the resulting cellular representation with the planner LLM for tool-sequence generation. Experiments on four tool-planning benchmarks with topology-guided loop, merge, and loop-merge workflows show consistent improvements over prompt-based and graph-enhanced baselines across different local LLM backbones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TopoPlanner，一种拓扑一致性规划框架，将工具依赖图提升为元胞工作流复形，用作 LLM 工具规划的拓扑感知上下文，以支持验证-纠正循环、分支汇聚与可复用中间状态等工作流模式。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体任务规划器擅长处理顺序或 DAG 类结构，但难以应对真实工具编排中常见的验证-纠正循环、汇聚分支合并和可复用中间状态等工作流模式，导致用户意图与子任务依赖难以同时满足。
AI.method: TopoPlanner 通过同调层一致的元胞检索（cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval）获取与请求相关的闭子复形，在检索到的拓扑结构上执行多维结构推理，并将所得元胞表示与规划器 LLM 对接以生成工具序列。
AI.result: 在四个工具规划基准上，针对拓扑引导的循环、合并以及循环-合并工作流，TopoPlanner 在不同本地 LLM 骨干模型上均持续优于基于提示和图增强的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将工具依赖图建模为元胞工作流复形并作为拓扑感知上下文，可有效提升 LLM 智能体在复杂依赖结构下的工具规划性能，且具备跨骨干模型的泛化能力。

title: Crop Yield Prediction for Punjab, Pakistan: A Tree-Ensemble and Leaf-Health Prototype, and What Random Validation Hides
summary: Yield forecasts help planners and farmers decide on inputs, storage and imports, but small agricultural tables can make reported accuracy fail on a new season. We built a crop-yield prototype for Punjab, Pakistan that combines Random Forest, XGBoost, support vector regression and a Ridge-stacked ensemble with a MobileNetV2 leaf-health classifier, and deployed it as a web application with SHAP explanations. A random 80/20 split of a merged Kaggle-derived table (414 rows) gives the ensemble an R2 of 0.991. An audit showed that the table contains only 46 independent observations: a join with nine temperature records per year copied every crop-year nine times. Holding out whole years takes XGBoost on the same rows from R2 = 0.994 to -0.20. On deduplicated data, and on a longer FAOSTAT table (1990-2024, 70 observations), a per-crop linear trend (leave-one-year-out RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha) beats every model not given the year (0.84-1.06). Neither pesticide use nor national temperature change explains the trend residuals. An apparent pesticide gain in the Kaggle table disappears on FAOSTAT, where the pesticide series is mostly imputed and the two releases disagree. An independent district-level wheat panel (36 districts, 13 seasons) shows that most variation in Punjab is spatial and that a district mean with a common trend matches the learned models. The leaf classifier reaches 99.87% accuracy on held-out PlantVillage images and recalls 96.4% of 336 unseen diseased leaves after near-duplicates were removed. However, no leaf image is paired with a yield record, so the health score used in the yield models had to be constructed and adds nothing. We report these negative findings together with the prototype.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了巴基斯坦旁遮普省的作物产量预测原型（随机森林、XGBoost、SVR、Ridge堆叠集成 + MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器 + SHAP解释的Web应用），但在审计中发现数据存在严重重复问题，导致高精度结果不可靠，最终报告了一系列负面发现。
AI.motivation: 产量预测对规划者和农民决定投入、储存和进口很重要，但小型农业数据表可能使报告的准确率在新季节失效。作者希望构建一个可用的作物产量预测原型，并对其真实性进行严格审计。
AI.method: 构建集成模型（随机森林、XGBoost、支持向量回归、Ridge堆叠集成）结合MobileNetV2叶片健康分类器，部署为带SHAP解释的Web应用。使用合并的Kaggle数据表（414行）随机80/20划分，并进行年度留出验证；在去重数据和更长的FAOSTAT表（1990-2024，70个观测）上测试；用逐作物线性趋势对比；使用独立的县级小麦面板（36县，13季）；叶片分类器在PlantVillage图像上评估并去除近重复。
AI.result: 随机80/20划分下集成模型R2=0.991，但审计发现表中仅有46个独立观测（因每年9条温度记录导致重复9次）。留出整年时XGBoost从R2=0.994降至-0.20。去重数据和FAOSTAT上，逐作物线性趋势（留一年RMSE 0.29 Ton/Ha）优于所有未给年份的模型（0.84-1.06）。农药使用和国家温度变化均无法解释趋势残差。Kaggle表中的农药增益在FAOSTAT上消失（农药序列多为插补且两版不一致）。县级小麦面板显示旁遮普省大部分变异是空间性的，县均值加共同趋势即可匹配学习模型。叶片分类器在PlantVillage上达99.87%准确率，去除近重复后对336片未见病叶召回96.4%，但无叶片图像与产量记录配对，健康分数是构造的且无贡献。
AI.conclusion: 报告的高精度大多源于数据泄漏（重复行）而非真实预测能力。简单线性趋势和县均值在真实数据上更稳健。叶片健康分类器虽性能高但无法与产量关联，对产量模型无贡献。作者将这些负面发现与原型一并报告，强调农业小数据表的审计必要性。

title: Do Neural PDE Solvers Learn the Right Dynamics?
summary: Neural PDE solvers can achieve low prediction errors, but do they reproduce the dynamics of the systems they model? Prediction scores alone offer an incomplete answer: they measure agreement with reference solutions but provide limited insight into how errors accumulate, nearby states diverge, or extreme events arise. We propose an evaluation framework that directly examines these behaviors in deterministic and stochastic neural solvers. By evolving ensembles of nearby initial states and comparing them with direct numerical simulation, we assess three complementary aspects of learned dynamics: error formation, ensemble geometry, and extreme events. Experiments on two-dimensional Kolmogorov flow reveal limitations that conventional scores can obscure. Smaller trajectory errors can reflect weaker error amplification despite less accurate local updates. Models can match an ensemble's overall spread and effective dimension while failing to capture the spatial directions where nearby states diverge. Similarly, matching overall event frequencies can conceal failures to predict persistent extreme events. These findings show that improved prediction accuracy does not necessarily imply greater dynamical fidelity. Our framework makes this distinction measurable, providing concrete criteria for evaluating whether advances in neural PDE solvers better capture the underlying dynamics.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个评估框架，通过在确定性/随机神经PDE求解器中演化邻近初始态集合，考察误差形成、集合几何与极端事件三方面，揭示传统预测分数掩盖的动力学保真度局限。
AI.motivation: 神经PDE求解器虽能取得低预测误差，但预测分数仅衡量与参考解的一致性，无法揭示误差如何累积、邻近状态如何发散、极端事件如何产生。因此需要直接考察这些动力学行为的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出评估框架：对确定性与随机神经求解器，演化邻近初始态的集合，并与直接数值模拟对比，从三个互补方面评估所学动力学——误差形成、集合几何、极端事件。在二维Kolmogorov流上实验。
AI.result: 实验揭示传统分数掩盖的缺陷：更小轨迹误差可能源于更弱的误差放大而非更准确的局部更新；模型可匹配集合整体散布与有效维度，却无法捕捉邻近态发散的空間方向；匹配总体事件频率可掩盖对持续性极端事件的预测失败。
AI.conclusion: 预测精度的提升不必然意味着动力学保真度的提升。该框架使这一区分可量化，为评价神经PDE求解器进展是否更好捕捉底层动力学提供了具体标准。

title: When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers. Self-verification offers a practical way to improve answer reliability without relying on external judges, but existing methods typically depend on a single verification criterion or fixed prompt, resulting in incomplete and unstable reliability estimates. We first systematically analyze how verifier capability and prompt design affect verification performance. Our findings show that stronger verifiers provide more reliable judgments, while verification performance is highly sensitive to prompt choice, with no single prompt consistently dominating across tasks. Guided by these findings, we propose \texttt{MOTIVE}, a \textbf{M}ulti-View Self-Verificati\textbf{O}n wi\textbf{T}h Rel\textbf{I}ability-Guided Selecti\textbf{VE} Rethinking framework for reliable multimodal reasoning. \texttt{MOTIVE} evaluates each candidate answer from complementary verification perspectives and learns a correctness-aligned reliability score through correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning. During inference, this score governs an accept-or-rethink decision, allowing reliable answers to be returned directly while uncertain ones trigger history-guided rethinking. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and VLM backbones demonstrate that \texttt{MOTIVE} consistently outperforms strong self-verification and self-correction baselines. Further results show that reliable verification improves accept-or-rethink decisions and reduces unnecessary reasoning turns, enabling more reliable and efficient self-verification without an external judge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOTIVE框架，通过多视角自验证与可靠性引导的选择性重思考，提升视觉语言模型推理的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽在多模态推理上表现优异，但易生成看似合理实则错误的答案。现有自验证方法通常依赖单一验证标准或固定提示，导致可靠性估计不完整且不稳定。
AI.method: 作者先系统分析验证器能力与提示设计对验证性能的影响；据此提出MOTIVE框架：从互补的验证视角评估每个候选答案，并通过基于正确性的多视角验证学习得到与正确性对齐的可靠性分数。推理时该分数控制接受或重思考决策，可靠答案直接返回，不确定答案触发历史引导的重思考。
AI.result: 在多种多模态基准和VLM主干上的大量实验表明，MOTIVE一致优于强自验证与自校正基线；可靠性验证改善了接受或重思考决策并减少不必要的推理轮次。
AI.conclusion: MOTIVE实现了无需外部评判者的更可靠、更高效的自验证，为多模态推理提供实用方案。

title: Decomposition-Guided Curvelet Thresholding for Sharp-to-Soft CT Kernel Conversion
summary: Image denoising is a crucial task in image processing, focused on improving image quality by minimizing noise while maintaining essential structural elements. This study presents a hybrid denoising framework that combines several decomposition techniques, including empirical mode decomposition (EMD), variational mode decomposition (VMD), multichannel EMD (MEMD), and bidimensional EMD (BEMD), with curvelet transform thresholding. Each decomposition mode undergoes processing through both soft and hard thresholding, and the denoised modes are combined to rebuild the final image. Comprehensive evaluations of standard CT image datasets reconstructed with various kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36) reveal substantial enhancements in denoising efficacy. VMD consistently achieves the highest peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM), signifying exceptional noise reduction and feature preservation. The study analyses the trade-offs between soft and hard thresholding: soft thresholding maintains intricate visual details, whilst harsh thresholding provides enhanced noise reduction. The suggested method surpasses traditional techniques in both reference and non-reference quality criteria, indicating its potential for broader application in medical imaging and future incorporation with adaptive thresholding algorithms.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种混合图像去噪框架，将EMD、VMD、MEMD、BEMD等分解技术与曲波变换阈值处理相结合，在标准CT图像数据集上验证，VMD取得最高的PSNR与SSIM。
AI.motivation: 图像去噪需在降低噪声的同时保留关键结构信息。现有单一方法在去噪效果与特征保持之间难以兼顾，因此作者希望构建混合框架以提升医学CT图像的去噪性能。
AI.method: 将EMD、VMD、MEMD、BEMD等分解方法与曲波变换阈值化结合，对各分解模态分别施加软阈值和硬阈值处理，再重构图像；在采用B50、B46、B41、B36等不同重建核的CT图像数据集上进行评估，并比较软硬阈值的权衡。
AI.result: 去噪效果显著提升，VMD在PSNR和SSIM上表现最佳；软阈值更好保留细节，硬阈值降噪更强；该方法在有参考与无参考质量指标上均优于传统方法。
AI.conclusion: 该混合去噪框架在CT医学图像上优于传统方法，具备推广到医学成像及结合自适应阈值算法的潜力。

title: EVFormer: An Egocentric Vision-EMG Bidirectional Attention Model for Bimanual Hand Pose Estimation
summary: Egocentric bimanual hand pose estimation is important for virtual interaction, wearable control, and rehabilitation, but visual observations are often degraded by self-occlusion, hand-hand contact, and object manipulation. We propose EVFormer, a multimodal framework that combines the current RGB frame with the preceding 200 ms of bilateral wrist surface electromyography (sEMG) to estimate 44 finger and wrist joint angles. EVFormer separately encodes visual spatial features and sEMG temporal features, enables cross-modal information exchange through sequential bidirectional cross-attention, and integrates the two modalities using feature-wise gated fusion. We evaluate EVFormer in a single-participant feasibility study using one synchronized public EgoEMG recording with chronologically separated training, validation, and test splits. On 296 test samples, EVFormer achieves a mean absolute error of 11.482 degrees, compared with 13.228-13.610 degrees for vision-only, sEMG-only, late-fusion, and training-mean baselines. This corresponds to relative error reductions of 13.20% compared with the vision-only model and 14.23% compared with late fusion. EVFormer also achieves the lowest error in four of the five evaluated gesture classes. These results provide preliminary evidence that feature-level interaction between egocentric vision and sEMG can improve bimanual hand pose estimation. Further evaluation across participants, recording sessions, sensor placements, and real-world interaction conditions is required to establish the generalizability of the approach.

AI.tldr: EVFormer 是一个融合第一视角 RGB 图像与双臂腕部 sEMG 的多模态框架，通过双向交叉注意力与门控融合估计 44 个手指与腕部关节角，在单被试可行性研究中将平均绝对误差降至 11.482°，优于视觉、sEMG 及后融合基线。
AI.motivation: 第一视角双手姿态估计对虚拟交互、可穿戴控制与康复具有重要意义，但自遮挡、手-手接触和物体操作常导致视觉观测退化，单靠视觉难以稳定估计手部姿态，因此需要引入 sEMG 等互补模态。
AI.method: EVFormer 将当前 RGB 帧与之前 200 ms 的双侧腕部表面肌电（sEMG）结合，分别编码视觉空间特征与 sEMG 时间特征，通过顺序双向交叉注意力实现跨模态信息交换，并采用特征级门控融合估计 44 个手指与腕部关节角。实验使用一段公开同步 EgoEMG 记录，按时间顺序划分训练/验证/测试集，进行单被试可行性研究。
AI.result: 在 296 个测试样本上，EVFormer 的平均绝对误差为 11.482°，而仅视觉、仅 sEMG、后融合和训练均值基线为 13.228–13.610°；相较仅视觉降低 13.20%，相较后融合降低 14.23%。在五类手势中的四类上 EVFormer 误差最低。
AI.conclusion: 结果初步表明，第一视角视觉与 sEMG 的特征级交互可提升双手姿态估计精度，但需在被试间、不同记录场次、传感器佩戴位置及真实交互条件下进一步验证其泛化性。

title: Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

AI.tldr: 提出SSRFT框架，将安全对齐重构为"安全角色"内化，通过构建SRQA数据集实现比标准SFT更鲁棒、更泛化的安全对齐，同时减少过度拒答并保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT、RLHF）需要大量攻击特定监督和计算资源，且存在浅层对齐与过度拒答问题，亟需一种更高效、更泛化的替代方案。
AI.method: SSRFT将安全对齐重新表述为对预定义安全角色的内化。基于心理测量学问题、少量越狱提示和安全角色描述构建Safe-Role Question-Answer（SRQA）数据集，合成、验证并扩展角色一致的回答至多样场景，使模型内化安全价值观与原则，而非显式的拒答模式。
AI.result: 在多种Base和Instruct模型上，SSRFT比标准SFT实现更鲁棒、更泛化的安全对齐；对预填充攻击鲁棒性显著更强，对未见越狱域泛化更好，同时减少对良性查询的过度拒答并保留通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 安全角色内化是拒绝导向安全对齐的有效替代方案。

title: A BEMD-Based Quaternion Filtering Approach Sharp-to-Soft Kernel CT Image Conversion
summary: The quality of computed tomography (CT) images is significantly affected by the selection of reconstruction kernels: sharp kernels improve spatial resolution but increase noise, whereas soft kernels diminish noise at the expense of edge clarity. This study presents an innovative enhancement framework utilising Bidimensional Empirical Mode Decomposition in conjunction with Quaternion Bilateral Filtering (BEMD--QBF) to convert sharp-kernel CT images into representations resembling soft-kernels, while maintaining critical anatomical structures. The technique disaggregates each image into intrinsic mode functions via BEMD and analyzes them inside a cohesive quaternion framework to attain efficient noise reduction and structural integrity. The proposed methodology is evaluated using several reconstruction kernels (B50, B46, B41, B36, B35, B31) and compared with recognised filtering strategies, including Non-Local Means, Anisotropic Diffusion, Bilateral Filtering, and Quaternion Bilateral Filtering. Quantitative evaluations of the Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) indicate that BEMD-QBF consistently attains superior structural fidelity and competitive noise reduction across all evaluated kernels. The results underscore the efficacy of the proposed strategy as a viable approach to enhancing post-reconstruction CT images, yielding superior image quality without requiring access to raw projection data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BEMD-QBF框架，将锐核CT图像转换为类软核表征，在保持解剖结构的同时降噪，无需原始投影数据。
AI.motivation: CT重建核选择存在分辨率与噪声的权衡：锐核提升空间分辨率但增加噪声，软核降低噪声却损失边缘清晰度。研究旨在找到兼顾结构保真与降噪的后重建图像增强方法。
AI.method: 结合二维经验模态分解（BEMD）与四元数双边滤波（QBF）。通过BEMD将图像分解为多个本征模态函数，并在统一的四元数框架内进行分析，以实现有效降噪与结构完整性保持。使用多种重建核（B50、B46、B41、B36、B35、B31）进行评估，并与非局部均值、各向异性扩散、双边滤波及四元数双边滤波等滤波策略比较。
AI.result: 在SSIM与PSNR定量评估中，BEMD-QBF在所有测试核下均持续取得更优的结构保真度和具竞争力的降噪效果。
AI.conclusion: 该策略作为后重建CT图像增强的有效方法，无需访问原始投影数据即可获得更优图像质量。

title: Uncertainty in Representation Learning on Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graph embedding (KGE) methods represent entities and predicates in continuous vector spaces to infer missing knowledge. Despite strong benchmark performance, their predictions often lack principled reliability guarantees, limiting their use in high-stakes applications. Moreover, uncertainty arises throughout the KGE pipeline, from incomplete or probabilistic input knowledge to stochastic training and prediction. This thesis systematically investigates three sources of uncertainty in KGE: knowledge uncertainty, arising from incomplete, noisy, or probabilistic input knowledge; algorithmic uncertainty, induced by randomness in model training; and predictive uncertainty, concerning the reliability of model outputs. To address algorithmic uncertainty, the thesis demonstrates that models trained under identical settings can produce substantially different predictions and introduces a voting-based aggregation framework to mitigate this instability. To quantify predictive uncertainty, it adapts conformal prediction to KGE, constructing answer sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees and extending them to provide predicate-conditional reliability guarantees. To support reasoning under knowledge uncertainty, it develops statistically valid prediction intervals for confidence-scored triples and an embedding-based approach to approximate probabilistic reasoning over statistical ontologies with formal soundness guarantees. Together, these complementary, model-agnostic methods provide a practical and theoretically grounded approach to uncertainty in KGE, advancing beyond predictive accuracy toward reliable and uncertainty-aware knowledge graph reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统研究了知识图谱嵌入（KGE）中的三类不确定性——知识不确定性、算法不确定性与预测不确定性，并提出了一系列模型无关、兼具理论与实践基础的方法来量化和缓解这些不确定性。
AI.motivation: 尽管KGE方法在基准测试上表现优异，但其预测往往缺乏可靠性保证，限制了在高风险场景中的应用。同时，从输入知识的不完整/概率性，到训练与预测的随机性，整个KGE流程中都存在不确定性，而现有研究缺乏系统性的应对方案。
AI.method: 论文将KGE中的不确定性分为三类并分别处理：（1）针对算法不确定性，揭示相同设置下训练模型预测差异显著，提出基于投票的聚合框架以缓解不稳定性；（2）针对预测不确定性，将保形预测（conformal prediction）适配到KGE，构建具有无分布覆盖保证的答案集，并扩展为谓词条件可靠性保证；（3）针对知识不确定性，为带置信度评分的三元组开发统计有效的预测区间，并提出基于嵌入的方法以带形式化可靠性保证近似统计本体上的概率推理。
AI.result: 所提出的方法均为模型无关，能够提供分布无关的覆盖保证与形式化的可靠性保证，涵盖训练稳定性、预测可靠性与概率推理三个层面。
AI.conclusion: 该论文通过互补的、兼具理论与实践基础的方法，为KGE中的不确定性提供了系统化解决方案，推动知识图谱推理从单纯追求预测精度迈向可靠且不确定性感知的推理。

title: Offline AI Modules: Voice-First Offline Architecture, Hardware Reference Stack, Quantization and Benchmarking
summary: The Offline AI Modules workstream enables practical, low-power, and community-accessible deployment of voice-first AI systems that operate fully offline. Designed for African language communities where speech is the dominant mode of interaction and internet connectivity is unreliable or absent, the workstream delivers three reinforcing components: a modular voice-first offline architecture, a low-cost hardware reference bill of materials, and a reproducible quantization and a reproducible quantization and benchmarking pipeline for instruction-tuned language models in the 2-5B parameter class. This paper presents the first end-to-end benchmark evaluation of the stack across two hardware tiers: an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) and a Raspberry Pi5 (TierA). Three instruction-tuned models are evaluated across four quantization formats, assessed for deployment metrics (decode throughput, chat latency, memory, power) and multilingual quality (topic classification accuracy on MasakhaNEWS across English, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba; per-language perplexity drift). Speech recognition is evaluated using Ethio-ASR on Amharic and Oromo across both tiers. The principal finding is that Q4_K_M quantization represents the best size-to-quality trade-off for deployment on both tiers: gemma-4-E2B-it achieves 28.8t/s decode throughput and 89.2% topic classification accuracy at Q4_K_M on TierB, while all three models run within the 16GB memory budget on TierA.

AI.tldr: 该论文对面向非洲语言社区的离线语音优先AI系统进行端到端基准评测，覆盖两种硬件层级、三种小规模指令模型与四种量化格式，结论是Q4_K_M在体积与质量间权衡最佳。
AI.motivation: 非洲语言社区以语音为主要交互方式，且网络连接不可靠或缺失，因此需要低功耗、社区可及的完全离线语音AI方案。
AI.method: 该工作流提供三个组件：模块化语音优先离线架构、低成本硬件参考物料清单、针对2-5B参数指令微调模型的可复现量化与基准测试流程。评测在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX（TierB）与Raspberry Pi 5（TierA）上进行，评估三种指令微调模型、四种量化格式，指标含解码吞吐、对话延迟、内存、功耗；多语言质量采用MasakhaNEWS主题分类准确率（英语、豪萨语、伊博语、尼日利亚皮钦语、约鲁巴语）及每语言困惑度漂移；语音识别用Ethio-ASR评估阿姆哈拉语和奥罗莫语。
AI.result: Q4_K_M量化在两个硬件层级上均体现最佳体积-质量权衡；TierB上gemma-4-E2B-it以Q4_K_M达到28.8t/s解码吞吐和89.2%主题分类准确率；三个模型在TierA上均运行于16GB内存预算内。
AI.conclusion: Q4_K_M可作为该离线语音优先AI栈的推荐量化格式，支持在低成本硬件上实现可实用的多语言离线部署。

title: On Color Alignment in VAE Latent Spaces and Its Applications
summary: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are a key part of modern text-to-image models, which generate images within their latent space. VAEs are known to disentangle the main factors of variation in the data, and color is known to be one of the most structured of these in natural images: decorrelating it yields one luminance axis and two opponent-color axes. Color should therefore be expected to emerge as a distinct factor in the VAE latent space. Yet how these latent spaces represent color remains largely unexplored. In this work, we show that the VAEs of text-to-image models share a color subspace aligned with brightness and opponent-colors. Through a linear approximation of the encoder and targeted latent steering, we find this subspace consistently across a broad range of VAEs, from SD1.5 to FLUX.2 and Z-Image. Building on this characterization, we propose three applications: ColorTuning, which achieves state-of-the-art in precise numerical color generation on the fine-grained CSS3/X11 system of GenColorBench, saturation control, to adjust the global chromatic intensity, and color transfer, to change the palette to match a reference. The code and models are publicly available at https://julian075.github.io/Color_Subspace/

AI.tldr: 本文发现主流文生图模型的VAE隐空间中都存在一个与亮度及对立色轴对齐的"颜色子空间"，并通过线性近似编码器与定向隐空间操控验证了该子空间在SD1.5至FLUX.2、Z-Image等广泛模型中的一致性，进而提出ColorTuning、饱和度控制与颜色迁移三项应用。
AI.motivation: VAE是文生图模型的关键组件，其隐空间被认为能解耦数据的主要变化因子，而颜色在自然图像中是最具结构性的因子之一（解耦后呈现一个亮度轴与两个对立色轴）。然而，现有研究对VAE隐空间如何表征颜色这一问题几乎没有探索。
AI.method: 通过对编码器进行线性近似并结合定向隐空间操控（targeted latent steering），在多种VAE中定位并刻画颜色子空间。基于此表征，作者提出三种应用：ColorTuning（精确数值颜色生成）、饱和度控制（调整全局色彩强度）以及颜色迁移（匹配参考图像调色板）。
AI.result: 在从SD1.5到FLUX.2、Z-Image的广泛VAE范围内一致地发现了与亮度及对立色对齐的颜色子空间；ColorTuning在GenColorBench的细粒度CSS3/X11颜色体系上取得了精确数值颜色生成的当前最优表现。代码与模型已公开。
AI.conclusion: 文生图VAE隐空间存在普遍且结构化的颜色子空间，可被线性刻画与定向操控，为精确颜色控制、饱和度调节和颜色迁移等下游应用提供了统一且有效的机制。

title: A Data-Driven Framework for Unsupervised Monitoring of Transmission Systems Using End-of-Line Testing Data: A Case Study at Ford Motor Company
summary: Sensing technologies have advanced rapidly across industries ranging from energy to automotive manufacturing. These systems generate high-dimensional (HD) data characterized by complex nonlinear patterns and strong temporal dependencies. Traditional statistical monitoring methods are often limited in their ability to capture such nonlinear structure. Likewise, many analytical approaches used in End-of-Line testing rely on predefined thresholds and heuristic rules, which restrict their ability to detect informative anomaly signatures in HD temporal data. In contrast, while modern deep learning and generative AI models offer strong predictive capabilities, they are often unsuitable in applications where data are costly to collect and where the monitoring system must remain interpretable, low-latency, computationally efficient, and usable by non-technical practitioners. To overcome these limitations, we propose an advanced multivariate monitoring framework for HD data. The framework operates in two stages. In the first stage, the data are preprocessed to remove incomplete and non-informative samples and to temporally align time series data. In the second stage, nonlinear dimensionality reduction is performed, followed by anomaly detection through a control chart based phase I monitoring procedure. The framework can be used in both unsupervised and supervised settings, depending on the availability of ground truth labels during training. Moreover, its flexible and modular structure allows practitioners to adapt its components to different domains and operational requirements. We evaluate the proposed framework on real production data from an automotive manufacturing environment at Ford Motor Company. The proposed method achieves higher accuracy, recall, and F1 score than the company's existing model, improving these metrics from 0.50, 0.30, and 0.429 to 0.625, 1.00, and 0.769, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段高维多元监测框架，通过非线性降维与控制图相位I监测实现异常检测，在福特汽车制造真实数据上优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 传感技术快速发展产生高维、非线性、强时间依赖的数据，传统统计监测难以捕捉非线性结构，产线末端测试依赖预定义阈值与启发式规则，难以发现信息性异常特征；而深度学习与生成式AI虽预测强，但在数据采集昂贵且需可解释、低延迟、计算高效、非技术人员可用的场景下并不适用。
AI.method: 提出两阶段多元监测框架：第一阶段预处理，剔除不完整与非信息样本并对时间序列进行时间对齐；第二阶段进行非线性降维，再通过控制图相位I监测流程进行异常检测。框架支持无监督与有监督两种设置（取决于训练时是否有真实标签），且模块化结构便于跨领域适配。
AI.result: 在福特汽车公司真实生产数据上评估，准确率、召回率与F1分别从现有模型的0.50、0.30、0.429提升至0.625、1.00、0.769。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在保持可解释、低延迟与计算高效的前提下，有效提升高维时序数据异常检测性能，具备良好的灵活性与跨领域应用潜力。

title: JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

AI.tldr: 提出JIVEAdapter，一种受JIVE启发的加法式多任务低秩适配器，将权重更新分解为跨任务共享的Joint结构与任务特有的Individual结构，并将二者池化以自适应分配秩。
AI.motivation: 多数低秩适配器是单任务的，并以乘法方式表示权重更新，无法显式区分跨任务共享信息与任务特定信息。作者希望借鉴统计中的Joint and Individual Variation Explained思想，使共享与任务特有信号可分离、可解释，并能将共享部分冻结后复用。
AI.method: JIVEAdapter将每个权重更新分解为所有任务共享的Joint结构加每任务独立的Individual结构；对Individual施加近正交于Joint的惩罚以保持信号分离；在共享Joint池和任务Individual池之间自适应分配秩。Joint可一次性联合学习，也可按任务增量学习，之后冻结并作为新任务的先验，无需重训共享部分。
AI.result: 在GLUE和SuperGLUE上使用DeBERTaV3-base，在每任务等效秩匹配的条件下，JIVEAdapter与强单任务及多任务低秩基线相当，且无需MoE等额外模块。当存在相关已见任务时，冻结的Joint可通过复用该任务的Individual（仅需廉价的逐方向缩放）服务留出任务，否则训练一个小的新Individual。
AI.conclusion: JIVEAdapter通过可加性Joint-Individual分解实现了可解释、可复用的多任务参数高效微调，在匹配有效秩下达到有竞争力性能，并支持共享部分的冻结与任务间迁移。

title: Graph-Based Recognition of Simulated Train-Driver States From Facial and Upper-Body Keypoints
summary: Driver fatigue poses a significant challenge to railway safety, with traditional systems like the dead-man switch offering limited and basic alertness checks. This study presents a vision-based monitoring system that relies solely on a single front-facing RGB camera and a graph neural network to classify simulated train-driver states into alert, not-alert, and an emergency class comprising acted emergency-like behaviours. To optimize input representations for the model, an ablation study was performed, comparing three feature configurations: skeletal-only, facial-only, and a combination of both. Experimental results show that combining facial and skeletal features yields the highest accuracy (81%) for the three-class model under the light condition, outperforming models that use only facial or skeletal features. Furthermore, the combination of facial and skeletal features achieves 99% accuracy in the alert/not alert classification in light condition. Additionally, we introduced a controlled RGB video dataset containing alert, not alert, and acted emergency-like behaviours recorded under three illumination conditions. These contributions represent a step toward passive and non-contact train-driver state recognition based on facial and upper-body dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出仅用单个前置RGB摄像头与图神经网络识别列车司机疲劳状态（警觉、非警觉、紧急行为）的系统，并构建了三种光照条件下的受控视频数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统列车安全监测手段（如死亡开关）对司机警觉性的检查有限且基础，需要一种被动、非接触的司机状态识别方案。
AI.method: 基于单前置RGB摄像头采集视频，使用图神经网络进行状态分类；通过消融实验比较三种特征配置：仅骨骼、仅面部、面部与骨骼结合；并采集含警觉、非警觉及模拟紧急行为、覆盖三种光照条件的受控RGB视频数据集。
AI.result: 面部与骨骼特征结合在光照条件下三分类准确率最高（81%），优于单一特征模型；该组合在警觉/非警觉二分类中光照条件下达到99%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 面部与上部身体动态相结合可有效支持被动、非接触的列车司机状态识别，为相关监测系统提供了数据集与方法基础。

title: An Information-Theoretic Evaluation Framework for Benchmark and Model Diagnosis in Knowledge Tracing
summary: Knowledge tracing (KT) models are predominantly evaluated using aggregate metrics such as area under the curve (AUC) and accuracy. However, these global scores obscure where the remaining errors originate and fail to indicate whether a benchmark is approaching saturation. While estimating a global theoretical performance limit is challenging in realistic KT settings, it is possible to quantify local predictability. To address this, we propose an information-theoretic evaluation framework for KT benchmark diagnosis. We use Context Tree Weighting (CTW) on item-response histories and current-item queries as an operational causal uncertainty coordinate, while distinguishing it from the unobserved Local Irreducible Uncertainty (LIU) under the full KT information set. By projecting predictions onto this shared uncertainty coordinate, we evaluate model performance gains across distinct entropy bands rather than only at the global level. Comprehensive evaluations on NIPS Task 3/4 and Algebra 2005 reveal that model improvements are highly non-uniform. Modern KT models show substantial gains in high-entropy regions, and additional item-aware references, log-loss, and equal-frequency analyses support this localization. The framework also flags regions where apparent gains require checks for noise-sensitive behavior. By surfacing these local modeling failures alongside genuine gains, this approach provides a diagnostic tool for studying both residual predictive structure and the limitations of current KT benchmarks and models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于信息论的KT评测框架，用CTW构建可操作的不确定性坐标，分熵带评估模型表现，从而揭示全局指标掩盖的局部建模差异与基准饱和问题。
AI.motivation: 现有知识追踪（KT）模型多以AUC、准确率等聚合指标评估，这类全局分数掩盖了剩余误差的来源，也无法判断基准是否接近饱和。在真实KT场景中估计全局理论性能上限很困难，但局部可预测性是可以量化的，因此需要一个能刻画局部可预测性并诊断基准的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出信息论评估框架：在项目-作答历史和当前项目查询上使用Context Tree Weighting (CTW)，将其作为可操作的因果不确定性坐标，并与全KT信息集下不可观测的Local Irreducible Uncertainty (LIU)相区分。将模型预测投影到该共享不确定性坐标上，按不同熵带而非仅全局层面评估性能增益；并辅以item-aware参考、log-loss和等频分析来支持这种局部化诊断。
AI.result: 在NIPS Task 3/4和Algebra 2005上的综合评估显示，模型改进高度非均匀：现代KT模型在高熵区域获得显著增益。额外的item-aware参考、log-loss与等频分析支持这种局部化结论。框架还能标记出看似有增益但需检查噪声敏感行为的区域。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过同时呈现局部建模失败与真实增益，为研究残余预测结构以及当前KT基准与模型的局限性提供了诊断工具。

title: Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models
summary: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出两种闭式投影算子,在推理时对AF3类共折叠模型的$\hat{x}_0$施加物理约束,无需重训练即可恢复物理有效性。
AI.motivation: AF3类共折叠模型虽结构精度高,但输出常物理无效:界面链重叠、配体键长键角畸变、环非平面、手性反转。现有方法或用物理势引导采样(成本高、内存大,大复合物无法推理),或微调模型(耗时且绑定单一架构)。作者观察到物理有效性可在推理时从采样器已有的量中完全验证,故将其视为约束推理问题。
AI.method: 在扩散模型的去噪干净坐标估计$\hat{x}_0$上应用两个闭式投影算子:(1)链间范德华投影,推开最严重的原子对冲突;(2)配体距离几何投影,恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性与手性。两算子均为局部、稀疏、位移受限,无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样,且不改动去噪器及其权重,可直接嵌入任意AF3风格采样器。
AI.result: 在两个独立开发的模型Boltz-2与OpenFold-3上,于五个基准(CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters单体与复合物集、Boltz物理有效性测试集)评估,方法恢复完美物理有效性,同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标,运行时与内存开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为模型无关的实用途径,可在不重训练、几乎无额外开销的情况下实现物理有效的全原子结构预测。

title: A Data-Centric Review of Plant Disease Datasets: Taxonomy, Critical Analysis, Environmental Variability, and Implications for Precision Agriculture
summary: Despite rapid advances in artificial intelligence, reliable real-world plant disease detection remains a persistent challenge. Visual and deep learning approaches have shown promising results, but their deployment under field conditions remains limited. A key bottleneck is the reliance on laboratory-generated datasets that lack environmental diversity, realistic backgrounds, and balanced class distributions, resulting in poor generalization. In contrast, datasets collected directly from agricultural environments capture natural variability and better reflect challenges faced by farmers across regions. This review presents a critical analysis of visual and deep learning approaches for plant disease detection, with emphasis on plant disease datasets. It establishes a taxonomy based on acquisition setting, accessibility, plant diversity, disease composition, class structure, and imbalance severity, and examines their implications for model generalization and real-world deployment. A comparative analysis of laboratory and real-field datasets identifies critical gaps that hinder disease detection. The review further analyzes how multi-level dataset imbalance, including intra-class, inter-crop, and cross-dataset imbalance, and limited environmental variability affect model performance and robustness, an area insufficiently examined in existing surveys. Beyond image-based approaches, it highlights the importance of integrating environmental parameters such as temperature, humidity, and leaf wetness with image data to improve prediction under dynamic field conditions. Finally, the review identifies key challenges, research gaps, and future directions concerning dataset construction, environmental variability, structural imbalance, standardization, and multimodal disease monitoring. It provides a foundation for developing next-generation multimodal frameworks for precision agriculture.

AI.tldr: 本综述聚焦植物病害检测中数据集瓶颈，建立分类体系，比较实验室与真实田间数据集的差距，分析多层不平衡与环境变异对模型泛化的影响，并倡导融合环境参数的多模态监测框架。
AI.motivation: 尽管人工智能与深度学习在植物病害检测上进展迅速，但真实田间部署仍受限。核心瓶颈在于依赖实验室生成的数据集，缺乏环境多样性、真实背景和均衡的类别分布，导致泛化能力差。而直接从农业环境采集的数据集更能反映自然变异与农民实际面临的挑战。
AI.method: 对视觉与深度学习方法进行批判性分析，重点关注植物病害数据集。建立基于采集环境、可获取性、植物多样性、病害组成、类别结构和失衡严重程度的分类体系，并考察其对模型泛化与部署的影响；对实验室与真实田间数据集进行比较分析；进一步分析多层数据集不平衡（类内、作物间、跨数据集）及有限环境变异性的作用；同时探讨将温度、湿度、叶面湿度等环境参数与图像数据融合的方法。
AI.result: 识别出实验室与真实田间数据集之间的关键差距，这些差距阻碍病害检测；揭示多层不平衡与环境变异性不足对模型性能和鲁棒性的显著影响，而这一方面在既有综述中研究不足；表明融合环境参数与图像数据可提升动态田间条件下的预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 指出数据集构建、环境变异性、结构性失衡、标准化及多模态病害监测等关键挑战、研究空白与未来方向，为精准农业的下一代多模态框架奠定基础。

title: Repair Lot Skyline: A Weighted Constraint Satisfaction Approach to Pavement Repair Optimization from Geospatial Hazard Density
summary: Pavement agencies must translate a spatially distributed distress inventory into a bounded, actionable repair-lot plan: accident-critical defects (potholes) must always be addressed, lower-risk defects (cracks) should be included only when their benefit justifies the repair cost, and historical patch locations signal re-degradation risk without themselves triggering repair. We formalize this as a Repair Lot Skyline problem: a Weighted Constraint Satisfaction Problem (WCSP) defined over chainage (distance along the road) rather than over time, so that it requires only a single-epoch distress survey and makes no claim about future deterioration. The WCSP identifies 143 candidate hazard clusters (61 hard, 82 soft), of which 106 are merged into a final repair plan totaling 1,997.4 m---83.7% of the 2,385.9 m that would be required if every soft candidate were included regardless of cost. This plan covers 100% of observed potholes (138/138) and 91.6% of observed cracks (404/441), capturing 93.6% (542/579) of the total hazard benefit available in the full candidate set. The skyline frontier shows pronounced diminishing returns beyond this point: the remaining 37 excluded soft candidates would add only 6.8% additional benefit for a 19.4% increase in repair length. We further formalize the minimum-lot-length $L_{\min}$ and historical-context radius $κ$ as a joint, four-objective hyperparameter search over this WCSP; on the same case study, the recommended configuration ($L_{\min} = 14.7$ m, $κ= 10$ m) reduces repair-crew mobilizations by 7.1% relative to an untuned default, at the cost of a 12.9% larger budget and a 1.1-percentage-point lower crack coverage.

AI.tldr: 将路面病害清单转化为修复批次计划的问题被形式化为"Repair Lot Skyline"（加权约束满足问题），在链age上定义，仅需单期病害调查。案例中选出143个候选隐患簇（61硬约束、82软约束），最终合并106个、总长1997.4米，覆盖100%坑洞与91.6%裂缝，占全部收益93.6%；并联合搜索最小批次长度L_min与历史背景半径κ。
AI.motivation: 路面管理机构需要把空间分布的病害清单转化为有界、可执行的修复批次计划：事故关键缺陷（坑洞）必须修复，较低风险缺陷（裂缝）仅在收益能证明成本合理时纳入，而历史修补位置仅作为再退化风险信号、不直接触发修复。现有方法缺乏对这类"硬约束必选、软约束可选、链age连续空间"决策的形式化。
AI.method: 提出Repair Lot Skyline问题：在链age（沿路距离）而非时间上定义的加权约束满足问题（WCSP），仅需单期病害调查，不对未来退化作假设。将坑洞设为硬约束、裂缝设为软约束、历史修补作为背景信号；在案例研究中识别143个候选隐患簇（61硬、82软）。进一步将最小批次长度L_min与历史背景半径κ形式化为联合的四目标超参数搜索。
AI.result: 最终计划合并106个候选簇，总长1997.4米，为全软约束纳入所需2385.9米的83.7%；覆盖100%坑洞（138/138）与91.6%裂缝（404/441），获得全部收益的93.6%（542/579）。剩余37个被排除的软约束仅增加6.8%收益却需增加19.4%长度，呈现明显递减收益。推荐配置L_min=14.7米、κ=10米，相比未调优默认值减少7.1%的修复班组出动次数，代价是预算增加12.9%、裂缝覆盖率下降1.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将路面修复批次规划形式化为链age上的WCSP，并提供可量化的效益-成本天际线取舍；通过对L_min与κ的联合四目标调优，可在出动次数、预算与覆盖率之间实现可解释的折中，支持仅基于单期调查的实用修复决策。

title: CuratorMAS: Automating Dataset Curation via Multi-Agent Orchestration
summary: High-quality datasets are essential for reliable machine learning, but dataset curation remains costly and hard to generalize across domains. Existing methods typically rely on manually designed heuristics or model-dependent signals, limiting their applicability across tasks and user queries. To address these limitations and automate data curation, we propose \textbf{CuratorMAS}, a multi-agent collaboration framework that orchestrates agents to evaluate and curate high-quality datasets. To achieve the goal of flexible curation, CuratorMAS decomposes the complex curation process into five programmable execution stages and forms a parallelizable workflow. Specifically, CuratorMAS first performs dataset exploration to collect contextual information such as file structures and constraint cues, thereby developing a comprehensive understanding of the given task. In order to acquire up-to-date information, CuratorMAS retrieves domain knowledge from online sources to augment the evaluation process. Next, CuratorMAS derives the necessary evaluation criteria and computes the corresponding metrics. Based on these results, CuratorMAS executes filtering accordingly. Finally, an evolution module summarizes the evaluation outcomes and updates the relevant skills. Extensive and comprehensive experiments demonstrate that CuratorMAS significantly reduces the noise rate by up to 36.03 percentage points (pp) while also improving the F1 score of downstream models by up to 8.88 pp.

AI.tldr: 提出 CuratorMAS，一个多智能体协作框架，通过五个可编程阶段实现数据集自动化评估与筛选，显著降低噪声率并提升下游模型 F1。
AI.motivation: 高质量数据集是可靠机器学习的基础，但数据策管成本高、跨领域泛化难。现有方法依赖人工设计的启发式规则或特定模型信号，难以适应不同任务和用户查询。
AI.method: CuratorMAS 将数据策管过程分解为五个可编程执行阶段并组成可并行工作流：数据集探索（收集文件结构、约束线索等上下文）、在线检索领域知识以增强评估、推导评估标准并计算指标、据此执行过滤、最后由演化模块总结结果并更新相关技能。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，CuratorMAS 将噪声率最多降低 36.03 个百分点，同时使下游模型 F1 分数最多提升 8.88 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体协作框架能有效自动化数据策管，兼顾灵活性与效果，在降噪与提升下游任务性能方面均取得显著收益。

title: MoonGS: High-quality Representation of the Lunar Surface via Gaussian Splatting Using Robust Depth Features from Image Pairs
summary: High-quality 3D reconstruction of lunar terrain from sparse rover images is indispensable for autonomous lunar exploration, but remains challenging because viewpoint overlap is insufficient, surface textures are weak, and data volume is limited. We propose MoonGS, the first feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework tailored to lunar scenes. Given only two input images, MoonGS predicts pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives in a single forward pass and renders photorealistic novel views without any per-scene optimization. MoonGS (i) adopts an adaptable backbone design that seamlessly integrates advanced vision foundation models to extract robust depth features; (ii) integrates semantic priors in two manners: merging semantic cues with visual features to refine Gaussian parameter estimation, and adopting a semantic ranking loss that regularizes background depth; and (iii) employs an entropy-guided heuristic resampling strategy to augment sparse observations by selecting the most informative distant viewpoints with negligible overhead. Experiments on the LuSNAR benchmark and our synthetic weak-texture MoonBlender dataset show that MoonGS surpasses state-of-the-art feed-forward NeRF/3DGS baselines by +4.9 dB PSNR, +0.29 SSIM, and 40\% lower LPIPS while maintaining sub-second inference. Furthermore, we validate the broad applicability of our framework by demonstrating that it effectively leverages state-of-the-art backbones, including VGGT, to significantly boost performance. Qualitative evaluations on Chang'e mission imagery also show the best visual quality among compared methods, indicating robustness on real lunar data. The source code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/InRobots/MoonBlender.

AI.tldr: 提出前馈式3D高斯泼溅框架MoonGS，仅用两张图像即可实现高质量月面三维重建，无需逐场景优化。
AI.motivation: 月球探测中稀疏巡视器图像的三维重建面临视角重叠不足、表面纹理弱、数据量有限等困难，传统方法难以实现高质量重建。
AI.method: MoonGS采用前馈架构，单次前向预测像素对齐的高斯基元；设计可适配骨干网络集成视觉基础模型提取深度特征；融合语义先验（语义与视觉特征合并改进高斯参数估计、语义排序损失正则化背景深度）；使用熵引导启发式重采样策略增强稀疏观测。
AI.result: 在LuSNAR基准和自建MoonBlender数据集上超越SOTA前馈NeRF/3DGS基线，PSNR提升+4.9 dB、SSIM提升+0.29、LPIPS降低40%，推理保持亚秒级；能有效利用VGGT等先进骨干提升性能；在真实月球数据上视觉质量最优。
AI.conclusion: MoonGS是首个面向月球场景的前馈3DGS框架，在合成与真实月球数据上均表现优异，代码和数据集已开源。

title: DART-ES: Difficulty-Aware Reweighting and Targeted Replay for Fine-Tuning LLMs with Evolution Strategies
summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) enable memory efficient full parameter fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) using only forward computation. However, standard ES uniformly averages rewards across problems and compresses problem level population feedback into a single scalar, making it difficult to capture how the learning value of each problem changes with model capability. To address this limitation, we propose Difficulty-Aware Reweighting and Targeted Replay for Evolution Strategies (DART-ES). DART-ES estimates the local solvability of each problem from its pass rate across the perturbation population and aggregates historical observations to construct a dynamic difficulty state. This shared state jointly guides continuous difficulty reweighting and rare solvable sample replay, thereby improving perturbation direction evaluation and training data allocation without introducing an additional difficulty model or backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that DART-ES achieves good fine-tuning performance. DART-ES outperforms ES on all five base models and improves the average accuracy from 72.07\% to 73.53\%, exceeding the 73.26\% achieved by GRPO on GSM8K. Across five challenging mathematical reasoning benchmarks, DART-ES achieves an average accuracy of 49.20\%, compared with 48.34\% for ES and remains competitive with strong 7B models trained with RL. Further experiments show consistent gains in instruction tuning, code generation and the Countdown task with a 14B model, demonstrating strong generalization across tasks and scalability to larger models. Beyond performance gains, DART-ES also shows clear advantages in system efficiency. It reduces runtime per step by 15.2\%--50.2\% and peak memory usage per GPU by 21.1\%--51.1\% compared with GRPO. Despite performing full parameter fine-tuning, DART-ES also requires less runtime and GPU memory than GRPO+LoRA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DART-ES，通过基于通过率的动态难度状态联合指导难度重加权与稀有可解样本回放，在无需额外难度模型和反向传播的前提下改进进化策略微调性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 标准进化策略在所有问题上统一平均奖励，并将问题级种群反馈压缩为单一标量，难以刻画每个问题的学习价值随模型能力变化的情况，限制了微调效果。
AI.method: DART-ES从扰动种群的通过率估计每个问题的局部可解性，并聚合历史观测构建动态难度状态；该共享状态同时用于连续难度重加权和稀有可解样本回放，从而改进扰动方向评估与训练数据分配，且不引入额外难度模型或反向传播。
AI.result: DART-ES在五个基础模型上均优于ES，平均准确率从72.07%提升至73.53%，超过GRPO在GSM8K上的73.26%；在五个数学推理基准上平均准确率为49.20%，优于ES的48.34%，并与强RL训练的7B模型相当。指令微调、代码生成和Countdown任务上均有稳定增益。效率方面，每步运行时间降低15.2%–50.2%，每GPU峰值内存降低21.1%–51.1%，且比GRPO+LoRA更省时省显存。
AI.conclusion: DART-ES通过动态难度感知重加权与稀有可解样本回放，在不增加难度模型和反向传播的情况下提升了ES微调的性能、泛化性与系统效率。

title: Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads
summary: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向生产的内容抽取系统，将内容抽取确立为生成式AI生命周期中的独立阶段，通过选择性OCR路由、基于参考的抽取评分器、结构感知分块器和只读检索评估器，实现可配置、可度量的抽取流程，并总结出三条设计原则。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI将模型与单一任务解耦，一个基础模型可服务开放的下游任务，但数据侧异构性剧增：企业知识以PDF、演示文稿、表格、扫描件、混合排版等格式存在，同时承载文本、视觉、几何和结构信息。若在此接口处信息被错误表示，语言模型或检索器无法可靠推理，且下游检索器或重排器无法修复此类错误。因此内容抽取需要成为独立的生命周期阶段。
AI.method: 系统包含四个组件：选择性OCR路由；以稀缺性优先的策展引擎，配合基于参考的抽取评分器（衡量字符、词和表格结构准确率）；确定性结构感知的父子分块器；只读检索评估器，从每一页生成有依据的问题并报告Hit@k、平均倒数排名和延迟。
AI.result: 在180篇文档语料上，最佳抽取器得分为97.4/100（字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995）；分块器在25,050个生成问题上达到hit@1为68.6%、hit@10为92.8%、MRR为0.77。
AI.conclusion: 论文提炼出三条设计原则：结构先于语义、绝不改变你所度量的对象、预算化使用标签；并将可度量的内容抽取定位为企业智能体系统的感知层。

title: R2RI: A Multi-View Event and RGB Dataset for Robot-to-Robot Interaction
summary: Understanding and modeling interactions between autonomous agents is a fundamental challenge in robotics, with broad implications for collaborative systems, social robotics, and human-robot coexistence. Although the study of robot interactions has emerged as a compelling research direction, progress has been severely hampered by the absence of large-scale benchmarks. In this paper, we introduce Robot-to-Robot Interaction (R2RI), the first dataset specifically designed to address the Robot-Robot Interaction (RRI) task. R2RI consists of different humanoid robots and realistic interactions modeled on real human social behaviors. Complementary viewpoints are available, \textit{i.e.}, an egocentric perspective from each robot's onboard sensors, and an exocentric perspective from external fixed cameras, thus enabling rich spatial and contextual understanding of the interaction dynamics. The dataset comprises more than $6.5$M frames and $\approx5000$ videos at $120$ fps, including Event and RGB domains. We investigate pros and cons of each domain, comparing state-of-the-art approaches for a number of key sensing and interaction based tasks. We publicly release the dataset and its annotations for all tasks and modalities at https://github.com/MagriniGabriele/R2RI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个专门针对机器人-机器人交互（RRI）任务的数据集 R2RI，包含超过650万帧、约5000段120fps视频，涵盖自我中心与外部中心视角以及Event和RGB两种模态。
AI.motivation: 理解和建模自主智能体之间的交互是机器人学中的基础性挑战，对协作系统、社交机器人和人机共存具有重要意义。然而，机器人交互研究虽已成为热门方向，却因缺乏大规模基准数据集而进展严重受阻。
AI.method: 构建了R2RI数据集，包含多种人形机器人和基于真实人类社交行为建模的交互。数据集提供互补视角：每个机器人机载传感器的自我中心视角和外部固定相机的外部中心视角，从而实现丰富的空间与上下文理解。数据包含Event和RGB两种域，超过650万帧、约5000段120fps视频。
AI.result: 研究了各域的优势与不足，并针对多个关键感知和交互任务比较了最先进方法。数据集及其所有任务和模态的标注已在GitHub上公开。
AI.conclusion: R2RI作为首个面向机器人-机器人交互任务的数据集，填补了该领域大规模基准的空白，为RRI研究提供了重要资源，并已公开数据集与标注。

title: Mask-Guided KV Cache Eviction in Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: Block diffusion language models keep a large key-value (KV) cache throughout generation and attend to it at every denoising step, limiting both memory capacity and generation speed. Reducing these costs requires deciding which past tokens to use for denoising the current block (selection) and which to keep in memory for future blocks (eviction). We propose MaskAhead, a training-free method that solves both tasks with a single mask-query-based ranking mechanism. Current-block masks guide selection, while probes of upcoming masked blocks guide eviction. Both rank KV entries by their estimated contribution to the attention output. Our quantized variant, Q-MaskAhead, computes selection and attention directly from low-bit KV, largely preserving the selected entries. Experiments on Fast-dLLM-v2, DreamReasoner, and LLaDA2.0-mini cover long-generation reasoning, long-prompt question answering, and needle-in-a-haystack retrieval. On long-prompt QA, MaskAhead reduces KV memory by $9.5\times$ on average with a 1.2-point mean F1 loss relative to dense inference. Q-MaskAhead increases the reduction to $20.1\times$ with a 2.3-point mean F1 loss. In a batch-32 systems profile, MaskAhead achieves $1.23\times$ end-to-end and $1.68\times$ decode-stage speedups over dense inference.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法 MaskAhead，用单一 mask-query 排序机制同时解决块扩散语言模型的 KV 选择与驱逐，并给出量化变体 Q-MaskAhead，在多项任务上实现显著内存压缩与加速。
AI.motivation: 块扩散语言模型在生成过程中保留大体积 KV 缓存并在每步去噪时全量注意力，导致内存容量和生成速度受限。要降低成本，需同时决定当前块去噪使用哪些历史 token（选择）以及哪些保留在内存供后续块使用（驱逐）。
AI.method: MaskAhead 是免训练方法，用统一的基于 mask-query 的排序机制同时完成两项任务：当前块 mask 指导选择，对即将到来的掩码块的 probe 指导驱逐；两者都以 KV 条目对注意力输出的估计贡献进行排序。量化变体 Q-MaskAhead 直接从低比特 KV 计算选择与注意力，基本保留所选条目。
AI.result: 在 Fast-dLLM-v2、DreamReasoner、LLaDA2.0-mini 上覆盖长生成推理、长提示问答与大海捞针检索。长提示问答中，MaskAhead 平均减少 KV 内存 9.5 倍，相对稠密推理平均 F1 损失 1.2 点；Q-MaskAhead 压缩达 20.1 倍，平均 F1 损失 2.3 点。batch-32 系统测试中，MaskAhead 取得 1.23 倍端到端和 1.68 倍解码阶段加速。
AI.conclusion: MaskAhead 以统一排序机制同时实现 KV 选择与驱逐，无需训练；并可扩展为低比特量化版本，在保持任务性能的同时大幅降低 KV 内存并提升生成速度。

title: Small Language Models for Smart Data Model Classification at the Edge: A Cost-Aware Hybrid Approach
summary: The rapid proliferation of heterogeneous data sources within the Internet of Things (IoT) across domains such as smart cities, energy management, and environmental monitoring necessitates efficient and scalable data standardization methods. Effective classification of smart data models (SDMs) is essential for facilitating interoperability. However, existing approaches are often limited by high resource consumption and lack applicability in edge environments with constrained computational capabilities. Aiming to bridge this gap, the proposed study evaluates the performance of lightweight open-source language models (LMs) to resolve an input data entity against its corresponding best fitting SDM representation under resource-constrained conditions. It systematically benchmarks a diverse array of models, including general purpose (GP), reasoning-specialized (RS), and code-specialized (CS) architectures, across multiple domain-specific datasets. Addressing the current omission of lightweight, resource-efficient solutions in the literature, the investigation provides significant and valuable insights into model selection, task formulation, and deployment strategies that optimize accuracy and efficiency. A complementary experiment also compares the surveyed large language models (LLMs) against two near-zero-cost similarity baselines (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and a lightweight sentence encoder) on the same task, providing a strong reference point for interpreting the practical value of LLM-based classification on edge platforms.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估轻量级开源语言模型在资源受限环境下将IoT数据实体分类到最匹配的智能数据模型（SDM）的性能，并对比近零成本相似度基线。
AI.motivation: IoT异构数据源快速扩张，跨智慧城市、能源管理等领域的智能数据模型（SDM）分类对互操作性至关重要。但现有方法资源消耗高，难以适用于计算能力受限的边缘环境，且文献中缺乏轻量、资源高效的解决方案。
AI.method: 系统性地基准测试多种轻量级开源语言模型，涵盖通用型（GP）、推理专用型（RS）和代码专用型（CS）架构，在多个领域特定数据集上评估其将输入数据实体解析为最匹配SDM表示的性能；并补充实验，在同一任务上将所调查的大语言模型（LLM）与两种近零成本相似度基线（TF-IDF和轻量级句子编码器）进行对比。
AI.result: 提供了关于模型选择、任务构建和部署策略的显著且有价值的见解，可在准确率与效率之间取得优化；基线的对比结果为解读边缘平台上LLM分类的实际价值提供了有力参考。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了轻量、资源高效SDM分类方案的文献空白，为在资源受限的边缘环境中进行SDM分类的模型选择、任务构建与部署策略提供了指导。

title: PlaySuite: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Interactive Visual Intelligence
summary: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models yield strong performance on static perception and reasoning benchmarks, yet such evaluations largely overlook a central aspect of intelligence: acting competently in dynamic environments over extended time horizons. We introduce PlaySuite, a large-scale benchmark for evaluating interactive visual intelligence across more than 5K open-source video games curated from PyWeek and itch.io. Spanning diverse genres and engines, including Pygame, HTML5, Godot, and Unity, these independent games are largely out-of-distribution for current models, reducing the likelihood that success can be achieved by retrieving memorized walkthroughs or web-scale training artifacts. To enable scalable evaluation across heterogeneous titles, we develop a unified closed-loop interaction framework optimized for HPC clusters alongside a Video-LLM-as-a-judge protocol that maps observable gameplay milestones to standardized progress levels. We evaluate fourteen recent open models spanning vision-language models, computer-use agents, and vision-language-action models. Our results yield strong evidence of a perception-action gap: despite strong reasoning capabilities, current models struggle to make sustained progress and exhibit recurring failures in spatial grounding, action execution, and self-correction. PlaySuite provides a reproducible and extensible testbed for measuring progress from visual perception to goal-directed interaction, and a foundation for developing models that can act, adapt, and generalize in dynamic visual environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 PlaySuite，一个基于 5K+ 开源视频游戏的大规模交互式视觉智能基准，用于评估模型在动态环境中的长时间交互能力，并揭示了当前模型的"感知-行动鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态基础模型虽在静态感知与推理基准上表现优异，但这类评估忽视了智能的核心方面——在动态环境中长时间地胜任行动。当前模型多为在分布内任务上表现良好，容易依赖记忆中的攻略或网络训练数据，缺乏对真实交互能力的衡量。因此需要一个能减少数据泄漏、跨异构游戏环境、可扩展的交互式评估基准。
AI.method: 研究构建了 PlaySuite 基准，涵盖来自 PyWeek 和 itch.io 的 5K+ 开源视频游戏，跨多种类型和引擎（Pygame、HTML5、Godot、Unity）。为支持异构游戏的可扩展评估，开发了针对 HPC 集群优化的统一闭环交互框架，以及将可观测游戏里程碑映射到标准化进度等级的 Video-LLM-as-a-judge 协议。评估了涵盖视觉语言模型、计算机使用智能体和视觉-语言-行动模型的十四种开源模型。
AI.result: 评估结果为"感知-行动鸿沟"提供了有力证据：尽管当前模型具备较强的推理能力，却难以取得持续进展，并在空间定位、动作执行和自我纠错方面反复出现失败。由于这些独立游戏多为分布外数据，模型难以依靠记忆攻略获得成功，从而更真实地反映交互能力短板。
AI.conclusion: PlaySuite 为衡量从视觉感知到目标导向交互的进展提供了一个可复现、可扩展的测试平台，也为开发能够在动态视觉环境中行动、适应和泛化的模型奠定了基础。

title: Should We Skip Diffusion?
summary: Diffusion models learn semantic representations while generating images. In the Decoupled Diffusion Transformer (DDT), a condition encoder provides features that guide a velocity decoder in denoising. To enable effective denoising at all noise levels, these features must capture both high-level abstract structures and low-level details. However, skip/residual connections in the encoder allow shallow features to bypass successive transformations, which may limit progressive abstraction, or at least make it difficult to disentangle different levels of abstraction. We propose DDT-RFE, which removes the residual connections around the Self-Attention and MLP operations in each encoder block while maintaining stable training. To retain the information that abstraction discards but that the decoder still needs, we fuse the input patch embedding with intermediate and final encoder features to form the encoder output. The decoder thus has access to information from multiple encoder depths, while each encoder block is able to learn more abstract representations. DDT-RFE achieves overall improvements over DDT across visual understanding tasks, including image classification, semantic segmentation, object discovery, and semantic correspondence, while using fewer encoder blocks. It also achieves a lower FID for image generation on ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DDT-RFE，通过移除条件编码器中Self-Attention和MLP的残差连接以增强层级抽象，并融合浅层到深层的多级特征保证解码器信息完备，在多项视觉任务上超越DDT。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的条件编码器需为速度解码器提供既包含高层抽象结构又包含低层细节的特征，以应对所有噪声水平的去噪。但编码器中的skip/residual连接使浅层特征绕过后续变换，可能限制了渐进式抽象，或至少使不同抽象层级难以解耦。
AI.method: 提出DDT-RFE：移除每个编码器块中围绕Self-Attention和MLP的残差连接，同时保持训练稳定；为保留抽象过程中丢弃但解码器仍需要的信息，将输入patch embedding与中间层及最终层编码器特征进行融合，作为编码器输出，使解码器可获取多个编码深度的信息。
AI.result: 在图像分类、语义分割、物体发现、语义对应等视觉理解任务上相较DDT取得整体提升，且使用的编码器块更少；在ImageNet图像生成上取得更低的FID。
AI.conclusion: 移除编码器残差连接并辅以多深度特征融合，可让每个编码器块学习更抽象的表征，同时为解码器提供多级信息，从而在更少编码器块下实现更优的视觉理解与生成性能。

title: Verified, not generated: expert-verified AI study materials and the distribution of learning gains in a university course
summary: Experimental studies of generative AI in education mostly report average effects, yet field evidence shows that AI can narrow attainment gaps or widen them. We argue that the direction depends on the judgement burden, the expertise a learner must supply to screen AI output before learning from it, and that expert verification before release moves this burden from students to an accountable tutor. We test the argument in a two-cohort difference-in-differences design in which one half of a compulsory firstyear university economics course received AI-generated podcasts, FAQs and quiz-based study guides, produced with a source-grounded model and checked by a named graduate teaching assistant (170 students; 340 examination marks). Access was associated with a 2.34-mark advantage on a 50-mark component. The share of marks below the upper-second classification boundary fell by 24.7 percentage points relative to the counterfactual, effects were significant at every threshold from 23 to 31 marks and at none above, and roughly three-quarters of the average originated in the bottom quintile. The threshold estimate is robust to removing the lowest-scoring students from the pre-intervention cohort; the average effect is not. Interviews and feedback from 36 students indicate that the verification label gave students a reason to engage with AI-generated material without ending their scrutiny of it. Evaluations of AI learning resources that report only mean effects cannot detect whether the students the resources are meant to help are the ones who gain.

AI.tldr: AI教育资源的效应方向取决于"判断负担"，将审核负担由学生转移给负责的助教并通过"已验证"标签，可显著提升弱势学生成绩并缩小及格线附近的差距。
AI.motivation: 既有生成式AI教育研究多只报告平均效应，而实地证据显示AI既能缩小也能扩大成绩差距。作者认为方向取决于"判断负担"——学习者必须自行审核AI输出所付出的专业判断成本；若在发布前由可问责的助教完成专业验证，即可把该负担从学生转移到教师，从而可能使AI真正惠及它本应帮助的学生。
AI.method: 采用两届学生的双重差分设计。一所大学必修一年级经济学课程的一半学生获得AI生成的播客、FAQ和测验式学习指南，内容由基于资料来源的模型生成并由具名研究生助教审核（170名学生，340个考试成绩）。同时对36名学生进行访谈并收集反馈。
AI.result: 获得资源的学生在50分制组成部分上有2.34分的优势；低于二等一分类边界的成绩占比相对反事实下降24.7个百分点；效应在23至31分各阈值上均显著，在更高阈值上均不显著；平均效应约四分之三来自最低五分位组。阈值估计在剔除干预前低分学生后依然稳健，而平均效应则不再稳健。访谈显示"已验证"标签促使学生接触AI材料但未放弃对其的审视。
AI.conclusion: 仅报告平均效应的AI学习资源评估无法识别资源是否真正惠及目标学生；判断负担的归属与发布前的专家验证是决定AI是缩小还是扩大成绩差距的关键机制。

title: CALR: Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning via Render-of-Thought Compression
summary: Visual latent reasoning compresses rendered derivations into compact intermediate states, reducing textual reasoning overhead. Existing approaches differ in how they represent these states: continuous methods avoid vocabulary constraints, whereas discrete methods improve accuracy through quantization into a finite codebook. Our analysis of representative continuous and discrete systems identifies two functional requirements: answers must rely on latent states, and those states must carry valid, problem-specific reasoning. Continuous latents influence answers despite collapsed reasoning content, whereas discrete latents retain recoverable intermediate reasoning that answer prediction largely bypasses. To address these challenges, we propose Continuous Anchored Latent Reasoning (CALR), which connects latent formation with answer use through functional anchoring. With reference latents from information-balanced compression, CALR couples latent-mediated answer supervision with derivation-level semantic anchoring: the former routes answer supervision through intermediate states, while the latter grounds their decoded content in problem-specific derivations. A parallel-to-autoregressive curriculum develops sequential reasoning by conditioning subsequent latent blocks on generated prefixes. Evaluations on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks across model families show substantial accuracy gains. Under matched budgets, CALR gains 26.0 percentage points over a comparable continuous latent reasoning method. Further analyses show that its latents support answer prediction and carry problem-specific intermediate reasoning.

AI.tldr: CALR通过"功能锚定"将潜在状态的形成与答案使用连接起来，使连续潜在推理既能驱动答案预测，又能携带问题特定的中间推理，在五个数学推理基准上取得显著准确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉潜在推理方法分为连续法和离散法：连续法不受词表约束但推理内容易崩塌，离散法通过量化提高准确率但答案预测往往绕过可恢复的中间推理。作者分析后发现两个功能需求——答案必须依赖潜在状态，且潜在状态须携带有效、问题特定的推理内容，而现有方法均未能同时满足。
AI.method: 提出连续锚定潜在推理（CALR）。以信息均衡压缩得到的参考潜在状态为基础，将潜在介导的答案监督与推导级语义锚定相结合：前者让答案监督经由中间状态传递，后者将解码内容锚定到问题特定推导上。此外采用并行到自回归的课程学习，通过已生成前缀条件化后续潜在块来培养序列推理能力。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准、多个模型系列上评估，准确率大幅提升；在相同预算下，CALR相比可比的连续潜在推理方法提升26.0个百分点。进一步分析表明其潜在状态既能支持答案预测，又携带问题特定的中间推理。
AI.conclusion: 通过功能锚定同时满足"答案依赖潜在状态"与"潜在状态携带有效推理"两个需求，CALR有效解决了连续潜在推理中推理内容崩塌的问题，兼顾了连续表示的灵活性与离散表示的推理可恢复性。

title: STOCK-JEPA: Prior-Anchored Latent Revision Representation Learning in Equity Markets
summary: Learning effective representations helps characterize the structure and dynamics of equity markets from financial data with a low signal-to-noise ratio. Black-box deep models can capture complex patterns but may overfit sample noise and lack explicit economic structure. Meanwhile, classic linear financial models provide interpretable references, but their oversimplified assumptions leave non-linear signals uncaptured. To combine the strengths of these two directions, we propose Stock-JEPA, a joint-embedding predictive framework that learns predictable incremental revisions relative to a point-in-time financial prior. First, we leverage a low-complexity financial model to produce fixed statistics summarizing multi-horizon return and risk. A prior projector then maps these statistics into the target encoder's latent space as an anchor. Second, we design a context-conditioned revision predictor to estimate the future representation's predictable displacement from the anchor. Separate losses update the two branches: the anchor learns from prior statistics, while the revision captures additional predictable information from historical context. Third, we freeze all representation modules and train a downstream readout, evaluating its forecasts through cross-sectional ranking and portfolio performance. Theoretically, we prove that optimal revision reduces the prior anchor's expected squared error for the same future representation by exactly $\mathbb{E}[\|\boldsymbolΔ\|_2^2]$. This non-negative gain is the expected squared magnitude of the additional signal predictable from historical context. Experimentally, Stock-JEPA outperforms 13 strong baselines across large-scale China and U.S. equity universes on 5 key evaluation metrics. Ablation studies and representation analysis further demonstrate the value of the learned revisions for representation learning in equity markets.

AI.tldr: Stock-JEPA提出联合嵌入预测框架，将经典线性金融先验与深度表示学习结合，学习相对先验锚点的可预测增量修正，在美中股市多个指标上超越13个基线。
AI.motivation: 金融数据信噪比低，黑盒深度模型易过拟合噪声且缺乏经济结构，而经典线性金融模型可解释但假设过于简化，无法捕捉非线性信号。论文旨在融合两者优势。
AI.method: 用低复杂度金融模型生成多期限收益与风险统计，经先验投影器映射为目标编码器潜空间的锚点；设计上下文条件化的修正预测器估计未来表示相对锚点的可预测位移；两分支分别用独立损失训练（锚点学先验统计，修正学历史上下文的额外信息）；冻结表示模块后训练下游读出，通过横截面排名和组合表现评估。
AI.result: 理论上证明最优修正使先验锚点对未来表示的期望平方误差降低E[‖Δ‖²]；实验上在大规模中国与美国股票池上，5个关键评估指标均优于13个强基线；消融与表示分析验证了所学修正的价值。
AI.conclusion: 将可解释金融先验作为锚点、由上下文预测可预测增量修正，可有效提升股票市场表示学习的预测与组合表现，兼顾可解释性与非线性信号捕捉。

title: When to Remember, When to Abstain: Category-Conditioned Retention for Reliable Agent Memory
comment: 4 pages, 1 Figure, Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Social Agent Workshop (https://openreview.net/group?id=NeurIPS.cc%2F2026%2FWorkshop%2FSocialAgent#tab-your-consoles)
summary: Persistent agent memory is only as reliable as its retention decision: an assertion weakly supported by its source can be stored and later reused as established fact. We study whether the retention decision should be governed by a confidence bar conditioned on the semantic category of the assertion rather than by a single global threshold, retaining well-evidenced categories liberally while abstaining more aggressively where inference is unreliable. We evaluate this in a deployed cold-start memory pipeline on 100 synthetic personas. The empirical evaluation is motivated by a sharp reliability asymmetry: across 4{,}715 candidate assertions, only 77.9\% of value and belief assertions are supported by their source, versus 96.2\% for all other categories. A global confidence threshold cannot separate these: it either admits unsupported value claims or discards well-evidenced ones. Conditioning the threshold on category resolves the tradeoff. In repeated held-out evaluation, a stricter bar on values alone reduces unsupported retentions from 6.2\% to 4.0\% (an ${\approx}36\%$ relative reduction, modest but consistent across folds) and, as corroborating evidence, preserves an estimated 13 percentage points more coverage (95\% CI 9.8--16.0) than a global threshold at comparable retention. Our results suggest that reliable retention depends on the type of assertion, not on confidence alone, and that a category-conditioned threshold can act as a simple, effective form of selective prediction at the write boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文将智能体记忆的"保留决策"重新表述为选择性预测问题，提出按断言语义类别调节置信度阈值，而非使用单一全局阈值，并在冷启动记忆流水线上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 持久化智能体记忆的可靠性取决于保留决策：一条证据薄弱的断言一旦被写入，日后可能被当作既定事实复用。实证发现存在显著可靠性不对称——在4,715条候选断言中，仅77.9%的价值与信念类断言有来源支撑，而其他类别高达96.2%。单一全局阈值无法区分二者，要么纳入无支撑的价值主张，要么丢弃证据充分的断言。
AI.method: 在已部署的冷启动记忆流水线上，面向100个合成人格进行评测；将保留阈值按断言的语义类别进行条件化，对证据充分的类别宽松保留，对推理不可靠的类别更积极地弃权，并与全局阈值方案对比，在重复的留出集（held-out）评估中检验。
AI.result: 仅对价值类施加更严格的阈值，可将无支撑保留从6.2%降至4.0%（约36%的相对下降，幅度不大但跨折一致）；作为佐证，在可比保留率下，相比全局阈值多保留约13个百分点的覆盖率（95% CI 9.8–16.0）。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的记忆保留取决于断言类型而非仅取决于置信度；类别条件化阈值可作为写入边界处一种简单而有效的选择性预测形式。

title: Deep Learning Based Illegal Bowling Action Detection
summary: Cricket, often referred to as the "gentleman's game," adheres to a strict rule set for both batsmen and bowlers, where each delivery can significantly impact the match outcome. Detecting illegal bowling actions is crucial for maintaining fair play, yet it remains challenging for umpires to monitor in real time. Existing sensor-based solutions have limitations in live match scenarios, making real-time assessment difficult. This paper proposes a computer vision-based deep learning solution to detect illegal bowling actions in live cricket matches. To develop and evaluate our approach, we compiled a dataset of 62 videos featuring 11 male bowlers, capturing both legal and illegal bowling actions from multiple angles-front, back, and side. However, the dataset predominantly comprises right-handed bowlers with conventional actions. The proposed system identifies two key frames, the shoulder frame and the release frame from video footage of a bowler's delivery and analyzes the change in the bowling arm's angle between these frames. If the angle difference exceeds a predefined threshold (e.g., 15 degrees), the delivery is flagged as potentially illegal. We evaluated the system on a custom dataset and achieved a high true positive rate, suggesting the system's potential effectiveness in real-time match settings. However, further research is required to validate the system across diverse environmental conditions and larger datasets to ensure generalizability and robustness in various live match scenarios. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first AI-based computer vision method for detecting illegal bowling actions in cricket.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个基于AI计算机视觉的板球非法投球动作检测方法，通过提取肩部帧与出手帧并分析投球臂角度变化（阈值15度）来判别违规，在自建视频数据集上取得高真阳性率。
AI.motivation: 板球对投球动作有严格规则，非法投球动作会影响比赛公平性，但裁判难以实时监控。现有基于传感器的方案在真实比赛场景中存在局限，难以实现实时评估，因此需要一种可行的实时检测手段。
AI.method: 采用基于计算机视觉的深度学习方案。构建包含62段视频、11名男性投球手、涵盖合法与非法动作及正面/背面/侧面多角度的数据集。系统从投球视频中定位两个关键帧（肩部帧与出手帧），计算两帧间投球臂角度的变化，若角度差超过预设阈值（如15度）则标记为疑似非法投球。
AI.result: 在自建数据集上评估，系统取得了较高的真阳性率，表明其在实时比赛场景中具有潜在有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为板球非法投球动作检测提供了首个AI视觉解决思路，但数据集以右手投球手和常规动作为主，仍需在多样环境条件和更大数据集上验证其泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: Identifiable World Models from Pretrained Diffusion Representations
summary: Diffusion-based world models can generate and predict trajectories in high-dimensional dynamical systems, but predictive accuracy does not imply that their latent coordinates recover the underlying state variables or causal interactions. We ask whether a frozen pretrained diffusion model can be equipped with identifiable coordinates without retraining its generative backbone. We show that auxiliary-variable nonlinear ICA guarantees can be transferred to Contrastive Diffusion Alignment (ConDA), which learns only a lightweight alignment map on top of frozen diffusion latents. Under standard TCL/GCL assumptions, the aligned representation identifies latent dynamical states up to permutation and componentwise invertible transformations, preserves the latent dynamic structural causal model, and reduces lagged graph recovery to transition-Jacobian sparsity. We evaluate TCL-, GCL-, and CEBRA-based ConDA against TDRL, CaRiNG, IDOL, temporal SuaVE, and iVAE across physical and robotic video systems. TCL and GCL achieve near-perfect blockwise state recovery and competitive lagged graph recovery, including exact recovery in a simulated falling-body system. In a simulated bipedal robot, learned dynamics recover the sign and temporal structure of responses to held-out control perturbations. These results show that a frozen generative diffusion model can be equipped with coordinates that are identifiable, structurally interpretable, and useful for analyzing intervention-relevant dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出 ConDA，在冻结扩散模型潜变量上学习轻量对齐映射，使潜坐标可识别、结构可解释，并能恢复滞后因果图。
AI.motivation: 扩散世界模型虽能预测高维动力学轨迹，但预测准确不代表潜坐标能恢复真实状态变量或因果交互。作者关注能否在不重训生成主干的前提下，为冻结预训练扩散模型赋予可识别坐标。
AI.method: 将辅助变量非线性 ICA 的可识别性保证迁移到 Contrastive Diffusion Alignment (ConDA)，仅在冻结扩散潜变量之上学习轻量对齐映射。在标准 TCL/GCL 假设下，证明对齐表示可识别潜动力学状态（至置换与逐分量可逆变换），保留潜动态结构因果模型，并将滞后图恢复简化为转移雅可比稀疏性。评估 TCL/GCL/CEBRA 版 ConDA 对比 TDRL、CaRiNG、IDOL、temporal SuaVE、iVAE。
AI.result: 在物理与机器人视频系统上，TCL 与 GCL 实现近乎完美的分块状态恢复与有竞争力的滞后图恢复，在模拟落体系统中实现精确恢复；在模拟双足机器人中，学到的动力学能恢复对留出控制扰动的响应符号与时间结构。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的生成扩散模型可被赋予可识别、结构可解释、并有助于分析干预相关动力学的坐标。

title: AMBER: Training Long-Horizon Web Agents through Append-Only Memory
summary: Modern language-model agents increasingly interact with external environments over long-horizon, multi-step trajectories, where the accumulated interaction history can quickly exceed practical context budgets. To ensure reliability, agents must maintain factual information over long horizons, remember execution errors and corrective feedback, and track progress across actions. Several approaches have been proposed to achieve this without the need for maintaining the entire execution history in context, such as using the reasoning and action history, learning to maintain a fixed-size memory through an overwrite mechanism, and periodic summarization. Although overwrite memory can in principle retain anything an append-only memory can, it must learn to carry each fact through every subsequent rewrite, which is difficult to learn from sparse outcome rewards; for interactive applications like web agents, we find that trained overwrite memories delete key information required by the trajectory, as well as corrective feedback received from the environment.
