We introduce AMBER (Append-only Memory Bank for Evidence Retention) - a simple and scalable framework where an agent jointly learns to reason, act, and write free-form memory, while an append-only rule guarantees retention by construction. This allows AMBER to be trained end-to-end with reinforcement learning from outcome rewards without the need for extensive curated SFT data. On WebArena Lite, AMBER improves average success over overwrite-based memory by 4.09 percentage points, increases the fraction of tasks solved in five repeated runs by 4.8 percentage points, and matches an overwrite baseline trained on substantially more expensive curated supervision. AMBER achieves these improvements while maintaining a practical token budget, providing a strong balance between context efficiency, task performance, and reliable long-horizon execution.

AI.tldr: 提出AMBER（仅追加式记忆库），通过让智能体学习推理、行动并写入自由形式记忆，以仅追加规则从结构上保证信息保留，实现端到端强化学习，在WebArena Lite上优于覆写式记忆。
AI.motivation: 长程多步交互中，累积历史会超出上下文预算。智能体需保持事实信息、记住执行错误与纠错反馈、跟踪进度。覆写式记忆虽理论上可保留任意信息，但需学会在每次重写中携带每个事实，难以从稀疏结果奖励中学习；在Web智能体等交互场景中，训练后的覆写记忆会删除轨迹所需关键信息及环境反馈。
AI.method: 提出AMBER（Append-only Memory Bank for Evidence Retention）框架：智能体联合学习推理、行动并写入自由形式记忆，仅追加规则通过构造保证保留信息，从而可仅用结果奖励进行端到端强化学习，无需大量精心整理的SFT数据。
AI.result: 在WebArena Lite上，AMBER相对覆写式记忆平均成功率提升4.09个百分点；五次重复运行中解决任务的比例提升4.8个百分点；并匹敌使用更昂贵人工监督训练的覆写基线，同时维持实用的token预算。
AI.conclusion: AMBER在上下文效率、任务性能与可靠长程执行之间取得良好平衡，为长程智能体记忆提供了一种简单、可扩展的解决方案。

title: Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network for Early Breast Cancer Detection in Low-Resource Clinical Settings
comment: 5 double pages numbers, conference paper presented at AI4SD 2026 (https://www.mu.edu.et/index.php/component/content/article/artificial-intelligence-for-sustainable-development-conference-participants?catid=69&Itemid=101)
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related mortality among women in Sub-Saharan Africa, where delayed diagnosis results from limited radiology expertise and fragmented clinical data systems. Although deep learning models have demonstrated strong performance in mammographic analysis, most rely solely on imaging data and are trained on Western populations, limiting their applicability in African healthcare settings. This paper presents a Hybrid Cross-Modal Attention Network (HCMAN) that integrates mammogram images with structured clinical data using transformer-based cross-modal attention mechanisms. The model was developed and validated using a locally collected dataset of 2,560 mammogram images from 1,024 patients across four Ethiopian referral hospitals, with biopsy-confirmed ground truth labels. The proposed framework achieves 97.8% accuracy, 97.2% sensitivity, 98.3% specificity, and an AUC of 0.987, significantly outperforming image-only baselines. The system demonstrates robustness to low-quality images typical of resource-limited settings, with only 3.2% performance degradation compared to 8.7% for image-only models. Cross-modal attention analysis reveals clinically appropriate behavior: higher reliance on clinical features for ambiguous cases such as dense breasts and young patients. The model's lightweight architecture enables deployment on standard hospital workstations (<2 seconds inference on CPU). This work advances sustainable, context-aware AI solutions for equitable breast cancer diagnostics in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合跨模态注意力网络（HCMAN），融合乳腺X线图像与结构化临床数据，在埃塞俄比亚多中心数据集上实现高精度乳腺癌诊断，并在资源受限环境下展现鲁棒性与可部署性。
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲乳腺癌死亡率高，延迟诊断源于放射学专业人才匮乏和临床数据系统碎片化。现有深度学习模型多仅依赖影像数据且基于西方人群训练，难以适用于非洲医疗场景，因此需要结合影像与临床数据的本地化、跨模态诊断方案。
AI.method: 提出混合跨模态注意力网络（HCMAN），采用基于Transformer的跨模态注意力机制，将乳腺X线图像与结构化临床数据相融合。模型基于埃塞俄比亚四家转诊医院本地采集的2,560张乳腺X线图像（来自1,024名患者）进行开发与验证，标签由活检确认。
AI.result: 模型达到97.8%准确率、97.2%敏感度、98.3%特异度及0.987的AUC，显著优于仅使用图像的基线。对资源受限环境中的低质量图像具有鲁棒性，性能下降仅3.2%（图像单模态模型为8.7%）。跨模态注意力分析显示临床合理行为：对致密乳腺和年轻患者等模糊病例更依赖临床特征。轻量架构可在标准医院工作站CPU上于2秒内完成推理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动了面向非洲公平乳腺癌诊断的可持续、情境感知AI解决方案发展，证明跨模态融合在资源受限医疗环境中兼具高精度、鲁棒性与可部署性。

title: Shaping the Wind: Nested Potentials for Kinematically Admissible Urban Wind Prediction
summary: Predicting transient urban winds is fundamental to understanding urban microclimates and designing climate-resilient cities. Building-resolving large-eddy simulation produces detailed incompressible urban wind fields at substantial computational cost for each layout. Neural surrogates offer a faster alternative by learning to predict the evolution of velocity fields. However, minimizing velocity prediction error does not guarantee local mass conservation and wall impermeability, which together define kinematic admissibility. This limitation stems from an unconstrained output representation: geometry conditioning guides predictions but does not restrict them to admissible velocity fields. Correcting boundary violations in these outputs changes the flux balance in adjacent fluid cells and may consequently compromise local mass conservation. To address the challenge, we propose Sculpt, a nested potential framework that builds the coupled, geometry-dependent constraints directly into its parameterization. This nested parameterization generates divergence-free velocity updates through the discrete curl of a volume vector potential on the native three-dimensional staggered grid. A shared scalar potential constrains the vector potential's boundary values so that the same operator also enforces impermeability, without a per-step pressure projection. Because backpropagation through this curl attenuates large-scale gradient signals, we parameterize the volume potential at multiple resolutions to better capture large-scale flow structures. We introduce UrbanWindFlow, an LES dataset spanning urban morphologies and inflow conditions, to evaluate accuracy and kinematic admissibility together.

AI.tldr: 提出嵌套势场框架Sculpt，将无散度与不可渗透约束内嵌于参数化中，实现快速且运动学可行的城市风场预测。
AI.motivation: 建筑级大涡模拟计算成本高昂；神经代理模型虽快，但仅最小化速度误差无法保证局部质量守恒与壁面不可渗透性（即运动学可行性），根源在于输出表示缺乏约束：几何条件仅引导预测而不限制其落在可行速度场内，且事后修正边界违背会改变相邻流体单元的通量平衡，破坏局部质量守恒。
AI.method: 提出Sculpt嵌套势场框架，将几何相关的耦合约束直接构建进参数化：(1) 通过原生三维交错网格上体积矢势的离散旋度生成无散度速度更新；(2) 用共享标势约束该矢势的边界值，使同一算子同时强制不可渗透性，无需逐步压力投影；(3) 因旋度反传会衰减大尺度梯度信号，在多分辨率上参数化体积势以更好捕捉大尺度流动结构。同时构建UrbanWindFlow数据集（覆盖多种城市形态与入流条件），以同时评估精度与运动学可行性。
AI.result: 构建了涵盖多种城市形态与入流条件的LES数据集UrbanWindFlow，用于联合评估预测精度与运动学可行性；Sculpt在无需每步压力投影的情况下即可生成满足无散度与不可渗透约束的速度场更新。
AI.conclusion: 将运动学可行性约束直接嵌入神经网络参数化，是实现快速且物理可行城市风场代理预测的有效途径，可在保持精度的同时保证局部质量守恒与壁面不可渗透性。

title: Is this machine playing?
summary: We placed a modern AI coding assistant in an unintended role: as the mind of a body on an unknown digital island. With only a minimal instruction mentioning no specific task, reward, or activity, the machine started animating its virtual body. Across thirty-hour runs, the embodied AI agent climbed hills, stacked blocks into towers, drew mandalas, reinterpreted sports, ran experiments on the physics of its world, and learned techniques that later expanded what it could accomplish. These activities recurred across thirteen agents but diverged into distinct histories. We examine whether this behavior satisfies classical criteria for play and ask whether play can become a mode of machine development.

AI.tldr: 研究者将现代AI编程助手置于未知数字岛屿的身体中，仅给出极简指令，观察其三十小时运行中自发出现的攀爬、堆叠、绘画、实验等行为，并探讨这些行为是否符合"玩耍"的经典定义。
AI.motivation: 探索AI在没有明确任务、奖励或活动指令的情况下，被赋予"身体"后会产生何种行为，并尝试用"玩耍"这一概念来理解机器的自发活动与自我发展。
AI.method: 将AI编码助手作为虚拟身体的心智，置于无人知晓的数字岛屿环境中，仅提供不含具体任务、奖励或活动的极简指令，进行长达三十小时的运行观察，并对比13个智能体的行为差异。
AI.result: 智能体自发进行爬山、堆叠方块成塔、绘制曼陀罗、重新诠释体育运动、对世界物理规律做实验等活动，并习得可扩展其后续能力的技巧；这些活动在13个智能体中反复出现，但又各自发展出不同的个体历史。
AI.conclusion: 论文考察这些行为是否满足经典"玩耍"标准，并进一步追问：玩耍是否能够成为机器发展（自我成长）的一种模式。

title: What Words Keep of a Place: Zero-Shot Language Reasoning for Cross-View Geo-Localization
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop Physical World AI: Geometry, Characteristics, and Multimodal Sensing
summary: Cross-view geo-localization is commonly solved as an image retrieval problem, matching a ground-level image against a database of satellite tiles through a jointly trained embedding. Such models are accurate, but they need large paired supervision and cannot show what evidence supports a match. In this paper, we study a different question: how much of this task can be solved through language alone? We prompt a multimodal large language model (MLLM) to describe each ground panorama and each satellite tile as structured text, and localize by comparing these descriptions. No component is trained. We evaluate on 9,826 VIGOR pairs from four U.S. cities, in three settings. First, the descriptions are faithful but not discriminative. They agree closely across the two views, yet ranking the full pool by description similarity almost never returns the correct tile (0.39% Recall@1). Second, we narrow the pool to ten neighboring tiles, as a coarse prior would do. The same descriptions now become useful: an MLLM judge that scores structural consistency doubles random ranking and matches a strong lexical baseline. It also states which fields of the two descriptions agree and which conflict, which an embedding distance cannot do, and which we see as a step toward interpretable localization. Third, we place the judge on a trained visual retriever. On the queries it ranks wrongly, reranking from images works, while reranking from our descriptions does not (23.5% against 10.7% Recall@1). Scene structure survives the conversion into language, while the fine appearance detail needed to separate nearby places does not. Code and prompts are publicly available at https://github.com/AyeshAbuLehyeh/GeoLingual.

AI.tldr: 本文探究仅靠语言能否完成跨视角地理定位，用MLLM把地面全景与卫星瓦片转为结构化文本并用LLM裁判比对，在VIGOR数据集三种设定下评测，发现语言保留场景结构但丢失细粒度外观细节。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视角地理定位方法多为图像检索，依赖联合训练的嵌入模型，需要大量配对监督，且无法说明匹配依据、缺乏可解释性。作者希望探究：仅凭语言（不训练任何组件）能解决多少该任务，以获得可解释的定位线索。
AI.method: 提示多模态大语言模型分别将地面全景和卫星瓦片描述为结构化文本，通过比较这些描述进行定位，全程不训练任何组件；在VIGOR的9,826对数据（四个美国城市）上设计三种实验设定：全库描述相似度排名、缩小到十个邻近瓦片后用MLLM裁判评估结构一致性、以及将裁判置于训练好的视觉检索器之上做重排序。
AI.result: 描述忠实但区分度低：全库检索仅0.39% Recall@1；在十个邻近瓦片候选中，MLLM裁判的结构一致性打分使排名翻倍于随机并媲美强词法基线，还能指出两描述中哪些字段一致或冲突；置于视觉检索器上时，图像重排序有效而描述重排序效果差（23.5% vs 10.7% Recall@1）。
AI.conclusion: 场景结构信息能在转为语言后保留，但区分近邻地点所需的细粒度外观细节无法保留。语言可用于可解释的粗定位与片段重排，但难以替代视觉细节。代码与提示词已开源。

title: The Premise Is the Problem: Exchangeability Failure in Self-Monitored Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Modern forecasting models are often updated after deployment so they can respond to changing data. These updates can also make predictions worse, so practical systems need a reliable monitor that can detect harmful changes and trigger protection. A natural design is to monitor the same prediction errors that guide the updates. This paper asks whether the statistical guarantee behind such a monitor remains valid when monitoring and adaptation use the same feedback. We study this question in multi-step time-series forecasting. We show that overlapping targets and dependence in forecast errors can break a key assumption required by the guarantee. The monitor may then raise alarms even when no harmful change has occurred, and its response can further damage prediction quality. We also find that adaptation can hide sustained changes from its own monitor, while the original frozen model retains a clearer signal. These results expose a basic failure mode in self-monitored adaptation. They show why reliable deployment requires checking the monitor's assumptions, comparing adaptation with the frozen model under realistic feedback, and limiting the effect of every protective response.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多步时间序列预测中"自我监控自适应"的可靠性问题：当监控与自适应共享同一预测误差反馈时，统计保证可能失效，导致误报、自适应掩盖持续变化，从而损害预测质量。
AI.motivation: 现代预测模型在部署后常被更新以适应数据变化，但更新也可能使预测变差。因此系统需要可靠的监控来检测有害变化并触发保护。一个自然的设计是用驱动更新的同一预测误差来监控。本文质疑：当监控与自适应使用同一反馈时，监控背后的统计保证是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 作者在多步时间序列预测的设定下，理论分析监控的统计保证所依赖的关键假设，考察重叠目标（overlapping targets）与预测误差中的依赖性如何破坏该假设，并分析自适应过程对监控信号的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现：重叠目标和预测误差依赖会破坏统计保证所需的关键假设；监控器可能在没有有害变化时也发出警报，其响应反而进一步损害预测质量；自适应会向自身监控器隐藏持续变化，而原始冻结模型却保留了更清晰的信号。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了"自我监控自适应"的一个基本失效模式。可靠的部署需要：检验监控器的假设、在真实反馈下比较自适应与冻结模型、并限制每种保护响应的实际影响。

title: Sim-to-Real Transfer of Vision-Language Navigation in Continuous Environments Using an Ackermann-Steered Mobile Robot
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) enables robots to navigate through environments using natural language instructions, making human-robot interaction intuitive. Traditional VLN models often rely on navigation graphs, 360-degree views, and perfect localization which pose significant challenges when adapting these models to real-world settings. This work addresses these limitations by performing a simulation-to-real domain shift of a VLN approach that operates in continuous environments without requiring navigation graphs or panoramic views. The proposed system integrates vision-language models that align visual inputs and linguistic instructions within a shared embedding space, facilitating natural language-driven navigation. We employ a Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) based architecture trained on an existing dataset in a simulated environment and fine-tune it using real-world data collected from a custom-built Ackermann-steered robot equipped with a camera and a LiDAR sensor. By utilising linear photometric adjustments and fine-tuning on a limited number of episodes, our model successfully adapts to real-world environments, achieving effective navigation while running offline on dedicated hardware. Experimental results, evaluated using Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) and Normalized Dynamic Time Warping (nDTW) metrics, demonstrate the robustness and adaptability of our approach. Keywords: Vision-Language Navigation, Cross-Modal Attention, Natural Language Instructions, Sim-to-Real Transfer, Autonomous Navigation, Ackermann-steering.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于跨模态注意力（CMA）的视觉-语言导航方法，在连续环境中无需导航图与全景视图，通过线性光度调整和少量真实数据微调实现仿真到真实的迁移，并在Ackermann转向机器人上离线运行，取得良好导航性能。
AI.motivation: 传统VLN模型依赖导航图、360度视图和完美定位，难以适应真实世界场景，因此需要一种可在连续环境中运行、无需全景视图与导航图、并能从仿真迁移到真实环境的方法。
AI.method: 构建基于跨模态注意力（CMA）的架构，将视觉输入与语言指令对齐到共享嵌入空间；在仿真数据集上训练，然后使用自制的Ackermann转向机器人（配备相机和LiDAR）采集的真实数据进行微调，并采用线性光度调整与少量回合微调实现域迁移，模型可离线在专用硬件上运行。
AI.result: 使用SPL和nDTW指标评估，实验结果表明该方法在真实环境中具有良好的鲁棒性和适应性，能够实现有效导航。
AI.conclusion: 该系统成功实现了连续环境下的仿真到真实迁移，验证了跨模态注意力架构结合少量真实数据微调在真实机器人导航中的可行性与有效性。

title: Localize Any Object in X-Ray Security Scans without Human Annotation
summary: Universal object localization in X-ray security inspection is critical for automated threat detection in safety-critical venues. However, unlike everyday RGB images that dominate web-scale visual data, X-ray scans exhibit distinct color patterns, ambiguous boundaries, and compositional structures caused by volumetric superposition. These gaps hinder the direct zero-shot transfer of dense perception foundation models trained on web-scale RGB data. Moreover, annotated X-ray data is scarce and requires expert labeling, limiting both the training of generalizable X-ray native models and the adaptation of RGB foundation models for X-ray data via fine-tuning. Given these challenges, the bright promise of highly generalizable perception models, enabled by data scaling laws in the RGB domain, remains largely out of reach for X-ray inspection. To this end, we introduce LAO-X, a self-supervised adaptation framework that Locates Any Object in X-ray scans using diverse synthesized image--annotation pairs with granularity-aware supervision. LAO-X first designs a saliency-guided X-ray object mining module to separate diverse object instances, which are then used for physics-guided synthesis in the absorbance domain. LAO-X further incorporates an occlusion-controlled curriculum strategy to fine-tune a Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) localizer, progressively adapting it to X-ray scans with increasing object counts and overlap levels. Experiments on six X-ray benchmarks show that LAO-X substantially improves category-agnostic localization, achieving 2\% to 23\% mAP gains over SAM2 and X-ray specific baselines in heavily cluttered scenarios, entirely without human-annotated labels.

AI.tldr: 提出了LAO-X自监督自适应框架，无需人工标注即可在X射线安检图像中实现通用物体定位。
AI.motivation: X射线图像具有独特的颜色模式、模糊边界和体积叠加结构，与RGB图像差异大，导致在RGB数据上训练的密集感知基础模型难以直接零样本迁移；同时X射线标注数据稀缺且依赖专家标注，限制了原生模型训练和微调适配。
AI.method: 设计显著性引导的X射线物体挖掘模块分离多样物体实例，在吸光度域进行物理引导合成；并引入遮挡控制的课程策略微调SAM2定位器，逐步适应物体数量和重叠度递增的场景。
AI.result: 在六个X射线基准上，LAO-X显著提升类别不可知定位能力，在高杂乱场景下相较SAM2和X射线专用基线取得2%~23%的mAP增益，且完全不使用人工标注标签。
AI.conclusion: LAO-X通过合成数据与自监督课程学习，有效弥合了RGB基础模型与X射线安检之间的域差距，实现了无标注的高泛化物体定位。

title: TRIAGE: Direction-Aware Mismatch Stabilization of Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning
summary: Low-precision execution can substantially accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models, but discrepancies between learner and sampler execution can destabilize policy optimization. In this paper, we characterize the interaction between mismatch and the policy-gradient direction, distinguishing locally amplifying from contracting update contributions that mismatch magnitude alone cannot identify. In native NVFP4 runs, we observe an early imbalance between the two amplifying regions, favoring negative-advantage, negative-gap updates. Their tail tokens become concentrated in a small fraction of response segments before mismatch spreads globally. Motivated by these findings, we introduce TRIAGE, a direction-aware stabilization method that uses segment-level diagnosis to selectively rebalance policy-gradient updates and applies bounded repair to residual severe mismatch. TRIAGE modifies the optimization objective while retaining native NVFP4 weight-and activation 4-bit (W4A4) forward execution on both the sampler and learner. Experiments on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B show stable optimization throughout the evaluated training horizon and achieve full precision level performance across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, while native NVFP4 with TRIAGE provides up to 2.3x higher rollout throughput than BF16.

AI.tldr: 本文提出方向感知的稳定化方法 TRIAGE，通过诊断并重新平衡策略梯度更新，解决低精度执行中 learner 与 sampler 不匹配导致的优化不稳定问题，在 NVFP4 W4A4 下实现稳定训练并达到全精度性能。
AI.motivation: 低精度执行可显著加速大语言模型的强化学习，但 learner 与 sampler 执行之间的差异会破坏策略优化的稳定性。仅凭不匹配的大小（magnitude）无法识别哪些更新贡献会放大或收敛，因此需要从策略梯度方向的角度进行刻画。
AI.method: 作者刻画了不匹配与策略梯度方向之间的相互作用，区分局部放大与收缩的更新贡献。基于在原生 NVFP4 运行中观察到的两个放大区域之间的早期失衡（偏向负优势、负 gap 更新），提出 TRIAGE：一种方向感知的稳定化方法，使用段级（segment-level）诊断选择性地重新平衡策略梯度更新，并对残余的严重不匹配施加有界修复。TRIAGE 修改优化目标，同时在 sampler 与 learner 上保持原生 NVFP4 的 W4A4 前向执行。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的实验中，TRIAGE 在评估的训练周期内保持稳定优化，在五个数学推理基准上达到全精度水平性能；相比 BF16，原生 NVFP4 配合 TRIAGE 提供最高 2.3 倍的 rollout 吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 方向感知的段级诊断与选择性重平衡可有效缓解低精度 RL 中的不匹配不稳定问题，在保持原生 NVFP4 W4A4 高效执行的同时实现全精度级别的策略学习性能。

title: Energy-Conditioned Noise Schedule and Whitening for Spectral Diffusion
comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 2 tables, Manuscript submitted for publication in Elsevier Pattern Recognition Letters
summary: This paper introduces an energy-adaptive noise scheduling and whitening strategy for transform-domain diffusion models. Existing spectral diffusion methods account for the non-uniform statistics of transform coefficients through coefficient scaling, normalization, or frequency prioritization, while the forward diffusion noise schedule remains largely independent of the underlying spectral-energy distribution. We investigate whether the temporal evolution of the forward diffusion process should also follow the spectral organization of natural images. The proposed formulation combines global spectral whitening with energy-conditioned noise allocation that jointly modulates the injected noise according to the energy of individual transform coefficients and an image-dependent energy path over diffusion time. The resulting forward process preserves Gaussian transitions with closed-form marginals and remains compatible with standard DDPM and DDIM procedures without modifying the diffusion architecture. Experiments on CIFAR-10 demonstrate the contribution of the proposed energy-conditioned noise schedule and spectral whitening, reducing Fréchet Inception Distance from 142.48 for a compact DCTdiff U-Net variant to 100.45.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种能量自适应噪声调度与白化策略，用于变换域扩散模型，通过全局频谱白化与能量条件噪声分配，改善前向扩散过程与图像频谱结构的匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有频谱扩散方法虽通过系数缩放、归一化或频率优先等方式处理变换系数的非均匀统计特性，但前向扩散的噪声调度仍基本独立于底层频谱能量分布。作者希望探究前向扩散过程的时间演化是否也应遵循自然图像的频谱组织规律。
AI.method: 提出将全局频谱白化与能量条件噪声分配相结合，根据各变换系数的能量以及随扩散时间变化的图像依赖性能量路径，联合调制注入的噪声。该前向过程保持高斯转移与闭式边缘分布，且无需修改扩散架构即可兼容标准DDPM与DDIM流程。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上的实验表明，所提出的能量条件噪声调度与频谱白化均有贡献，将紧凑DCTdiff U-Net变体的Fréchet Inception Distance从142.48降至100.45。
AI.conclusion: 前向扩散噪声调度应与自然图像的频谱能量分布相联系，能量自适应调度结合频谱白化能有效提升变换域扩散模型的生成质量。

title: Compositional Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery
summary: Removing copyrighted, unsafe, or user-specified concepts from a deployed text-to-image diffusion model is now a practical requirement. Weight-editing methods can suppress fixed targets, but they require per-target retraining and modify the model checkpoint. Training-free methods, on the other hand, are deployment-friendly, but they suffer from text-side routing failures on compositional prompts. In such prompts, the erase target may be invoked through a related class rather than its lexical name, and its modifiers may migrate onto preserved objects. This paper proposes Hierarchically Grounded Semantic Surgery (HGSS), a training-free framework for compositional concept erasure. The framework lifts both the routing signal and the edit operator used by text-side erasure. First, hierarchical span grounding resolves erase-target spans through lexical, taxonomic, and semantic evidence, while guarding against broad-hypernym and compound-head false positives. Second, dynamic attribute binding refines the text conditioning during early denoising via a counterfactual reference and a preserve-aware cross-attention objective, keeping surviving attribute-noun bindings intact. HGSS selectively removes the erase target without updating model weights or adding learned parameters. On SEE, HGSS cuts hierarchical evasion from 29.54 to 10.02 and roughly halves pairwise attribute leakage, achieving the best Neighbor E and AttrP scores among the reported erasure methods. On UnlearnCanvas, HGSS slightly improves the six-metric average over the matched Semantic Surgery baseline, reaching state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的组合式概念擦除框架 HGSS，通过分层跨度定位与动态属性绑定，在文本侧精确移除擦除目标并保留其余属性绑定，在 SEE 与 UnlearnCanvas 上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 已部署的文本到图像扩散模型需要移除受版权保护、不安全或用户指定的概念。权重编辑方法虽能抑制固定目标，但需逐目标重训练并修改模型检查点；免训练方法虽便于部署，却在组合式提示上出现文本侧路由失败——擦除目标可能经由相关类别而非其字面名称被调用，其修饰词也可能迁移到被保留的物体上。
AI.method: 提出 HGSS 免训练框架，同时提升文本侧擦除所使用的路由信号与编辑算子：其一为分层跨度定位，通过词汇、分类学和语义证据解析擦除目标跨度，并防止宽泛上位词与复合词中心语的误判；其二为动态属性绑定，在早期去噪阶段借助反事实参考与保留感知的交叉注意力目标来精炼文本条件，维持存留的属性—名词绑定完好。整个过程不更新模型权重，也不新增可学习参数。
AI.result: 在 SEE 上，HGSS 将分层规避率从 29.54 降至 10.02，并将成对属性泄漏约减半，在报告的擦除方法中取得最佳的 Neighbor E 与 AttrP 分数。在 UnlearnCanvas 上，HGSS 相对匹配的 Semantic Surgery 基线在六项指标均值上略有提升，达到当前最优。
AI.conclusion: HGSS 以免训练、不修改模型的方式实现了组合式概念擦除，在抑制擦除目标的同时有效保护存留概念与属性绑定，验证了分层定位与动态属性绑定相结合的有效性。

title: Skillful Data-Driven Subseasonal Soil Moisture Forecasting: Prospects and Limits for Flash Drought Prediction
comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in npj Hydrosphere. Supplementary information available with the published version
summary: Despite substantial progress in short-to-medium-range weather forecasting, predicting high-impact events such as flash droughts remains a key challenge for both early warning operations and physically-based subseasonal-to-seasonal (S2S) prediction systems. Here we demonstrate that, for S2S soil-moisture forecasting over Europe, forecast skill depends as much on how the prediction problem is formulated as on the forecasting model itself. Using a Vision Transformer-based architecture with dual-pathway temporal and spatial attention, we show that residual learning is essential to outperform persistence. This advantage is realized only when forecasting root-zone soil moisture in physical units rather than standardized anomalies, revealing that the target representation itself constrains predictability. A probabilistic extension via quantile-head fine-tuning further provides well-calibrated predictive distributions. Benchmarked against deep-learning and operational ECMWF S2S baselines over 2021-2022, our model achieves the highest deterministic and probabilistic skill at all lead times and reliably detects anomalously dry root-zone states (below the 20th percentile). Yet flash drought onset, defined by multi-pentad intensification criteria, remains a fundamental challenge shared across all current S2S systems. These findings advance data-driven S2S soil-moisture forecasting while highlighting the remaining challenge of predicting rapid drought development.

AI.tldr: 预测S2S土壤湿度时，预测技巧不仅取决于模型，更取决于问题如何表述，如残差学习与物理单位目标。
AI.motivation: 短中期天气预报已有进展，但突发干旱等高影响事件的S2S预测仍是挑战，需要研究数据驱动方法在土壤湿度S2S预测中的可预测性约束。
AI.method: 采用基于Vision Transformer的双路径时空注意力架构，结合残差学习；在物理单位而非标准化异常下预测根区土壤湿度；通过分位数头微调实现概率预测。
AI.result: 在2021-2022年欧洲S2S土壤湿度预测中，模型在所有预见期取得最高确定性与概率技巧，优于深度学习及ECMWF S2S基线，并能可靠识别低于20百分位的异常干燥根区状态。
AI.conclusion: 预测表述方式与目标表示显著影响技巧，推进了数据驱动S2S土壤湿度预测，但突发干旱起始预测仍是所有现有S2S系统的共同挑战。

title: Cascadia: Resident 975B MoE Inference on Eleven AI PCs
summary: Mixture-of-experts models make nearly trillion-parameter capacity accessible with sparse per-token computation, provided that the serving system can distribute the weights and coordinate their execution. We present Cascadia's resident execution of Inkling, a 975B-total/41B-active-parameter model, on eleven Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PCs, each with 64 GB of memory, Arc B390 integrated graphics and gigabit Ethernet. We contribute a custom resident MoE engine that preserves Inkling's routing rules, constructs compressed graphs for OpenVINO's fused iGPU primitives, and coordinates FP16 expert computation with FP32 output restoration. The engine fits six consecutive decoder layers per machine and represents dense feed-forward blocks as all-active expert slices, reducing measured dense-layer call time from approximately 8.1 to 4.5 ms. A streaming pipeline coordinates concurrent generation, while captured-state draft evaluation measures agreement with the deployed numerical path. Paired measurements at fifteen concurrency levels from 1 to 176 streams reach 60.29 aggregate decode tokens/s at 88 streams, with 46.87 tokens/s over the complete serving phases. At fifteen streams, median first-token latency is 6.05 s. Raising the context budget from the 1,024-position default, real prompts of 1k to 64k tokens recover the embedded code in all 19 measured answers, with first-token time growing as $aN+bN^2$ and decode latency growing approximately linearly, both bounded by a single-threaded CPU attention loop rather than by memory, which holds 512k positions per stream. Evaluation on captured fleet states separates the effects of vocabulary selection and weight quantization on draft agreement. Together, these contributions establish an execution and evaluation approach for large sparse models on distributed client systems with shared CPU-GPU memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Cascadia 系统性方案，在 11 台 Intel Core Ultra X7 358H AI PC 上以常驻方式执行 975B 总参数/41B 激活参数的 Inkling MoE 模型，通过定制 MoE 引擎、OpenVINO iGPU 融合图与流式流水线实现分布式客户端推理，聚合解码速度达 60.29 tokens/s（88 流并发）。
AI.motivation: 近万亿参数的 MoE 模型虽以稀疏逐 token 计算降低了算力需求，但其实用性取决于服务系统能否有效分布权重并协调执行。现有方案多依赖数据中心级硬件，缺乏在分布式客户端（共享 CPU-GPU 内存的 AI PC）上部署超大稀疏模型的执行与评估方法。
AI.method: 贡献了一套常驻式 MoE 引擎：保留 Inkling 的路由规则，为 OpenVINO 融合 iGPU 原语构建压缩计算图，并将 FP16 专家计算与 FP32 输出恢复相协调；每台机器承载六个连续解码层，把稠密前馈块表示为全激活专家切片；采用流式流水线协调并发生成，并使用捕获状态草稿评估来测量与部署数值路径的一致性。
AI.result: 稠密层调用时间由约 8.1 ms 降至 4.5 ms。在 1 至 176 流的十五个并发级别中，88 流时聚合解码达 60.29 tokens/s，完整服务阶段为 46.87 tokens/s；15 流时首 token 中位延迟 6.05 s。将上下文预算从 1024 提升后，1k–64k 真实提示在全部 19 个测量回答中均恢复出嵌入代码，首 token 时间按 aN+bN² 增长，解码延迟近似线性，瓶颈为单线程 CPU 注意力循环而非内存（每流可容纳 512k 位置）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一套面向分布式客户端系统（共享 CPU-GPU 内存）执行与评估大型稀疏模型的完整方案，验证了在消费级 AI PC 集群上常驻服务近万亿参数 MoE 模型的可行性，并分离了词表选择与权重量化对草稿一致性的影响。

title: A doctrine-grounded visual question answering dataset for Tactical Combat Casualty Care
comment: 20 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23170287; code: https://github.com/Kamaleswaran-Lab/TC3-VQA
summary: Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TC3) requires responders to connect visual observations of injuries and interventions with established clinical guidance. Developing vision-language models to support this process requires supervision that links visible evidence to traceable doctrine. We present TC3-VQA, a dataset constructed from public instructional and field TC3 videos and authoritative TC3 documents. It contains 581 items spanning 11 concepts, with 1,860 questions covering intervention recognition, doctrine, clinical reasoning, procedural guidance, and refusal when visual information is insufficient. Doctrine-based answers preserve verbatim source passages and character offsets. Construction combines visual annotation, passage retrieval, entailment checks, and verification across model families. Equipment boxes, anatomical labels, temporal segments, and source metadata accompany the question-answer pairs. Automated audits and ratings by two physicians and two medical students characterize annotation quality, with human ratings available for 88 retained items. The dataset provides a resource for adapting vision-language models to TC3, studying the connection between visual evidence and clinical knowledge, and evaluating recognition, doctrine recall, and abstention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TC3-VQA，一个面向战术战伤救治的视觉问答数据集，旨在为视觉语言模型建立"视觉证据—救治教条"的可追溯连接。
AI.motivation: 战术战伤救治（TC3）要求救援者将伤情视觉观察与既定临床指南相连接。开发支持该过程的视觉语言模型，需要能够将可见证据与可追溯教条联系起来的监督数据，而现有资源缺乏此类监督。
AI.method: 从公开的TC3教学与实战视频及权威TC3文档构建数据集。数据集含581个条目、覆盖11个概念，共1,860个问题，涵盖干预识别、教条问答、临床推理、操作指导以及在视觉信息不足时拒绝回答。构建流程包括视觉标注、段落检索、蕴含检查及跨模型家族的验证；基于教条的答案保留原文段落与字符偏移。问答对附带器械框、解剖标签、时序片段和来源元数据。通过自动化审计，以及两名医生和两名医学生的评分来评估标注质量。
AI.result: 获得覆盖11个概念、581个条目、1,860个问题的数据集，含丰富的多模态标注与可追溯的教条来源；88个保留条目具有人工评分，用于刻画标注质量。
AI.conclusion: TC3-VQA可作为资源，用于将视觉语言模型适配至TC3领域，研究视觉证据与临床知识之间的关联，并评估模型的识别、教条召回与拒答能力。

title: Learning to Simulate Individuals from Macro Social Signals
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate how individuals respond to new situations, yet the behavioral reasoning behind these responses is either inherited from pretraining or learned from individual-level annotations, which offer limited behavioral diversity and little supervision of the reasoning itself. We propose to learn behavioral reasoning from prediction markets, whose price trajectories record how populations respond to real-world events at scale. We introduce macro2mind, which trains a language model with GRPO using market signals. A social behavioral decomposition makes behavioral reasoning an explicit step of forecasting: the model infers representative groups of market participants, predicts how each interprets the news and updates its beliefs, reasons about their interactions, and aggregates these responses into a price. A hindsight-regret curriculum with difficulty-aware sampling focuses training on transitions where hindsight-identified groups substantially improve the forecast while prioritizing examples that remain learnable for the current policy. The learned reasoning applies to user simulation without further training. On SWM-Bench, macro2mind achieves state-of-the-art directional accuracy and correlation on Polymarket. Trained on market data, it transfers zero-shot to four user-simulation benchmarks (Humanual, OvertonBench, PRISM, and CAD) and has competitive performance among zero-shot methods. Used as a data generator, macro2mind also raises a downstream simulator's accuracy on unseen users by 15.5 points, outperforming data generated by its backbone by 13.2 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 macro2mind，利用预测市场的价格轨迹学习"行为推理"，用 GRPO 训练语言模型，使行为推理成为预测的显式步骤，并可零样本迁移到用户模拟任务。
AI.motivation: 现有用大模型模拟个体对新情境反应的方法存在局限：行为推理要么继承自预训练，要么从个体级标注中学习，而这类标注的行为多样性有限，且对推理过程本身缺乏监督。作者希望从预测市场——其价格轨迹大规模记录了人群如何应对真实事件——中学习行为推理。
AI.method: 提出 macro2mind，用市场信号配合 GRPO 训练语言模型。核心是"社会行为分解"，把行为推理显式化为预测步骤：推断市场参与者的代表性群体→预测各群体如何解读新闻并更新信念→推理群体间互动→将反应聚合为价格。训练上采用"后见之悔课程"（hindsight-regret curriculum）与难度感知采样，聚焦于后见识别出的群体能显著改善预测的转变，并优先选择当前策略仍可学习的样本。
AI.result: 在 SWM-Bench 上，macro2mind 在 Polymarket 数据上取得最优的方向准确率与相关性。仅用市场数据训练，即可零样本迁移到四个用户模拟基准（Humanual、OvertonBench、PRISM、CAD），在零样本方法中表现有竞争力。作为数据生成器，它使下游模拟器在未见用户上的准确率提升 15.5 个百分点，比其骨干模型生成的数据高出 13.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 行为推理可以从预测市场信号中习得，且无需额外训练即可迁移到用户模拟；该方法兼具预测与数据生成价值，为模拟人群行为提供了可扩展的新路径。

title: SPECTRUM: Proximal Spectral Modulation for Looped Self-Distillation
summary: A model that learns from its own outputs inherits more than their correctness: it inherits which solutions it produces. We formulate Looped Self-Distillation, a self-evolution framework for code generation in which a model repeatedly generates and learns from its own raw outputs, under a fixed information budget, without ongoing external assessment or test-based selection of the generated samples. We identify a consequential separation: correctness can improve while the breadth of correct implementations contracts. We introduce SPECTRUM, which re-estimates loss-sensitive key/value geometry from a fixed reference anchor at each round and converts it into full-rank proximal spectral modulation. All generated completions train a single student, whose subsequent inference requires no intervention. After five rounds of experiments on MBPP, SPECTRUM retains 89.9% of the initial model's 64-sample correct AST richness, compared with 66.4% for Vanilla self-distillation and 65.5% for a subspace-projection control. The advantage persists at matched correct-sample counts. Without further training or recalibration, the resulting student also achieves higher matched-correct richness than Vanilla SD on HumanEval+ and APPS Intro, demonstrating transfer of the diversity benefit. These findings establish correct-solution retention as a complementary objective of recursive self-improvement (RSI) and show that generation-time intervention can improve the solution repertoire retained by subsequent students.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Looped Self-Distillation框架，揭示自蒸馏中正确性提升与解空间多样性收窄的分离现象，并设计SPECTRUM方法在固定信息预算下缓解多样性流失。
AI.motivation: 模型从自身输出学习时，不仅继承其正确性，也继承其产出的解集合。递归自我改进中，正确率可能上升，但正确实现的多样性（广度）会收缩，这一后果此前未被充分认识。作者希望把"正确解保留"确立为RSI的补充目标。
AI.method: 提出Looped Self-Distillation：模型在固定信息预算下反复生成并学习自身原始输出，不做持续外部评估或基于测试的样本筛选。引入SPECTRUM，在每轮中从固定参考锚点重新估计对损失敏感的key/value几何结构，并将其转化为满秩近端谱调制；所有生成样本训练单一学生模型，推理阶段无需额外干预。
AI.result: 在MBPP上经过五轮实验，SPECTRUM保留了初始模型64样本正确AST丰富度的89.9%，而Vanilla自蒸馏为66.4%、子空间投影对照为65.5%；在匹配正确样本数量下优势依然存在。无需再训练或重校准，所得学生在HumanEval+和APPS Intro上也取得高于Vanilla SD的匹配正确丰富度，表明多样性收益可迁移。
AI.conclusion: 正确解保留可作为递归自我改进的补充目标；生成时干预能够改善后续学生模型所保留的解集合丰富度，说明自演化过程中需同时关注正确性与多样性。

title: Tracking Is Not Permanence: What Video World Models Keep of a Hidden Object
summary: Video world models track objects they can see; we ask what they keep of objects they cannot. We hide an object from a frozen V-JEPA 2 predictor and compare its prediction for the hidden region with the encoder's representation of two worlds that differ only inside that region. The predictor's decision keeps a stationary object in part and one carried inside a container not at all, and loses a moving one within 0.3 s (0.5 s under V-JEPA's own tube mask; ViT-H keeps it to 1.1 s at pretraining's 90% masking ratio); in projection a trace remains, below the midpoint, at 14-60% of what a baseline copying the last view retains. The information is there: the encoder reads the object's presence at 1.00 and keeps a closed container's contents decodable for 3.5 s, while the predictor's output, read with the encoder's own probe, contains the ball in 2% of scenes once the box has been closed for half a second. On rendered scenes, permanence is missing on the predictor's side, and training installs it cheaply as a prior: three thousand predictor-only steps on synthetic containers take this belief from 0.05 to 1.00 against two matched controls. They also raise IntPhys-2019 from 84.2% to 93.3%, but so does a curriculum without containers, and which training habit the benchmark credits changes with its scoring rule. Continued training with tube masks produces 1.1-1.6 s of moving-object carry-over on manipulation and internet-style video, so the deficit is not intrinsic to latent prediction. VideoMAE keeps almost nothing, and Cosmos's next-token prediction keeps a stationary hidden object but not one carried inside a moving container.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究视频世界模型（以V-JEPA 2为代表）能否在物体被遮挡后仍保留其表征。研究发现冻结的预测器对隐藏物体的保持能力很差：静止物体仅部分保留、容器内物体几乎完全丢失、运动物体0.3秒内消失，而编码器本身其实"知道"物体存在。这说明物体永久性缺失是预测器侧的缺陷，且可通过少量训练廉价地安装为先验。
AI.motivation: 视频世界模型能追踪看得见的物体，但作者关心一个核心问题：模型对被遮挡、看不见的物体还保留了多少信息？物体永久性（object permanence）是人类直觉物理的关键，作者想检验当前的潜在视频预测模型是否具备这种能力。
AI.method: 作者采用"探测"方法：将物体从冻结的V-JEPA 2预测器中隐藏，比较其对隐藏区域的预测与编码器对两个"仅在该区域不同"的世界的表征。同时对比不同模型（ViT-H、VideoMAE、Cosmos）、不同掩码设置（tube mask、90%掩码率），并用编码器自身的探针去读取预测器输出。此外还做了仅用3000步预测器训练的实验，并设置两个匹配对照，以及在IntPhys-2019上评估。
AI.result: 预测器部分保留静止物体，但对容器内物体完全不保留，运动物体0.3秒内丢失（tube mask下0.5秒；ViT-H在90%掩码下保持到1.1秒），投影中仅残留基线14-60%的信息，低于中点。而编码器能1.00读出物体存在、对闭合容器内容可解码3.5秒；预测器输出在盒子关闭半秒后仅2%场景含球。3000步预测器训练可将该信念从0.05提升到1.00，并把IntPhys-2019从84.2%提升到93.3%，但无容器的课程也有同样效果。带tube mask的持续训练在操作和互联网风格视频上产生1.1-1.6秒的运动物体保持。VideoMAE几乎不留任何信息，Cosmos能保留静止隐藏物体但不能保留移动容器内的物体。
AI.conclusion: 物体永久性的缺失并非潜在预测的内在属性，而是可归因于训练习惯的缺陷。信息在编码器中是存在的，问题出在预测器侧，且该能力可以通过少量训练廉价地安装为一种先验。不同训练习惯与基准评分规则会影响结果，说明这种信念的习得具有可塑性和条件依赖性。

title: What Must Replay Preserve? Separating Correctable Bias from Class Correspondence
summary: Class-incremental learning must recognize all classes seen so far without task labels. Logit replay methods such as DER and DER++ mitigate forgetting by matching the model's past predictions on stored examples. Deleting this matching reveals its benefit, but the resulting accuracy cost cannot show whether the stored scores themselves are needed, or whether the cost survives correction of the classifier's bias toward recent classes. We propose a diagnostic framework that treats a cached prediction as temporally heterogeneous supervision: it separates classes known when an example was stored from classes learned afterward, edits each group, and evaluates every model before and after a task-level offset that leaves within-task predictions unchanged. On CIFAR-100 with DER++, suitable fixed constants replace the unrefreshed stored scores of later-learned classes within an equivalence margin of 1 percentage point, and the offset reduces the cost of deleting their matching from 14.9 to 1.8 points. Reassigning the non-gold scores of classes known at storage, which preserves their values and each task's target probability, costs 4.3 points before and 4.0 after the offset, and a parallel cost persists in image distillation. In the tested fixed-head setting, the large cost of deleting later-class matching is thus mostly correctable by this offset, whereas the smaller cost of disrupting class correspondence persists. Code and data are available at anonymous.4open.science/r/replay-preserve-E22B.

AI.tldr: 提出诊断框架，将缓存预测视为时间异质监督，揭示logit replay中大部分遗忘代价可由任务级偏移修正。
AI.motivation: logit replay方法（如DER、DER++）通过匹配存储样本的过去预测来缓解遗忘，但删除该匹配后的精度损失无法判断存储分数本身是否必要，也无法判断该损失是否在修正分类器对近期类别的偏置后仍存在。
AI.method: 诊断框架：①将缓存预测视为时间异质监督，区分存储时已知类别与之后学到的类别，分别编辑；②在每个模型上评估任务级偏移前后表现，该偏移不改变任务内预测。
AI.result: CIFAR-100+DER++上，合适固定常数可在1个百分点等价边界内替代后期类别的未刷新存储分数；偏移将删除这些匹配的代价从14.9降至1.8个点。重分配存储时已知类别的非金分数代价为4.3（偏移前）与4.0（偏移后），图像蒸馏中类似的代价持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 在固定头设定下，删除后期类别匹配的大代价大多可通过任务级偏移修正，而破坏类别对应关系产生的较小代价则持续存在。

title: Can Semantic Geometry Teach an AI Judgement?
comment: 16 pages, 6 figures. Four bounded studies of semantic measurements for pre-action judgment; consequence-graph hypothesis remains untested
summary:
How can an AI agent determine what rules to follow? One rule permits an action. Another imposes a condition, exception, or conflicting obligation. Deterministic systems can resolve those relationships when they have been specified. When they remain implicit in language, an agent can follow one rule while missing another that should stop it. Refusing every unresolved action avoids that risk, but also blocks permissible actions.
  We wanted the agent to make the distinction and still act. Our initial hypothesis was that geometric measurements could supply a basis for judgment. We represented actions and policies as vectors, then tested whether their geometry could identify governing policies and interpret the action's relation to them.
  Across four studies, the tested approaches did not establish reliable pre-action judgment. In the final synthetic study, a lexical router recovered every governing and blocking policy while reducing median policy checks by 97.7%. The composed pipeline nevertheless escalated all 2,304 test actions, including those it should have allowed. Supplying every policy to the same downstream mechanism changed no decision. Finding the policies had not solved the problem of interpreting them.
  This result led us to revise our hypothesis: judgment in AI agents requires developing a consequence graph. Such a graph would connect the actor and authority to policy conditions, exceptions, and the changes an action would produce. Follow-on studies will ask whether making those relationships explicit helps the agent distinguish when to act, stop, or seek review.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI智能体如何判断应遵循哪条规则，尝试用几何方法进行行动前判断，四轮研究均未成功，最终转向"后果图"假设。
AI.motivation: 智能体面临多条规则时，规则间的关系（许可、条件、例外、冲突义务）若隐含于语言中，智能体可能遵守一条却忽略本应阻止它的另一条。全面拒绝所有未解决行动虽可避险，却也会阻碍本应允许的行动，因此需要让智能体做出区分并依然行动。
AI.method: 初始假设为几何测量可提供判断依据：将行动与策略表示为向量，检验其几何关系能否识别主导策略并解释行动与策略的关系。共开展四项研究，最后一项为合成研究，采用词法路由器检索所有主导与阻断策略，并与下游机制组成流水线进行测试。
AI.result: 四项研究均未建立可靠的行动前判断。最终合成研究中，词法路由器成功找回全部主导与阻断策略，策略检查中位数减少97.7%，但组合流水线仍将全部2304个测试行动升级处理，包括本应被允许的行动；即使提供全部策略，下游机制决策也毫无变化。
AI.conclusion: 找到策略并不等于解决策略解释问题。作者据此修正假设：AI智能体的判断需要构建"后果图"，将行动者与权威同策略条件、例外及行动后果相连接。后续研究将检验显式化这些关系能否帮助智能体区分何时行动、停止或请求复核。

title: Identity-Conditioned Score Fusion for Open-Set Person Re-Identification
summary: Robust person re-identification often combines complementary cues such as face, gait, and body shape. While adaptive fusion typically targets query quality, model strength also varies across identities. We introduce identity-conditioned score fusion, a framework that tailors weights to each gallery identity without training. By contrasting intra-identity consistency against cross-identity impostors, it extracts identity-specific profiles that couple with query-conditioned adaptation via a parameter-free rule. This widens the separation between true and false matches while preserving score calibration. Evaluations on three clothes-changing person re-identification benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms statistical, rank-based, and learned baselines, achieving up to an 8.8% absolute reduction in the false non-identification rate and demonstrating the value of identity-conditioned fusion in open-set person re-identification.

AI.tldr: 提出身份条件化得分融合（identity-conditioned score fusion），无需训练即可为每个底库身份定制权重，与查询条件自适应结合，提升开集行人重识别性能。
AI.motivation: 鲁棒的行人重识别常融合人脸、步态、体形等多种互补线索。现有多数自适应融合方法只关注查询质量，但不同身份的模型强度也存在差异，融合权重应随底库身份而变，这一因素被忽视。
AI.method: 提出身份条件化得分融合框架，无需训练即可针对每个底库身份定制权重。通过对比同一身份内部的得分一致性与跨身份冒充者得分，提取身份特异性画像，并用无参数规则与查询条件自适应相结合。
AI.result: 在三个换装行人重识别基准上评估，方法持续优于统计类、基于排名类和学习类基线，错误未识别率（FNIR）绝对下降最高达8.8%。
AI.conclusion: 身份条件化融合能扩大真匹配与假匹配的得分间隔并保持分数校准，在开集行人重识别中具有明显价值。

title: Few-Shot Bioactivity Prediction with Meta-Learning under Assay Heterogeneity
summary: Accurate bioactivity prediction is a central challenge in early-stage drug discovery, as individual assays often contain too few measurements to train reliable models independently. Meta-learning offers a principled approach to this few-shot setting, but assay heterogeneity may limit its effectiveness. Here, we test this hypothesis and show that meta-learning performance degrades as meta-training tasks become more heterogeneous. To address this, we introduce MetaHeta, a meta-learning framework that accounts for assay heterogeneity by conditioning predictions on auxiliary data from related assays, with relatedness defined flexibly from available assay information. The architecture of MetaHeta combines linear attention over large auxiliary datasets with exact attention over scarce task-specific context, enabling efficient scaling to the former without compromising exact attention over the latter. We demonstrate the benefits of our approach on assays from ChEMBL and BindingDB, improving few-shot bioactivity prediction and downstream compound prioritization in retrospective Bayesian optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaHeta 元学习框架，通过引入相关 assay 的辅助数据来缓解 assay 异质性，提升少样本生物活性预测与化合物优先级排序性能。
AI.motivation: 早期药物发现中单个 assay 测量数据过少，难以独立训练可靠预测模型。元学习适合少样本场景，但 assay 之间异质性可能削弱其效果，本文旨在验证该假设并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 先验证元学习性能随元训练任务异质性增加而下降的假设；然后提出 MetaHeta，通过在相关 assay 的辅助数据上进行条件化预测来应对异质性，相关性可灵活定义。架构上结合对大规模辅助数据的线性注意力与对稀缺任务上下文数据的精确注意力。
AI.result: 在 ChEMBL 与 BindingDB 的 assay 数据上验证了方法的优势，改善了少样本生物活性预测，并在回顾性贝叶斯优化中提升了下游化合物优先级排序效果。
AI.conclusion: MetaHeta 通过显式建模 assay 异质性，兼顾高效扩展与精确任务建模，为少样本生物活性预测提供了有效方案，并有益于下游药物发现任务。

title: Internalizing Agent Experience into Diffusion Model Weights via On-Policy Context Distillation
summary: Wrapping an image generation model in an agentic harness can effectively boost Text-to-Image task performance: the harness can leverage memory, skills, workflow orchestration, result verification, and iterative refinement to continually construct and revise prompts, thereby eliciting better images. These gains, however, remain external to the diffusion model and are realized only while the full harness runs. We propose Diffusion On-Policy Context Distillation (D-OPCD), which treats the agent-improved prompt as privileged context and distills the knowledge encoded in the agent harness into the weights of the diffusion model, so that the model retains part of the harness's benefit when conditioned on the original query alone. Using a Text-to-Image agent equipped with our proposed Auto Skill Evolver (ASE), we show that D-OPCD can internalize harness capabilities into the generator's weights, raising the average direct-generation score from 60.52 to 65.09 across four benchmarks. With this knowledge absorbed into the weights, the harness can shed its saturated skills and resume evolving: a second ASE round on the updated generator improves on a skill-free harness by additional 1.83 points, pointing toward text-to-image systems in which harness and model keep improving each other through continual co-evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出D-OPCD方法，把agent增强提示作为特权上下文蒸馏进扩散模型权重，使模型仅凭原始查询也能保留harness收益，实现harness与模型协同进化。
AI.motivation: 将图像生成模型包裹在agentic harness中可显著提升文生图性能，但增益外在于扩散模型，只在完整harness运行时才有效。作者希望把harness编码的知识内化到模型权重中。
AI.method: D-OPCD（Diffusion On-Policy Context Distillation）把agent改进后的提示视为特权上下文，将其知识蒸馏进扩散模型权重；并配合所提出的Auto Skill Evolver（ASE）构建文生图agent。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，直接生成的平均得分从60.52提升至65.09；权重吸收知识后harness可舍弃饱和技能并继续进化，第二轮ASE在更新后的生成器上比无技能harness再提升1.83分。
AI.conclusion: D-OPCD可将harness能力内化到生成器权重中，指向harness与模型通过持续协同进化相互提升的文生图系统。

title: SimCortex v2: Joint Cortical Surface Reconstruction with Near-Zero Collisions and Self-Intersections
summary: Reconstructing cortical WM and pial surfaces from structural magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is a prerequisite for surface-based neuroanatomical analysis, yet remains challenging because the cortex is thin and tightly folded. Reconstruction methods can produce geometric artifacts such as mesh self-intersections and collisions between cortical surfaces, and although recent deep learning methods have reduced reconstruction time from hours to minutes, these artifacts persist. We propose SimCortex v2, a deep learning framework for simultaneous reconstruction of the left and right WM and pial surfaces from T1-weighted MRI. SimCortex v2 estimates topologically correct initial surfaces from a volumetric segmentation and refines all four jointly using multi-scale stationary velocity fields predicted by a ribbon-conditioned, U-Net-like network. We evaluated SimCortex v2 on 560 cases from 14 cohorts, thirteen of them unseen during training, spanning ages 6-89, healthy and clinical populations, and scanners from three vendors. SimCortex v2 matched the surface-distance accuracy of the strongest baseline (average symmetric surface distance 0.253 mm) while showing no detected inter-surface collision in 92.14% of cases and the lowest self-intersection fraction (0.044%) among learning-based methods, whereas every baseline produced at least one collision in every case. Source code, configuration files, pretrained weights, preprocessed data, and the exact evaluation splits are publicly released.

AI.tldr: SimCortex v2 是一个深度学习框架，可同时重建左右半球的白质与软膜表面，在保证精度的同时显著减少几何伪影。
AI.motivation: 从结构 MRI 重建皮层白质与软膜表面是表面神经解剖分析的前提，但皮层薄且折叠紧密导致重建困难。现有方法易产生网格自相交和皮层表面间的碰撞等几何伪影，即使深度学习已将重建时间从数小时缩短至数分钟，这些伪影仍然存在。
AI.method: SimCortex v2 从体素分割中估计拓扑正确的初始表面，并利用带状条件（ribbon-conditioned）的类 U-Net 网络预测多尺度静态速度场，对左右半球四个表面进行联合细化。
AI.result: 在来自 14 个队列的 560 例（其中 13 个队列训练时未见）、覆盖 6–89 岁健康与临床人群、三家厂商扫描仪的测试中，SimCortex v2 达到最强基线相当的表面距离精度（平均对称表面距离 0.253 mm），92.14% 的案例未检测到表面间碰撞，具有学习方法中最低的自相交比例（0.044%），而所有基线在每个案例中均至少产生一次碰撞。
AI.conclusion: SimCortex v2 在保持高精度的同时有效抑制了几何伪影，且公开了源代码、配置、预训练权重、预处理数据与评测划分，具有良好可复现性。

title: When Attention Does Not Explain the Peak: Temporal Reference vs. Forecast Output in Attention-Based Time-Series Forecasting
comment: NeurIPS 2026: Accepted to the TAE (Trust-AI-Eval) Workshop
summary: Attention maps are often interpreted as evidence of what a forecasting model uses when making predictions. In our load-forecasting model, a CLS representation of historical demand queries 24 future exogenous horizon tokens through cross-attention, inviting a temporal interpretation in which highly attended horizons may appear to explain forecast peak timing. We test this interpretation using a horizon-level attention descriptor, $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$. Across 31 day-aligned windows of the Panama load dataset, the forecast achieves a median peak-time error of 0 h and a 51.6% exact-match rate, whereas the argmax of $Ψ_{\mathrm{out}}$ has a median error of 5 h and 0% exact match. The forecast peak is closer to the observed peak in 27 of 31 windows. This dissociation is not merely an argmax artifact: within $\pm1$ h, attention reaches only $1.16\times$, $1.11\times$, and $1.14\times$ the uniform baseline around observed, predicted, and weekly-naive peaks, respectively, indicating weak and non-selective concentration. Yet the attention profile is structured, with cross-window consistency of 0.83. Replacing 12 future weather features with their training-set means makes the profile nearly uniform, showing sensitivity to future weather variation rather than fixed horizon position alone. The dissociation is also reproduced across three random-seed runs. These results show that structured, input-sensitive, and reproducible horizon-level cross-attention need not provide a valid peak-selective explanation of forecast behavior. The observed behavior is instead consistent with an internal horizon-reference role for integrating future exogenous information, although this functional role is not causally established.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验了负荷预测模型中跨注意力图能否作为预测峰值时间的有效解释，发现注意力结构与预测行为存在解离，注意力并非峰值选择性解释。
AI.motivation: 注意力图常被解读为模型预测所依赖的证据，尤其在负荷预测中，高度关注的未来时段看似能解释峰值时间。作者希望检验这种时间性解释是否成立。
AI.method: 提出时段级注意力描述子Ψ_out，在Panama负荷数据集31个日对齐窗口上比较预测峰值与注意力argmax；并通过±1小时范围内的注意力集中度、跨窗口一致性（0.83）、替换12个未来天气特征为训练集均值等消融实验，以及三个随机种子重复验证。
AI.result: 预测峰值时间中位误差0小时、精确匹配率51.6%，而Ψ_out的argmax中位误差5小时、精确匹配率0%；27/31窗口中预测峰值更接近观测峰值。±1小时内注意力仅达均匀基线的1.16×、1.11×、1.14×，集中度弱且非选择性。替换天气特征后注意力近似均匀，说明其对未来天气变化敏感而非固定时段位置。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的、输入敏感的、可复现的时段级跨注意力并不必然提供有效的峰值选择性解释；其行为更符合内部时段参考作用，用于整合未来外生信息，但该功能角色尚未经因果确立。

title: MemMux: Runtime Verification and Honest Resource Attribution for Fleets of Parallel Coding Agents
summary: Developers increasingly run a fleet of coding agents side by side on one workstation. The tools they reach for, terminal multiplexers like tmux and a new generation of agent managers, were built to arrange windows, not to govern memory. When ten agents each spawn language servers, test runners, and browsers, no standard tool can say how much memory belongs to which agent, confirm that a terminated agent's descendants are gone, notice a child that has escaped its agent, or keep the machine off the swap cliff when an OOM kill would silently discard uncommitted work. We treat these as runtime-verification problems: an agent-hosting substrate should continuously emit observable signals an operator or auditor can check while agents run. We present MemMux, a local runtime that turns resource governance into checkable signals (per-agent attribution, complete reclamation, escaped-process visibility, bounded footprint under overcommit, and monitoring overhead), with a claims-disciplined benchmark against tmux, a purpose-built agent multiplexer, and a raw-process baseline on identical workloads. Under a binding memory budget on a Linux host, MemMux keeps the fleet under budget (7.5 GiB) with zero swap by admitting a subset and reclaiming under pressure, while the ungoverned tools run every agent, pin the machine at its RAM ceiling (2x over budget), and spill about 2 GiB into swap. MemMux reclaims 100% of a terminated agent's process subtree where the raw baseline strands half of it, and it alone surfaces escaped children (10 of 10 detected). We report the cost: the 1 Hz attribution scan runs near 0.6% CPU at one agent but 2.7% at ten, above our 2% target. Running the harness on real Claude Code sessions shows 100% attribution and low overhead carry over to live agent trees. We release the engine, benchmark, and a one-command reproducer.

AI.tldr: MemMux 是一个本地运行时资源治理系统，将多智能体内存管理转化为可验证信号，以在内存预算内运行智能体集群并避免 swap 溢出。
AI.motivation: 开发者常在一台工作站上并行运行多个编码智能体，但现有工具（如 tmux）只用于窗口管理，无法治理内存。当十个智能体各自启动语言服务器、测试运行器和浏览器时，没有标准工具能判断内存归属、确认进程回收、发现逃逸子进程，或在 OOM 前避免 swap 溢出导致未提交工作丢失。作者将这些问题视为运行时验证问题。
AI.method: 提出 MemMux，一个将资源治理转化为可检查信号的本地运行时，包括每智能体归属、完整回收、逃逸进程可见性、超卖下的有界占用和监控开销。在相同工作负载下，与 tmux、专用智能体复用器和裸进程基线进行基准对比。
AI.result: 在 Linux 主机的严格内存预算下，MemMux 将集群控制在 7.5 GiB 预算内且零 swap，通过准入子集和压力回收实现；而未治理工具运行所有智能体，使内存达到上限（超预算 2 倍）并将约 2 GiB 溢出到 swap。MemMux 可回收终止智能体进程子树的 100%，而裸基线仅回收一半；且只有它能发现逃逸子进程（10/10 检测到）。代价是 1 Hz 归属扫描在单智能体时 CPU 占用约 0.6%，十个智能体时达 2.7%，高于 2% 目标。
AI.conclusion: 在真实 Claude Code 会话上运行测试框架显示，100% 归属和低开销可延续到实际智能体进程树。作者发布引擎、基准测试和一键复现脚本。

title: GeoWM: Efficient Direct World Modeling in Explicit Geometry
summary: Modeling 3D scene geometry and its evolution over time is essential for autonomous driving and robotics. A common paradigm is to use world models to predict future images or latent representations of the environment and subsequently recover geometry from these predictions. However, this paradigm does not explicitly model geometric structure and typically relies on recursive rollouts to reach longer prediction horizons, leading to error accumulation and increasing computational cost. To address these limitations, we present GeoWM, a geometry world model that directly forecasts future scene geometry at specified future horizons without recursive rollout. The key idea is to leverage a geometry foundation model to transform observed RGB frames into a geometric history, which conditions a flow-matching transformer to predict the scene geometry at a specified future horizon. We further show that a lightweight camera-motion predictor can accurately estimate the future viewpoint, and that projecting the observed geometry into the predicted viewpoint provides an effective geometric prior for future geometry forecasting. Extensive experiments on four datasets spanning urban driving, aerial flight, and dynamic manipulation demonstrate that GeoWM outperforms the evaluated world models in forecasting depth, camera pose, and 3D scene geometry, while substantially reducing inference time at longer horizons.

AI.tldr: GeoWM 是一个几何世界模型，利用几何基础模型将观测 RGB 帧转化为几何历史，并用流匹配 Transformer 直接预测指定未来时刻的场景几何，避免递归展开带来的误差累积与计算开销。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶与机器人需要建模三维场景几何及其随时间的演化。常见做法是用世界模型预测未来图像或潜表示再恢复几何，但这种方式未显式建模几何结构，且需递归展开以达到较长的预测时域，导致误差累积和计算成本上升。
AI.method: GeoWM 直接预测指定未来时域的场景几何，无需递归展开。其核心是借助几何基础模型把观测到的 RGB 帧转换为几何历史，用以条件化一个流匹配 Transformer 来预测指定未来时刻的场景几何。此外引入轻量级相机运动预测器估计未来视点，并将观测几何投影到预测视点，作为未来几何预测的有效几何先验。
AI.result: 在涵盖城市驾驶、空中飞行和动态操作的四个数据集上的大量实验表明，GeoWM 在深度、相机位姿和三维场景几何预测方面优于所评估的世界模型，同时在较长时域下大幅降低推理时间。
AI.conclusion: GeoWM 通过直接预测未来几何并结合几何先验，在精度与效率上均优于现有世界模型，为长时域几何预测提供了有效方案。

title: SchemaFill: Efficient LLM Tool Calling via Slot-Parallel Speculative Decoding
summary: LLM agents interact with external systems by generating structured tool calls. Given a user request, conversational context, and a catalog of tool schemas, a tool-calling model must select tools and generate their arguments, potentially producing multiple calls in a single response. Standard autoregressive decoding generates these calls token by token, incurring substantial latency for requests involving multiple calls or many argument fields. The explicit argument structure offers opportunities for parallel generation, but later argument values may depend on preceding fields and calls, so independently generated values can differ from the target model's output. We present SchemaFill, a framework for efficient LLM tool calling through slot-parallel speculative decoding. SchemaFill generates future slot values concurrently as candidates, without requiring advance knowledge of the actual call sequence or argument values. Candidates spanning multiple fields and calls are concatenated for verification by the target model under the actual output prefix. Only verified tokens are committed, and the target supplies corrections when candidates disagree. This applies target verification while exploiting parallelism across slots and calls. On Glaive and BFCL, SchemaFill achieves up to a 4.05$\times$ improvement in end-to-end throughput over autoregressive decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill.

AI.tldr: SchemaFill 是一个用于 LLM 工具调用的槽位并行推测解码框架，通过并发生成多个字段和调用的候选值并经目标模型验证，实现最高 4.05 倍的端到端吞吐提升。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体通过生成结构化工具调用来与外部系统交互，标准自回归解码逐 token 生成，在涉及多次调用或多个参数字段时延迟较高。虽然显式参数结构提供了并行生成的机会，但后续参数值可能依赖前面的字段和调用，独立生成的值可能与目标模型输出不同。
AI.method: 提出 SchemaFill 框架，采用槽位并行推测解码。它在无需预知实际调用序列或参数值的情况下，并发生成未来槽位值作为候选；将跨越多个字段和调用的候选拼接后，在实际输出前缀下由目标模型验证；仅提交通过验证的 token，当候选不一致时由目标模型提供修正，从而在槽位和调用间实现并行同时应用目标验证。
AI.result: 在 Glaive 和 BFCL 数据集上，SchemaFill 相比自回归解码实现了最高 4.05 倍的端到端吞吐提升。代码开源于 https://github.com/Czzzk/SchemaFill。
AI.conclusion: SchemaFill 通过对工具调用参数槽位的并发生成与目标模型验证，有效降低了多调用、多参数字段场景下的解码延迟，在保持输出准确性的同时显著提升吞吐效率。

title: Verifying Coordination in Parallel Coding Agents: NP-Bench and a Scheduling Planner
summary: A team of coding agents can look fine agent by agent yet fail as a team: each passes its own tests while the merged result is broken, and single-agent evaluation never catches it. As teams run several LLM coding agents in parallel on one codebase, the agents collide: two rewrite the same function, one codes against a contract a teammate just changed, and integration fails after the work is done. Most coordination tools react (watch for a conflict, then warn), but at agent speed the warning arrives after the wasted edit. We recast the problem as scheduling: take each work item's declared scope, partition the work into disjoint scopes, and order merges along the producer->consumer graph, all up front. We build this planner into Nerveplane and evaluate it with NP-Bench, an environment-grounded three-arm benchmark (no coordination; reactive detection; proactive planning) that verifies integration off a real git merge, both in a deterministic simulation and with live agents. The planner lifts clean-integration from 1/9 to 9/9 scenarios and cuts merge conflicts from 13 to 0, with a gap that grows in the number of agents. On a live breaking contract change it rescues an outcome both baselines miss on every seed: the clean-integration rate rises from 0 (no coordination and reactive detection) to 1.0 on a frontier model and 0.6 on a small one, while agents respect assigned scopes (0/5 leakage). A cross-session memory drops the repeated-mistake rate from 1.00 to 0.00 on strong and weak models alike. We also report a negative result: routing facts to agents does not rescue long-context accuracy at window-fitting scales; its value is cost and capacity, not attention. Across two capability tiers and two vendors, the benefit did not shrink as models got stronger, because it comes from how work is allocated, not model reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多智能体并行编码中的协调失败重新表述为"调度问题"，提出先验规划器 Nerveplane，通过划分互斥作用域并按生产者->消费者图排序合并，配合 NP-Bench 基准验证，将干净集成率从 1/9 提升至 9/9、合并冲突从 13 降至 0。
AI.motivation: 多智能体编码团队常常"个体合格、整体失败"：各智能体各自通过测试，但合并后结果损坏，单智能体评估无法发现。并行运行时智能体会相互碰撞——两人重写同一函数、一人依据队友刚改动的契约编码，集成在完工后才失败。现有协调工具多为"反应式"（发现冲突再警告），但在智能体速度下警告往往在无效编辑之后才到达，造成浪费。因此需要将协调问题前置，从调度视角提前解决冲突。
AI.method: 作者将问题重构为调度：依据每个工作项声明的作用域，把工作划分为互不重叠的 scopes，并沿 producer→consumer 依赖图提前排定合并顺序。该规划器被集成进 Nerveplane 系统，并用 NP-Bench 评估——这是一个基于真实环境的"三臂"基准（无协调／反应式检测／主动式规划），在真实 git merge 上验证集成，同时覆盖确定性模拟与实时智能体两种设置。此外还引入跨会话记忆，并测试了向智能体"路由事实"以应对长上下文的效果。
AI.result: 规划器将干净集成场景从 1/9 提升到 9/9，合并冲突从 13 降到 0，且差距随智能体数量增加而扩大。在实时破坏性契约变更情境中，该规划器挽救了两个基线在每个随机种子上都失败的结果：干净集成率由 0（无协调与反应式检测）升至前沿模型的 1.0、小模型的 0.6，同时智能体遵守分配的作用域（0/5 越界）。跨会话记忆将重复错误率从 1.00 降至 0.00，强、弱模型均如此。负面结果：将事实路由给智能体并不能在窗口适配规模下挽救长上下文准确率，其价值在于成本与容量，而非注意力。在两个能力层级和两家供应商上，收益未随模型变强而缩小，说明收益来自工作分配方式而非模型推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体编码的协调失败本质是调度与工作分配问题，而非模型推理能力问题；前置的主动规划（作用域划分＋依赖排序）能显著提升集成成功率并随团队规模扩大而愈发有效，且不受模型强度或供应商差异影响。跨会话记忆能有效消除重复错误。相反，事实路由并非提升长上下文能力的有效手段，其价值局限于成本与容量层面。

title: WildMatch: Weakly Supervised Image Matcher Adaptation for Wildlife Re-Identification
comment: 15 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://wildmatch.gmum.net
summary: Individual animal re-identification from camera-trap imagery is an instance retrieval problem central to non-invasive wildlife monitoring: a query image must retrieve the correct individual from a reference set of known animals. This requires computer vision models to recognize distinctive local patterns in fur, skin, or other visual markings. Current approaches either learn global embeddings as a classification problem, requiring many labeled images per individual while largely ignoring local evidence, or apply off-the-shelf, domain-agnostic image matchers. Although such matchers are pretrained on large and diverse image collections, adapting them to wildlife imagery is challenging because available datasets are small and lack correspondence-level annotations. We study weakly supervised adaptation of a pretrained keypoint matcher using only identity labels, without keypoint-level or geometric correspondence ground truth. We mine informative image pairs with the pretrained matcher, derive weak positive and negative supervision from identity agreement, and contrastively fine-tune the matching network to strengthen correspondences for same-identity pairs and suppress them for different identities. Across open-source wildlife re-identification datasets, our approach improves accuracy over off-the-shelf matchers and a state-of-the-art local--global fusion method. Under an open-world protocol with held-out individuals, it learns a transferable correspondence prior rather than memorizing training identities. To our knowledge, this is the first study of matcher-level, identity-supervised adaptation for animal re-identification. Our method enables data-efficient specialization of image matching models to wildlife domains using identity annotations already available in typical monitoring datasets.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何仅用身份标签对预训练关键点匹配器进行弱监督适配，以实现相机陷阱图像的动物个体重识别。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么依赖全局嵌入的分类训练、需大量个体标注且忽略局部特征，要么直接使用域无关的现成图像匹配器，而野生动物数据集小且缺乏对应级标注，难以适配。
AI.method: 用预训练匹配器挖掘信息量大的图像对，依据身份一致性构造弱正负监督，并以对比方式微调匹配网络，增强同身份对应、抑制异身份对应，无需关键点或几何对应真值。
AI.result: 在多个开源野生动物重识别数据集上，方法优于现成匹配器和先进的局部-全局融合方法；在留出个体的开放世界协议下也有效。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个面向动物重识别的匹配器级身份监督适配研究，学习到可迁移的对应先验而非记忆训练身份，可用现有身份标注实现数据高效的域特化。

title: Muon Is Theoretically Wrong For Convolutions, But Empirically Effective
summary: Muon, an optimizer known for its efficiency, has a clear interpretation for matrix-valued updates, but convolutional kernels are stored as four-dimensional tensors. Standard implementations reshape these tensors into matrices, a shortcut which breaks the theoretical understanding behind Muon. To investigate this, we formalize the corresponding optimization objective directly in convolutional operator geometry and introduce Convolutional Newton-Schulz (Conv-NS), which approximates the polar factor in this geometry while preserving kernel support. When applied in fast training experiments, Conv-NS and reshape-based Muon are both computationally efficient and achieve comparable accuracy on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet classification tasks. However, as one could expect a theoretically aligned Conv-NS to outperform reshape-based Muon, we investigate this mismatch between practice and theoretical understanding, with the hypothesis that exact convolutional orthogonalization may overconstrain updates. These findings highlight Muon's strong practical performance while opening directions for its further development on convolutions. Our code is publicly available at \href{https://github.com/thib-s/muonconv-cifar10-airbench}{github conv-muon}.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Muon优化器在卷积核上的理论解释问题，提出在卷积算子几何中直接形式化优化目标并引入Conv-NS方法，实验发现其与reshape版Muon性能相当，二者高效但精度接近。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器对矩阵值更新有清晰的理论解释，但卷积核以四维张量存储，标准实现将其reshape为矩阵，这一捷径破坏了Muon背后的理论理解。作者希望探究在卷积算子几何中直接形式化优化目标是否能带来更好的效果。
AI.method: 作者在卷积算子几何中直接形式化对应的优化目标，并提出Convolutional Newton-Schulz（Conv-NS），该方法在该几何下近似极因子（polar factor），同时保持卷积核的支持（kernel support）。
AI.result: 在快速训练实验中，Conv-NS与基于reshape的Muon均计算高效，在CIFAR-10和ImageNet分类任务上达到可比的精度。理论上对齐的Conv-NS并未如预期般优于reshape版Muon。
AI.conclusion: 作者研究这一实践与理论理解之间的不匹配，假设精确的卷积正交化可能过度约束了更新。这些发现凸显了Muon的强实践性能，同时为其在卷积上的进一步发展开辟了方向。

title: Does the Model Use the Feature? Separating Steering from Mechanism in LLMs
summary: Internal features in LLMs are often interpreted as mechanisms when they track a concept and their manipulation changes a related behavior. Yet steering can push a feature far outside its natural range, where its effects need not reflect the model's own computation. We examine this inference and propose an empirical contract whose tests evaluate features at values observed on natural inputs. One test copies a feature's value from an input that shows a behavior into a matched input that does not (installation) or the reverse (removal); the other restores the feature after an upstream edit (downstream rescue). Installation measures how far the feature suffices for the behavior; removal and downstream rescue measure how much the model uses it. Applied to three kinds of representations, the two strengths separate sharply. The published unknown-entity latent strongly steers knowledge abstention, yet installing observed values from either published latent into matched prompts transfers only a small fraction of the natural known--unknown abstention contrast. Dense known--unknown directions show opposite asymmetries between installation and removal in Gemma and Llama, and how fully a released subject--verb agreement feature set reproduces and restores the behavior depends on how its values are written into the model. Tracking a concept and steering a behavior therefore do not by themselves show that the model uses a feature, and each conclusion holds only for the intervention tested.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个"经验契约"来检验LLM内部特征是否真的被模型使用：在自然输入观测到的特征值范围内做安装、移除和下游救援测试，发现"追踪概念"和"能操控行为"并不等于模型真的在计算中使用该特征。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常把LLM内部特征解释为机制：只要某特征追踪某概念、且操控它能改变相关行为，就认为模型使用了它。但引导(steering)常把特征推到自然范围之外，此时效果未必反映模型自身的计算，因此这一推断需要被检验。
AI.method: 提出一个经验契约，其测试均在自然输入上观测到的特征值范围内评估。包含两类测试：(1)安装(installation)/移除(removal)——把表现出某行为的输入的特征值复制到行为不出现的匹配输入中，或反之；(2)下游救援(downstream rescue)——在上游编辑后恢复该特征。安装衡量特征对行为的充分性，移除和下游救援衡量模型对该特征的使用程度。应用于三类表示。
AI.result: 三种表示的结果差异明显：已发表的unknown-entity隐变量虽能强烈引导知识弃答，但将观测值安装到匹配提示中只迁移了自然已知-未知弃答对比的一小部分；密集的已知-未知方向在Gemma和Llama中表现出安装与移除相反的对称性；已发布的subject-verb agreement特征集能否完整复现和恢复行为，取决于其特征值如何写入模型。
AI.conclusion: 追踪一个概念和操控一个行为本身并不能证明模型使用了该特征，且每个结论只对所做的那项干预成立，说明需要基于自然观测值的多重测试来支撑"特征即机制"的推断。

title: Semantic Capability Acquisition and Specialization During Vision-Language Model Fine-Tuning
summary:
Fine-tuning vision-language models (VLMs) is typically evaluated at a single downstream checkpoint, obscuring whether a semantic capability was never acquired or emerged earlier and later declined during specialization. We ask how semantic capabilities are acquired, when they peak, how well they transfer, and what remains at deployment. We study these dynamics as a semantic capability trajectory, tracking identity- and attribute-based capabilities over training.
  We formulate a trajectory-based framework that separates capability acquisition, capability-specific optima, and later specialization, and introduce Structured Semantic Routing (SSR) to study how the representation of supervision shapes what is acquired. Across six pretrained backbones spanning DFN, MetaCLIP, and OpenAI CLIP, we show that fine-tuning can acquire semantic capability beyond the pretrained state, including gains observed on held-out evaluations. Unstructured name-and-attribute supervision produces strong name-and-attribute retrieval with comparatively weak name-free attribute-profile retrieval, whereas SSR yields substantially stronger name-free attribute-profile retrieval and is further strengthened by stochastic name-branch dropout. Different capabilities can peak at different stages, so a checkpoint selected by target class-name retrieval need not coincide with a transferable semantic optimum. Continued optimization can therefore preserve strong target class-name retrieval while reducing previously acquired transferable semantic capability. In a representative diagnostic study, this late specialization is consistent with reduced cross-modal semantic accessibility while substantial image-only class structure remains available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义能力轨迹"框架，追踪视觉语言模型微调过程中身份与属性类语义能力的获取、峰值与衰退，并引入结构化语义路由（SSR）来研究监督表示形式对能力形成的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有微调评估通常只看单一的下游检查点，无法判断语义能力是从未获得，还是在专门化过程中先出现、后衰退。作者希望厘清语义能力如何被获取、何时达到峰值、迁移性如何，以及部署时还剩下什么。
AI.method: 提出基于轨迹的框架，将能力获取、能力特定最优值、后期专门化三个阶段分离；并引入结构化语义路由（SSR），研究监督信息的表征方式如何影响所学内容。在 DFN、MetaCLIP、OpenAI CLIP 六种预训练骨干上开展实验，并测试随机名称分支 dropout 的作用。
AI.result: 微调可获取超出预训练状态的语义能力，并在留出评估上有增益。非结构化的"名称-属性"监督能带来强的名称与属性检索，但无名称的属性画像检索较弱；SSR 显著提升无名称属性画像检索，随机名称分支 dropout 进一步增强。不同能力会在不同阶段达到峰值，按目标类名检索选出的检查点未必是迁移性语义最优点。持续优化可在保持目标类名检索的同时削弱此前的迁移性语义能力。诊断研究显示，这种后期专门化伴随跨模态语义可达性降低，但图像本身的类别结构仍大量保留。
AI.conclusion: 应按语义能力轨迹而非单点检查点来评估微调；监督的表示结构（如 SSR）决定了所获能力类型，且部署用最优检查点应依据所关注的迁移性语义能力来选择，而非仅看目标类名检索指标。

title: LiLib: Lifelong Air-to-Ground Path-Loss Prediction on UAVs via a Drift-Triggered Model Library
summary: UAVs that act as relays or base stations need accurate air-to-ground path-loss predictions for rate adaptation and placement, but propagation conditions change as a UAV moves between suburban, urban and high-rise areas, and the same areas are often revisited. Online regressors that adapt by forgetting must relearn each environment from scratch, whereas a single model trained on all data averages incompatible regimes. We propose LiLib, a lightweight continual-learning scheme in which a UAV maintains a small library of recursive-least-squares experts. A windowed residual test detects drift; a short probe phase then either reuses the best stored expert or creates a new one. In simulations based on four standard urbanization profiles, LiLib reduces prediction RMSE from 5.89 dB (best sliding-window baseline) to 4.03 dB (p < 0.001), lowers the error shortly after a return to a known environment from 12.3 dB to 5.7 dB, and recovers 99% of the throughput of a regime-aware oracle in rate adaptation. The library stores four experts in under 0.5 KB, and identifies regimes with 92% purity without labels. When a second UAV is initialized with the library of a peer, its error after environment changes halves. LiLib does not reach the oracle, and similar regimes may be merged when shadowing is strong. The results indicate that, for recurring drift, remembering is more effective than re-adapting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiLib，一种面向无人机空对地信道预测的轻量级持续学习方案，通过维护递归最小二乘专家的专家库，实现对反复出现的传播环境的记忆与复用，而非遗忘后重新适应。
AI.motivation: 无人机作为中继或基站需要准确的空对地路径损耗预测以支持速率自适应和部署。然而随着无人机在郊区、城区和高层建筑区之间移动，传播条件不断变化，且常会重复访问相同区域。现有的在线回归器依靠遗忘进行适应，每次都要从零学习每个环境；而用全部数据训练单一模型又会平均掉互不相容的信道状态，效果不佳。
AI.method: LiLib让无人机维护一个小型的递归最小二乘（RLS）专家库。系统通过加窗残差检验检测漂移；一旦检测到漂移，便进入一个短暂的探测阶段，决定复用库中表现最好的已有专家，还是创建一个新的专家。整个库的存储开销极小。
AI.result: 在基于四种标准城市化剖面的仿真中，LiLib将预测RMSE从5.89 dB（最佳滑窗基线）降至4.03 dB（p < 0.001）；在返回已知环境后，误差由12.3 dB降至5.7 dB；在速率自适应中恢复了regime-aware oracle约99%的吞吐量。专家库在不足0.5 KB内存下存储四个专家，无需标签即可达到92%的状态识别纯度。当第二架无人机用同伴的专家库初始化时，其环境变化后的误差减半。
AI.conclusion: LiLib的性能尚未达到oracle水平，且在阴影较强时相似状态可能被合并。但结果表明，对于反复出现的漂移，记忆比重新适应更为有效。

title: A Trust Layer for Agent Evaluation
summary: Deterministic benchmark scores show that an agent received credit, but not whether that credit was earned, reported honestly, or would hold on a second run. We introduce a Trust Layer for Agent Evaluation, an additive post-hoc framework that reports, beside each recorded score, whether it should be believed. It verifies four properties: whether the result is supported by the benchmark's own grading logic, whether a passing answer was earned through traceable computation, whether the agent's completion claim matches what occurred, and whether the result is stable under repeated execution. The first three use only saved artifacts; the fourth re-runs the agent. Model judgments only label evidence under majority voting; all verdicts follow deterministic rules and never modify the recorded score. Applied to five agent configurations on 108 tasks from Agents' Last Exam, every model shows passing runs with no traceable computation (at rates varying tenfold), confirmed false completion claims, and unstable results: 18-46% of tasks do not stay in one score band over five runs. Only 22.6% of recorded passes clear all four checks (95% CI 15.0-32.6, n=84). Measuring what an agent can do and verifying that it did it are different problems, and current benchmarks address only the first.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"智能体评估信任层"（Trust Layer for Agent Evaluation），一个附加式的后验评估框架，在记录分数旁报告该分数是否可信，通过四项属性验证揭示现有基准分数可能虚假。
AI.motivation: 确定性基准分数只能说明智能体"获得了分数"，却无法说明该分数是否真正"挣得"、是否如实报告、是否在重复运行下稳定。衡量智能体能做什么与验证它确实做了，是两个不同问题，而现行基准仅解决了前者。
AI.method: 提出附加式后验框架，与每个记录分数并列报告其可信度，验证四项属性：结果是否被基准自身评分逻辑支持、通过答案是否经由可追溯计算获得、智能体的完成声明是否与实际相符、结果在重复执行下是否稳定。前三项仅使用已保存工件，第四项需重跑智能体。模型判断仅在多数投票下对证据打标签，所有裁定遵循确定性规则，且从不修改记录分数。
AI.result: 在 Agents' Last Exam 的 108 个任务、五种智能体配置上应用：每个模型都存在无可追溯计算的通过运行（比率相差十倍）、被确认的虚假完成声明，以及不稳定结果——18% 至 46% 的任务在五次运行中未能保持在同一分数区间。仅有 22.6% 的记录通过满足全部四项检查（95% CI 15.0–32.6，n=84）。
AI.conclusion: 衡量智能体能力与验证其确实执行是不同问题，当前基准只解决了第一个。信任层以不改变原分数的附加方式，为评估结果提供可信度层面的补充验证。

title: ElasticFit: Fit-Aware 3D Object Insertion via VLM Reasoning and Generative Adaptation
summary:
Inserting objects into existing 3D scenes requires more than selecting a plausible location:
  the inserted object must also fit local geometry while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility.
  Although recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and generative models enable semantic reasoning and visual content creation, they offer limited 3D grounding and geometric control when an inserted object must fit into constrained local spaces.
  We introduce \textbf{ElasticFit}, a VLM-guided framework for fit-aware object insertion centered on a novel scene-grounded representation.
  Given a language instruction and rendered scene observations, ElasticFit infers structured fitting cues that specify where the object should be grounded, what volume it should occupy, how it should be oriented, and its adaptation mode (rigid placement, uniform scaling, or elastic fitting).
  These cues convert high-level VLM reasoning into explicit 3D constraints that condition object generation and guide downstream geometric fitting.
  ElasticFit then generates a scene-conditioned object prior, reconstructs it in 3D, and refines the mesh through mode-specific fitting while enforcing collision avoidance, contact consistency, and physical grounding.
  In fixed-asset baseline comparisons, ElasticFit improves spatial relation success from 50.8\% to 69.7\% and support success from 48.3\% to 91.7\% over the strongest baseline, while providing novel support for generative "make-it-fit" insertions in complex scenarios.

AI.tldr: ElasticFit是一个VLM引导的、面向"适配"的3D场景物体插入框架，通过场景感知的结构化适配线索实现刚性放置、均匀缩放与弹性拟合，显著提升空间关系与支撑成功率。
AI.motivation: 将物体插入现有3D场景不仅需要合理位置，还需兼顾局部几何适配、语义意图与物理合理性。现有VLM与生成模型虽具备语义推理与视觉生成能力，但在约束空间下的3D grounding与几何控制方面仍显不足。
AI.method: 提出ElasticFit：给定语言指令与渲染的场景观测，由VLM推断结构化适配线索（着地点、占据体积、朝向、适配模式），将高层语义推理转为显式3D约束；随后生成场景条件化的物体先验，重建为3D并做模式特定的网格精修，同时施加碰撞避免、接触一致性与物理着地约束。
AI.result: 在固定资产基线对比中，空间关系成功率从50.8%提升至69.7%，支撑成功率从48.3%提升至91.7%（对比最强基线），并在复杂场景下支持生成式"make-it-fit"插入。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的3D适配约束与多模式几何拟合，ElasticFit有效弥合了VLM语义推理与3D几何控制之间的鸿沟，实现语义合理且物理可行的"适配感知"物体插入。

title: Sample-Optimal Estimation of the Fréchet Inception Distance
summary: The Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) is widely used to evaluate generative models, but its empirical plug-in estimator suffers from finite-sample bias [BSAG18, CF20]. We study the sample complexity $n$ of estimating FID to error $ε$ between $d$-dimensional Gaussians with bounded mean distance and covariances, when one distribution is known. Our contributions are threefold. (1) We establish tight finite-sample $Θ(\frac{d^2}{n})$ bias and $Θ(\frac{d}{n} + \frac {d^2} {n^2})$ variance bounds for the empirical plug-in estimator, establishing a $\gtrsim d^2$ sample complexity. (2) To debias the empirical plug-in estimator, we generalize the ${\rm FID}_\infty$ estimator of [CF20] to extrapolation methods of arbitrary order $k$. We further prove tight bias and variance bounds of $Θ(\frac{d^{k + 2}}{n^{k + 1}})$ and $Θ(\frac d n + \frac{d^2}{n^2})$ for any order-$k$ extrapolation under our framework. (3) We introduce Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD), a new, computationally efficient FID estimation algorithm using debiasing techniques inspired by U-statistics. We show that RTD achieves an $O(\frac d {ε^2})$ sample complexity, and prove that this is optimal. We provide a complementary empirical evaluation of our new estimators. Our experiments on synthetic Gaussians validate the predicted residual bias and support the tightness of our bounds. On ImageNet with Inception embeddings, RTD achieves the lowest mean estimation error at the standard 50K sample budget, while our second-order variance-aware extrapolation estimator (VALE$_2$) uses only 10K samples to achieve accuracy comparable to FID$_\infty$ at 50K samples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究FID估计的样本复杂度，提出紧致的偏差与方差界、任意阶外推估计器及Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD)算法，证明RTD达到最优的O(d/ε²)样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: FID广泛用于评估生成模型，但其经验plug-in估计器存在有限样本偏差，缺乏对其样本复杂度的理论与去偏方法的系统研究。
AI.method: 在均值距离与协方差有界、且一个分布已知的d维高斯设定下，建立紧致的有限样本偏差与方差界；将FID_∞推广为任意阶k外推方法并证明其偏差方差界；提出基于U统计量思想的Relative Taylor Debiasing (RTD)算法。
AI.result: 证明plug-in估计器需≳d²样本；任意阶k外推偏差为Θ(d^{k+2}/n^{k+1})、方差为Θ(d/n+d²/n²)；RTD达到O(d/ε²)样本复杂度且为最优。合成高斯实验验证残余偏差与界的紧致性；ImageNet上RTD在50K样本预算下误差最低，VALE₂仅用10K样本即达到FID_∞在50K样本的精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论与实验两方面揭示了FID估计的样本复杂度，并提出高效去偏算法RTD及二阶外推估计器VALE₂，显著降低样本需求。

title: The Right Memory in the Wrong Context: Verifying Retrieval Admissibility in Long-Term Agent Memory
comment: 26 pages. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development". Code: https://github.com/ziwang11112/right-memory-wrong-context
summary: Long-term-memory agents can retrieve relevant information that is inadmissible for the current request because it belongs to another principal, violates policy, or reflects an incompatible lifecycle state. Recall and final-answer accuracy do not reveal this: a route can appear safe by missing required evidence, while a correct answer may follow inadmissible prompt exposure.
