We introduce a retrieval-admissibility verification framework that assigns each memory-query pair one of three statuses (admissible, inadmissible, or unresolved), compares routes at matched required-evidence recall with bounds for unresolved cases, and tracks memory IDs through prompt exposure while linking exposure to target-level disclosure. We evaluate its stages on separate, non-pooled populations. A post-hoc top-20 reanalysis of frozen rankings from two public long-term-memory benchmarks, RHELM and MemOps, covers 3,767 queries. All released anchors lie within trusted query namespaces; with within-namespace scores unchanged, off-namespace filtering cannot lower their ranks. Top-20 anchor recall increases from 0.432 to 0.533, 80% recall feasibility from 0.237 to 0.311, and exact similarity evaluations decrease by 98.3%. In a frozen 72-case development diagnostic, a released-metadata reference preserves required evidence, whereas neither text-only verifier detects violations under the 1% required-anchor false-denial limit. Across 1,523 paired benchmark-native cases, namespace routing is associated with judged-accuracy gains of 0.053-0.068 across three readers; recall also changes, so this comparison is observational. In 16 controlled exposure scenarios, only one of four reader-specific 95% confidence intervals excludes zero for relevant-inadmissible literal disclosure (+0.156, 95% CI [0.031, 0.312]). Results motivate separate verification of candidate support, admissibility, prompt exposure, and answer disclosure.

AI.tldr: 提出检索可采纳性验证框架，对内存-查询对赋三种状态并在匹配召回下比较路由，追踪记忆ID的提示暴露与披露，结果显示按命名空间路由可提升锚点召回、减少相似度评估并带来准确率增益。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆智能体可能检索到对当前请求不可采纳的信息（属于其他主体、违反策略或不兼容的生命周期状态），而传统的召回率与最终答案准确率无法揭示这一问题：路由可能因缺失必需证据看似安全，正确答案也可能源于不可采纳的提示暴露。
AI.method: 引入检索可采纳性验证框架，将每个内存-查询对标记为可采纳、不可采纳或未决三种状态；在匹配的必需证据召回率下比较路由并为未决情况设置边界；追踪记忆ID的提示暴露并将暴露与目标级披露关联。在独立非合并人群上评估各阶段，包括对RHELM与MemOps两个公开长期记忆基准冻结排名的top-20事后重分析（3,767条查询）、72例冻结开发诊断、1,523个配对基准原生案例以及16个受控暴露场景。
AI.result: 所有发布锚点均位于可信查询命名空间内，命名空间内分数不变时域外过滤不会降低其排名；top-20锚点召回从0.432升至0.533，80%召回可行性从0.237升至0.311，精确相似度评估减少98.3%。72例诊断中发布元数据参考保留了必需证据，而两种纯文本验证器在1%必需锚点误拒限下均未检测到违规。1,523个配对案例中命名空间路由在三种读取器上带来0.053-0.068的判定准确率增益（观测性）。16个暴露场景中仅一个读取器的95%置信区间排除零。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对候选支持、可采纳性、提示暴露与答案披露进行分别验证。

title: Protective Perturbations Must Survive the Resize: Scale-Robust Image Immunization against Malicious Editing
summary: Protective perturbations aim to stop malicious instruction-guided editing of personal photos, but they are optimized and evaluated at the editor's working resolution, whereas shared photos have 10 megapixels or more and editors first downscale them by an unknown factor. We model this resize as a frequency-selective channel. In this model, a perturbation computed at the native resolution decays with the downscaling factor and is weak even without a resize, and a perturbation computed at a fixed working resolution protects only a window of scales. The best worst-case protection over an unknown range of scales degrades only logarithmically with the width of the range, and averaging over scales does not reach it. Guided by this analysis, we propose SRIM, which samples a grid of anchor scales covering the whole range, with weights that favor the currently weakest scale, at the cost of standard expectation over transformation. On full-resolution photos of 9 to 30 megapixels and downscaling factors from 2 to 8, SRIM raises the worst-case disruption of FLUX.2-klein edits from 0.192 LPIPS, attained by the strongest published protection, to 0.463. At equal visibility, it roughly doubles the protection. The same protected photos also protect against the 9B model and against FLUX.2-dev, with worst cases of 0.450 and 0.386 against at most 0.184 for published protections, and SRIM leads on InstructPix2Pix as well.

AI.tldr: 本文对图像保护性扰动在缩放信道下的衰减进行频域建模，并提出SRIM方法，在多尺度下实现最坏情况保护显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有保护性扰动在编辑者的工作分辨率下优化和评估，但共享照片分辨率高达10MP以上，编辑者会先按未知因子缩小，导致扰动衰减、保护失效。
AI.method: 将缩放建模为频率选择性信道；据此提出SRIM，在覆盖整个尺度范围的锚点尺度网格上采样，并以偏向当前最弱尺度的权重加权，替代对变换的标准期望。
AI.result: 在9–30MP全分辨率照片、2–8倍缩放因子下，SRIM将FLUX.2-klein编辑的最坏情况破坏从最强已发布保护的0.192 LPIPS提升到0.463；同等可见度下保护约翻倍；对9B模型和FLUX.2-dev最坏情况为0.450和0.386（已发布保护至多0.184），在InstructPix2Pix上也领先。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明最坏情况保护随尺度范围宽度仅对数下降，平均尺度无法达到该上界；SRIM通过锚点尺度加权实现更强的跨尺度鲁棒保护。

title: Will the Judge Flip? Predicting Position-Sensitive LLM Judgments from Residual Stream Activations
comment: It was submitted to neurips workshop (JUDGE workshop) and received a review score 6.5 combined with one strong accept and one above threshold accept
summary: The order in which candidate responses are presented can change an LLM judge's verdict. Detecting such a position flip ordinarily requires judging each pair in both orders, which doubles the number of judgments. We investigate whether residual stream activations recorded immediately before the initial verdict can predict a flip. We use nested grouped cross-validation to evaluate regularized linear probes on 534 JudgeBench pairs for three Qwen3 judges and Llama-3.1-8B. The linear probes achieve AUROCs of .621-.850 and outperform a combined baseline that uses verbalized confidence, verdict-label logits, response lengths, and the judge's initial choice by .062-.113 AUROC. Linear probes trained on JudgeBench and then frozen achieve AUROCs of .685-.853 on 1,802 MT-Bench comparisons without MT-Bench fitting or recalibration. These results show that pre-verdict activations support prediction of susceptibility to candidate order and outperform the non-activation predictors evaluated here.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在最终裁决前记录的残差流激活可以预测LLM裁判是否会因候选回答呈现顺序而改变判决。
AI.motivation: LLM裁判的判决会受到候选回答呈现顺序的影响（位置翻转），常规检测需对每对回答正反两种顺序各判断一次，使判断量翻倍，因此需要更高效的方法来预测这种翻转。
AI.method: 使用嵌套分组交叉验证，在JudgeBench的534对样本上评估正则化线性探针，覆盖三个Qwen3裁判和Llama-3.1-8B。探针基于初次裁决前的残差流激活。并对比使用语言化置信度、判决标签logits、回答长度和裁判初始选择组成的基线。
AI.result: 线性探针的AUROC为0.621–0.850，比组合基线高0.062–0.113；在JudgeBench上训练后冻结的探针在1,802个MT-Bench比较上仍达到0.685–0.853的AUROC，无需MT-Bench拟合或重新校准。
AI.conclusion: 裁决前的激活能够支持对候选顺序易感性的预测，并且优于本文评估的非激活预测因子。这表明可利用内部激活更高效地检测LLM裁判的位置翻转风险。

title: Understanding and Mitigating Inference-Time Overreliance Using Agentic Memory
summary: Agentic memory allows LLM agents to reuse past experience, yet retrieved memories can also distort inference even when they are benign, correctly stored, and appropriately retrieved. We study this failure mode, which we call memory over-reliance. Across benchmarks and memory architectures, we find that memory is useful when past experience transfers to the current task, but can become misleading when only part of the evidence transfers. Failures are strongest under partial query-memory overlap, a pattern further confirmed by controlled experiments thatvary the amount of overlapping evidence. Motivated by this finding, we propose MEMTRIM, a plug-and-play framework that indexes memory evidence at write time and controls its reuse at read time. MEMTRIM removes repeated or conflicting evidence while preserving useful memory-specific information, requires no retraining, and applies to both embedding-based and structured memory systems.Experiments show that MEMTRIM reduces memory overreliance while preserving the benefits of useful memory across models and memory settings.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体记忆的"过度依赖"失效模式：即使记忆本身良性、存储正确、检索恰当，也可能扭曲推理；并提出免训练框架MEMTRIM，在写入时索引证据、在读取时控制复用。
AI.motivation: 智能体记忆虽能复用过去经验，但检索到的记忆即便良性、正确存储且恰当检索，仍可能扭曲推理。作者将此失效模式命名为"记忆过度依赖"，并发现当过去经验只有部分证据能迁移到当前任务时，记忆会变得具误导性。
AI.method: 通过在多个基准与记忆架构上的实验，结合控制实验（改变重叠证据的量）定位失败模式；据此提出MEMTRIM——一个即插即用框架，在写入时索引记忆证据、在读取时控制其复用，去除重复或冲突证据，同时保留有用的记忆特有信息；无需重新训练，适用于基于嵌入与结构化的记忆系统。
AI.result: 失败在部分查询-记忆重叠时最强，并经控制实验验证；MEMTRIM在多种模型与记忆设置下降低了记忆过度依赖，同时保留了有用记忆带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 记忆在经验可完全迁移时有用，部分迁移时会误导；通过写入时索引与读取时控制的MEMTRIM能有效缓解记忆过度依赖并保持记忆收益。

title: LARK: A Low-Cost, Accurate, Occlusion-Resilient, Kalman Filter-Assisted Tracking System for Image-Guided Surgery
comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, including appendices. Supplementary document included as an ancillary file. Supplementary video: https://youtu.be/ApZ8q9DjB-4
summary: Image-guided surgery (IGS) depends on accurate tracking of surgical instruments to provide real-time navigation relative to anatomical structures. Commercial stereo infrared trackers are accurate but prone to occlusion and cost-prohibitive for many settings. This work presents LARK, a multi-camera optical tracking system using commodity RGB hardware and multi-view redundancy and fusion. We develop and evaluate two complete tracking methods: multi-view monocular pose fusion and multi-view triangulation. Both methods are assessed under varying occlusion levels using a precision-machined grid and an anatomical head phantom, and compared against a gold-standard stereo infrared system. With five cameras and adaptive Kalman filtering, LARK achieves median target registration errors of 0.64 mm for point localization with triangulation and 0.73 mm for trajectory tracking with pose fusion on the machined grid. Camera-subset experiments show graceful degradation in adaptive pose-fusion accuracy as fewer views remain available. With tracking hardware costing under $1,000 USD, LARK provides a low-cost platform for image-guided surgery research. Hardware designs and software are publicly available at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/software/ , and datasets at https://nist.mni.mcgill.ca/data/ .

AI.tldr: LARK是一种基于商用RGB相机的多相机光学跟踪系统，通过多视角冗余与融合实现低成本、抗遮挡的手术器械跟踪，精度接近商用立体红外跟踪系统。
AI.motivation: 商用立体红外跟踪系统精度高但易受遮挡，且成本高昂，限制了图像引导手术在资源有限环境中的应用。作者希望用廉价RGB硬件结合多视角冗余来替代昂贵方案。
AI.method: 提出LARK多相机光学跟踪系统，使用商用RGB硬件，开发并评估两种完整跟踪方法：多视角单目位姿融合和多视角三角测量。在精度加工网格和头部解剖体模上测试不同遮挡程度，并与金标准立体红外系统对比，采用五相机与自适应卡尔曼滤波。
AI.result: 在加工网格上，五相机加自适应卡尔曼滤波下，三角测量点定位中位配准误差0.64 mm，位姿融合轨迹跟踪误差0.73 mm；相机子集实验显示随视角减少自适应位姿融合精度平滑下降。硬件成本低于1000美元。
AI.conclusion: LARK以低成本商用硬件实现了接近金标准的跟踪精度，并具备抗遮挡的优雅降级能力，为图像引导手术研究提供了低成本平台，硬件设计与软件公开可用。

title: SoloQ: Calibration-Free Quantization for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive language models through bidirectional diffusion-based token generation. However, their growing model sizes and high inference costs make efficient deployment challenging: full-sequence denoising repeatedly invokes compute-intensive forward passes, while block-diffusion models additionally introduce a memory-intensive KV-cache. Low-bit weight-activation quantization is therefore attractive, yet existing dLLM post-training quantization methods rely on calibration data despite activation distributions shifting across masking states and denoising steps. We present SoloQ, a calibration-free quantization framework that maps weights and activations into a normalized rotated basis with a predictable marginal distribution, enabling data-independent quantization. SoloQ combines a structured K-RPBH rotation with a lightweight rescaling correction for calibration-free quantization. Its predictable post-rotation distribution supports both distribution-matched codebooks and hardware-native NVFP4. For block-diffusion models, SoloQ further applies commit-time KV-cache quantization to compress persistent states without perturbing the actively denoised block. Across full-sequence dLLMs (LLaDA and Dream) and block-diffusion dLLMs(Fast-dLLM v2 and Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion), SoloQ retains accuracy under 4-bit quantization and outperforms calibration-based baselines on knowledge- and reasoning-intensive benchmarks. With NVFP4, SoloQ reduces peak memory by up to 2.61X and accelerates end-to-end inference by up to 2.24X.

AI.tldr: SoloQ：面向扩散大语言模型的无校准量化框架，基于旋转归一化基底实现数据无关量化，支持NVFP4，最高降低2.61X峰值内存、加速2.24X。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型因模型规模增长与推理成本高而难以高效部署：全序列去噪需反复前向计算，块扩散模型还引入内存密集的KV缓存。低比特量化虽具吸引力，但现有dLLM训练后量化方法依赖校准数据，而激活分布随掩码状态和去噪步数发生漂移，导致校准不可靠。
AI.method: 提出SoloQ无校准量化框架：将权重与激活映射到具有可预测边缘分布的归一化旋转基底，实现数据无关量化。方法包括结构化K-RPBH旋转与轻量重缩放校正；旋转后分布可预测，支持分布匹配码本与硬件原生NVFP4。针对块扩散模型，进一步采用提交时刻KV缓存量化，在不干扰当前去噪块的前提下压缩持久状态。
AI.result: 在全序列dLLM（LLaDA、Dream）和块扩散dLLM（Fast-dLLM v2、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion）上，SoloQ在4比特量化下保持精度，并在知识与推理密集基准上优于基于校准的基线。使用NVFP4时，峰值内存最多降低2.61X，端到端推理最多加速2.24X。
AI.conclusion: SoloQ通过可预测的旋转归一化分布实现无校准量化，兼顾精度与效率，为扩散大语言模型的低比特高效部署提供了可行方案。

title: Rule-Based Languages for Neurosymbolic AI
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of Rules and Reasoning - 10th International Joint Conference, RuleML+RR 2026, Vilnius, Lithuania
summary: Logic programming is increasingly used as the symbolic component of neurosymbolic AI systems. We survey the main rule-based languages in this setting, namely Datalog, answer set, and probabilistic logic programs, along four axes: semantics, expressiveness, neural integration, and evaluation mechanism. We analyse over 50 recent systems and applications, comparing formalism usage across four research areas: databases and programming languages, machine learning, vision, and robotics. We provide a decision matrix mapping application scenarios to required features and close by outlining open problems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了神经符号AI中作为符号组件使用的逻辑编程语言，涵盖Datalog、回答集与概率逻辑程序，从语义、表达能力、神经集成和求值机制四个维度分析50余个近期系统与应用，并给出决策矩阵与开放问题。
AI.motivation: 逻辑编程正日益成为神经符号AI系统的符号组件，但该领域语言多样、跨学科应用分散，缺乏对形式化使用方式的系统梳理与对比，因而需要一篇综述为研究者提供选型依据与研究脉络。
AI.method: 采用文献综述方法，围绕四条轴线（语义、表达能力、神经集成、求值机制）梳理Datalog、回答集程序、概率逻辑程序等主要基于规则的语言，并分析50多个近期系统与应用，在数据库与编程语言、机器学习、视觉、机器人四个研究领域间比较其形式化使用情况。
AI.result: 分析并对比了超过50个近期系统与应用，揭示了不同研究领域中形式化语言的使用差异，并构建了将应用场景映射到所需特征的决策矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 该综述为神经符号AI中逻辑编程语言的选用提供了结构化框架与决策参考，并指出了该领域尚待解决的开放问题。

title: AIMS: Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis for Scalable Novel View Rendering
summary: Feed-forward novel view synthesis methods achieve strong generalization from posed multi-view inputs, but scaling them to large input view sets remains challenging. Transformer-based approaches that jointly process all input-view tokens incur rapidly increasing computation and memory as the number of views grows, while simple view subsampling discards potentially useful observations. We introduce Anchor-Integrated Multi-View Synthesis (AIMS), a scalable framework that decouples the number of available observations from the number of views processed by the global synthesis model. AIMS selects a fixed set of spatially distributed anchor views using farthest point sampling, groups nearby observations around each anchor, and uses a lightweight learnable integrator to fuse their information into enriched anchor representations. This allows additional observations to contribute to synthesis while keeping the downstream global view budget fixed. Evaluations on RealEstate10K and ScanNet demonstrate a favorable quality--efficiency trade-off against transformer-based and Gaussian-based baselines. AIMS achieves 29.41 dB and 17.73 dB PSNR on the two datasets, respectively, with rendering averaging 7.24 ms per view.

AI.tldr: AIMS通过锚点整合多视角信息，将可用观测数量与全局合成模型处理的视角数量解耦，在保持固定全局视角预算的同时利用更多观测，实现了质量与效率的良好权衡。
AI.motivation: 前馈新视角合成虽泛化能力强，但扩展到大规模输入视角集困难：基于Transformer的方法联合处理所有输入视角token，计算和内存随视角数快速增长；而简单视角子采样又会丢弃有用观测。
AI.method: AIMS先用最远点采样选出固定数量的空间分布锚点视角，将邻近观测分组到各锚点周围，再用轻量可学习整合器把组内信息融合为增强的锚点表示，从而让额外观测参与合成而下游全局视角预算固定。
AI.result: 在RealEstate10K和ScanNet上分别达到29.41 dB和17.73 dB PSNR，平均每视角渲染7.24 ms，相比Transformer和Gaussian基线展现出更优的质量—效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: AIMS提供了一种可扩展的多视角合成框架，有效解耦观测数量与全局处理视角数，在大规模输入下兼顾合成质量与计算效率。

title: The Implicit Bias of Hyperbolic Representation Learning for Multiclass Data: A Busemann Risk Perspective
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: We study the implicit bias of Riemannian gradient flow for hyperbolic multiclass classification with fixed class prototypes in hyperbolic space $\mathbb{H}^n$. Our framework accommodates general permutation invariant relative margin (PERM) losses, a class that includes cross entropy and other standard multiclass losses. Our analysis is based on a decomposition: at large radius, the distance to each prototype splits into a radial term and a direction-dependent term described by the Busemann function. This yields two main results. First, we prove a radial dichotomy: the sign of a drift coefficient $μ$ determines whether the radius is pushed toward the ideal boundary or back toward the interior; if the positive drift persists, then $r(t)=\frac{1}{2}\log t+O(1)$, while persistent negative drift returns the trajectory to the large-radius threshold in finite time. Second, we show that the boundary direction converges to a critical point of the Busemann risk on $\partial\mathbb{H}^n$. These results provide a rigorous asymptotic perspective on two phenomena we refer to as boundary saturation and near-boundary clustering in hyperbolic representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究双曲多类分类中黎曼梯度流的隐式偏置，基于距离分解给出径向二分与边界方向收敛两大结果。
AI.motivation: 理解双曲表示学习中"边界饱和"与"近边界聚类"现象的隐式偏置机理，为固定类原型下的双曲多类分类提供严格的渐近分析。
AI.method: 在双曲空间 H^n 中，对大半径处的距离按 Busemann 函数分解为径向项与方向依赖项，针对一般置换不变相对间隔（PERM）损失分析黎曼梯度流。
AI.result: 证明径向二分：漂移系数 μ 的符号决定半径被推向理想边界还是回到内部——正的持续漂移下 r(t)=½log t+O(1)，负漂移则在有限时间内回到大半径阈值；同时边界方向收敛到 ∂H^n 上 Busemann 风险的临界点。
AI.conclusion: 结果对双曲表示学习中的边界饱和与近边界聚类给出了严格的渐近解释。

title: Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization: Learning to Reason with Adaptive Rationale Scaffolding
summary: On-policy reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is often limited by reward sparsity: when a model fails to discover correct trajectories for difficult problems, the optimization process receives little useful signal and may stagnate. Existing approaches mitigate this issue by incorporating off-policy demonstrations, expert traces, or model-generated solutions, but they typically require the auxiliary data to match the format of the reinforcement-learning task, often relying on rejection sampling from stronger models to obtain suitable training trajectories. We introduce Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization (RGPO), a framework that adaptively leverages ground-truth rationale information according to the model's current capability while preserving its freedom to explore. Rather than treating reference solutions as fixed imitation targets, RGPO uses them as temporary scaffolds: rationales help the model generate improved responses, after which only higher-reward, model-generated solutions are transferred back to the original unguided setting. This design allows training to exploit available ground-truth information without requiring off-policy data to follow the same format as the RL task. Across both language-only and vision-language reasoning settings, RGPO consistently improves performance over RLVR baselines, and ablation studies show that adaptive rationale guidance is a key contributor to these gains. These results suggest that RGPO offers a practical and general approach for reducing reward sparsity, stabilizing reinforcement learning, and improving reasoning performance in both text-only and multimodal models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RGPO框架，利用真值理由作为临时脚手架缓解强化学习中的奖励稀疏问题，在语言和多模态推理任务上优于RLVR基线。
AI.motivation: on-policy强化学习是提升大语言模型推理能力的核心范式，但奖励稀疏问题严重限制其效果：当模型无法找到正确轨迹时，优化信号匮乏导致训练停滞。现有方法引入off-policy演示或专家轨迹，但要求辅助数据与RL任务格式一致，通常依赖强模型的拒绝采样。
AI.method: 提出Rationale-Guided Policy Optimization（RGPO）。该方法根据模型当前能力自适应地利用真值理由信息，同时保留探索自由。不同于将参考解作为固定模仿目标，RGPO将其视为临时脚手架：理由帮助模型生成改进的响应，随后仅将更高奖励的、模型自生成的解迁移回原始的无引导设定。该设计无需off-policy数据与RL任务格式一致。
AI.result: 在纯语言和视觉-语言推理两种设定下，RGPO均持续优于RLVR基线；消融研究表明自适应理由引导是性能提升的关键贡献因素。
AI.conclusion: RGPO为缓解奖励稀疏、稳定强化学习并提升纯文本与多模态模型的推理性能提供了一种实用且通用的方法。

title: CETUS: How Far Do Representations Trained on Earth Transfer to Cassini SAR of Titan?
comment: Research work at NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Available at: https://github.com/magnaprog/CETUS
summary: Cassini synthetic aperture radar (SAR) images reveal the dunes, plains, and lake basins of Titan, providing an instance of representations learned from Earth imagery for planetary terrain classification. Cross-domain Evaluation of Earth-to-Titan Transfer Using SAR (CETUS) compares features from DINOv2, DOFA and CROMA with classical image measurements and features from an untrained vision transformer on the U.S. Geological Survey's Cassini SAR mosaic. The classifiers learn terrain labels from an expert geomorphological map and predict those labels in geographically separate Titan regions. Under logistic regression settings, pretrained encoders achieve higher mean macro F1 than the combined classical features. Encoder rankings change when feature scaling, optimization, and regularization change together. Further training on Titan improves DINOv2 performance, degrades DOFA performance, and leads to mixed results for CROMA under the tested settings. Architectural and input processing differences prevent these comparisons from isolating the effect of pretraining. Classifier fitting and performance on individual terrain classes matter when assessing representation transfer for planetary mapping. Since the map draws partly on the same radar observations, the scores measure agreement with expert interpretation.

AI.tldr: CETUS 对比 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA 等预训练编码器与经典图像特征在 Cassini SAR 影像上的土卫六地形分类迁移表现，发现预训练编码器在逻辑回归下平均宏 F1 更高，但排名受缩放与优化设置影响，且需注意评估的是与专家解译的一致性。
AI.motivation: 利用地球影像学到的表征进行行星地形分类具有应用潜力，但地球到土卫六的跨域迁移效果尚不明确，需要系统比较不同预训练编码器与经典特征的表现，并厘清评测设置与评估含义。
AI.method: 基于美国地质调查局 Cassini SAR 镶嵌图，将 DINOv2、DOFA、CROMA 的特征与经典图像测量特征及未训练视觉 transformer 特征进行比较；分类器从专家地貌图学习地形标签，并在土卫六地理上分离的区域进行预测，在逻辑回归设置下评估，并考察特征缩放、优化与正则化的联合变化以及进一步在土卫六上训练的影响。
AI.result: 逻辑回归下预训练编码器的平均宏 F1 高于组合经典特征；当特征缩放、优化与正则化同时改变时，编码器排名会发生变化。进一步在土卫六上训练后，DINOv2 性能提升，DOFA 性能下降，CROMA 结果不一。架构与输入处理差异使比较无法单独分离预训练的作用。
AI.conclusion: 行星制图中的表征迁移评估需关注分类器拟合与各别地形类别表现；由于所用地图部分基于同一雷达观测，所得分数衡量的是与专家解译的一致性，而非绝对分类精度。

title: Adversarial Training for Deep Hedging in Nonstationary Markets
summary: Deep hedging learns trading policies from historical or simulated market trajectories, yet under nonstationarity these training paths may not represent future market conditions. We propose WRAP (Wasserstein-Reweighting Adversarial Perturbation), a drift-aware adversarial training framework derived from a two-budget distributionally robust optimization (DRO) formulation. The formulation is anchored to a weighted empirical reference distribution whose fixed baseline weights are chosen to balance sampling uncertainty against temporal drift. Around this reference distribution, the ambiguity set addresses two complementary forms of distributional misspecification by allowing an adversary to reweight the observed trajectories subject to a $φ$-divergence constraint and perturb their paths subject to an optimal-transport (OT) constraint. We derive a joint first-order expansion in which the leading-order increase over the nominal expected loss decomposes into a reweighting contribution determined by the dispersion of hedging losses across trajectories and a transport contribution determined by the sensitivity of the loss to path perturbations. This expansion yields an explicit finite-dimensional adversarial attack that replaces the distributional inner supremum with a tractable first-order approximation. Across stationary and nonstationary Heston dynamics and a generalized affine diffusion (GAD), the experiments show complementary benefits from reweighting and transport, with joint adversarial training providing the largest gains under nonstationarity.

AI.tldr: 提出WRAP框架，把深度对冲的训练分布失配问题建模为双预算DRO，用重加权加路径扰动的一阶展开构造可训练对抗攻击。
AI.motivation: 深度对冲依赖历史或模拟轨迹训练，但在非平稳市场中这些路径未必代表未来分布，导致策略在新市场条件下失效。
AI.method: 基于双预算分布鲁棒优化，以加权经验分布为参考（基准权重平衡采样不确定性与时间漂移）；模糊集同时允许φ-散度约束下的轨迹重加权与最优传输约束下的路径扰动；对名义期望损失作联合一阶展开，得到重加权项（损失跨轨迹离散度）与传输项（损失对路径扰动的敏感度），并据此设计有限维一阶对抗攻击替代内层上确界。
AI.result: 在平稳与非平稳Heston动态及广义仿射扩散（GAD）上实验，重加权与传输各有互补收益，联合对抗训练在非平稳条件下增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 重加权与路径扰动刻画了两类互补的分布误配，WRAP通过联合对抗训练提升非平稳市场下的深度对冲鲁棒性。

title: Trajectory-Retrieval Speculative Decoding: When Does a Model's Own History Help?
summary: Long chain-of-thought reasoning increases sequential decoding cost while creating a growing history of potentially reusable continuations. We investigate when this history supplies useful drafts and complements an existing drafter. Controlled source comparisons reveal trajectory-specific reuse, motivating our method Trajectory-Local Adaptive Retrieval (TLAR). TLAR retrieves approximately matched continuations from the current trajectory and uses recent verification outcomes to adapt retrieval activation and candidate width. TLAR combines retrieved continuations with model-generated drafts in a shared candidate tree, preserving the target model's output distribution through exact verification. Across code debugging, mathematics, and open-ended writing, our evaluation connects source reuse, incremental acceptance, and execution cost. Combining TLAR with strong retrieval baselines improves token acceptance under matched verification budgets and increases end-to-end throughput over the draft-model baseline. These findings support generated trajectories as runtime memory for adaptive inference.

AI.tldr: 提出TLAR方法，从当前长链推理轨迹中检索近似匹配的续写作为草稿，结合验证结果自适应调整检索激活与候选宽度，在保持目标模型输出分布的同时提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 长链思维链推理增加顺序解码成本，但同时也持续生成大量可能可复用的续写历史。论文探究这种历史何时能提供有用的草稿，并与已有草稿模型互补。
AI.method: 受控来源对比实验揭示轨迹特定的复用特性，据此提出轨迹局部自适应检索（TLAR）。TLAR从当前轨迹中检索近似匹配的续写，利用近期验证结果自适应调整检索激活和候选宽度，并将检索续写与模型生成草稿合并到共享候选树中，通过精确验证保持目标模型输出分布。
AI.result: 在代码调试、数学和开放式写作任务上，评估结果将来源复用、增量接受与执行成本联系起来。TLAR与强检索基线结合后，在相同验证预算下提升token接受率，并相对草稿模型基线提高了端到端吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，生成的推理轨迹可作为运行时的记忆，用于自适应推理。

title: REViT-v2: Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViT for Equivariant Feature Extraction
comment: 7 pages, Accepted for presentation at NeurIPS NeurREPS workshop 2026
summary: We propose a scalable roto-reflection-group-equivariant vision transformer based on windowed group-convolutional self-attention and a hierarchical feature architecture. We demonstrate that our approach can be scaled to group-equivariant vision transformers (ViTs) with millions of parameters and large datasets with practically sized images, i.e., ImageNet. The code and pretrained weights for the proposed Hierarchical Windowed Roto-reflection Equivariant ViTs (REViT-v2) are available at https://github.com/kc-ml2/revit.

AI.tldr: 提出可扩展的旋转-反射群等变视觉Transformer（REViT-v2），基于窗口群卷积自注意力与分层特征架构，可扩展到百万参数级、ImageNet规模的实用尺寸图像。
AI.motivation: 已有群等变视觉Transformer难以扩展到百万参数规模与大尺寸图像数据集（如ImageNet），可扩展性受限。
AI.method: 采用窗口化群卷积自注意力机制，并结合分层特征架构，构建旋转-反射群（roto-reflection group）等变的视觉Transformer。
AI.result: 验证了方法可扩展到百万参数级的群等变ViT，并可在ImageNet等实用尺寸图像数据集上训练；代码与预训练权重已开源。
AI.conclusion: REViT-v2在保持群等变性的同时实现了良好的可扩展性，为群等变视觉模型的大规模应用提供了可行方案。

title: A theory of platonic representations in language models
summary: Representations of translated sentences are similar in the inner layers of multilingual language models -- an observation connected to the platonic representation hypothesis, yet unexplained theoretically. We provide an explanation based on the assumption that data have a hidden hierarchical structure whose abstract levels are shared across languages while surface levels are modality- or language-specific. Concretely, we generate synthetic languages from probabilistic context-free grammars sharing upper-level but not lower-level production rules. In this setting the Bayes-optimal next-token predictor is belief propagation (BP); encoding its messages in successive layers yields analytical predictions that agree well with transformers trained on the same data. The framework explains why cross-lingual similarity peaks in middle layers, coexists with language-specific structure, and strengthens with language proximity, model quality and data exposure. It distinguishes similarity (shared neighborhood geometry) from alignment (shared coordinates), showing that the latter occurs when code-switched data, i.e. mixed-language sentences, are abundant enough. It further predicts that subtracting from each layer the component linearly predictable from the preceding one increases cross-lingual similarity, which we confirm in pretrained LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上解释了多语言模型中间层跨语言表示相似的成因，基于共享抽象层级的数据层次结构假设，用合成语言和信念传播给出了可验证的预测。
AI.motivation: 观察到翻译句子的表示在多语言模型的内层（中间层）相似，这一现象与柏拉图表示假设相关，但缺乏理论解释。作者希望提供一种理论机制来说明为何跨语言相似性在中间层达到峰值，以及它与语言特异性结构、语言邻近度、模型质量和数据暴露量的关系。
AI.method: 假设数据具有隐藏的层次结构，其抽象层跨语言共享，而表层为语言或模态特有。基于此，从概率上下文无关文法生成合成语言，使上层产生式规则共享而下层不共享。在该设定下，贝叶斯最优下一词预测器即为信念传播（BP），将其消息编码到连续网络层中，得到可解析的预测，并与在同一数据上训练的 transformer 进行对比验证。
AI.result: 解析预测与训练得到的 transformer 表现吻合良好。该框架成功解释了跨语言相似性在中间层出现峰值、与语言特有结构共存、并随语言邻近度、模型质量和数据暴露量增强的现象；区分了“相似性”（共享邻域几何）与“对齐”（共享坐标），指出后者在混合语言句子（码切换数据）足够多时出现；并预测从每层减去可由前一层线性预测的成分会提升跨语言相似性，该预测在预训练大模型中得到了证实。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多语言模型中间层跨语言相似性提供了首个理论解释，将柏拉图表示假设与数据的层次结构、信念传播联系起来，区分了相似性与对齐，并给出了可实验验证的预测，在预训练模型中得到了支持。

title: Evaluating Escalation Signals for LLM Routing: Targets, Controls, and Five Ways to Fool Yourself
summary: Deciding when to escalate a query from a small language model to a larger one requires a cheap signal that predicts, before the large model is called, whether escalating would help. Semantic entropy, originally developed to detect hallucinations, is a natural candidate: it measures how much a model's sampled answers disagree in meaning, and high disagreement often signals an unreliable answer. We test it across three benchmarks and two model families. On GSM8K, with a small/large pair about twelve times apart in size, semantic entropy reliably distinguishes the small model's mistakes (AUROC 0.871) and improves routed accuracy over random escalation by up to nine points at matched cost. An earlier strong-looking result on a synthetic benchmark proved misleading: a simple rule based only on question difficulty, with no model involved, matched semantic entropy almost exactly. This paper's main contribution is a set of checks that catch this before it is reported as real. We show that scoring a cheap, question-only difficulty estimate alongside any signal reveals whether the signal adds real information or just tracks how hard a question looks; that two reasonable definitions of "escalation worked" can produce very different results on the same data; that a benchmark can leave almost no room for any signal to beat simply always using the large model; and that the true cost of live sampling can make routing more expensive than calling the large model directly. For a cheaper alternative that reuses cached past outcomes, we show how to predict whether it will work on a new dataset -- confirmed by correctly forecasting a collapse from AUROC 0.908 to chance level (0.518) ahead of time. We offer these as a general checklist for evaluating escalation signals.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了用语义熵作为"小模型答案是否需升级到大模型"的廉价信号，并提出一套评估检查清单，揭示多个看似有效的升级信号实为假象。
AI.motivation: 在调用大模型前，需要一个廉价信号预测"升级"是否有帮助。语义熵（原用于检测幻觉）是自然候选，但作者担心其表面效果可能被问题难度等混杂因素伪造，需要系统检验。
AI.method: 在三个基准、两个模型家族上测试语义熵。引入"仅基于问题难度的廉价估计"作为对照信号，与任意升级信号同时打分；比较两种"升级是否有效"的定义；分析基准是否给信号留下超越"始终用大模型"的空间；核算实时采样的真实成本；并对复用缓存结果的更廉价替代方案做跨数据集可预测性分析。
AI.result: GSM8K上（大小模型规模差约12倍），语义熵能区分小模型错误（AUROC 0.871），在同等成本下比随机升级提升路由准确率最多9个点。但一个合成基准上的"亮眼"结果具有误导性：仅凭问题难度的简单规则几乎完全匹配语义熵的表现。缓存替代方案在AUROC 0.908上新数据集会崩塌至随机水平（0.518），且该崩塌被提前正确预测。
AI.conclusion: 作者的主要贡献是一套能在结果被误报为"真实"之前发现问题的检查方法，并作为评估升级信号的通用清单：需与问题难度对照、明确"升级有效"的定义、检查基准的上升空间、计入采样真实成本，以及验证缓存方案的跨数据集可迁移性。

title: PhysLDM: Latent Diffusion for High-Fidelity Deformable Simulation
summary: Neural simulation of high-fidelity deformable bodies is a foundational challenge in computer graphics and physical AI. Long-horizon prediction for high-resolution 3D volumetric meshes is hard: autoregressive methods are susceptible to error accumulation, while direct multi-frame prediction at native resolution is computationally prohibitive. This motivates a compact spatiotemporal latent representation, which is largely unexplored for mesh-based volumetric physics. Meanwhile, it remains unclear whether deterministic regression or generative diffusion is the more appropriate predictive paradigm. To address these coupled challenges, we introduce PhysLDM, a unified latent-diffusion paradigm for one-shot volumetric deformable simulation. Its core is a holistic spatiotemporal VAE that avoids the "staircase" artifacts of standard temporal compression (as in common video VAEs), achieving ~2.48 mm reconstruction precision on meter-scale scenes at up to 78x token compression. Based on this reliable latent space, we systematically compare regression and diffusion methods. Our experiments uncover a key modeling insight: complex deformable dynamics are often chaotic, and in this regime deterministic regression tends to produce non-physical averages, whereas diffusion better models their distribution. Accordingly, we employ a latent diffusion model that effectively learns from the chaotic data to generate physically plausible trajectories. Trained purely kinematically on an Objaverse-scale dataset, a single PhysLDM generalizes zero-shot to unseen OOD datasets (GSO and Toys4K). Its differentiability further enables efficient solution of inverse problems and higher-order design optimization. To our knowledge, PhysLDM is the first high-fidelity spatiotemporal autoencoder and latent-diffusion paradigm for volumetric deformable dynamics, offering a scalable and robust approach to neural simulation.

AI.tldr: PhysLDM提出统一隐扩散范式实现一次性体积可变形仿真，核心是避免"阶梯"伪影的时空VAE，实现78倍token压缩下约2.48毫米重建精度，并发现混沌动力学中扩散优于确定性回归。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率3D体积网格的长期预测困难：自回归方法易累积误差，原生分辨率的多帧直接预测计算代价过高，因此需要紧凑的时空隐表示；同时确定性与生成式预测范式的优劣尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建整体式时空VAE，避免标准时间压缩的阶梯伪影；在该隐空间上系统比较回归与扩散；采用隐扩散模型学习混沌动力学生成物理合理的轨迹。
AI.result: 在米级场景上达到约2.48毫米重建精度，最高78倍token压缩；仅运动学训练于Objaverse规模数据集，单模型零样本泛化到GSO和Toys4K等OOD数据集；可微性支持逆问题与高阶设计优化。
AI.conclusion: PhysLDM是首个面向体积可变形动力学的高保真时空自编码器与隐扩散范式，为神经仿真提供可扩展且稳健的方法。

title: CLM-as-a-Judge: Evaluating an Open Contrastive Decision Model on Public Judge Benchmarks
summary: An open contrastive decision model is near chance as a judge on the hard public benchmarks: Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B scores between 0.351 (best- of-four, chance 0.250) and 0.593 (pairwise, chance 0.500), is statistically indistinguishable from coin flipping on RM-Bench and JudgeBench, and answers every HaluEval item with one constant label, matching the trivial always-first baseline at 0.581. Judges with the same parameter count score far higher everywhere: a reward model reaches 0.764 to 0.976 and a generative judge 0.611 to 0.778, and every gap to CLM is significant after Benjamini-Hochberg correction. Two properties do work. Raw confidences are overconfident by up to +0.401, yet one pooled temperature fit on held-out calibration items repairs expected calibration error to at most 0.062, and the repaired confidence ranks the model's own errors above chance on three of six benchmarks. The decision order-flip rate is 0.0002 against 0.2188 for the generative judge, and the length-preference shift is -0.023 against -0.217. The confidence-gated cascade, however, escalates between 0.923 and 1.000 of items to the strong judge at the preregistered 0.97 retention bar: calibrated confidence about a near-chance judge has almost nothing to keep. The design: five public preference benchmarks and one hallucination benchmark with real labels, scored under a preregistration frozen before any test item was seen, against generative, reward-model, and trivial baselines, with per-item predictions released.

AI.tldr: 对比式决策模型CLM-v0.1-8B在六个公开基准上表现接近随机猜测，校准和稳定性虽好但判别力近乎为零。
AI.motivation: 评估一个开放对比式决策模型（Contrastive-LM/CLM-v0.1-8B）作为评判者（judge）的实际判别能力，检验其是否真正具备评判价值，并与同规模生成式模型、奖励模型及平凡基线进行严格比较。
AI.method: 在五个公开偏好基准和一个真实标签的幻觉基准上，采用预先冻结的预注册协议，与生成式评判者、奖励模型和"总是选第一个"等平凡基线对比；对原始置信度进行校准（留出集上拟合单一温度参数），并测试置信度门控级联策略；同时测量顺序翻转率与长度偏好偏移。
AI.result: CLM得分介于0.351（四选一，随机为0.250）与0.593（两两比较，随机为0.500）；在RM-Bench、JudgeBench上与抛硬币无显著差异，在HaluEval上恒输出同一标签（0.581，等同平凡基线）。同参数量的奖励模型达0.764–0.976，生成式评判者达0.611–0.778，差距经Benjamini-Hochberg校正后均显著。原始置信度过度自信达+0.401，温度校准后ECE≤0.062，且校准置信度在六项基准中的三项上能高于随机地排序自身错误。顺序翻转率0.0002（生成式为0.2188），长度偏好偏移-0.023（生成式为-0.217）。置信度门控级联在0.97保留门槛下将92.3%–100%样本升级给强评判者。
AI.conclusion: CLM判别力接近随机，与其同规模生成式及奖励模型差距显著且统计可信。其唯一可靠优点是决策稳定性和可校准性，但因判别力几乎为零，基于其校准置信度的级联几乎无有效样本可保留，实用价值有限。

title: Evaluate the Stack, Not the Layer: Do Deterministic and LLM Gates for Agent Actions Fail Independently?
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure, 10 tables. Artifact (data, scripts, provenance): https://github.com/chenglin1112/evaluate-the-stack
summary: Runtime gates for agent tool calls are stacked on the assumption that their errors multiply. We test it on 1,119 labelled agent actions from three corpora, without an adaptive adversary. The stack has one deterministic rule layer and four LLM judges, three of them re-collected with the served model recorded on every call. We read each stack as a number of multiplication-equivalent layers, n_mult, with its floor under perfect coupling. Under the STRICT miss definition (escalation to a human scored as not stopped), any two judges compose to about 1.2 to 1.4 layers (φ median +0.430, 6 of 6 pairs significant, floors 1.02 to 1.17). The rule layer plus one judge composes to 1.86 to 2.09 layers (φ median +0.014, 0 of 4 significant, floors 1.01 to 1.09). Under PRIMARY (escalation scored as caught) the bands are 1.21 to 1.57 and 1.80 to 2.13. Intervals separate on the pooled data, point estimates split on each corpus, and a third-vendor judge lands in the judge band. Solo accuracy does not predict what a layer adds: a cloud rule pack lowers the rule layer's solo miss rate by 20% and adds no new joint coverage. The difficulty share of judge coupling is not identifiable: 31.8% to 61.8% depending on the probe and the miss definition. One judge tier was served by an unrequested model version in 50 of 112 batches, concentrated on the external corpus. That event overturned a pre-declared analysis rule, and the scoring of review verdicts reversed five conclusions. We report both.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验"运行时门控错误相乘"的假设，用1,119条带标签的智能体动作评估叠加式门控（1个确定性规则层+4个LLM评判器）的真实等效层数。
AI.motivation: 运行时门控被认为是独立可乘的防线，但其错误是否真的相乘此前缺乏实证检验。作者希望量化"层数"这一直觉假设是否成立，并考察评判器之间是否耦合，以及部署中的模型版本漂移对结论的影响。
AI.method: 在三个语料库的1,119条动作上，无自适应对手条件下测量门控组合。将每组门控读作"乘法等效层数"n_mult并给出完美耦合下的下界。采用两种漏检定义（STRICT：升级到人工记为未拦截；PRIMARY：升级记为已捕获）。用φ统计量检验评判器两两间相关性，并复现了三个评判器（每次调用记录所服务模型）。
AI.result: STRICT下任意两个评判器合起来仅约1.2–1.4层（φ中位数+0.430，6对全部显著，下界1.02–1.17）；规则层加一个评判器约1.86–2.09层（φ中位数+0.014，4对均不显著，下界1.01–1.09）。PRIMARY下区间为1.21–1.57与1.80–2.13。合并数据上区间可分离，单语料上点估计分离，第三方厂商评判器落入评判器带。单独准确率无法预测增量贡献：云规则包将规则层的单独漏检率降低20%却未带来新的联合覆盖。评判器耦合中难度占比不可辨识（31.8%–61.8%）。一个评判器层在112批中有50批被服务了未被请求的模型版本，集中于外部语料，该事件推翻了一条预先声明的分析规则，评审结论的打分逆转了五项结论。
AI.conclusion: 门控叠加的"错误相乘"假设不成立：同一类（LLM评判器）门控彼此高度耦合，叠加近乎无增益；异类（规则+评判器）组合才呈现接近2层的等效。单独准确率不能作为增量价值的代理指标，且部署中的模型版本漂移足以逆转分析结论，作者对两种情况均予以报告。

title: Disentangling Dual Image References in Frequency Aware Diffusion Models for Personalized Generation
comment: 28 pages, 14 figures, to appear at NeurIPS 2026, Sydney, Australia
summary: Personalized image generation aims to synthesize text-driven images conditioned on reference images, while mainly casting the generation as image customization for foreground and style transfer for background. Previous arts of diffusion models suffers from the text misalignment with background for image customization and foreground for style transfer during the denoising process. Such facts, as we observed, rooted from the entanglement among hybrid frequency bands during the denoising process. To address such salient limitation, in this paper, we study personalized generation based on dual references - customization and color and style reference - and propose a paradigm to disentangle these Dual image references within Frequency-aware Diffusion Models, dubbed Dual-FDM, to simultaneously tackle two crucial personalized image generation tasks: customization style transfer and color style transfer, by disentangling different frequency bands via mask strategy within frequency domain. For customization style transfer, we replace the mid-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from the foreground of the customized reference. For color style transfer, we substitute the low-frequency band of the background in the style reference with that from both the foreground and background of the color reference. Both the substituted frequency bands are used as the key and value to reconstruct the query foreground and background of the denoised personalized image.Extensive experiments validate the superiority of Dual-FDM over the state-of-the-art diffusion models for personalized image generation. Our code can be accessed from https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dual-FDM，一种基于频域解耦的双参考个性化图像生成范式，同时处理定制风格迁移和颜色风格迁移两类任务，性能优于现有扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化图像生成方法（扩散模型）在图像定制时存在背景与文本不对齐问题，在风格迁移时存在前景与文本不对齐问题。作者观察到这些问题的根源在于去噪过程中混合频段之间的纠缠。
AI.method: 基于双参考（定制参考与颜色/风格参考）开展个性化生成，提出 Frequency-aware Diffusion Models（Dual-FDM）。通过在频域中利用掩码策略解耦不同频段：定制风格迁移时，用定制参考前景的中频段替换风格参考背景的中频段；颜色风格迁移时，用颜色参考的前景和背景低频段替换风格参考背景的低频段。替换后的频段作为 key 和 value，用于重建去噪后个性化图像的前景与背景 query。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Dual-FDM 在个性化图像生成任务上优于当前最先进的扩散模型。代码开源于 https://github.com/htyjers/Dual-FDM。
AI.conclusion: 通过频域掩码解耦双图像参考中的不同频段，Dual-FDM 有效缓解了前景/背景与文本的不对齐问题，为定制风格迁移与颜色风格迁移提供了统一且优越的解决方案。

title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
summary: A key challenge in building AI systems for scientific research is enabling $\textit{scientific exploration}$: the systematic process of investigating unknown phenomena or ideas to gain new knowledge through sequences of research decisions and actions. Yet this process is largely missing from existing scientific corpora; for example, research papers primarily record final outcomes rather than the trajectories that produced them. In this work, we introduce $\textbf{ResearchTrails}$, a dataset of $\textbf{human research trajectories constructed from Git repositories}$, where $\textbf{commit histories}$ serve as proxies for research exploration. We develop an automated and scalable pipeline that extracts structured research trajectories from repository commits, capturing successive changes to methods, experiments, and ablations. We characterize the resulting dataset and show that these trajectories contain meaningful signals about intermediate research decisions beyond what final papers reveal. We further demonstrate utilities of ResearchTrails in multiple use cases, including retrieving human research experience as external skills at test time and training models on research trajectories to improve generalization to new research decisions. Our results suggest a path toward AI systems that learn not only from the products of science, but from the evolving process of discovery itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ResearchTrails 数据集，从 Git 仓库的提交历史中提取人类科研探索轨迹，弥补现有科学语料只记录最终成果的不足，并验证其在经验检索与模型训练中的价值。
AI.motivation: 构建科研 AI 系统的关键挑战是实现"科学探索"，即通过一系列研究决策与行动系统性地探究未知现象以获取新知识。然而现有科学语料大多缺失这一过程：研究论文主要记录最终结论，而非产生结论的研究轨迹。
AI.method: 作者构建了 ResearchTrails 数据集，以 Git 提交历史作为科研探索的代理。开发了一个自动化、可扩展的流水线，从仓库提交中抽取结构化的研究轨迹，捕捉方法、实验与消融的连续变化，并对数据集进行了特征刻画。
AI.result: 分析显示，这些轨迹包含关于中间研究决策的有效信号，且超出最终论文所揭示的信息。多个用例验证了其效用：在测试时将人类研究经验作为外部技能检索，以及在研究轨迹上训练模型以提升对新研究决策的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，AI 系统不仅可以学习科学的成果，还可以从发现过程本身中学习，为通向具备科学探索能力的 AI 系统提供了路径。

title: MemCo: Memory-Centric Collaboration for Generalizing LLM Agents to Unseen Environments
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate in interactive environments, where they need to make sequential decisions through observation, action, and feedback. Although memory can help agents reuse experience, existing work designs memory in isolation, where collecting enough trajectories to populate it is expensive. Existing shared-memory approaches mitigate isolated experience by pooling episodic memories across tasks and environments. However, retrieving shared memory is challenged by the granularity, where retrieved memories can be either too specific to preserve current grounding or too coarse to support the next action. In this work, we propose MemCo, a memory-centric collaboration framework for generalizing LLM agents to unseen interactive environments. It maintains complementary local and global memory spaces, preserving environment-specific details locally while promoting transferable workflows induced from local trajectories to global memory. During online interaction, MemCo routes relevant local and global memories in terms of the agent's current state and decision phase, enabling agents to reuse the experience of other agents without blindly transferring environment-specific details. Experiments on interactive decision-making benchmarks show that MemCo improves task success and reduces redundant exploration compared with isolate-memory and shared-memory baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/SYannL/nvdamas.

AI.tldr: 提出MemCo，一个以记忆为中心的协作框架，通过互补的局部与全局记忆空间让LLM智能体泛化到未见交互环境。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆设计孤立，收集足够轨迹代价高；共享记忆虽能缓解，但检索时存在粒度问题：记忆要么过于具体破坏当前语境接地，要么过于粗糙难以支撑下一步动作。
AI.method: MemCo维护互补的局部与全局记忆空间：局部保留环境特定细节，全局从局部轨迹中归纳可迁移的工作流；在线交互时，依据智能体当前状态和决策阶段路由相关的局部与全局记忆，使智能体复用他人经验而不盲目迁移环境特定细节。
AI.result: 在交互式决策基准测试上，MemCo相比孤立记忆和共享记忆基线，提升了任务成功率并减少了冗余探索。
AI.conclusion: 通过局部-全局互补记忆与基于状态和决策阶段的路由检索，MemCo有效解决了共享记忆的粒度问题，实现了LLM智能体在未见交互环境中的经验复用与泛化。

title: Unlocking Fine-Grained Perception in CLIP via Structurally-Aware Latent Masked Modeling
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as CLIP excel in global semantic alignment but often lack fine-grained perceptual capabilities. This hinders dense prediction tasks and bottlenecks the visual potential of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing research has attempted to enhance CLIP's visual representations by incorporating geometric priors from vision-centric models. However, these strategies often struggle to achieve deep alignment for both local spatial structures and global semantics, potentially even distorting the original image-text space. To address these limitations, we propose SALM, an unsupervised embedding alignment framework based on structurally-aware latent mask modeling. SALM effectively synergizes local and global alignment via a dual-path design combining explicit and implicit mechanisms, without requiring any image-text pairs. First, we introduce a dual-matrix alignment strategy that explicitly calibrates intra-sample spatial correlations and activation intensities, thereby effectively injecting local geometric priors. Based on this, we further design a latent mask modeling mechanism to guide CLIP to restore the missing semantic details of the target model, thereby implicitly aggregating fine-grained structures into the global semantic space. Furthermore, driven by the empirical observations that CLIP's shallow features inherently possess strong spatial observational capabilities, we naturally extend SALM to a highly efficient self-distillation paradigm, SALM-Self. This unlocks CLIP's intrinsic fine-grained potential without relying on any external models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SALM not only significantly improves performance in dense prediction tasks but also boosts CLIP's zero-shot accuracy, effectively enhancing the fine-grained understanding capabilities of MLLMs. Project page at https://qzfm.github.io/salm_project_page/.

AI.tldr: SALM：一种无需图像-文本对的无监督嵌入对齐框架，通过结构感知潜在掩码建模，融合局部几何先验与全局语义，提升CLIP的细粒度感知能力。
AI.motivation: CLIP等视觉-语言模型擅长全局语义对齐，但缺乏细粒度感知能力，制约了密集预测任务及多模态大模型的视觉潜力。现有借助视觉模型几何先验的增强方法难以同时实现局部空间结构与全局语义的深度对齐，甚至可能扭曲原始图像-文本空间。
AI.method: 提出SALM框架，采用显式与隐式结合的双路径设计，无需图像-文本对。1) 双矩阵对齐策略：显式校准样本内空间相关性与激活强度，注入局部几何先验；2) 潜在掩码建模机制：引导CLIP恢复目标模型缺失的语义细节，将细粒度结构隐式聚合到全局语义空间；3) 基于CLIP浅层特征具强空间观测力的发现，扩展出高效自蒸馏范式SALM-Self。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SALM不仅显著提升密集预测任务性能，还提高了CLIP的零样本准确率，有效增强了多模态大模型的细粒度理解能力。
AI.conclusion: SALM通过无监督的结构感知对齐，兼顾局部与全局语义，在不依赖外部模型（SALM-Self）的情况下释放CLIP内在细粒度潜力，为提升VLMs与MLLMs的感知能力提供了有效途径。

title: Exact Unlearning via Quantized Sufficient Statistics
comment: 33 pages, 20 figures, 15 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Exact unlearning requires a deployed predictor to match one rebuilt without the information named by a deletion request. Existing general-purpose exact methods localize retraining through disjoint shards, but every request still invalidates a model, and smaller shards reduce the data available to each constituent predictor. We introduce Quantized Sufficient Statistics (QSS), which separates a small frozen schema from mutable, sum-decomposable content. The schema learns global structure; the content stores local prediction corrections as additive statistics indexed by quantized regions. Deleting content is therefore exact subtraction rather than optimization. We distinguish two guarantees: QSS-L exactly removes a label while retaining the unlabelled input, whereas QSS-E exactly removes both input and label by learning the schema without deletable examples. A deletion takes the arithmetic fast path with probability $1-ρ$ and triggers a full rebuild with probability $ρ$; all reported expected latencies include both events. Across 15 vision, text, and tabular datasets at $ρ=0.5\%$, QSS-L is within 2 percentage points of SISA on 11 tasks and provides 4--483$\times$ lower expected deletion latency on the low-class-count tasks where a compact schema is effective. QSS-E quantifies the additional accuracy cost of removing every trace of an input.

AI.tldr: 提出量化充分统计量（QSS）方法，将模型拆为冻结的全局模式与可加性、可减的量化内容，实现删除即精确减法而非重优化，在视觉/文本/表格15个数据集上以极低期望删除延迟达到接近精确遗忘的效果。
AI.motivation: 精确遗忘要求部署模型与移除被删数据后重建的模型一致，但现有通用精确方法（如SISA）依赖不相交分片进行局部重训：每次删除请求仍会使一个模型失效，且分片越小，各子模型可用数据越少，精度与效率难以兼顾。因此需要一种既保证精确性又能显著降低删除延迟的机制。
AI.method: QSS将预测器分为两部分：一个冻结的小型模式（schema）学习全局结构；可变的内容（content）以按量化区域索引的加性统计量存储局部预测校正。删除内容即为精确的算术减法，而非优化过程。方法区分两种保证：QSS-L在保留无标签输入的同时精确移除标签；QSS-E通过在不含可删样本的情况下学习模式，精确移除输入与标签。删除以概率1-ρ走算术快速路径，以概率ρ触发完全重建，报告延迟包含两种事件的期望。
AI.result: 在15个视觉、文本与表格数据集上，ρ=0.5%时：QSS-L在11个任务上与SISA的精度差距在2个百分点以内，并在低类别数任务上实现4–483倍的更低期望删除延迟（此类任务中紧凑模式更有效）。QSS-E进一步量化了彻底移除输入所有痕迹所带来的额外精度代价。
AI.conclusion: QSS通过将删除转化为加性统计量的精确减法，在保持与SISA相当精度的同时大幅降低期望删除延迟，并给出了两种精确遗忘保证（仅标签/输入与标签）及其精度代价的量化分析。

title: Defense-in-Depth for LLMs: Evaluating Memory Gates Against Activation-Induced and Memory-Induced Sycophancy
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS (IAB, RTCA, AIWILD, and CL4FM)
summary: Long-term memory allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to maintain personalized context across interactions, but retrieved user history can induce memory-induced sycophancy, causing models to favor stored user beliefs over objective evidence. Existing defenses primarily operate on retrieved context and are rarely evaluated jointly with internal behavioral bias. We introduce a $2 \times 2$ defense-in-depth framework separating internal activation steering from external memory handling. We extract sycophancy steering directions from 100 paired prompts and evaluate four open-weight models across 10 steering coefficients and five memory-defense configurations on MemSyco-Bench (answers for all 1,550 items; defense conditions judged on a fixed 250-item subsample), with three LLM judges. Three of the five configurations are new (rewriting every memory, a Router Gate that keeps, rewrites, or drops each memory, and dropping all memory); the other two are MemSyco's baselines. Selective Router Gate filtering preserves substantially more of MemSyco's average accuracy than complete memory removal, and this separation persists when the models are steered toward sycophancy. On Llama 3.1 8B with Router Gate, mild inverse steering ($α= -1.5$) lowers judge-averaged sycophancy from 35.80% to 31.32% while average accuracy moves from 43.99% to 43.31%; this reduction has the same direction under all three judges but is not statistically significant (paired $p = 0.08$ to $0.63$ on 149 items). External memory filtering is the part of the design that holds up; our data do not show that inverse steering adds to it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个2×2纵深防御框架，将内部激活转向与外部记忆处理分离，用于缓解长期记忆引发的谄媚行为；实验表明选择性记忆过滤（Router Gate）比完全移除记忆更能保留准确率，而反向转向的额外收益未被统计显著地证实。
AI.motivation: 长期记忆让大模型能跨交互维持个性化上下文，但检索到的用户历史会诱发"记忆诱导型谄媚"，使模型偏向存储的用户信念而非客观证据。现有防御多只作用于检索上下文，且很少与模型内部行为偏差联合评估，因此需要一个同时覆盖内部与外部层面的防御框架。
AI.method: 提出2×2纵深防御框架，分离内部激活转向与外部记忆处理。从100对提示中提取谄媚转向方向，在4个开放权重模型、10个转向系数、5种记忆防御配置上评测，使用MemSyco-Bench（全部1550题作答，防御条件在固定250题子样本上评判），并由3个LLM裁判评分。5种配置中3种为新设计：改写每条记忆、Router Gate（对每条记忆保留/改写/丢弃）、丢弃全部记忆；另2种为MemSyco基线。
AI.result: 选择性Router Gate过滤比完全移除记忆保留显著更多的MemSyco平均准确率，且该分离在模型被转向谄媚时依然存在。在Llama 3.1 8B配合Router Gate时，轻度反向转向（α=-1.5）将裁判平均谄媚率从35.80%降至31.32%，平均准确率从43.99%变为43.31%；该下降在3个裁判下方向一致，但统计不显著（149题上配对p=0.08至0.63）。
AI.conclusion: 外部记忆过滤是设计中真正站得住脚的部分；数据未能显示反向激活转向能在其之上带来额外增益。

title: Anchor-driven Multi-modal Multi-scale Expert Selection for Survival Prediction
summary: The integrative analysis of histopathological Whole-Slide Images (WSIs) and transcriptomic profiles holds significant promise for cancer survival prediction. However, existing methods typically project multi-modal features directly into a shared latent space without explicit alignment, leading to the entanglement of mismatched morphological cues and molecular signals. Furthermore, current fusion strategies often treat the extreme spatial heterogeneity of WSIs uniformly, lacking mechanisms to adaptively prioritize clinically relevant tissue scales for individual patients. To address these limitations, we propose an Anchor-driven Multi-modal Multi-scale Expert Selection (AM$^2$ES) framework for survival prediction. Specifically, we present an Anchor-driven Multi-modal Fusion (AMF) module, which introduces learnable semantic anchors as cross-modal mediators to bridge the semantic gap by enforcing a structurally regularized alignment between transcriptomic features and multi-scale pathology representations. Built upon this aligned semantic space, we further design a Hierarchical Mixture-of-Experts (H-MoE) selection module to decouple the hierarchical prognostic selection process. Mimicking the pathologist's diagnostic workflow, H-MoE performs (i) Intra-scale Expert Filtering to discriminatively identify salient tumor regions within each magnification, and (ii) Inter-scale Hierarchy Routing to dynamically weight and select the most informative resolution levels. Extensive experiments on multiple TCGA cancer cohorts demonstrate that our AM$^2$ES achieves state-of-the-art performance while offering fine-grained interpretability by visualizing how specific molecular pathways drive the expert routing decisions across tissue scales. The code will be released at https://github.com/taozh2017/AM2ES.

AI.tldr: 提出AM²ES框架，通过锚点驱动的多模态对齐与分层专家选择，提升病理WSI与转录组联合生存预测性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有WSI与转录组联合生存预测方法通常将多模态特征直接映射到共享隐空间而缺乏显式对齐，导致形态学线索与分子信号错配纠缠；同时融合策略对WSI极端空间异质性一视同仁，缺乏针对个体患者自适应优先关注临床相关组织尺度的机制。
AI.method: 提出AM²ES框架：1）锚点驱动多模态融合（AMF）模块，引入可学习语义锚点作为跨模态中介，通过结构正则化对齐转录组特征与多尺度病理表征，弥合语义鸿沟；2）基于对齐语义空间设计分层专家混合（H-MoE）选择模块，解耦分层预后选择过程，模拟病理学家诊断流程，包含尺度内专家过滤（识别各放大倍数下显著肿瘤区域）与跨尺度层级路由（动态加权选择信息量最高的分辨率层级）。
AI.result: 在多个TCGA癌症队列上的大量实验表明，AM²ES达到最先进性能，并通过可视化特定分子通路如何驱动跨组织尺度的专家路由决策，提供细粒度可解释性。
AI.conclusion: AM²ES通过显式多模态对齐与分层多尺度专家选择，有效解决模态错配与空间异质性挑战，在生存预测任务中兼顾性能与可解释性，代码将开源。

title: Distributionally Robust Mixture-of-Experts Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers scale capacity by activating only a few experts per token, but this sparsity creates a hidden reliability problem: when routing is imperfect, load-balanced models may send tokens to experts that are insufficiently trained for the assigned inputs. We propose Distributionally Robust MoE Training (DRMoET), a drop-in objective that treats layer-wise experts as endogenous robustness groups and optimizes high-loss routing outcomes rather than merely equalizing traffic. DRMoET updates a per-layer expert distribution by an entropy-regularized softmax rule on EMA-smoothed, activation-weighted expert losses, strengthening plausible non-top routing paths while preserving standard MoE computation. Under the FLAME-MoE recipe at 746M-total and 10.3B-total scales, DRMoET improves downstream averages over both standard FLAME-MoE and auxiliary-loss-free balancing. At 10.3B total parameters and 67B training tokens, DRMoET improves the seven-task average from 0.6625 to 0.6767, while the auxiliary-loss-free baseline achieves 0.6431. Mechanistic analyses show lower expert-loss variance with nearly unchanged mean loss, 4.3% lower excess loss under forced mid-$k$ misrouting, and improved domain-expert specialization. These results position routing robustness-not only utilization balance-as a practical objective for reliable sparse MoE scaling. Project page and code are available at: https://drmoet.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DRMoET，一种即插即用的分布鲁棒MoE训练目标，通过优化高损失路由结果提升稀疏MoE的可靠性，在10.3B规模下将七任务平均从0.6625提升至0.6767。
AI.motivation: MoE通过稀疏激活扩展容量，但路由不完美时，负载均衡模型可能将token分配给训练不足的专家，形成隐藏的可靠性问题。现有方法仅关注流量均衡，忽视了路由鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将每层专家视为内生的鲁棒性分组，用熵正则化softmax规则在EMA平滑、激活加权的专家损失上更新每层专家分布，强化合理的非top路由路径，同时保持标准MoE计算。
AI.result: 在FLAME-MoE配方下（746M和10.3B总参数），DRMoET下游平均优于标准FLAME-MoE和无辅助损失均衡方法。10.3B参数、67B token时七任务平均从0.6625升至0.6767，而无辅助损失基线为0.6431。机制分析显示专家损失方差更低、平均损失几乎不变、强制中k误路由下超额损失降低4.3%、领域专家专精性提升。
AI.conclusion: 路由鲁棒性（而非仅利用率均衡）是可靠稀疏MoE扩展的实用目标，DRMoET为此提供了有效方案。

title: 2d-fet-bench: from spatial reasoning to fet design on flakes
summary: Field-effect transistor (FET) layouts on exfoliated two-dimensional flakes are typically drawn by hand for each flake, placing contacts and gates to match its position and outline in optical micrographs. To our knowledge, no executable benchmark tests whether language-model agents can perform this flake-specific construction reliably. We introduce 2D-FET-Bench V2, a benchmark of 128 layout tasks built from microscopy-derived flake contours, including hole-containing flakes and multi-flake tasks. Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. A deterministic verifier checks geometric and structural requirements, and a separate integrity check verifies that the supplied contours remain unchanged. Scripted reference layouts pass all 128 tasks, showing that every task is solvable. We evaluate six models and seven workflow and scaffold variants of GPT5.6-Luna, with five attempts per task. The best-performing configuration in the six-model panel, GPT5.6-Luna with ReAct-3, passes 62.3% of attempts and solves 80.5% of tasks at least once (coverage) and 43.8% in all five attempts (consistency). ReAct-3 exceeds the one-pass Plan-and-Execute by 27.0 pass@1 points at 2.46 times the tokens. An expert audit of one sampled verifier-passing layout per covered task, across five ReAct-3 configurations, accepts 56.4% to 63.5% of them. The benchmark evaluates geometric and structural FET layout construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 2D-FET-Bench V2，一个用于评测语言模型智能体能否完成二维材料场效应晶体管版图构建的基准，包含 128 项任务，最优配置在单次尝试通过率 62.3%、任务覆盖 80.5%。
AI.motivation: 二维剥离薄片的 FET 版图通常需针对每个薄片手工绘制，以匹配显微图像中的位置与轮廓，缺乏可执行的基准来检验语言模型智能体能否可靠完成这种薄片相关的构建工作。
AI.method: 基于显微图像提取的薄片轮廓构建 128 项版图任务，含带孔薄片与多薄片任务；每项任务给出文本化器件规格与轮廓坐标，智能体生成带类型的多边形与路径操作并渲染为 GDSII；使用确定性验证器检查几何与结构要求，另设完整性检查确保轮廓未被改动；评测六个模型及 GPT5.6-Luna 的七种工作流/脚手架变体，每任务五次尝试。
AI.result: 脚本参考版图通过全部 128 项任务，证明任务均可解；六模型组中最佳配置 GPT5.6-Luna + ReAct-3 单次尝试通过率 62.3%，任务覆盖 80.5%，五次全部通过率 43.8%；ReAct-3 相比一次性 Plan-and-Execute 的 pass@1 高 27.0 个百分点，但消耗 2.46 倍 token；专家审阅覆盖任务中每任务一个通过验证的版图样本，在五种 ReAct-3 配置下接受率为 56.4% 至 63.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准可评测 FET 版图的几何与结构构建能力，揭示当前智能体在可靠完成薄片相关版图任务上仍有明显差距，且验证器通过并不完全等同于专家认可。

title: RBMatch: Dual-Level Class Rebalancing for Semi-Supervised Building Footprint Extraction
summary: Accurate building footprint extraction from high-resolution remote sensing imagery is essential for urban planning, disaster response, and environmental monitoring. However, obtaining dense pixel-level annotations is costly, motivating the use of semi-supervised learning (SSL) to leverage unlabeled imagery. In remote sensing, severe foreground--background imbalance poses a particular challenge for self-training, as it can bias pseudo-label generation and the resulting unsupervised optimization toward the majority background class. We show that addressing this imbalance at only one stage is insufficient: balancing pseudo-label selection alone does not prevent background bias from re-emerging during unsupervised loss optimization, a failure mode we term \emph{imbalance leak}. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{RBMatch}, a dual-level class-rebalancing framework that jointly regulates pseudo-label generation and unsupervised optimization. RBMatch combines a supervised learning pathway with a self-training module comprising three components: adaptive class-specific thresholding (ACT) for balanced pseudo-label selection, confidence-aware class-balanced reweighting (CACBR) for mitigating class bias in the unsupervised loss, and distribution alignment (DAL) for matching the predicted unlabeled-data distribution to the labeled-data prior. Experiments on the WHU, INRIA, and Massachusetts building footprint datasets across labeled ratios of 1%--10% show that RBMatch consistently achieves the best building IoU and F1-score among the evaluated methods. The improvement is most pronounced on the highly imbalanced Massachusetts dataset, where RBMatch improves IoU by 1.37 points over the strongest baseline at a 1% labeling ratio and is the only method to outperform the fully supervised baseline across all twelve dataset--ratio settings.

AI.tldr: 提出RBMatch，通过双层类别重平衡框架解决遥感建筑提取半监督学习中的“imbalance leak”问题。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率遥感影像的建筑足迹提取对城市规划、灾害响应和环境监测至关重要，但像素级标注成本高昂，需借助半监督学习利用无标注影像。遥感场景中前景-背景严重不平衡会给自训练带来困难，使伪标签生成和无监督优化偏向多数背景类。作者指出仅在单一阶段处理不平衡不足够：仅平衡伪标签选择无法阻止背景偏差在无监督损失优化阶段再次出现，即“imbalance leak”。
AI.method: 提出RBMatch双层级类别重平衡框架，同时调控伪标签生成与无监督优化。框架结合监督学习路径与自训练模块，自训练模块含三个组件：自适应类别特定阈值（ACT）用于平衡伪标签选择；置信度感知的类别平衡重加权（CACBR）用于缓解无监督损失中的类别偏差；分布对齐（DAL）用于使无标注数据的预测分布匹配有标注数据先验。
AI.result: 在WHU、INRIA、Massachusetts建筑足迹数据集上，标注比例1%–10%的实验中，RBMatch在评估方法中持续取得最佳建筑IoU和F1分数。在不平衡程度最高的Massachusetts数据集上提升最明显：1%标注率下IoU比最强基线高1.37个点，并且是唯一在全部十二个数据集-比例设置下都超过全监督基线的方法。
AI.conclusion: RBMatch通过联合调控伪标签生成与无监督优化，有效缓解前景-背景不平衡导致的imbalance leak，在低标注率遥感建筑足迹提取中显著优于现有半监督方法与全监督基线。

title: Can LLM-assisted regularization increase forecast accuracy for migration flows in low data regimes?
summary: Predicting migration flows remains a significant challenge for traditional gravity-based forecasting models, which primarily rely on structured socio-economic indicators such as economic disparity, political stability, and geographic distance. This work investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can improve migration forecasting by extracting contextual migration-related signals from news articles and incorporating them into a weighted Lasso forecasting framework through feature-specific regularization penalties. The proposed framework uses hierarchical LLM inference pipelines to classify migration-related push--pull signals from news data and evaluates the resulting forecasting performance across multiple migration corridors between November 2021 and November 2022, including Mexico--United States, Ukraine--Poland, and Syria--Turkey. Experimental results showed mixed performance across migration corridors and modeling strategies, and no single regularization approach consistently outperformed the others across all experiments. The best-performing Mexico configuration, which consisted of a gravity-based model augmented with the proposed push--pull ratios, achieved a Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) of 17.15%, while the strongest Syria configuration achieved a MAPE of 29.29% using Direct LLM-Lasso. For Ukraine, the best-performing configuration used LLM-Assisted Regularization (AR) and achieved a MAPE of 41.05%. Overall, the results suggest that contextual article-derived features and LLM-guided regularization can improve migration forecasting under certain conditions, although migration corridor characteristics, article volume, and hyperparameter configuration strongly influenced performance.

AI.tldr: 本文探索用大语言模型从新闻中提取迁移相关信号，并将其融入加权Lasso预测框架以改进迁移流量预测。
AI.motivation: 传统基于重力的预测模型主要依赖结构化社会经济指标（如经济差距、政治稳定性和地理距离），在迁移流量预测上仍面临显著挑战，因此作者希望引入新闻文本中的情境化信号来提升预测能力。
AI.method: 使用分层LLM推理流程从新闻数据中分类迁移相关的推—拉信号，并通过特征特定正则化惩罚将其纳入加权Lasso预测框架；在2021年11月至2022年11月间的多条迁移走廊上评估预测表现，包括墨西哥—美国、乌克兰—波兰和叙利亚—土耳其。
AI.result: 各迁移走廊和建模策略表现不一，没有单一正则化方法在所有实验中持续占优。表现最好的墨西哥配置（重力模型+推—拉比率）MAPE为17.15%；叙利亚最佳配置（Direct LLM-Lasso）MAPE为29.29%；乌克兰最佳配置（LLM-Assisted Regularization）MAPE为41.05%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，情境化文章衍生特征和LLM引导的正则化在特定条件下可改善迁移预测，但迁移走廊特征、文章数量与超参数配置会强烈影响预测性能。

title: Adaptive Gait Biofeedback With Participant-Held-Out Modeling and Participant-Specific Updating in Chronic Ankle Instability
comment: 28 pages (14-page main manuscript and 14-page supplementary material), 5 main figures
summary: Adaptive gait biofeedback may support repeated practice in chronic ankle instability, but its evaluation must address model performance and human response. We evaluated a temporal convolutional classifier on protocol-defined, angle-derived GOOD/BAD gait-cycle labels using participant-held-out leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) cross-validation in 20 participants. Seven participants in the adaptive-intervention group completed nine sessions over three weeks, with one motion-capture recording analyzed per session. Models updated after failed sessions were compared offline with their parent models on the same-session validation subset used for candidate selection and the first subsequent adaptive-session recording. Frontal-plane ankle angle was compared between the adaptive group and 10 sequentially enrolled controls at Baseline, Post, and 7-day Retention. Across 20 held-out folds, mean fold-level area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.948, sensitivity for angle-threshold-exceeding BAD cycles was 0.941, and specificity for angle-threshold-meeting GOOD cycles was 0.366. Mean BAD-class F1 was higher in candidate models by 0.187 on the same-session subset and 0.118 on the first subsequent recording. At Post, the adaptive group had a baseline-adjusted frontal-plane ankle angle 5.168 degrees lower than controls (95% confidence interval, 1.766-8.569 degrees lower); the Retention contrast was uncertain. These findings characterize population-model discrimination and offline participant-specific updating during repeated biofeedback use, alongside a nonrandomized Post frontal-plane ankle angle association. They do not establish independent clinical gait classification or a causal benefit of updating.

AI.tldr: 该研究在20名慢性踝关节不稳者中评估时序卷积分类器的步态GOOD/BAD标签性能（LOSO交叉验证），并考察自适应生物反馈干预中模型离线更新效果及踝角变化。
AI.motivation: 自适应步态生物反馈可能支持慢性踝关节不稳的重复训练，但其评估需同时兼顾模型性能与人体响应两方面证据。
AI.method: 采用参试者留一交叉验证（LOSO）评估时序卷积分类器；7名自适应干预组完成3周9次训练，每次一次动作捕捉；对失败会话后更新的模型与其父模型进行离线比较（同一会话验证子集及首次后续自适应会话记录）；比较自适应组与10名序贯入组对照者的额面踝角（基线、Post、7天Retention）。
AI.result: 20折平均AUROC 0.948，对超阈值BAD周期敏感度0.941，对达标GOOD周期特异度0.366。候选模型BAD类平均F1在同一会话子集高0.187、在首次后续记录高0.118。Post时自适应组基线校正后额面踝角较对照组低5.168度（95%CI 1.766–8.569），Retention对比不确定。
AI.conclusion: 结果刻画了群体模型判别力与重复反馈中离线个体化更新，并显示非随机的Post踝角关联；但未能确立独立的临床步态分类，也不能证明模型更新具有因果获益。

title: What Frame-Level Labels Can and Cannot Do for Small-UAV Point Detection in Thermal Video
summary: The growing use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) has increased the importance of image-based UAV detection. Learning-based detectors are trained on imagery and annotations, with annotation type determining the information available during training. We focus on learning localization from frame-level target presence/absence labels when sensor or scene changes make spatial annotations for additional training burdensome. We analyze the detection capability, learning behavior, and potential applications of an existing architecture for point detection of small UAVs, trained with presence/absence labels and requiring no external detector. The architecture freezes spatial features learned through classification and trains a readout with the same frame labels to produce spatial score maps and point detections. On two thermal infrared datasets, CST Anti-UAV and Anti-UAV410, we evaluate localization hit rates and detection rates under false-alarm constraints, analyze the effects of training stages, label allocation, synthesis, and model configuration, and compare with bounding-box detectors. We also explore potential applications on Airborne Object Tracking (AOT) using its visible-light imagery and frame labels. Classification training strengthened target-related spatial responses, while readout training helped extract them consistently. Distributing similar label counts across more videos yielded higher localization hit rates, while synthesis effects varied by dataset and evaluation criterion. Higher localization hit rates did not always improve detection under false-alarm constraints, and failures remained when target signals were weak relative to background variation and under cross-dataset transfer. These findings provide guidance on label allocation, spatial representations and readouts, synthesis, and false-alarm control.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在仅有帧级“存在/缺失”标签、无空间标注条件下，对小尺寸无人机进行点检测的可行性与学习行为。
AI.motivation: 传感器或场景变化使空间标注成本高昂，因此需要探索仅依赖帧级标签的无人机检测方法。
AI.method: 采用现有架构冻结分类阶段学到的空间特征，并用相同帧标签训练读出层，生成空间分数图与点检测；在CST Anti-UAV和Anti-UAV410两个热红外数据集上评估定位命中率及虚警约束下的检测率，并分析训练阶段、标签分配、合成与模型配置的影响，同时与边界框检测器比较，并在AOT可见光图像上探索应用。
AI.result: 分类训练增强了目标相关空间响应，读出训练有助于稳定提取；将相似标签数量分散到更多视频可提高定位命中率；合成效果因数据集和评价标准而异；更高定位命中率不一定改善虚警约束下的检测；目标信号弱或跨数据集迁移时仍存在失败。
AI.conclusion: 研究为标签分配、空间表示与读出、合成及虚警控制提供了指导。

title: Reward-Driven Learning under Prompt-Level Differential Privacy
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trains a language model on problems that may themselves be confidential, and the trained model can reveal which problems it saw. We study RLVR under prompt-level differential privacy: the released weights must be (ε,δ)-differentially private with respect to the presence of any one training problem. Taking the group of responses to one prompt as the privacy record, our method aggregates their gradients, clips the prompt's contribution once, adds Gaussian noise, and composes the privacy loss across updates, so the budget depends on neither the number of responses per prompt nor the clipping norm; to our knowledge this is the first differential privacy guarantee for RLVR training. We train Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with LoRA at a per-run budget of ε=8 and compare, on the same prompts and at the same budget, a control that removes only the reward signal and two private supervised fine-tuning recipes. The reward signal improves accuracy over the control by 2.65 points on MATH and 3.24 on GSM8K, in every seed; the improvement survives a format-robust scorer, at 1.3 points on MATH, and is not explained by response length. At the same budget the private model outperforms both supervised recipes on MATH and GSM8K by 2.3 to 3.8 points, retains 85--90% of the gain of non-private GRPO on these tasks, and on MATH the noise of an eightfold tighter budget costs at most 1.2 points. The reward effect also carries to CommonsenseQA, an exploratory non-mathematical task. Verifier feedback thus remains a usable learning signal under prompt-level privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练提供差分隐私保证，在提示级差分隐私下训练Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，证明奖励信号在隐私约束下仍是有效的学习信号。
AI.motivation: RLVR训练所用的问题可能本身是机密的，而训练后的模型会泄露它见过哪些问题，因此需要研究在提示级差分隐私下进行RLVR训练。
AI.method: 以单个提示的所有回答作为隐私记录，聚合其梯度、对提示贡献只裁剪一次（clipping）、加入高斯噪声，并跨更新步组合隐私损失，使预算不依赖于每个提示的回答数量或裁剪范数。使用LoRA训练Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，在ε=8预算下与去掉奖励信号的对照组及两种私有监督微调方案对比。
AI.result: 奖励信号相比对照组在MATH上提升2.65分、GSM8K上提升3.24分，且在每个随机种子上都成立；该提升在格式鲁棒评分器下仍存在（MATH上1.3分），且不能由回答长度解释。相同预算下，私有模型在MATH和GSM8K上比两种监督方案高2.3至3.8分，保留非私有GRPO增益的85%至90%，在MATH上收紧八倍预算的噪声代价至多1.2分。奖励效应还延伸到CommonsenseQA。
AI.conclusion: 在提示级隐私约束下，验证器反馈仍然是一种可用的学习信号。

title: When Does AI Supervision Help? A Role-Aware Study of Network Fraud Decision Management with Blockchain Auditability
summary: When does a second artificial intelligence (AI) component improve a primary network-fraud decision rather than add operational burden? We study this question through a role-aware Decider-Supervisor (DS) framework with blockchain auditability, evaluating four directional configurations that combine centralised machine learning, a Federated Averaging (FedAvg)-trained federated meta-model, and Base or Quantized Low-Rank Adaptation (QLoRA) large language model variants. The analysis compares primary-only and supervised decisions using non-hard fraud performance, intervention burden, conditional calibration, traffic-mix and Review-capacity sensitivity, dependability tests, and blockchain lifecycle controls. The deterministic hard gate resolves 89.994% of fraudulent requests, leaving the non-hard population as the main AI decision setting. Conditional validation calibration does not produce a consistently transferable supervisory advantage on deployment replay. DS-3 QLoRA is the least disruptive supervised configuration, but it still underperforms its primary FedAvg stage in F1 and total errors. Across 36 reweighted traffic mixtures, supervision reduces total errors only for DS-4 Base in two extreme high-fraud scenarios. Blockchain tests support digest verification, tamper detection, authorisation, single-use review resolution, and post-finalisation integrity, while exposing a pre-finalisation single-write limitation. The results show that the value of AI supervision depends on role assignment, calibration, escalation policy, traffic composition, and lifecycle controls rather than on the presence of a second model alone.

AI.tldr: 本文通过角色感知的 Decider-Supervisor (DS) 框架研究何时第二个 AI 组件能改进网络欺诈决策而非增加负担，发现监督价值取决于角色分配、校准、升级策略、流量构成和生命周期控制，而非第二模型本身的存在。
AI.motivation: 探讨何时引入第二个 AI 组件能真正改进主要网络欺诈决策，而不是仅仅增加运营负担。
AI.method: 提出带区块链可审计性的角色感知 Decider-Supervisor (DS) 框架，评估四种方向性配置，结合中心化机器学习、FedAvg 训练的联邦元模型，以及 Base 或 QLoRA 大语言模型变体。分析比较仅主决策与监督决策，涵盖非硬欺诈性能、干预负担、条件校准、流量混合与审核容量敏感度、可靠性测试及区块链生命周期控制。
AI.result: 确定性硬门控解决 89.994% 的欺诈请求；条件验证校准未在部署重放中产生一致可迁移的监督优势；DS-3 QLoRA 是干扰最小的监督配置，但在 F1 和总误差上仍不如其 FedAvg 主阶段；在 36 种重加权流量混合中，仅 DS-4 Base 在两种极端高欺诈场景下监督降低了总误差；区块链测试支持摘要验证、篡改检测、授权、单次审核解决和最终化后完整性，但暴露了最终化前的单次写入限制。
AI.conclusion: AI 监督的价值取决于角色分配、校准、升级策略、流量构成和生命周期控制，而非单纯依赖第二个模型的存在。

title: Comprehensive Evaluation and Fine-Tuning of Foundational Cell Nuclei Segmentation Models in Renal Pathology
comment: 11 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2027
summary: Accurate nuclei instance segmentation is essential for quantitative renal pathology, yet general-purpose models often struggle with low contrast, dense nuclei, complex morphology, and strong background staining. In this work, we extended a human-in-the-loop framework by combining 5,901 foundation-model-generated pseudo-labels from well-segmented cases (Easy), 860 newly expert-annotated unresolved challenging cases (Medium), and 198 expert-annotated consensus failure cases (Hard). These annotations, spanning different levels of segmentation difficulty, enabled the systematic evaluation of seven single-source and mixed-source fine-tuning strategies across nine cell segmentation model configurations. Fine-tuning improved all models, with Medium data included in seven of the nine best-performing strategies. LSP-DETR achieved the highest F1 score of 0.8725 with Hard-only fine-tuning, while StarDist showed the largest improvement, increasing from 0.7380 to 0.8332 with Medium-only fine-tuning. These findings show that annotations spanning multiple difficulty levels support effective model adaptation, although the optimal annotation composition remains model dependent.

AI.tldr: 构建含不同难度层级标注的人机协同框架，系统评估九种细胞分割模型的单源与混合源微调策略，发现微调普遍提升性能且最优标注组合因模型而异。
AI.motivation: 精确的细胞核实例分割对定量肾脏病理学至关重要，但通用模型在低对比度、细胞核密集、形态复杂和强背景染色等条件下表现不佳，需要针对性的模型适配方案。
AI.method: 扩展人机协同框架，整合三类标注：来自分割良好样本的5901个基础模型生成伪标签（Easy）、860个新专家标注的未解决困难样本（Medium）、198个专家标注的共识失败样本（Hard）。基于这些跨难度标注，系统评估七种单源与混合源微调策略在九种细胞分割模型配置下的表现。
AI.result: 微调提升了所有模型，九种最佳策略中七种包含Medium数据；LSP-DETR在仅用Hard微调时取得最高F1分0.8725；StarDist提升最大，仅用Medium微调时从0.7380升至0.8332。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖多个难度层级的标注能够支持有效的模型适配，但最优标注组合仍取决于具体模型。

title: Constant-Curvature Sliced Gromov-Wasserstein for Heterogeneous Cross-Curvature Alignment
summary: Recent advances in representation learning have highlighted the utility of constant-curvature models, such as hyperbolic and spherical spaces, for modeling complex data. Mixed-curvature models further enhance this by integrating multiple constant-curvature components. However, these models typically learn each component space independently because spaces with different curvatures are inherently heterogeneous and lack a unified metric. Consequently, they lack explicit mechanisms to enforce geometric consistency across various spaces. Moreover, the problem of comparing probability distributions across mixed-curvature spaces remains unexplored. To compare distributions on heterogeneous spaces, Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) distances provide a principled framework by aligning their intra-space geometries. Building on this, we propose constant-curvature sliced Gromov-Wasserstein (CCSGW), a novel divergence for aligning distributions supported on heterogeneous constant-curvature spaces. We first introduce the missing geodesic-based one-dimensional projections for spherical spaces, and then extend sliced GW to constant-curvature spaces, enabling efficient and principled comparison across manifolds with different curvatures. This formulation preserves intrinsic geometric relationships while avoiding the high computational cost. We provide theoretical analysis showing that CCSGW controls intrinsic geometric discrepancy across heterogeneous spaces, promoting distribution-level geometric consistency. By integrating CCSGW into existing mixed-curvature learning tasks, including graph anomaly detection, graph node classification, and multimodal learning, we observe consistent performance gains across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了常曲率切片Gromov-Wasserstein（CCSGW）散度，用于对齐异构常曲率空间上的分布，弥补混合曲率模型缺乏统一度量与跨空间几何一致性的问题。
AI.motivation: 混合曲率模型整合多个常曲率分量，但不同曲率空间本质异构、缺乏统一度量，各分量通常独立学习，缺少显式机制保证跨空间几何一致性；同时跨混合曲率空间比较概率分布的问题尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出CCSGW散度：先补充球面空间缺失的基于测地线的一维投影，再将切片Gromov-Wasserstein扩展到常曲率空间，通过对齐各空间内部几何实现异构空间上分布的高效、有原则比较，并避免高计算成本。
AI.result: 理论分析表明CCSGW能控制异构空间间的内在几何差异，促进分布级几何一致性；在图表异常检测、图节点分类和多模态学习等任务中均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CCSGW为异构常曲率空间上的分布对齐提供了原理性且高效的框架，保留内在几何关系的同时提升混合曲率学习任务的性能。

title: Auditable Claims about AI Agents
summary: Organizations make claims about their AI agents: a person approves every external email, every action is logged, an evaluation shows the agent is safe to deploy. Article 12 of the EU AI Act requires high-risk systems to allow the automatic recording of events but does not say which records settle a given claim. The position is one sentence: to be checked, a claim about an agent must first name its policy, its scope, the records that would settle it, and who writes them. Adapting the preconditions of an assurance engagement, we call a claim auditable when these elements and a decision rule are fixed before any verdict and the records are obtainable. This extends the Policy Checkability dimension of our Auditable Agents framework from single actions to claims. Agents add three conditions: coverage by an independent record, authorization bound to each action's arguments, and completeness beyond integrity. Under an explicit model, we prove that support is impossible without each wherever its hypotheses hold. A claim-check table applies the method to six common claims, anchored in current NIST, IETF, and OWASP drafts. A worked case follows one claim through five evidence states. We close with a practice box and steps for operators, buyers, auditors, and standard setters.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可审计声明"的概念：要让关于AI智能体的声明可被核查，必须先明确其策略、范围、可定案的记录以及记录由谁生成。作者将保证业务的前置条件扩展到智能体场景，并加入三项智能体特有条件（独立记录覆盖、与动作参数绑定的授权、超越完整性的完备性），在显式模型下证明缺失任一条件则支持不可行，并给出声明-核查表、案例与实操步骤。
AI.motivation: 组织常对AI智能体做出各类声明（如每次外部邮件都经人工批准、每个动作都被记录、评估显示可安全部署），但EU AI Act第12条仅要求高风险系统支持自动记录事件，并未说明哪些记录足以定案某一声明。因此声明与实际可核查性之间存在缺口，需要一种方法让声明在被核查前就具备可审计的结构。
AI.method: 作者借鉴保证业务（assurance engagement）的前置条件，定义"可审计声明"：策略、范围、可定案的记录、记录作者以及决策规则必须在任何结论作出前固定，且记录可获取。该方法将既有Auditable Agents框架中的Policy Checkability维度从单一动作扩展到声明层面，并针对智能体补充三个条件：独立记录的覆盖、绑定到每个动作参数的授权、以及超越完整性的完备性。作者在显式模型下证明：在其假设成立之处，缺失任一条件则无法形成支持。此外构建声明-核查表并应用于六类常见声明，依据NIST、IETF与OWASP现行草案，并以一个案例贯穿五种证据状态。
AI.result: 在显式模型下证明支持不可能缺少三项智能体条件中的任何一项（在其假设成立处成立）；声明-核查表成功应用于六类常见声明；一个工作案例演示同一声明在五种证据状态下的推进；并给出面向运营方、买方、审计方与标准制定方的实操步骤与实践框。
