We explicitly encourage turn-level expert selections to align with agentic operations while regularizing token-level expert selections to maintain local consistency. To resolve stability issues that arise during post-training with the proposed methods, we further introduce an entropy-gated control mechanism. Overall, our routing control framework achieves over 10-point improvements in success rate on all evaluated benchmarks. These results demonstrate that agentic trajectory structure provides an effective signal for optimizing MoE capacity during RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究长时任务LLM智能体与稀疏MoE结构的联合设计，发现专家路由与智能体操作类型自然对齐，并提出分层路由控制框架提升性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 长时任务LLM智能体常用稀疏MoE模型实现，但智能体行为与MoE结构的联合设计尚未被充分探索；现有RL算法忽视MoE路由的专门化结构，导致路由在训练中失控，从而限制任务表现和推理效率。
AI.method: 提出分层路由控制框架：在turn层面鼓励专家选择与智能体操作（如READ、UPDATE）对齐，在token层面正则化专家选择以保持局部一致性；并引入熵门控控制机制以解决后训练中的稳定性问题。
AI.result: 在所有评估基准上成功率提升超过10个百分点，同时改善了任务性能与推理效率。
AI.conclusion: 智能体轨迹结构为RL后训练中优化MoE容量提供了有效信号，表明智能体行为与MoE结构的联合设计具有重要价值。

title: Cooperating with Future Collaborators: Multi-Agent RL under Staggered Participation
summary: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents are often trained under concurrent participation, while in many tasks some agents act earlier and leave task-relevant information that becomes useful to agents participating later. We study this setting as staggered participation (SP), which introduces a cross-time, cross-agent learning dependency because an early action may affect the return through the information it provides and the later policy that uses it. Learning under SP therefore requires both identifying what information is useful for future decisions and learning how later agents should use it. We propose Staggered Participation Learning (SPL), a training-time augmentation that addresses these two parts with prospective acquisition supervision for earlier agents and outcome-supervised receiver learning for later agents. We evaluate SPL across multiple policy-based MARL backbones, environments, and staggered-participation patterns. Across 60 MPE/RWARE backbone setting comparisons, SPL achieves higher observed mean task completion in every case, with an average difference of 14.1%. The gains also extend to eight-agent teams and a physics-based UAV-UGV environment in Isaac Lab, providing evidence across algorithmic, temporal, and embodied settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究交错参与（SP）下的协作多智能体强化学习，提出SPL训练增强方法，通过前瞻获取监督和历史智能体基于结果的接收者学习，显著提升任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习通常假设智能体同时参与，但实际任务中部分智能体先行动并留下对后续智能体有用的信息，形成跨时间、跨智能体的学习依赖，现有方法未能有效处理这一设置。
AI.method: 提出Staggered Participation Learning（SPL），一种训练期增强方法：对早期智能体进行前瞻获取监督，对后续智能体进行基于结果的接收者学习，以分别解决“识别有用信息”和“学习后续智能体如何使用该信息”两个问题。
AI.result: 在多种策略型MARL主干、环境和交错参与模式上评估：60组MPE/RWARE主干设置对比中，SPL在所有情况下均取得更高的平均任务完成率，平均提升14.1%；在八智能体团队及Isaac Lab的UAV-UGV物理环境中同样有效。
AI.conclusion: SPL能有效应对交错参与带来的跨时间、跨智能体学习依赖，在算法、时间和具身设置等多层面均展现出普适性和优越性。

title: Diverse Motion Customization via Control-based Dynamic Optimization
summary: Despite recent advances in video generation, motion customization remains challenging due to content leakage, where appearance attributes from the reference video unintentionally propagate into the generated output. We identify this issue as a consequence of the generative process collapsing toward the reference video, which arises from formulating the learning objective as a direct regression on the reference. To address this, we propose Control-based Motion Customization (CMC), a principled training framework that is structurally robust to content leakage. Our key idea is to steer generative dynamics toward desired motion while avoiding collapse toward the reference video, which we formalize using Stochastic Optimal Control (SOC). Under this formulation, customized videos acquire the target motion yet remain within the pre-trained model's prompt-conditional distribution, where appearance is determined by the text prompt rather than the reference video. Furthermore, to improve efficiency, we tailor the SOC formulation to motion customization by eliminating the need for an explicit reward and introducing a timestep-adaptive motion cost that focuses only on early generative stages, accelerating training by 2.5 times. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CMC effectively mitigates content leakage and achieves competitive motion fidelity while preserving the diversity of the base model across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出基于控制理论（随机最优控制）的运动定制训练框架 CMC，从根本上缓解参考视频内容泄漏问题，训练加速 2.5 倍。
AI.motivation: 视频生成中运动定制存在"内容泄漏"：参考视频的外观属性会非预期地渗入生成结果。作者将其归因于学习目标被建模为对参考视频的直接回归，导致生成过程向参考视频塌缩。
AI.method: 提出 Control-based Motion Customization（CMC）训练框架，用随机最优控制（SOC）形式化：在引导生成动力学趋向目标运动的同时避免向参考视频塌缩，使定制视频获得目标运动且仍处于预训练模型的提示条件分布内（外观由文本提示决定）。为提效，将 SOC 定制化：去除显式奖励，引入只关注早期生成阶段的时间步自适应运动代价。
AI.result: 训练加速 2.5 倍；大量实验表明 CMC 有效缓解内容泄漏，在多种场景下取得有竞争力的运动保真度，并保持基础模型的多样性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将运动定制重构为受控生成过程（SOC），可在不牺牲运动保真度和生成多样性的前提下解决内容泄漏，为视频运动定制提供了结构性更稳健的训练范式。

title: Weight Oracles: Reading Neural Network Weights with Language Models
comment: Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Neural Network Artifacts as a New Data Modality (NeuralArtifacts), Paris. 14 pages, 10 figures
summary: Interpretability methods for neural networks are predominantly reactive: they analyse activations produced during specific forward passes, requiring known inputs to find hidden capabilities such as backdoors. We propose Weight Oracles, fine-tuned language models that diagnose properties of a target network by reading its raw weights directly, without behavioural testing. We investigate this paradigm in two phases. Phase I establishes feasibility: through a staged curriculum and an external chain-of-computation that delegates parameter-free operations to deterministic code, an explainer LLM learns to simulate the forward pass of small transformers from their weights, achieving 99% holdout accuracy on unseen targets. Phase II repurposes this infrastructure for safety auditing. We train an oracle on natural language diagnostic questions about weight anomalies using only benign pathologies as training signal, and evaluate it zero-shot on backdoors absent from training. The oracle achieves AUROC 0.93 on attention-routed backdoors and 0.81 across a diversified threat distribution including stealth and adversarially regularized variants. Hand-crafted statistical detectors are sharp on the threat models they implicitly target but collapse on threat-model shift, while the oracle remains uniformly competent across attack types. Scaling to realistic model sizes remains the principal open challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出Weight Oracles：用微调语言模型直接读取目标网络权重来诊断其属性，无需行为测试，在小型Transformer上前向模拟达99%准确率，后门检测AUROC达0.93/0.81。
AI.motivation: 现有神经网络可解释性方法多为反应式，需在已知输入下分析特定前向传播的激活才能发现隐藏能力（如后门），缺乏直接、不依赖行为测试的诊断手段。
AI.method: 两阶段研究。阶段一验证可行性：通过分阶段课程与外部计算链（将无参数操作委托给确定性代码），让解释器LLM学会从权重模拟小型Transformer的前向传播。阶段二转向安全审计：仅用良性病理作为训练信号，训练一个针对权重异常的自然语言诊断问答oracle，并在训练中未出现的后门类型上做零样本评估。
AI.result: 阶段一在未见目标上取得99%的留出准确率；阶段二在注意力路由后门上AUROC为0.93，在包含隐蔽与对抗正则化变体的多样化威胁分布上为0.81。手工统计检测器在其隐含针对的威胁模型上表现锐利，但在威胁模型迁移时崩溃，而oracle在各攻击类型上保持稳定能力。
AI.conclusion: 直接从原始权重诊断网络属性的范式可行且对威胁模型迁移更鲁棒，但扩展到现实模型规模仍是主要未解挑战。

title: LOGIC: An LLM Benchmark for Intent-Grounded Change Impact in Aerospace Electrical Systems
summary: Aerospace electrical-design revisions can contain multiple genuine changes, although an engineering request may authorize only a subset. Propagating every detected difference can therefore produce overly broad impact reports. We present LOGIC, a controlled benchmark and evaluation framework in which locally deployable language models ground a request in a deterministic candidate-change inventory before selected changes are propagated through a typed electrical traceability graph. This separation permits candidate-selection errors to be distinguished from downstream propagation errors. LOGIC contains 168 scenarios, including 144 selection and 24 abstention cases. We evaluate three 7--8B models against intent-agnostic, lexical, and structured-evidence methods, with an oracle-root upper bound. On 96 explicitly anchored selection cases, gate-only structured evidence achieves candidate F1 of 1.0000, compared with 0.9677 for token-lexical matching. On 12 relational-paraphrase cases, token-lexical F1 is 0.1772 and gate-only F1 is 0.0000, compared with 0.5000--0.6400 for the large language models. Model grounding degrades as candidate inventories grow from 4 to 64 changes, while affected-element and typed-path accuracy remain comparatively stable when frozen selections are replayed over graphs of approximately 1K to 100K nodes. Strict evidence gating suppresses false positives but can remove correct semantic selections. An exploratory evidence-empty abstention policy raises strict abstention accuracy to 0.6667 for all three models and reduces unsafe-report rates to 0.1667, while decreasing answerable-case coverage by 16.0--27.1 percentage points. Four of six conflicting requests remain unsafe for each model. These findings support combining literal evidence and language-model reasoning with engineering review when intent cannot be established reliably.

AI.tldr: LOGIC 是一个可控基准与评估框架：本地部署的语言模型先在确定性的候选变更清单中定位请求，再通过类型化电气追溯图传播被选中的变更，从而把"候选选择错误"与"下游传播错误"区分开。
AI.motivation: 航空航天电气设计修订常包含多个真实变更，但工程请求可能只授权其中一部分。若把所有检测到的差异都传播，会产生影响范围过宽的报告，因此需要把"选择哪些变更"与"如何传播"两步解耦并分别评估。
AI.method: LOGIC 含 168 个场景（144 个选择、24 个弃权），对比三个 7–8B 模型与意图无关、词法、结构化证据方法，并设 oracle-root 上界；分别在显式锚定、关系改写、候选规模扩展（4→64）以及约 1K–100K 节点的图上冻结选择回放等设定下评估，同时测试严格证据门控与证据为空弃权策略。
AI.result: 96 个显式锚定选择用例上，仅门控的结构化证据候选 F1 达 1.0000，词法匹配为 0.9677；12 个关系改写照抄用例上，词法 F1 为 0.1772、仅门控为 0.0000，大模型为 0.5000–0.6400。候选清单从 4 增至 64 时模型接地能力下降，而受影响元件与类型化路径准确率在冻结选择回放中相对稳定。严格门控能抑制假阳性，但会剔除正确的语义选择；证据为空弃权策略把严格弃权准确率提升至 0.6667、把不安全报告率降至 0.1667，代价是可用用例覆盖率下降 16.0–27.1 个百分点；六个冲突请求中每个模型仍有四个不安全。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当意图无法可靠确定时，应把字面证据、语言模型推理与工程人工复核结合起来使用。

title: Multimodal Knowledge Distillation for Gastric Adenocarcinoma Classification from Whole-Slide Images
summary: Gastric adenocarcinoma (GA) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, and accurate histopathological subtype classification from whole-slide images (WSIs) is essential for effective treatment planning. While multimodal approaches that integrate pathology report text with WSIs can improve classification, existing methods often depend on computationally expensive transformer architectures and large language models. We propose a multimodal knowledge distillation (MKD) framework that combines a pretrained WSI image encoder and a clinical text encoder using Low-Rank Multimodal Fusion (LMF) to efficiently model cross-modal interactions during training. Each WSI is represented as a bag of patches paired with a slide-level diagnostic caption. The teacher model learns fused image-text representations for subtype classification, while the student model distills this knowledge to enable accurate image-only inference. We evaluate our method on the PatchGastric benchmark dataset and achieve at least 3.35% higher mean accuracy than state-of-the-art approaches, without relying on transformer-based fusion, multi-task learning, or large language models. The source code is available at https://github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种多模态知识蒸馏框架（MKD），结合低秩多模态融合（LMF），在训练时利用病理报告文本提升胃腺癌WSI亚型分类，推理时仅用图像即可高效准确分类。
AI.motivation: 胃腺癌WSI组织学亚型分类对治疗规划至关重要；现有多模态方法虽能提升性能，但依赖计算昂贵的Transformer架构和大语言模型，效率低、成本高。因此需要一种无需Transformer融合、多任务学习或大语言模型的高效多模态方法。
AI.method: 将每张WSI表示为补丁包并配以切片级诊断文本。使用预训练WSI图像编码器和临床文本编码器，通过低秩多模态融合（LMF）建模跨模态交互。教师模型学习融合的图像-文本表示用于亚型分类，学生模型通过知识蒸馏获得该知识，实现仅图像输入的推理。
AI.result: 在PatchGastric基准数据集上，平均准确率比最先进方法至少高3.35%，且不使用Transformer融合、多任务学习或大语言模型。源代码已开源于https://github.com/helomelo1/MKD-LMF。
AI.conclusion: MKD-LMF框架以高效的多模态知识蒸馏方式融合病理文本与WSI，在不依赖重型架构的前提下显著提升胃腺癌亚型分类准确率，并支持仅图像推理，兼顾性能与效率。

title: Selective Critique for Cost-Aware LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Decision Making
summary: Improving the reliability of large language model (LLM) agents in long-horizon decision-making remains a key challenge. When deployed as autonomous agents interacting with complex environments, early mistakes can propagate through trajectories and cause cascading failures. Recent approaches improve reliability by incorporating external critique or deliberation, but invoking these mechanisms at every step substantially increases token consumption and latency, limiting practical deployment. We propose SAG (Self-improving Agent with Gated critique), a cost-aware framework that formulates critique invocation as a step-wise decision problem during long-horizon interaction. SAG introduces a lightweight, training-free gating mechanism that estimates the utility of critique using action-level ambiguity signals--global entropy and local top-2 margin--computed over admissible actions. From a decision-theoretic perspective, this mechanism approximates the Value of Information (VoI) of critique, enabling the agent to selectively allocate expensive feedback only when its expected benefit justifies the cost. SAG further incorporates online bootstrapped self-improvement, allowing the actor to internalize critic-assisted behaviors and progressively reduce reliance on critique. Across three long-horizon interactive benchmarks and multiple backbone models, SAG substantially improves the performance-cost trade-off compared with both no-critique and always-on critique agents. On ALFWorld, SAG increases task success from 24.6% to 78.4% while maintaining a token budget comparable to ReAct, yielding a $3.1\times$ improvement in normalized token efficiency. Moreover, a 7B actor with a lightweight 3B critic achieves performance comparable to a 14B actor without critique, showing that selective critique can recover most of the reliability benefits of deliberation while dramatically reducing inference cost.

AI.tldr: SAG 提出一种成本感知的门控评论框架，将是否调用外部评论建模为逐步决策问题，通过动作级歧义信号近似评论的信息价值，实现选择性调用评论，并结合在线自举自我改进，在长程交互任务中显著提升性能-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长程决策中可靠性不足，早期错误会在轨迹中传播并导致级联失败；现有通过外部评论或审议提升可靠性的方法若在每步都调用，会大幅增加 token 消耗与延迟，难以实际部署。
AI.method: SAG 将评论调用形式化为长程交互中的逐步决策问题，引入轻量、免训练的门控机制，利用可行动作上的全局熵与局部 top-2 间隔等动作级歧义信号估计评论效用，从决策论角度近似评论的信息价值（VoI），仅在期望收益超过成本时分配昂贵反馈；并加入在线自举自我改进，使执行者内化评论辅助行为，逐步降低对评论的依赖。
AI.result: 在三个长程交互基准和多个骨干模型上，SAG 相比无评论与始终开启评论的智能体显著改善性能-成本权衡。在 ALFWorld 上，任务成功率从 24.6% 提升至 78.4%，token 预算与 ReAct 相当，归一化 token 效率提升 3.1 倍；7B 执行者搭配轻量 3B 评论者即可达到无评论 14B 执行者的性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择性评论能够在显著降低推理成本的同时恢复大部分审议带来的可靠性收益，证明按需调用评论是提升 LLM 智能体长程决策可靠性与部署可行性的有效途径。

title: Representation Bias, Correction Transfer, and Resolution Sensitivity in Three-Dimensional Mitochondrial Morphometry
summary: Quantitative imaging pipelines can produce precise but systematically different measurements of the same object. We present an empirical reliability assessment of three-dimensional mitochondrial morphometry that connects representation bias, a controlled processing intervention, correction transfer, and resolution sensitivity. Using 2,720 development objects from the 3D Mitochondria Shape Library for Optical Microscopy, we find that occupancy-derived volumes exceed reference mesh volumes by 3.665% on average despite an intraclass correlation coefficient of 0.994. Boundary analysis identifies an outward label displacement of 0.00304 normalized units. In a controlled label-pipeline reimplementation, removing the depth offset reduces volume error in all 55 analyzed objects by a mean of 1.57 percentage points, approximately 45% of mean reproduced inflation; the source of the remainder is not isolated. A frozen regression using occupancy-derived features reduces median absolute percentage error from 3.481% to 0.664% in 2,728 previously unused objects from the same resource. However, its calibrated error bound covers only 92.1% overall and 49.2% in a low-occupancy subgroup, demonstrating that accuracy and uncertainty transfer must be evaluated separately. In 550 rat-cortex objects from the MitoEM resource, coarsening in-plane spacing from 8 to 24 nanometers changes median surface area by minus 10.60% and sphericity by plus 11.76%, despite a rank correlation of 0.994. These results provide quantitative checks for distinguishing processing-induced descriptor changes from candidate biological differences, without establishing biological invariance or cross-source correction transfer.

AI.tldr: 该研究对三维线粒体形态计量进行实证可靠性评估，串联了表征偏差、受控处理干预、校正迁移与分辨率敏感性四个环节，揭示了精度与不确定性转移需分开评估。
AI.motivation: 定量成像流程对同一对象可产生精确但系统性不同的测量。作者希望明确处理流程诱导的描述符变化与潜在的生物学差异之间的界限，从而为三维线粒体形态计量提供可靠性检查依据。
AI.method: 使用3D Mitochondria Shape Library for Optical Microscopy的2,720个发育期对象，比较占据度导出体积与参考网格体积；进行边界分析识别标签外移；通过受控的标签流程重实现，移除深度偏移并观察55个对象的体积误差变化；用占据度特征构建冻结回归，在2,728个未用对象上评估校正迁移；再用MitoEM资源中550个大鼠皮层对象，将面内间距从8纳米粗化到24纳米以考察分辨率敏感性。
AI.result: 占据度体积平均比参考网格体积高3.665%，尽管组内相关系数达0.994；边界分析显示0.00304归一化单位的外向标签位移。移除深度偏移后，55个对象体积误差平均降低1.57个百分点，约为复现膨胀均值的45%，其余来源未被分离。冻结回归将中位绝对百分比误差从3.481%降至0.664%，但校准误差界总体仅覆盖92.1%，低占据度亚组仅49.2%。在MitoEM数据中，面内间距由8纳米粗化至24纳米使中位表面积变化-10.60%、球形度变化+11.76%，尽管秩相关为0.994。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了定量检查手段，用以区分处理诱导的描述符变化与候选生物学差异，但未确立生物学不变性，也未实现跨来源的校正迁移；准确性与不确定性转移必须分别评估。

title: Can We Model the Artifacts Explicitly? Disentangle Artifacts via Pairwise Edit Relations for Image Manipulation Localization
summary: Image Manipulation Localization (IML) is commonly formulated as a fully supervised learning task that estimates the optimal manipulation mask $y$ for a given image $x$. In this work, we first reveal the latent nature of artifacts and thus reinterpret IML as a latent-variable problem, $P(y|x)=\int P(y|z)\,P(z|x)\,dz$, where $z$ denotes the artifacts. Following this interpretation, we pinpoint the cause for the current IML models' insufficiency as their implicit artifacts modeling strategy, highlighting the necessity of modeling $z$ in an explicit manner. Without direct labels, feature disentanglement is the most appropriate solution for this explicit modeling. Accordingly, we propose a two-stage learning paradigm with the Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL) and Standard Localization (SL) phases to estimate $P(z|x)$ and $P(y|z)$ via edit relations. To support our edit-relation-based learning, we further curate EditGroup-45K, a source-anchored dataset organized into edit groups for pair construction. Extensive experiments show that our PAL paradigm yields consistent improvements across diverse IML architectures, and empirical analyses further verify that PAL does capture artifacts explicitly through feature disentanglement. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/venus-guangjian/PAL

AI.tldr: 本文将图像篡改定位（IML）重新解释为隐变量问题，强调显式建模伪影，并提出两阶段PAL范式及EditGroup-45K数据集，在多种IML架构上取得一致性提升。
AI.motivation: 传统IML被当作全监督学习，直接学习x到篡改掩码y的映射，但现有模型对伪影（artifacts）仅隐式建模，限制了效果。作者揭示伪影的隐含本质，认为必须显式建模该隐变量z。
AI.method: 将IML重述为P(y|x)=∫P(y|z)P(z|x)dz，z为伪影；因缺乏直接标签，采用特征解耦显式建模z。提出两阶段学习：Pairwise Artifacts Learning (PAL) 估计P(z|x)，Standard Localization (SL) 估计P(y|z)，基于编辑关系学习。并构建源锚定的EditGroup-45K数据集，组织为编辑组以便配对构造。
AI.result: 在多种IML架构上进行大量实验，PAL范式均带来一致性提升；实证分析证实PAL通过特征解耦确实显式捕获了伪影。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模伪影隐变量的两阶段PAL范式与配套数据集，有效提升了IML性能，并验证了特征解耦对伪影显式建模的有效性。代码与数据集已开源。

title: CausalBind: Causal Modeling and Learning for Protein-Molecule Virtual Screening
summary: Protein-molecule virtual screening is increasingly cast as a problem of representation learning in a shared embedding space. Existing methods rely on dense holistic alignment, entangling invariant binding determinants with nuisance correlations and limiting transfer to new targets. It has been noted that binding in protein-molecule systems involves sparse cross-modality interactions: binding is governed by a small contact interface and a few decisive local interactions (e.g., hydrogen bonds, hydrophobic contacts, and salt bridges) rather than the global structures of the protein and molecule. We hypothesize that uncovering and leveraging sparse interaction patterns is critical for generalization beyond the training data, as these patterns are reusable and expected to improve performance across different scenarios. In this paper, we aim to identify and leverage sparse interaction patterns, and verify our hypothesis. Since the training data contain only observed binding pairs, we formalize this prior via a V-structure causal model under Heckman-style selection, and establish three theoretical results: (i) the latent concepts of interacting proteins and molecules are not identifiable without appropriate sparsity constraints; (ii) these concepts and their sparse interactions are component-wise identifiable under structural sparsity conditions; and (iii) a low-rank relaxation of these conditions yields subspace identifiability of the concepts and interactions. Inspired by these principles, we propose CausalBind with three implementation variants. Extensive experiments on DUD-E and LIT-PCBA benchmarks show that all variants consistently outperform strong retrieval baselines, with the largest gains on LIT-PCBA early enrichment, and further generalize to target- and scaffold-level out-of-distribution splits. Code is available at https://github.com/lokali/CausalBind.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CausalBind，通过V-结构因果模型与稀疏性约束实现蛋白质-分子稀疏交互模式的成分级与子空间可识别，并在虚拟筛选基准上一致超越检索基线且具备分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质-分子虚拟筛选方法依赖稠密的整体对齐，将不变结合决定因素与冗余相关混杂在一起，难以迁移到新靶点。作者认为结合本质上由稀疏的跨模态交互决定（如氢键、疏水接触、盐桥等少数局部作用），而非全局结构，因此假设挖掘并利用这种稀疏交互模式是超越训练数据泛化的关键。
AI.method: 作者将稀疏交互先验形式化为Heckman型选择下的V-结构因果模型，因为训练数据仅含观测到的结合对，存在选择偏差。理论上给出三条结果：(i) 无适当稀疏约束时交互蛋白与分子的潜在概念不可识别；(ii) 在结构稀疏条件下概念及其稀疏交互成分级可识别；(iii) 条件的低秩松弛给出概念与交互的子空间可识别性。据此提出CausalBind，并给出三个实现变体。
AI.result: 在DUD-E与LIT-PCBA基准上，三个变体均一致优于强检索基线，在LIT-PCBA的早期富集指标上提升最大；并进一步在靶点级与骨架级分布外划分上展现出泛化能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏交互模式可被理论保证地识别并有效利用，验证了作者的核心假设：显式建模稀疏跨模态交互有助于提升虚拟筛选的泛化性能，为因果可识别的表示学习提供了新视角与实用方案。

title: Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation with Cross-Platform User History
summary: Modern recommendation is shifting from platform-centric personalization toward user-governed personalization, where a personal LLM agent can act on the user's behalf across services. We formalize this emerging paradigm as Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation: a platform recommender ranks a candidate set using platform-local information, and a personal agent uses user-authorized cross-platform history to mediate the resulting ranking and produce the final top-K slate. Such mediation is nontrivial: the platform ranking can encode strong population evidence that the personal agent cannot observe, so effective mediation must therefore balance beneficial rescues against harmful overrides. To study this trade-off, we introduce MediateRec, a benchmark that includes scalable proxy cross-platform environments and a real cross-platform test under a controlled platform-agent information boundary. To train the agent to use cross-platform history effectively, we further propose Personal Attribution Mediation Optimization (PAMO), which counterfactually masks that history to estimate personal mediation support and reallocates rank-aware advantage mass under a platform-relative value floor. We theoretically prove that PAMO preserves cutoff-level advantage mass and is locally optimal among first-order reallocations that preserve this mass without lowering average platform-relative value. Experiments on MediateRec show that personal-agent mediation enables meaningful platform corrections, yet even strong proprietary LLMs introduce non-negligible harmful overrides. PAMO consistently improves over matched outcome-only RL across seen and unseen target platforms and on the real cross-platform test, while achieving a better rescue-harm balance.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化提出"个人智能体中介推荐"(Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation)新范式,并构建基准 MediateRec 与训练方法 PAMO 来研究跨平台个性化中介中"有益纠正"与"有害覆盖"之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐正从平台中心化个性化转向用户自主的个性化:个人 LLM 智能体可代表用户跨服务行动。但平台排序蕴含个人智能体无法观测的群体证据,因此中介过程必须在"有益挽救"与"有害覆盖"间取得平衡。该问题此前缺乏形式化定义、评测基准与有效训练方法。
AI.method: 1) 形式化 Personal-Agent Mediated Recommendation:平台用本地信息对候选集排序,个人智能体用用户授权的跨平台历史中介该排序并产出最终 top-K。2) 构建 MediateRec 基准,包含可扩展的代理式跨平台环境,以及在受控平台-智能体信息边界下的真实跨平台测试。3) 提出 PAMO(Personal Attribution Mediation Optimization):通过反事实遮蔽跨平台历史来估计"个人中介支持度",并在平台相对价值下限约束下重新分配排序感知的优势质量。
AI.result: 实验显示个人智能体中介能实现有意义的平台纠偏,但即便强专有 LLM 也会引入不可忽视的有害覆盖。PAMO 在已见与未见目标平台以及真实跨平台测试上均稳定优于匹配的纯结果 RL 基线,并取得更好的挽救-危害平衡。理论证明 PAMO 保持截断层级的优势质量,是在不降低平均平台相对价值前提下的一阶重分配中的局部最优解。
AI.conclusion: 个人智能体中介是可行且有价值的推荐新范式,但需谨慎处理有害覆盖。PAMO 提供了有理论保证的优化方案,在跨平台迁移性与挽救-危害权衡上均表现更优。

title: TF-PRVR: Training-Free Partially Relevant Video Retrieval
summary: Partially Relevant Video Retrieval (PRVR) aims to retrieve untrimmed videos containing moments relevant to a given text query. Despite recent progress, existing PRVR methods suffer from two key limitations: a fixed video decomposition scheme that causes semantic dilution, and source-domain overfitting induced by task-specific training. In this paper, we propose TF-PRVR, the first training-free framework for PRVR. TF-PRVR leverages frozen vision-language features to construct video-specific hierarchical representations. It derives temporal semantic signals from frame-level features and applies frequency-based multi-scale analysis to identify adaptive temporal boundaries, producing hierarchical segments with coherent event-level semantics. Built on these segments, TF-PRVR constructs a unified multi-scale graph and propagates query relevance across temporally and semantically related nodes. A moment-aware scoring strategy then aggregates temporally aligned relevance across scales, emphasizing consistently supported moments while suppressing isolated false responses. Without task-specific training, TF-PRVR preserves the general-purpose alignment capability of pre-trained vision-language models and avoids dataset-specific overfitting. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent performance across datasets with diverse visual and temporal characteristics, suggesting a practical direction for training-free PRVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TF-PRVR，首个无需训练的PRVR框架，利用冻结的视觉-语言特征构建层次化表示，通过频率多尺度分析确定自适应时序边界，构建多尺度图传播查询相关性，并用moment-aware评分聚合，避免过拟合，在多个数据集上表现一致。
AI.motivation: 现有部分相关视频检索（PRVR）方法存在两大局限：固定的视频分解方案导致语义稀释，以及任务特定训练引发的源域过拟合。作者希望提出一种无需训练、保留预训练模型通用对齐能力的方法。
AI.method: TF-PRVR为training-free框架：1) 利用冻结的视觉-语言特征构建视频特定的层次化表示；2) 从帧级特征提取时序语义信号，进行基于频率的多尺度分析以识别自适应时序边界，生成事件级语义连贯的层次片段；3) 基于这些片段构建统一的多尺度图，在时序与语义相关的节点间传播查询相关性；4) 采用moment-aware评分策略聚合跨尺度时序对齐的相关性，强化一致支持的片段、抑制孤立误响应。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TF-PRVR在具有多样视觉与时间特征的各数据集上均取得一致性能。
AI.conclusion: TF-PRVR在无需任务特定训练的情况下，保留了预训练视觉-语言模型的通用对齐能力，避免数据集特定过拟合，为training-free PRVR提供了实用方向。

title: Stepped MoE: Segment-Level Routing with Configurable Inference Complexity
comment: Apple Foundation Models, 15 Pages, Edge LLMs
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) is resource-intensive, and adapting them for diverse deployment scenarios with varying computational constraints remains challenging. While elastic architectures enable flexible model deployment and sparsely activated models allow input-adaptive computation, existing approaches treat these dimensions independently. Moreover, models catered towards on-device edge inference need to conform to the memory and compute limitations of the serving devices. In this paper, we introduce a unified framework that combines elastic structures with sparsely gated architectures to create models that adapt simultaneously to both deployment constraints and task requirements. Our approach employs a model backbone that conditions on both the context and target efficiency specifications, enabling fine-grained control over the accuracy-efficiency trade-off at inference time. The model learns to activate task-relevant parameters within elastically-nested sub-networks, allowing a single model to span multiple capacity points while maintaining input-adaptive routing. Through experiments we demonstrate that we can create a model that allows the flexibility to use 1,2,3,4 billion parameters while being more accurate than their dense counter-parts (2-5\% on knowledge-intensive benchmarks) and at par with their static versions while delivering similar latency metrics as dense models. Overall, we save on device disk space by sharing the model parameters, allow flexibility of serving based on DRAM and compute available while delivering more accurate results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架，将弹性结构与稀疏门控架构结合，使单一模型能同时适配部署约束与任务需求，可在1-4B参数间灵活切换。
AI.motivation: 训练LLM资源消耗大，向不同算力约束的部署场景适配困难。现有弹性架构与稀疏激活模型各自独立处理维度，且面向端侧推理的模型需符合设备内存与算力限制。
AI.method: 构建以context与目标效率规格为条件的model backbone，在弹性嵌套子网络内学习激活任务相关参数，实现单一模型覆盖多个容量点并保持输入自适应路由，支持推理时细粒度控制精度-效率权衡。
AI.result: 模型可在1、2、3、4B参数间灵活使用，在知识密集型基准上比稠密对应模型更准（提升2-5%），与静态版本持平，延迟指标与稠密模型相近，并通过共享参数节省设备磁盘空间。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架通过参数共享实现了基于DRAM与算力的灵活服务，并在精度上更优，为受限设备端部署提供了兼顾精度与效率的方案。

title: LSC-DPO: Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become a standard reward-model-free approach for aligning language models with preference data. However, as the scaled preference margin grows during training, the logistic DPO loss becomes progressively less sensitive to further changes. We study DPO from a loss-level geometric perspective and identify the sigmoid factor as a learning signal that characterizes the local sensitivity of the objective. Based on this view, we propose Learning-Signal-Controlled Direct Preference Optimization (LSC-DPO), which dynamically regulates the learning signal near a target regime. A log-space analysis establishes conditions for stable tracking of the target learning-signal regime. Experiments on AlpacaEval 2, MT-Bench, and Anthropic-HH show that LSC-DPO consistently improves over DPO and strong preference-optimization baselines. We further find that different coefficient initializations induce distinct transient learning-signal trajectories even when their later signal levels become similar. Based on this observation, we derive a signal-budget compensation rule that adjusts the target learning signal to compensate for these transient differences. The resulting compensation substantially reduces performance variation across coefficient initializations.

AI.tldr: 本文从损失几何视角研究DPO，将sigmoid因子视为刻画目标局部敏感性的学习信号，提出LSC-DPO动态调控该信号至目标区间，并给出信号预算补偿规则以降低系数初始化带来的性能波动。
AI.motivation: DPO已成为无需奖励模型的标准偏好对齐方法，但训练中规模化的偏好边际增大后，logistic DPO损失对进一步变化的敏感性逐渐下降，学习信号衰减，导致优化效率与效果受限。作者希望从损失层面理解这一敏感性变化并加以控制。
AI.method: 提出学习信号控制的直接偏好优化（LSC-DPO）：从损失级几何视角将sigmoid因子识别为表征目标函数局部敏感性的学习信号，并在训练中动态将其调节至目标区间；通过对数空间分析建立稳定跟踪该目标学习信号区间的条件。此外，观察不同系数初始化会产生不同的瞬态学习信号轨迹，据此推导信号预算补偿规则，调整目标学习信号以补偿瞬态差异。
AI.result: 在AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench和Anthropic-HH上的实验表明，LSC-DPO一致优于DPO及强偏好优化基线；信号预算补偿显著降低了不同系数初始化之间的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 从损失几何角度控制学习信号是提升DPO对齐效果的有效途径，LSC-DPO在多个基准上稳定超越基线；瞬态学习信号轨迹差异可通过信号预算补偿加以校正，从而增强方法对超参数初始化的鲁棒性。

title: Dynamic Alignment and Calibration for Multimodal Learning
summary: Dynamic multimodal learning aims to learn robust representations by adaptively modeling information discrepancies across modalities. However, existing methods still suffer from two limitations: (i) static cross-modal alignment strategies usually impose uniform constraints on all samples while overlooking sample-wise variations, potentially leading to unreasonable over-alignment; and (ii) confidence- or uncertainty-aware fusion methods often fail to adequately account for feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities. For modality pairs with significant feature magnitude differences or small confidence gaps, it might be unreliable to strictly align fusion weights according to confidence. To address these issues, we propose an Alignment- and Calibration-driven Multimodal Learning framework (ACML). Specifically, ACML incorporates a dynamic cross-modal triplet alignment module, which enforces strong semantic consistency for high-confidence positive pairs while encouraging diverse representation learning between high- and low-confidence positive pairs according to their confidence gaps. Additionally, ACML introduces a difference-aware attention calibration strategy that adaptively adjusts attention regularization based on feature magnitude and confidence differences across modalities, thereby mitigating biases caused by unreasonable fusion constraints. Extensive experiments on multiple multimodal benchmark datasets demonstrate that ACML consistently achieves superior performance and robustness over recent state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出ACML框架，通过动态跨模态三元组对齐和差异感知注意力校准解决现有多模态学习方法中的过度对齐和融合偏差问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态学习存在两个局限：(i) 静态跨模态对齐策略对所有样本施加统一约束，忽视样本间差异，可能导致不合理的过度对齐；(ii) 基于置信度或不确定性的融合方法未能充分考虑跨模态的特征幅度和置信度差异，当特征幅度差异大或置信度差距小时，严格按置信度对齐融合权重并不可靠。
AI.method: ACML框架包含两个核心模块：(1) 动态跨模态三元组对齐模块，对高置信度正样本对施加强语义一致性约束，同时根据置信度差距鼓励高置信度与低置信度正样本对之间的多样化表示学习；(2) 差异感知注意力校准策略，基于跨模态的特征幅度和置信度差异自适应调整注意力正则化，减轻不合理融合约束带来的偏差。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集上的大量实验表明，ACML在性能和鲁棒性上持续优于近期最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: ACML通过动态对齐与注意力校准有效缓解了过度对齐和融合偏差问题，实现了更优且更鲁棒的多模态表示学习。

title: RELACE: retrospective likelihood-based action credit estimation for long-horizon language agents
summary: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) avoids a separate critic by estimating advantages from rollout groups. For multi-turn agents, however, trajectory-level supervision provides coarse, noisy credit: terminal rewards do not locate errors and can penalize useful actions alongside mistakes. Group-in-Group Policy Optimization (GiGPO) and subsequent methods refine supervision through state-conditioned comparisons, but their credit estimates remain sensitive to downstream decisions and outcomes. We introduce RELACE, Retrospective Likelihood-based Action, a critic-free framework that integrates retrospective action assessment with state-conditioned advantage estimation. RELACE evaluates executed actions through teacher-forced likelihood scoring under both their original contexts and outcome-augmented contexts. Comparing these likelihoods yields a trajectory-normalized retrospective factor that captures outcome-dependent changes in action plausibility, rather than hindsight plausibility alone. We use this factor to reweight discounted task returns and construct local advantages by comparing weighted returns among actions from equivalent states within a task. This couples retrospective relevance with observed reward, producing fine-grained credit that complements trajectory-level GRPO supervision. Temporal smoothing and success-protecting masking further stabilize the local signal. RELACE requires neither auxiliary value nor reward models nor additional autoregressive rollouts for credit estimation. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate substantial improvements over GRPO, GiGPO, and HCAPO. With the 1.5B model, RELACE achieves $96.35\%$ success on ALFWorld and $79.43\%$ on WebShop, surpassing GiGPO by $5.47$ and $5.60$ percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RELACE，一种无需 critic 的多轮智能体强化学习框架，通过回顾式动作评估与状态条件优势估计，实现细粒度信用分配，在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上显著超越 GRPO、GiGPO 和 HCAPO。
AI.motivation: GRPO 通过 rollout 组估计优势以避免单独 critic，但在多轮智能体场景中，轨迹级监督的信用分配粗糙且噪声大：终端奖励无法定位错误，还可能把有用动作与错误一并惩罚。GiGPO 等后续方法通过状态条件比较细化监督，但信用估计仍对下游决策与结果敏感。
AI.method: RELACE 是一个无 critic 框架，将回顾式动作评估与状态条件优势估计结合。它在原始上下文与结果增强上下文下，用 teacher-forced 似然打分评估已执行动作；比较两者似然得到一个轨迹归一化的回顾因子，用来重新加权折扣任务回报，并通过比较同一任务中等价状态动作的加权回报构造局部优势。此外采用时间平滑与成功保护掩码稳定局部信号，且不依赖辅助价值模型、奖励模型或额外自回归 rollout。
AI.result: 在 ALFWorld 与 WebShop 上，使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct 和 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 进行实验，均显著优于 GRPO、GiGPO 与 HCAPO。在 1.5B 模型下，RELACE 在 ALFWorld 达到 96.35% 成功率、WebShop 达到 79.43%，分别比 GiGPO 高出 5.47 和 5.60 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: RELACE 通过回顾式似然因子与状态条件比较，提供了与轨迹级 GRPO 监督互补的细粒度信用分配，在无需额外 critic 或奖励模型的情况下，于多轮智能体基准上取得一致且显著的性能提升。

title: Beyond Scalar IoU: Structured Verification from Rollout Groups for Video Temporal Grounding
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural framework for adapting pretrained models to video temporal grounding, where generated temporal intervals can be scored directly against ground truth intervals. Yet existing overlap verifiers typically score each rollout independently, leaving the joint structure of the rollout group unused. We introduce SUTURE, which conditions verification on the rollout group and exploits its structure at two complementary scales: disagreement across rollouts controls how strongly the target is reweighted, while coverage at each position determines where reward mass is redistributed. We show that the resulting verifier admits an exact decomposition into the standard IoU term and a covariance correction determined by the rollout group. A local gradient diagnostic finds a preference for responses covering relatively less supported target regions in the analyzed groups. Across five temporal grounding benchmarks, SUTURE improves grounding performance at every reported IoU threshold. Its trained policy also shows less video-start anchoring in reasoning traces: for later events, the first temporal mention more often overlaps the annotated target. Together, these results show that the joint structure of a rollout group can support a more informative temporal verifier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SUTURE，一种基于 rollout 组联合结构的可验证奖励机制，用于视频时序定位（RLVR），在多个基准上提升性能并减少视频起始锚定现象。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 中的重叠验证器通常对每个 rollout 独立打分，未利用 rollout 组的联合结构，导致奖励信号信息量不足，难以更好地适配视频时序定位任务。
AI.method: SUTURE 将验证条件建立在 rollout 组之上，在两个互补尺度上利用其结构：rollout 间的不一致控制目标重加权强度，每个位置的覆盖率决定奖励质量再分配的位置；作者证明该验证器可精确分解为标准 IoU 项与由 rollout 组决定的协方差修正项，并采用局部梯度诊断分析响应偏好。
AI.result: 在五个时序定位基准上，SUTURE 在所有报告的 IoU 阈值下均提升定位性能；训练后的策略在推理轨迹中表现出更少的视频起始锚定，对较晚事件而言，首次时间提及更常与标注目标重叠。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 rollout 组的联合结构能够支撑一个更具信息量的时序验证器，为视频时序定位的强化学习提供有效改进方向。

title: CCDF: A Benchmark Dataset for Deepfake Detection in Real-World Surveillance Footage
summary: Due to rapid advances in Generative AI, commercial video generation tools can be used to produce fabricated surveillance footage that can fool both human viewers and automated synthetic video detectors. Since these tools are so widely accessible, a malicious user can create a harmful video clip at minimal cost. The production and dissemination of such videos in high-stakes settings, such as crime reporting and elections, can misdirect emergency response efforts or distort political discourse. Existing deepfake video datasets, used by the research community to develop deepfake detection algorithms, exhibit two limitations: (1) they emphasize benign web content rather than footage of possibly malicious activity, and (2) they rely on older or open-source generators that do not represent recent advances in generative systems. We assemble CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF), a video deepfake dataset, to address both gaps. CCDF contains 1840 videos (460 real and 1380 generated) spanning 16 crime and accident categories, with generated content produced using three leading commercial systems: Grok Imagine, Google VEO 3.1, and OpenAI Sora 2. CCDF is a highly realistic, small-scale, manually annotated dataset targeting evaluation of detection models. We release three versions of the dataset: the raw generated data, a cleaned version in which video metadata are standardized between real and synthetic samples to prevent detectors from exploiting trivial cues, and an altered version simulating low-effort post-processing attacks. We evaluate CCDF with ten recent state-of-the-art detectors covering different detection approaches. Our results suggest that these approaches do not reliably distinguish CCDF's generated videos from real ones, despite their strong reported performance on existing datasets. These results further confirm that existing datasets are not well-suited to evaluating certain threats.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了 CCtv DeepFakes (CCDF) 数据集，包含1840个视频（460真实、1380生成），覆盖16类犯罪与事故场景，使用 Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1、OpenAI Sora 2 三个主流商业生成系统，并评估了十种最新检测器，发现其难以可靠区分真实与生成视频。
AI.motivation: 商业视频生成工具的普及使得恶意用户能以极低成本制造伪造的监控视频，可能误导应急响应或扭曲政治传播等高风险场景。现有deepfake数据集存在两大局限：(1) 侧重良性网络内容而非潜在恶意活动影像；(2) 依赖老旧或开源生成器，无法代表最新生成系统的能力。
AI.method: 构建 CCDF 数据集：共1840个视频（460真实、1380生成），涵盖16个犯罪与事故类别，生成内容由 Grok Imagine、Google VEO 3.1、OpenAI Sora 2 三大商业系统产出；该数据集规模小、高度真实且人工标注，面向检测模型评测。发布三个版本：原始生成数据、清洗版（统一真实与合成样本的视频元数据，防止检测器利用平凡线索）、以及模拟低强度后处理攻击的修改版。使用十种近期最先进检测器进行评测。
AI.result: 十个覆盖不同检测思路的最新SOTA检测器均无法可靠区分CCDF中的生成视频与真实视频，尽管它们在现有数据集上报告了强劲性能。结果进一步证实现有数据集并不适合评估此类特定威胁。
AI.conclusion: 现有deepfake检测方法在面对最新商业生成系统产出的高真实感监控视频时表现不佳，CCDF数据集揭示了评测基准与实际威胁之间的差距，说明需要针对恶意场景构建更贴合现实的评估数据集。

title: Towards Explainable Benchmarking for Data-driven Post-Wildfire Debris Flow Prediction
summary: Post-wildfire debris flows (PFDFs) are destructive sediment-laden hazards triggered when intense rainfall strikes recently burned terrain, destabilizing hillslopes and threatening infrastructure, local economies, and community safety. Data-driven methods have been proposed to learn predictive patterns directly from historical PFDF observations. However, the current research landscape of data-driven PFDF prediction remains highly fragmented across feature spaces, model architectures, and evaluation protocols, making rigorous comparison and the derivation of scientific insights difficult. Moreover, existing studies lack a systematic investigation into the relative importance of heterogeneous factors (e.g., meteorological conditions, terrain characteristics, soil properties, and burn severity) in triggering PFDF. To address these limitations, we present a unified benchmark for data-driven PFDF prediction, enabling fair and comprehensive evaluation across diverse models and feature configurations. Furthermore, to better understand the underlying drivers of PFDF formation, we propose a reinforcement learning-based feature selection framework that identifies factors whose perturbations render positive and negative events indistinguishable, thereby discovering the regional underlying mechanisms of PFDF occurrence across regions. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/KINDLab-Fly/PFDF-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于灾后泥石流（PFDF）预测的统一基准，并设计了基于强化学习的特征选择框架，以揭示不同区域PFDF发生的驱动机制。
AI.motivation: PFDF是破坏性强的灾害，威胁基础设施与社区安全。现有数据驱动预测研究在特征空间、模型架构和评估协议上高度碎片化，难以进行严格比较和科学洞察；同时缺乏对气象、地形、土壤、火烧严重度等异质因素相对重要性的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出统一的PFDF预测基准，支持跨多样模型与特征配置的公平全面评估；并提出基于强化学习的特征选择框架，通过识别使正负事件变得不可区分的扰动因素，发现不同区域PFDF发生的潜在机制。
AI.result: 所提基准实现了跨模型和特征配置的公平综合评估，强化学习特征选择框架能够识别关键驱动因素，并揭示不同区域的PFDF发生机制。代码与基准已在GitHub公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为数据驱动PFDF预测提供了统一评估平台，并通过特征选择深入理解PFDF形成的驱动因素，有助于推动该领域研究的可比性与机制发现。

title: VALSE: Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficient Inference in Large Language Models
summary: This paper establishes a theoretical framework for vertical adaptive layer skipping, proving three foundational results: (i) an Expected FLOPs formula (theorem 2) giving a closed-form expression for the computational cost of arbitrary per-sample skip schedules as a function of layer-wise skip probabilities; (ii) function-space superset (theorem 10) and strict inclusion (theorem 11) theorems showing that skip-layer models are strictly contained in---yet meaningfully approximate---the full-layer function space, with an explicit separating example; and (iii) a structural duality between VALSE and Mixture-of-Experts architectures (proposition 6), positioning vertical depth-wise sparsity as the orthogonal counterpart to horizontal width-wise sparsity. Building on this theory, we propose VALSE (Vertical Adaptive Layer Skipping for Efficiency), a per-sample, non-contiguous layer skipping method: a lightweight difficulty estimator scores each input from the first few layers, and per-layer gates selectively skip redundant layers---including arbitrary middle layers while retaining deeper ones---so that only the necessary depth is activated for each input, whose feasibility is preliminarily assessed at prototype scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文建立了垂直自适应层跳过的理论框架，提出VALSE方法，并初步验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 现有层跳过方法缺乏对计算成本、函数空间关系及与现有稀疏架构（如MoE）关系的系统理论刻画，且多局限于连续或尾部跳层，难以实现单样本任意中间层的灵活跳过。
AI.method: 建立垂直自适应层跳过的理论框架，证明三项基础结果：(i)期望FLOPs公式（定理2）；(ii)函数空间超集（定理10）与严格包含（定理11）定理；(iii)VALSE与MoE的结构对偶性（命题6）。基于此提出VALSE方法：轻量难度估计器从前几层为每个输入打分，逐层门控选择性跳过冗余层（包括任意中间层而保留更深层）。
AI.result: 给出任意逐样本跳过调度的闭式期望FLOPs表达；证明跳层模型严格包含于全层函数空间但能有效近似，并给出显式分离示例；揭示VALSE与MoE的结构对偶性；在原型规模上初步验证了VALSE的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 垂直深度稀疏性是与水平宽度稀疏性正交的对应维度，VALSE为单样本非连续层跳过提供了理论基础与可行方法。

title: Revisiting Numerical Forecasting Models for Language-Based Trajectory Prediction
summary: Language-based trajectory predictors represent coordinates as discrete tokens and learn auxiliary tasks such as destination and group reasoning. This formulation enables the model to capture behavioral intent and social context beyond coordinate dynamics alone. However, token-level objectives provide only indirect guidance for continuous coordinate-space dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce MoRE (Mixture of Reward Experts), a refinement framework that transfers numerical forecasting priors into a pretrained language-based predictor through reinforcement learning. Five frozen numerical predictors provide complementary coordinate-level knowledge of motion and interactions. Their predictions are converted into expert rewards and combined through an uncertainty-weighted consensus that penalizes disagreement. A ground-truth reward anchors the prediction to the target trajectory. To focus refinement on difficult cases, MoRE refines the policy using the top 1% of training samples ranked by predictive entropy. Expert predictions are computed once and cached before PPO training, so the experts are not run during policy updates or inference. In this way, MoRE combines the contextual modeling of the language-based predictor with coordinate-level feedback from numerical experts. On ETH-UCY, MoRE reduces ADE from 0.22 to 0.20 m and FDE from 0.32 to 0.29 m. Relative to the base policy, ADE decreases by 17.9% on SDD and 12.7% on NBA. On ETH-UCY, MoRE also reduces collision rates and better matches ground-truth pedestrian spacing, without increasing measured inference memory or latency. The project page is available at https://jungyu0413.github.io/MoRE/.

AI.tldr: 提出MoRE框架，通过强化学习将数值预测器的坐标级先验迁移到语言式轨迹预测器中，在ETH-UCY、SDD、NBA上降低ADE/FDE且不增加推理开销。
AI.motivation: 语言式轨迹预测器将坐标离散为token并学习目的地、群体推理等辅助任务，能捕捉行为意图与社会情境，但token级目标只能为连续坐标空间动力学提供间接指导，缺少坐标层面的直接监督。
AI.method: MoRE（Mixture of Reward Experts）微调框架：以五个冻结的数值预测器提供运动与交互的互补坐标级知识，将其预测转为专家奖励，通过不确定性加权共识（惩罚分歧）结合，并加入真值奖励锚定目标轨迹；仅用预测熵排名前1%的难样本进行策略微调；专家预测在PPO训练前一次性计算并缓存，因此训练更新与推理时均不运行专家。
AI.result: 在ETH-UCY上ADE由0.22降至0.20 m，FDE由0.32降至0.29 m；相对基础策略，ADE在SDD下降17.9%、在NBA下降12.7%；在ETH-UCY上还降低了碰撞率，并更接近真实行人间距，且未增加实测推理内存或延迟。
AI.conclusion: MoRE将语言式预测器的情境建模能力与数值专家的坐标级反馈相结合，以低成本强化学习微调实现更精确、更合规的轨迹预测，同时保持推理效率不变。

title: Dynamic Budget Allocation for LLM Evaluation under Hard Resource Constraints
summary: We evaluate large language models (LLMs) in multi-turn interactions through their time-to-event: the number of interaction steps required to produce an event of interest, such as a successful jailbreak or agentic task completion. Under limited compute, interactions may be terminated before the event occurs, so that event times are only partially observed (censored). Existing allocation methods for calibrating time-to-event bounds satisfy the budget only in expectation and can exceed the available budget on a particular evaluation run. Enforcing a hard constraint is particularly challenging as the cost of a trajectory is initially unknown. We introduce Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration (HARP), a budget allocation that satisfies hard resource constraints and adaptively reallocates unused budget. We show how to use HARP to construct lower predictive bounds (LPBs) on the time-to-event and to estimate evaluation metrics such as the jailbreak rate on a fixed benchmark. Although HARP induces dependence in acquisition decisions across different trajectories, we prove that HARP never exceeds the target budget, that its LPBs have finite-sample coverage guarantees, and that its metric estimates are unbiased. Experiments on agentic task success, LLM jailbreaks, toxic content generation, and RAG hallucinations show that HARP achieves coverage close to the nominal level with low variance, while never exceeding the given budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HARP，一种在硬预算约束下对多轮LLM交互的时间-事件（如越狱、任务完成）进行预测校准的预算分配方法，并证明其LPB的有限样本覆盖保证与指标估计的无偏性。
AI.motivation: 在多轮交互中评估LLM（如成功越狱或智能体任务完成）需要考虑时间-事件，即所需交互步数。当计算资源有限时，交互可能在事件发生前被终止，导致事件时间只能被部分观测（删失）。现有校准时间-事件界的分配方法仅在期望意义上满足预算，在单次评估运行中可能超出可用预算；由于轨迹成本初期未知，难以强制硬约束。
AI.method: 提出HARP（Hard-budget Allocation with Reflow for Predictive calibration），一种能满足硬资源约束并自适应重分配未使用预算的预算分配方法。用HARP构造时间-事件的下预测界（LPB），并估计固定基准上的评估指标（如越狱率）。尽管HARP在不同轨迹间的采集决策中引入了相关性，论文证明其永不超出目标预算，LPB具有有限样本覆盖保证，指标估计无偏。
AI.result: 在智能体任务成功、LLM越狱、有害内容生成和RAG幻觉等实验中，HARP达到接近名义水平的覆盖且方差较低，同时从不超出给定预算。
AI.conclusion: HARP为有限算力下的多轮LLM评估提供了一种满足硬预算约束、具有统计保证的预算分配与校准框架。

title: BioStudyBench: Evaluating Agents on Post-Cutoff Biomedical Studies
summary: We evaluate whether AI agents can match the reported findings of published biomedical studies using public data. Existing evaluations do not consistently separate analysis from prior knowledge or retrieval of the published answer. We introduce BioStudyBench, a benchmark of 25 long-horizon analysis tasks drawn from studies first published between July and September 2026, after the developer-reported knowledge cutoffs of the models we evaluate, semi-automatically filtered down from 404,019 PubMed records. In each task, the agent receives a neutral research question but no data files, so it must find and download the relevant public data, search the literature through tools that return only records dated before its cutoff, and report findings through data analysis. To measure gains over prior knowledge, we run every task both with and without access to data and tools. Across eight models, access to data and tools raises the pass rate by 47 percentage points on average over the no-data baseline. Open-weight models across sizes trail closed-weight models, with the best open-weight model passing 81.3% of tasks against 94.7% for the best closed-weight model.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BioStudyBench 基准，评估 AI 智能体能否仅凭公开数据复现已发表生物医学研究的发现，并在 25 个长周期分析任务上对比八种模型。
AI.motivation: 现有评测未一致区分分析能力与先验知识或对已发表答案的检索，难以判断模型是否真正具备数据分析能力。
AI.method: 构建 BioStudyBench，包含 25 个长周期分析任务，源于 2026 年 7 至 9 月发表的、晚于所评估模型知识截止的研究，经半自动方式从 404,019 条 PubMed 记录中筛选。任务只给中性研究问题、不给数据文件，智能体需自行查找下载公开数据、通过仅返回截止日期前记录的工具检索文献并进行数据分析；每个任务均在有无数据与工具两种条件下运行。
AI.result: 在八种模型上，具备数据与工具访问平均使通过率较无数据基线提高 47 个百分点；开放权重模型整体落后于闭源权重模型，最佳开放权重模型通过率 81.3%，最佳闭源模型达 94.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该基准能有效分离先验知识影响、突出真实分析能力差异，表明数据与工具访问对智能体复现研究结果至关重要，且当前开放权重模型仍有明显差距。

title: DensiTok: Making Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting See More Views Than It Is Given
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) reconstructs a scene in a single forward pass, replacing per-scene optimization with a network trained across many scenes. Its quality, however, degrades sharply as the number of input images drops. The bottleneck is upstream of the reconstruction heads: from a few unposed views, the internal representation they read carries no evidence for unobserved regions, leaving holes, floaters, and blur. The common remedy supplies that evidence as pixels, synthesizing extra views with an image or video generator and re-encoding them, which is costly and not 3D-consistent by construction. We instead densify the evidence itself. We present DensiTok, a plug-in module for pretrained feed-forward 3DGS models that densifies their internal geometry tokens directly, making a frozen backbone behave as though it had observed many more views than it was given. DensiTok compresses those tokens into a compact latent space, completes the latents of the unobserved viewpoints in a single flow-matching step conditioned on camera geometry, and decodes them back into tokens that the original reconstruction heads. The same module design can be integrated into different pretrained predictors while keeping each backbone and its reconstruction heads frozen. Completion in a low-dimensional latent space requires no image synthesis or additional encoder passes. Across three pretrained backbones and two benchmarks, DensiTok consistently improves sparse-view reconstruction and recovers much of the gap to dense-view reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出DensiTok插件模块，直接在隐空间稠密化前馈3DGS的内部几何token，以单步流匹配补全未观测视角，无需图像合成即可显著提升稀疏视角重建质量。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D高斯泼溅(3DGS)虽能一次前向重建场景，但输入图像数量减少时质量急剧下降。瓶颈位于重建头之前：少数无位姿视角下，内部表示缺少未观测区域的证据，导致空洞、悬浮物和模糊。常规做法是用图像/视频生成器合成额外视角并重新编码，但代价高且本质上不具3D一致性。
AI.method: DensiTok是一个即插即用模块，用于预训练前馈3DGS模型。它将内部几何token压缩到紧凑隐空间，在相机几何条件下用单步流匹配补全未观测视角的隐变量，再解码回token供原始重建头使用。该设计可集成到不同预训练预测器中，且各骨干网络与重建头保持冻结；隐空间补全无需图像合成或额外编码器前向。
AI.result: 在三个预训练骨干网络和两个基准上，DensiTok一致地改善了稀疏视角重建效果，并弥补了与稠密视角重建之间的大部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 与其用像素合成补充证据，不如直接稠密化内部证据本身；DensiTok以低成本、3D一致的方式让冻结骨干"仿佛"看到更多视角，为稀疏视角前馈3DGS提供通用增强方案。

title: Multigroup Fairness and Omniprediction: Separations and Equivalences
summary:
Omniprediction is a learning guarantee which requires a single predictor to be competitive relative to the best hypothesis from a benchmark class for any loss chosen from a family of loss functions. Loss Outcome Indistinguishability (loss OI for short) is a stronger notion that implies omniprediction. It requires the predicted distribution on labels to be indistinguishable from the true distribution to tests that depend on the loss functions and the benchmark class. Multiaccuracy and multicalibration are multigroup fairness notions that generalize classical notions of calibration and accuracy in expectation. Most known learning algorithms for omniprediction (both for the standard notion and for strengthenings like loss OI) rely on some version of these multigroup fairness notions, or on an intermediate notion called calibrated multiaccuracy. We ask if this is necessary: Does omniprediction require some form of multigroup fairness?
  We show that the answer is no for (plain) omniprediction, and yes for loss OI. First, a sequence of works shows that multicalibration or calibrated multiaccuracy imply omniprediction. We rule out even a weak converse, by showing that omniprediction for proper losses does not imply even accuracy in expectation, a much weaker notion than any of calibration, multiaccuracy, or multicalibration. Second, prior work showed how to achieve loss OI from a combination of calibration and multiaccuracy. We show a converse: loss OI is equivalent to a form of calibrated multiaccuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"全能预测"（omniprediction）是否必然蕴含某种多群组公平性。结论是：对于普通全能预测，答案是否定的；对于损失结果不可区分性（loss OI），答案是肯定的——loss OI 等价于一种校准多准确性。
AI.motivation: 多数已知的全能预测算法（包括 loss OI 等强化版本）都依赖多群组公平性概念（如多准确性、多校准）或"校准多准确性"这一中间概念。作者由此追问：全能预测是否在本质上需要某种多群组公平性？即这种依赖是必然的还是算法上的巧合。
AI.method: 从两个方向展开理论分析：（1）通过构造性分离结果，研究普通全能预测与多群组公平性之间是否存在逆命题；（2）针对 loss OI，建立其与校准多准确性之间的等价性证明。
AI.result: 第一，作者排除了即使是弱的逆命题：对 proper loss 而言，全能预测甚至不蕴含期望准确性，而期望准确性远弱于校准、多准确性或多校准。第二，此前工作表明校准与多准确性结合可推出 loss OI，作者证明了反向结论，即 loss OI 等价于某种形式的校准多准确性。
AI.conclusion: 全能预测并不必然要求多群组公平性（对普通全能预测而言，答案是否定的）；但 loss OI 则确实需要，且恰好等价于一种校准多准确性。这澄清了多群组公平性在全能预测中的角色：它并非普通全能预测的必要条件，而是更强 notion 的刻画。

title: Explore, Then Commit: Measurement-Efficient Scientific Law Discovery with Language Models
comment: 19 pages, including Supplementary Material S1; code and data included as ancillary files. Preprint
summary: Scientific law discovery requires selecting measurements and converting evidence into a governing equation. We evaluate an explore-then-commit protocol in which a large language model proposes hypotheses, a programmatic planner gathers measurements, and a fresh prompt synthesizes the final law from fixed observations. The protocol combines structured probes, automatic numerical diagnostics, restricted measurement batches, and optional interpreter access. Across 576 NewtonBench trials, we compare eight configurations on 12 physics modules using GPT-4.1-mini and a medium-difficulty GPT-4.1 replication. On medium tasks, interpreter-enabled planners use 8.6 versus 22.5 measurements per trial for GPT-4.1-mini and 8.9 versus 43.0 for GPT-4.1. Their mean magnitude-based root-mean-squared logarithmic error falls from 2.514 to 0.202 and from 0.626 to 0.149, respectively. An additional audit retains incomplete and invalid submissions in a coverage-sensitive analysis. Observed symbolic-accuracy gains are less consistent across modules, and random acquisition is competitive with disagreement scoring. Measurement savings occur in every module, but unequal batch constraints prevent attributing them solely to acquisition quality. These results support the complete protocol as a promising measurement-efficient configuration, while leaving its causal components and generalization beyond noiseless direct-equation tasks unresolved.

AI.tldr: 本文评估一种“先探索后提交”的科学定律发现协议：由大语言模型提出假设、程序化规划器采集测量、再用新提示从固定观测中合成最终定律；在576次NewtonBench试验中，该协议显著提升测量效率并降低误差，但符号准确率的提升和因果归因仍不确定。
AI.motivation: 科学定律发现需要在测量选择与将证据转化为支配方程之间做权衡。作者希望检验一种结合大语言模型假设生成与程序化测量规划器的协议，能否在保证定律发现质量的同时减少所需测量次数。
AI.method: 采用explore-then-commit协议：大语言模型提出假设，程序化规划器采集测量，再用全新提示从固定观测合成最终定律。协议包含结构化探针、自动数值诊断、受限测量批次和可选的解释器访问。在576次NewtonBench试验中，用GPT-4.1-mini和中等难度GPT-4.1复现，比较8种配置、覆盖12个物理模块，并额外进行保留不完整/无效提交的覆盖率敏感审计。
AI.result: 在中等任务上，启用解释器的规划器每试验使用8.6次测量（GPT-4.1-mini，对比22.5）和8.9次（GPT-4.1，对比43.0）。基于量级的均方根对数误差分别从2.514降至0.202、从0.626降至0.149。符号准确率的提升跨模块不太一致，随机采集与分歧评分相比具有竞争力。测量节省在每个模块都出现，但不等批次约束使这种节省不能完全归因于采集质量。
AI.conclusion: 完整协议是一种有前景的测量高效配置，但其因果组件以及在无噪声直接方程任务之外的泛化能力仍未解决。

title: EmbodiedSmith: Scaling Embodied Data through Recursive Self-Improvement Flywheel in Simulation
summary: Scaling robotic foundation models requires diverse training data and reliable evaluation environments. Simulation offers a scalable solution, yet existing generation pipelines remain constrained by predefined assets and skills, a disconnect between scene generation and task generation, and limited support for complex embodiments and physics. We introduce EmbodiedSmith, a framework for scalable embodied data generation through recursive self-improvement (RSI). EmbodiedSmith unifies asset, scene, and task generation in a pipeline that supports autonomous creation and language-driven customization. Its core is an agentic refinement loop: scene generation anticipates downstream task requirements, while task generation guides targeted scene edits, allowing scenes and tasks to iteratively improve one another. This joint refinement improves task generation success, including for long-horizon tasks. The framework further supports mobile manipulators, humanoids, and dexterous hands, as well as interactions involving deformable objects and fluids, broadening the range of behaviors and physical phenomena represented in generated data. Together, these capabilities provide a flexible simulation engine for both robot pretraining and evaluation. Extensive experiments validate the quality, diversity, and generation efficiency of the resulting data, while downstream policy experiments demonstrate that increased data diversity improves generalization.

AI.tldr: EmbodiedSmith 是一个通过递归自改进（RSI）实现可扩展具身数据生成的框架，统一了资产、场景与任务生成，并支持多种复杂机器人和物理现象。
AI.motivation: 扩展机器人基础模型需要多样化训练数据和可靠评测环境。仿真可提供可扩展方案，但现有生成流程受限于预定义资产与技能、场景生成与任务生成脱节、对复杂本体和物理支持有限。
AI.method: 提出 EmbodiedSmith，将资产、场景、任务生成统一到支持自主创建和语言驱动定制的管线中。核心是智能体式精炼循环：场景生成预判下游任务需求，任务生成引导针对性场景编辑，使场景与任务相互迭代改进。框架支持移动操作机器人、人形机器人和灵巧手，以及可变形物体和流体交互。
AI.result: 联合精炼提升了任务生成成功率，包括长时程任务。大量实验验证了生成数据的质量、多样性与生成效率；下游策略实验表明数据多样性增加可改善泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EmbodiedSmith 为机器人预训练和评测提供了灵活的仿真引擎，并能生成多样化数据以提升策略泛化。

title: Inference and learning in sparse autoencoders as natural gradient flow
summary: Sparse autoencoders are widely used to uncover interpretable features in neural networks, yet reliable recovery remains difficult when features overlap or activate infrequently. These challenges involve both inferring which features explain an input and learning the dictionary that represents them. Here, we unify inference and dictionary learning as natural-gradient flows on a shared variational free energy. We instantiate this framework as BeFOND, an encoder-free sparse coding model with closed-form inference and learning dynamics. We show how recurrent explaining away reduces interference between overlapping features, while Fisher preconditioning can compensate for the slow learning of rare features. On synthetic data, BeFOND improves dictionary recovery and rare-feature detection, with a growing advantage over amortized baselines as superposition increases. On language-model activations, it improves single-feature concept detection and selective intervention, outperforming pretrained reference SAEs with substantially less training data. Its feature quality continues to improve with dictionary width, whereas the evaluated baselines largely plateau. Together, these results show how improving inference and learning within a unified probabilistic framework can make better use of data and dictionary capacity to interpret and intervene on neural representations.

AI.tldr: 提出无编码器的稀疏编码模型 BeFOND，将推断与字典学习统一为变分自由能上的自然梯度流，改善重叠与稀有特征的恢复。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器虽广泛用于揭示神经网络的可解释特征，但在特征重叠或低频激活时，既难以推断哪些特征解释输入，也难以学习到好的字典表示，可靠恢复特征仍有困难。
AI.method: 将推断与字典学习统一为共享变分自由能上的自然梯度流，并实例化为无编码器的稀疏编码模型 BeFOND，具有闭式推断与学习动态；用循环式 explaining away 减少重叠特征间的干扰，用 Fisher 预条件补偿稀有特征学习缓慢的问题。
AI.result: 在合成数据上，BeFOND 改善字典恢复与稀有特征检测，随叠加程度增加对摊销式基线的优势扩大；在语言模型激活上，提升单特征概念检测与选择性干预效果，以少得多的训练数据超越预训练参考 SAE；特征质量随字典宽度持续提升，而基线大多趋于饱和。
AI.conclusion: 在统一概率框架内改进推断与学习，能更充分利用数据与字典容量，从而更好地解释和干预神经表征。

title: Learning to Outgrow a Theory: Experimental Discovery Beyond the Initial Hypothesis Space
summary: Scientific discovery systems typically optimize experiments within a fixed hypothesis space. This creates a failure mode when all available candidates omit the same missing mechanism: candidate disagreement can collapse even while the model class is systematically wrong. We formulate experimental model-class revision, in which a discovery policy jointly proposes a structural edit and a diagnostic experiment that tests whether that edit is necessary. The method couples a class-level distinguishability objective, in which one shared parameterization must explain all selected experiments, with anytime-valid sequential evidence that triggers structural revision only after the current class is rejected. On 400 held-out controlled dynamical environments, the joint policy reaches 89.5% exact recovery with a budget of 32 real experiments, improving the strongest matched baseline by 10.0 percentage points while requiring fewer executed experiments and candidate fits. The learned revision-experiment pairing transfers across unseen mechanism combinations, held-out but expressible primitives, parameter extrapolation, and shifted experiment costs; when the true mechanism is outside the edit grammar, it detects library insufficiency in 88% of cases with a 5.5% false-support rate. Revision gains also transfer to ODEBench and ODEBase model-library tasks, as well as DiscoverPhysics worlds. These results support a view of scientific discovery in which deciding what mechanisms a theory should make expressible and where to collect evidence are treated as a single sequential decision problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"实验性模型类修正"问题：发现策略同时提出结构编辑与诊断实验，检验该编辑是否必要，从而在假设空间本身错误时仍能修正模型类。方法结合类级可区分性目标与随时有效的序贯证据，仅在当前类被拒绝时触发结构修正。在400个受控动力学环境中达到89.5%精确恢复，较最强基线提升10.0个百分点。
AI.motivation: 科学发现系统通常在固定假设空间内优化实验，这存在一种失效模式：当所有候选都遗漏同一缺失机制时，候选间分歧可能消失，即便模型类系统性错误。论文希望解决这一"类级错误"问题，将"理论应表达哪些机制"与"在哪里收集证据"视为统一的序贯决策问题。
AI.method: 提出实验性模型类修正框架，发现策略联合提出结构编辑和用于检验该编辑必要性的诊断实验。方法耦合两个要素：一是类级可区分性目标，要求单一共享参数化能解释所有选定的实验；二是随时有效的序贯证据，仅当当前模型类被拒绝时才触发结构修正。
AI.result: 在400个留出受控动力学环境中，联合策略在32次真实实验预算下达到89.5%精确恢复，比最强匹配基线高10.0个百分点，且执行的实验与候选拟合更少。学到的修正-实验配对可迁移至未见机制组合、留出但可表达的原语、参数外推及变化的实验成本。当真实机制超出编辑语法时，88%情况能检测到库不足，假支持率5.5%。修正增益还迁移到ODEBench、ODEBase模型库任务及DiscoverPhysics世界。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将"理论应表达何种机制"与"在何处收集证据"统一为单一序贯决策问题是可行且有效的，为超越固定假设空间的科学发现提供了新视角。

title: M3SunAgent: Monocular 3D Spatial Understanding Agent for Metric Depth Estimation and 3D Visual Grounding
comment: 13 pages. 7 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT)
summary: Monocular metric depth estimation and 3D visual grounding represent the two complementary cornerstones of monocular 3D spatial understanding (M3Sun), from which the fundamental 3D spatial information required by M3Sun can be acquired. However, these complementary tasks are generally conducted by separate frameworks, which pose challenges of inflexible and unaligned spatial information access for embodied intelligence systems. In this paper, we propose a unified agent for monocular 3D spatial understanding (M3SunAgent) that leverages a large language model (LLM) as a task planner for spatial visual programming, which flexibly generate structured programs and coordinate tools. For instance-level metric depth estimation task, M3SunAgent invokes an object detector tool to locate the target, estimates depth at selected points with a depth estimation tool, and aggregates these predictions into an instance-level depth estimate. We also construct the M3Sun Instance (M3SI) dataset, a benchmark with 2,910 samples for evaluation. For monocular 3D visual grounding task, M3SunAgent uses a vision-language model (VLM) tool to locate the target and output basic spatial attributes, then combines back-projection tool with a dimension-lifting tool to predict its 3D bounding box. Experimental results demonstrate the superior performance of M3SunAgent. Specifically, in evaluations of instance-level monocular metric depth estimation, M3SunAgent achieves the best performance among all compared models, 52.61% of predicted instances are distributed below depth error 0.25 ($δ< 0.25$). In evaluations of monocular 3D visual grounding, M3SunAgent demonstrates overall competitive performance than vision and VLM models, reaching a 3D mean intersection over union (mIoU) of 41.73% and exceeding the state-of-the-art MonoVLM model by 3.62%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出M3SunAgent，一个以LLM为任务规划器的统一智能体，通过空间视觉编程协调工具，同时完成单目度量深度估计与3D视觉定位任务。
AI.motivation: 单目度量深度估计与3D视觉定位是单目3D空间理解（M3Sun）的两个互补基石，但通常由独立框架分别处理，导致空间信息获取不灵活、不对齐，难以满足具身智能系统的需求。
AI.method: 以LLM作为任务规划器进行空间视觉编程，灵活生成结构化程序并协调工具。实例级深度估计：调用目标检测器定位目标、用深度估计工具在选定点估计深度并聚合为实例级深度。3D视觉定位：用VLM工具定位目标并输出基本空间属性，再结合反投影工具与维度提升工具预测3D边界框。同时构建2,910样本的M3SI评测基准。
AI.result: 实例级单目度量深度估计中，M3SunAgent在所有对比模型中表现最佳，52.61%的预测实例深度误差低于0.25（δ<0.25）。单目3D视觉定位中整体性能具竞争力，3D mIoU达41.73%，超过SOTA的MonoVLM模型3.62%。
AI.conclusion: M3SunAgent通过统一的LLM规划框架协调工具，有效统一了单目3D空间理解的两项互补任务，在深度估计与3D视觉定位上均取得优异或具竞争力的性能，为具身智能提供了更灵活、对齐的空间信息获取方式。

title: Fed-BRDECS: Privacy-Preserving and Heterogeneity-Aware Federated Deep Embedded Clustering
summary: Federated deep clustering seeks to learn clustering-friendly representations from decentralized unlabeled data while preserving client privacy. However, Deep Embedded Clustering (DEC)-style objectives depend on global soft-assignment statistics that require clients to reveal their sensitive information. We propose Fed-BRDECS, a privacy-preserving and heterogeneity-aware federated deep embedded clustering framework. Fed-BRDECS replaces the globally normalized clustering objective with a locally computable sample-stability loss, avoiding the transmission of local soft-assignment distributions. To tackle non-IID client distributions, we introduce prediction-balanced sampling, which oversamples locally rare predicted clusters without requiring ground-truth labels, and centroid-level restarting, which periodically refreshes biased or inactive centroids. Experiments on image and text clustering benchmarks show that Fed-BRDECS consistently outperforms representative federated clustering and deep clustering baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions. We further demonstrate its applicability to federated time-series anomaly detection, where it improves reconstruction-based detectors without adding inference-time cost.

AI.tldr: Fed-BRDECS：一种隐私保护且面向异构性的联邦深度嵌入聚类框架，用本地可计算的样本稳定性损失替代需全局统计的聚类目标，并引入预测平衡采样与质心级重启应对非IID分布。
AI.motivation: 联邦深度聚类旨在从去中心化无标签数据中学习聚类友好的表示并保护客户端隐私。但传统深度嵌入聚类（DEC）目标依赖全局软分配统计，需要客户端泄露敏感信息；同时客户端数据常为非IID分布，导致聚类偏差。
AI.method: 1) 用本地可计算的样本稳定性损失替代全局归一化聚类目标，避免传输本地软分配分布；2) 预测平衡采样：在无需真实标签的情况下对本地稀有预测簇进行过采样；3) 质心级重启：周期性刷新有偏或不活跃的质心。
AI.result: 在图像与文本聚类基准上，Fed-BRDECS在IID与非IID划分下均持续优于代表性联邦聚类与深度聚类基线；进一步在联邦时间序列异常检测中提升基于重构的检测器表现，且不增加推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: Fed-BRDECS在保护隐私的同时有效应对非IID数据异构性，在聚类与异常检测任务上均具通用性与实用性。

title: Measuring climate backlash in Twitter and Reddit archives: Lexical definitions, recorded responses and participant turnover
summary: Social media archives are often used to study resistance to climate action, but words, response counters and observed participants do not measure the same social process. We examine four supplied Twitter and Reddit archives by processing all registered files without sampling and applying transparent, non-exclusive lexical rules. The study links frame co-occurrence to source-specific temporal and response models, then separates event-period changes among returning authors from participant turnover. Renewable-energy terms accompany cost-related language on Reddit, yet narrower backlash phrases sharply reduce cross-source contrasts and reverse the sign of the Paris Agreement contrast in submissions. Cross-discourse history does not improve eligible primary-context forecasts. Denial/hoax terms are associated with higher recorded Twitter likes, whereas Reddit response associations depend on frame, outcome and author specification. Around the 2019 global climate strike, returning-author expression and participant turnover both contribute to increased protest-language shares. An archive endpoint prevents the corresponding Climate Twitter migration inference. Most crossed-cluster estimates lack released intervals, and joint author/month response covariance estimates fail, restricting formal inference. These results show how operational definitions, platform-specific response fields and observation boundaries shape what can be claimed about climate backlash. The contribution is an archive-based account of these measurement consequences, rather than a measure of individual opposition, persuasion or advocacy-induced backlash.

AI.tldr: 该研究对四个Twitter和Reddit气候讨论档案进行全量、无抽样的透明词法分析，将框架共现与来源特定的时间和回应模型相联系，区分回归作者的事件期变化与参与者更替，揭示操作定义、平台回应字段和观测边界如何塑造关于气候反弹的结论。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体档案常被用于研究对气候行动的抵制，但词汇、回应计数和观测到的参与者并不测量同一社会过程，因此需要厘清测量方式对研究结论的影响。
AI.method: 对四个提供的Twitter和Reddit档案处理全部注册文件，不进行抽样，应用透明、非排他性的词法规则；将框架共现与来源特定的时间及回应模型相联系，并将回归作者的事件期变化与参与者更替分开。
AI.result: Reddit上可再生能源术语与成本相关语言共现，但更窄的反弹短语大幅降低跨来源对比并反转巴黎协定对比的符号；跨话语史不改善主要语境预测；否认/骗局术语与Twitter点赞更高相关，而Reddit回应关联取决于框架、结果和作者设定；2019年全球气候罢工前后，回归作者表达和参与者更替均提升抗议语言份额；档案端点阻止了相应的Climate Twitter迁移推断；多数跨聚类估计缺少发布的区间，作者/月份联合回应协方差估计失败。
AI.conclusion: 操作定义、平台特定回应字段和观测边界共同决定了关于气候反弹可主张的内容；本文贡献是基于档案对这些测量后果的说明，而非对个体反对、说服或倡导引发反弹的测量。

title: Decide Before You Look: Learning Which Retrieved Memories Deserve Pixels
summary: Multimodal assistants answer questions from long-term memories that contain images. After retrieval, each retrieved image reaches the answering model either as pixels, at about a thousand visual tokens per image, or as a stored text proxy that often misses the detail the question asks about. We find that the benefit of pixels usually comes from one or two retrieved memories, and that it can be predicted before the answering model runs, without reading any full-resolution image. In PixelTriage, a plug-in placed after retrieval, a small model that does not generate text reads the dialogue, a short note and a thumbnail of each retrieved memory and predicts how much its pixels would add. It is trained on synthetic memory episodes labeled by a frozen 27B model that answers each question with and without each memory's pixels. With a 7B answering model, PixelTriage lies on the accuracy--cost frontier of M$^3$Exam, DMV and MemEye and uses 11--23\% of the visual tokens without a significant loss of accuracy. On DMV it answers 2.9 times faster than opening all images. It outperforms retrieval order and uniform down-sizing at equal budgets and transfers to other memory systems and to a 397B answering model.

AI.tldr: PixelTriage 是一个检索后的插件，用小模型在不读全分辨率图像的情况下预测每个检索记忆的像素增益，从而决定是否为该记忆保留像素表示，大幅减少视觉 token 开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态助手需从含图像的长期记忆中答题。检索到的图像要么以像素形式（约千个视觉 token/图）送入回答模型，代价高；要么以文本代理形式存储，却常丢失问题所需的细节。且像素带来的收益通常只来自一两个检索记忆，因此需要一种低成本方式提前判断哪些记忆值得用像素表示。
AI.method: PixelTriage 置于检索之后，使用一个不生成文本的小模型，读取对话、简短笔记以及每个检索记忆的缩略图，预测其像素能带来多少增益。训练数据为合成的记忆片段，标签由冻结的 27B 模型在"有/无该记忆像素"两种条件下分别作答生成。
AI.result: 在 7B 回答模型下，PixelTriage 位于 M³Exam、DMV 和 MemEye 的精度—成本前沿，仅用 11–23% 的视觉 token 且精度无显著损失；在 DMV 上比打开所有图像快 2.9 倍；在同等预算下优于检索顺序和均匀降采样，并可迁移到其他记忆系统及 397B 回答模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过提前预测单个检索记忆的像素增益，PixelTriage 可在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著降低视觉 token 消耗与延迟，且具备良好的泛化与迁移能力。

title: What pass@k Cannot Measure: Evaluating Diversity and Capability Retention after Post-Training
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-training to Post-training (non-archival)
summary: pass@$k$, the fraction of problems a model solves within $k$ sampled attempts, is the field's default protocol for deciding whether reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training on verifiable rewards improved a model. At the population level, pass@$k$ depends only on a problem's probability of a correct sample, with no term for how it is distributed across outputs. We show this gap is not academic. Training Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on grade-school math with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and with rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT, training on the model's own shortest verifier-passed rollout) moves three complementary diversity measures (token-level entropy, answer-level entropy, unique answers per prompt) in opposite directions, with zero overlap across three seeds per arm. The gap survives restricting to verifier-correct completions only (lexical diversity among correct solutions is 15% lower for GRPO, after controlling for length) and a count-controlled check isolating diversity among incorrect answers alone, ruling out that GRPO's higher accuracy alone explains it. Yet pass@8 and pass@32 show no consistent winner on GSM8K, and a hard MATH-500 subset shows the same pattern: separation only at low $k$. Compared against the starting checkpoint, no trained arm significantly improves hard-problem coverage: RFT is significantly worse, while GRPO is statistically indistinguishable from it - so GRPO's pass@1 edge over RFT reflects a smaller loss relative to Base, not a capability gain, a missing-control issue, not a failure of pass@$k$. On GSM8K, only pass@1, with no role in detecting diversity by construction, separates the arms cleanly, rewarding the arm whose correct solutions are least diverse. We argue this is a concrete instance of a standard evaluation protocol missing a property it is routinely used to certify.

AI.tldr: pass@k仅依赖正确答案的采样概率，忽略输出分布结构。实验显示GRPO与RFT在多项多样性指标上呈相反方向变化，但pass@8/pass@32无法区分二者，且两种方法均未显著提升难题覆盖率，仅pass@1能区分却偏好正确解多样性最低的模型。
AI.motivation: pass@k是判断RL后训练是否提升模型的默认协议，但其总体层面只依赖单题正确采样概率，不含输出分布信息，作者希望验证这一缺失是否具有实质影响，即pass@k是否会掩盖模型在解空间多样性上的重要差异。
AI.method: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct上，用小学数学习题分别做GRPO与RFT后训练（每臂三个随机种子）；测量token级熵、答案级熵、每题唯一答案数三类多样性指标；补充仅限验证通过解的词法多样性分析（控制长度）与仅针对错误答案的计数控制检验；在GSM8K与MATH-500难题子集上比较pass@1、pass@8、pass@32，并与初始checkpoint作对照。
AI.result: GRPO与RFT在三个多样性指标上方向相反且三个种子间零重叠；仅看正确解时GRPO词法多样性低约15%（控制长度后）；仅看错误解也存在差异，排除GRPO高准确率单独解释的可能。但pass@8与pass@32在GSM8K上无稳定赢家，MATH-500难题子集同样只在低k处出现分离。相对Base，两臂均未显著提升难题覆盖率：RFT显著更差，GRPO与Base统计上不可区分。
AI.conclusion: GRPO相对RFT的pass@1优势只是相对Base损失更小，并非能力提升，属缺失对照问题而非pass@k失灵。GSM8K上只有pass@1能干净区分两臂，而它按构造不参与多样性检测，反而奖励正确解多样性最低的那一臂。这说明标准评测协议确实遗漏了它常被用来证明的属性。

title: Learning Explainable Representations of Complex Game-playing Strategies
summary: As part of learning to play complex games, human players develop develop abstractions for concepts and strategies of gameplay consistent with game rules to improve their performance. These concepts are applied to explain other players' actions, and to inform their own actions in-game. Understanding other players' strategies is a crucial part of such improvement, but requires time and effort. In this paper, we propose a strategy similar to human cognition for training RL agents to synthesize learned strategies and policies as executable procedures based on sequences of gameplay actions. We present methods to automatically learn such programs to play chess and to solve tasks in a grid-based environment. We show that the learned strategies produce effective actions, and can be learned from gameplay data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种类似人类认知的策略，通过训练强化学习智能体，将学到的策略综合为基于游戏动作序列的可执行程序（程序化策略），并在国际象棋和网格环境任务中自动学习此类程序，验证其能产生有效动作且可从对局数据中学习。
AI.motivation: 人类玩家在学习复杂游戏时会形成与规则一致的概念和策略抽象，用以解释他人行为并指导自身决策；理解他人策略是提升水平的关键，但耗时耗力。作者希望让强化学习智能体也具备这种类似人类认知的能力，从而提升学习与策略表达效果。
AI.method: 提出一种类似人类认知的训练思路：让RL智能体从游戏动作序列中自动学习并综合出可执行程序形式的策略。具体地，设计自动学习此类程序的方法，分别用于下国际象棋和在网格环境中求解任务，策略以可执行程序形式表达。
AI.result: 实验表明，所学到的策略能够产生有效的动作，并且可以从对局数据中学习获得，验证了方法的可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将策略综合为可执行程序并模仿人类认知过程，可使RL智能体学得有效且可解释的策略，并支持从游戏数据中自动学习；该思路在复杂游戏与网格任务中均具可行性。

title: VisionWeave: Weaving Elastic Visual Representations as a Native Capability of MLLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models have become the dominant paradigm for visual understanding, but incur substantial costs by encoding inputs into dense, fixed-size patch tokens. However, visual information is unevenly distributed: some regions require fine-grained detail, while others admit compact representations. Downsampling sacrifices this detail, while existing token pruning and adaptive approaches remain limited in content-adaptive granularity, task generalization, and integration with modern MLLMs and serving infrastructure. Overcoming these limitations calls for foundation models that learn, end to end, where-and at what granularity-to allocate visual representations, a native capability we term elastic visual representation weaving. We introduce VisionWeave, establishing this capability in frontier-level MLLMs through large-scale training. It combines two components: a gated spatial pooler constructs coarse-grained representations alongside native fine-grained representations within a shared MRoPE coordinate, while a granularity router learns their content-adaptive allocation. Through self-distillation alone, we validate this capability on Qwen3.5-4B and scale to Qwen3.8-27B with over 30K A100 GPU-hours. Based on Qwen3.8-27B, VisionWeave adaptively adjusts token savings to visual content, saving 43.0% tokens on average while retaining 98.9% native performance across eight benchmarks, versus only 88% performance preserved for token pruning baselines with a fixed 50% savings target. Extensive evaluations confirm robust efficiency-quality trade-offs across diverse tasks, resolutions and video frames. When deployed on SGLang serving engine, our method achieves a 2.3x throughput gain while reducing mean TTFT by 54.4% and mean TPOT by 60.6%. Together, we believe these results position elastic visual weaving as a promising capability for next-generation multimodal models.

AI.tldr: VisionWeave 提出"弹性视觉表征编织"能力，通过门控空间池化器与粒度路由器实现内容自适应的视觉令牌分配，在 Qwen3.8-27B 上平均节省 43.0% 令牌并保留 98.9% 原生性能，服务端吞吐提升 2.3 倍。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型视觉理解能力强，但将输入编码为稠密固定大小的 patch 令牌成本高昂。视觉信息分布不均：部分区域需细粒度细节，其他区域可用紧凑表征。降采样会损失细节，而现有令牌剪枝与自适应方法在内容自适应粒度、任务泛化性及与现代 MLLM 和服务基础设施的集成上均受限，因此需要能端到端学习"在何处、以何种粒度"分配视觉表征的基础模型能力。
AI.method: 提出 VisionWeave，通过大规模训练在前沿 MLLM 中建立该能力。包含两个组件：(1) 门控空间池化器（gated spatial pooler），在共享 MRoPE 坐标下同时构建粗粒度与原生细粒度表征；(2) 粒度路由器（granularity router），学习两者的内容自适应分配。仅通过自蒸馏即可验证该能力，先在 Qwen3.5-4B 上验证，再扩展至 Qwen3.8-27B，消耗超 30K A100 GPU 小时。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen3.8-27B，VisionWeave 能随视觉内容自适应调整令牌节省量，在八个基准上平均节省 43.0% 令牌，同时保留 98.9% 原生性能；而固定 50% 节省目标的令牌剪枝基线仅保留约 88% 性能。多任务、多分辨率与视频帧评估均显示稳健的效率-质量权衡。部署于 SGLang 服务引擎时，吞吐提升 2.3 倍，平均 TTFT 降低 54.4%，平均 TPOT 降低 60.6%。
AI.conclusion: 弹性视觉编织是一种面向下一代多模态模型的有前景的能力，可在内容自适应粒度下实现高效且高质量的视觉表征分配。

title: Evaluation of Active Feature Acquisition Policies with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Active feature acquisition learns policies that sequentially acquire features to maximize information about a target variable. We study how to learn and evaluate such policies from finite offline data using prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), which are off-the-shelf models that output posterior predictive distributions without task-specific training.
