We show that under the imbalanced coverage of offline data, using total predictive entropy as a reward creates an epistemic bias that penalizes acquiring sparsely observed features. Specifically, this reward conflates epistemic uncertainty (arising from lack of offline data) with aleatoric uncertainty (arising from uninformative features). To address this, we target the posterior expected (aleatoric) entropy instead of the total predictive entropy output by a PFN for evaluating feature acquisitions. Empirical evaluations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently reduces value estimation bias and yields credible intervals with strong empirical coverage, which can translate to improved downstream policy selection.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何利用先验数据拟合网络（PFN）从有限离线数据中学习和评估主动特征获取策略，并提出用后验期望（偶然）熵替代总预测熵以消除数据覆盖不均衡造成的信息偏差。
AI.motivation: 在有限离线数据下学习主动特征获取策略时，离线数据覆盖不均衡是一个核心挑战。使用PFN输出的总预测熵作为奖励会引入认知偏差，因为它将认知不确定性（源于离线数据不足）与偶然不确定性（源于特征本身无信息量）混为一谈，从而惩罚获取稀疏观测特征的行为。
AI.method: 作者提出针对PFN输出的后验期望（偶然）熵作为评估特征获取的目标，而非使用总预测熵，以区分认知与偶然不确定性。随后在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在合成与真实数据集上均能持续降低价值估计偏差，并产生具有良好经验覆盖率的可信区间，进而改善下游策略选择。
AI.conclusion: 使用后验期望熵替代总预测熵是一种更可靠的离线主动特征获取评估与学习方式，能够缓解数据覆盖不均衡导致的偏差，并提升策略选择质量。

title: Towards the Automatic Synthesis of Interpretable Chess Tactics
summary: State-of-the-art reinforcement learning agents are capable of outperforming human experts at games like chess, Go and StarCraft II. These agents do not simply take advantage of their digital hardware in being able to react and calculate faster than humans, but employ better strategies that lead to more victories. Interpreting these strategies would give human players valuable insight into how to improve their play. In this preliminary work, we propose a symbolic sub-policy model for playing chess. Inspired by chess tactics, our model attempts to incorporate domain knowledge to improve interpretability. We adapt patterns learned by an inductive logic programming system called PAL to derive our model. We contribute a divergence metric to evaluate our model against a random baseline, and find a set of tactics that is able to suggest moves of similar playing strength to a human beginner. Finally, we propose a computational evaluation scheme for the model by augmenting an off-the-shelf engine with it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于国际象棋的符号化子策略模型，借助归纳逻辑编程系统PAL学习战术模式以提升可解释性，并提出散度指标评估模型。
AI.motivation: 顶尖强化学习智能体在国际象棋、围棋等游戏中超越人类专家，其优势不仅在于计算速度，更在于更优策略。解读这些策略能为人类玩家提供改进思路，而现有方法可解释性不足。
AI.method: 受国际象棋战术启发，构建符号化子策略模型，引入领域知识以增强可解释性；改编归纳逻辑编程系统PAL所学模式来推导该模型；提出一种散度指标，用于将模型与随机基线进行对比评估；并设计通过将该模型增强到现成引擎上的计算评估方案。
AI.result: 通过散度指标评估，所得到的一组战术能够给出与人类初学者棋力相近的走法建议。
AI.conclusion: 该符号化子策略模型在可解释性和棋力上取得初步平衡，未来可通过增强现成引擎进行更完整的计算评估。

title: PhysTacGen: Physics-Aware Visual-Tactile Sensor Image Generation
summary: Realistic physical interaction is a cornerstone of embodied intelligence, yet collecting paired visual--tactile data remains costly. Visual-to-tactile synthesis offers a promising approach to augmenting such data, but learning this mapping is complicated by the gap between visual appearance and contact-related material properties, as well as spatial misalignment in paired observations. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{PhysTacGen}, a visual-to-optical-tactile image generation framework that integrates material-aware descriptions with geometric conditioning. First, we introduce Group Tactile Policy Optimization (GTPO), a reinforcement learning strategy that refines a vision--language model to generate structured material descriptions using task-specific rewards. Second, we combine DINOv2-based pair curation with monocular relative-depth estimation to select training pairs and provide geometric priors. Finally, an SDXL ControlNet synthesizes optical tactile images conditioned on RGB, relative depth, and GTPO-generated text. Experiments on curated SSVTP data demonstrate improved structural similarity over the compared baselines, while a blinded user study shows a preference for GTPO-generated descriptions. Generated tactile inputs also improve performance on an attribute-derived force-coefficient prediction proxy. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of PhysTacGen for optical tactile image synthesis and its utility in the evaluated downstream task.The code will be available at https://github.com/VDIGPKU/PhysTacGen.

AI.tldr: PhysTacGen是一个视觉到光学触觉图像生成框架，通过整合材料感知描述和几何条件，提升触觉数据合成质量。
AI.motivation: 真实物理交互是具身智能的基础，但配对视觉-触觉数据采集成本高。视觉到触觉合成可增强此类数据，但视觉外观与接触相关材料属性之间的差距，以及配对观测中的空间错位，使该映射学习变得困难。
AI.method: 方法包括三部分：1) 提出Group Tactile Policy Optimization (GTPO)，一种强化学习策略，利用任务特定奖励精炼视觉-语言模型以生成结构化材料描述；2) 结合DINOv2配对筛选与单目相对深度估计，选择训练对并提供几何先验；3) 使用SDXL ControlNet，以RGB、相对深度和GTPO生成文本为条件合成光学触觉图像。
AI.result: 在筛选后的SSVTP数据上，结构相似性优于对比基线；盲测用户研究显示GTPO生成的描述更受偏好；生成的触觉输入也提升了属性导出的力系数预测代理任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明PhysTacGen在光学触觉图像合成方面有效，并在所评估的下游任务中具有实用价值。代码将发布于 https://github.com/VDIGPKU/PhysTacGen。

title: Learnable Spectral Activations
summary: Implicit neural representations (INRs) are shaped by the spectral structure induced by their input encodings and activation functions. Existing methods improve fitting primarily by modifying which frequencies are available to the network, through coordinate encodings or periodic nonlinearities. However, frequency access is not the only bottleneck: signals with localized or spatially varying structure require the network to efficiently compose frequencies into multi-harmonic internal responses. We introduce learnable spectral activations (LSA), which replace fixed neuron-level nonlinearities with a residual truncated Fourier series whose harmonic amplitudes are learned during training. LSA does not expand the asymptotic function class. Instead, it changes the factorization of the representation: linear weights select features while activation coefficients control spectral shaping, and the two are updated by separate gradients. Because the activation output is affine in the coefficients given fixed pre-activations, spectral tuning becomes a more direct subproblem compared to architectures where it is entangled with feature selection. Empirically, this factorization concentrates more target-signal energy in the leading eigenmodes of the neural tangent kernel, consistent with improved optimization behavior. Across audio, image, neural radiance field, and neural acoustic field tasks, LSA also improves reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可学习频谱激活（LSA），用残差截断傅里叶级数替代固定神经元级非线性，通过将表示分解为"线性权重选特征+激活系数控频谱"两条独立梯度路径，改善隐式神经表示的优化与重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有隐式神经表示（INR）方法主要通过坐标编码或周期非线性来改变网络"可获得的频率"，但频率可得性并非唯一瓶颈：具有局部或空间变化结构的信号，需要网络高效地将频率组合成多谐波内部响应。因此需要在表示层面寻找新的改进视角，而非单纯扩展可用频率。
AI.method: 提出可学习频谱激活（LSA）：将固定的神经元级非线性替换为残差截断傅里叶级数，其谐波幅度在训练中学习。LSA 不扩展渐近函数类，而是改变表示的因式分解——线性权重负责特征选择，激活系数负责频谱塑形，二者由分离的梯度更新。由于在固定预激活下激活输出对系数是仿射的，频谱调优成为一个更直接的子问题，避免了与特征选择的纠缠。
AI.result: 这种因式分解使更多目标信号能量集中于神经正切核（NTK）的主导特征模，与优化行为的改善一致；在音频、图像、神经辐射场与神经声场等任务上，LSA 均提升了重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 频谱调优的瓶颈不只在频率可得性，也在频率的组合与分解方式。将频谱塑形从特征选择中解耦，可在不扩大函数类的前提下改善 INR 的优化与表现。

title: Matching Object or Relation? Tracing Abstract Reasoning Inside VLMs
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) excel on visual benchmarks but fail systematically on tasks requiring abstract reasoning. Existing benchmarks document this failure but cannot say \emph{why} it happens or which cognitive capability is missing. We close this gap by adopting the Relational Match-to-Sample (RMTS) paradigm from comparative and developmental psychology and pairing it with a mechanistic analysis of the model's internals. On a parametrically controlled stimulus set evaluated across frontier API models (GPT, Claude, Gemini) and three open-source families (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, InternVL3), we identify four levers that shift VLMs toward the relational match---capability tier, model scale, the number of objects per scene, and the absence of per-object stimulus noise---together producing a developmental-like trajectory that mirrors the human \emph{relational shift}. Opening up the model, a per-layer representational similarity analysis and a causal mediation analysis reveal that VLM abstract reasoning is implemented by two competing circuits: an early circuit that organises images by their surface object features, and a late circuit that organises them by their abstract relation. Extending the analysis to ARC-AGI-1, we find that ablating the relational heads identified on RMTS degrades performance more than ablating random heads, indicating that the relational circuit is recruited beyond our controlled stimuli. We hope this mechanism-level view serves as a step toward understanding how abstract reasoning is implemented in VLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文引入心理学中的关系匹配样本（RMTS）范式并结合机制分析，揭示VLM抽象推理失败的原因，发现其由早期表面特征回路与晚期抽象关系回路竞争实现。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只能记录VLM在抽象推理任务上的失败，却无法解释失败原因或指出缺失哪种认知能力，因此需要一种能定位认知机制的研究方法。
AI.method: 采用RMTS范式构建参数化受控刺激集，评测GPT、Claude、Gemini等前沿API模型及Qwen3.5、Gemma-4、InternVL3三个开源系列；同时进行逐层表征相似性分析和因果中介分析，并扩展到ARC-AGI-1进行消融验证。
AI.result: 识别出四个影响关系匹配的杠杆：能力层级、模型规模、每场景物体数量和逐物体刺激噪声的缺失，共同形成类似人类“关系转变”的发展轨迹；发现两个竞争回路——早期按表面物体特征组织图像、晚期按抽象关系组织图像；在ARC-AGI-1上消融关系头比随机头更显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: VLM的抽象推理由相互竞争的表面特征回路与关系回路实现，关系回路可迁移到受控刺激之外的任务，该机制视角有助于理解VLM抽象推理的实现方式。

title: Two Halves are More than One: Phase-wise Velocity Distillation for Fast and High-Quality Image Generation
summary: Recent diffusion-based image generation backbones have grown substantially in scale, making the network inference cost increase rapidly. While diffusion distillation techniques can reduce the number of inference steps, high-quality image generation within a single full-backbone-forward compute budget remains challenging. Existing one-step methods typically allocate this budget to a single evaluation of a monolithic student. However, approximating the heterogeneous coarse-to-fine transport with a single monolithic mapping is difficult and often leads to over-smoothed outputs. To address this issue, we propose Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD), which partitions the generation timeline into a coarse and a fine phase, and models the transition within each phase via the average velocity. A dedicated half-sized expert is assigned to each phase, decoupling structural composition from detail refinement while keeping the cumulative computation equivalent to one full-backbone forward pass. We show that the use of two half-sized phase-specific experts outperforms a single full-size monolithic student. On class-conditional image generation, PVD achieves an FID of 1.48 on ImageNet 256 x 256. On more complex text-to-image (T2I) tasks, PVD-distilled models (Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium, FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image) produce results competitive with their multi-step teachers, significantly outperforming prior distillation methods. Moreover, across the evaluated T2I backbones, PVD reduces active parameters by 49.10-50.89% and peak VRAM by 45.76-48.36% compared to the corresponding teachers. Source code and distilled models are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/PVD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD)，将生成时间线分为粗、细两阶段，各用半尺寸专家网络建模平均速度，在单次全骨干前向的计算预算内实现高质量一步生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型骨干规模不断增大导致推理成本快速上升。扩散蒸馏虽能减少推理步数，但在单次全骨干前向的计算预算下实现高质量一步生成仍具挑战。现有一步方法通常将该预算用于单体学生网络的单次评估，而用单一整体映射近似异构的"由粗到细"传输过程十分困难，常导致输出过度平滑。
AI.method: 提出 Phase-wise Velocity Distillation (PVD)：将生成时间线划分为粗阶段与细阶段，在每个阶段内通过平均速度建模状态转移；为每个阶段分配一个专用的半尺寸专家网络，从而将结构组成与细节精修解耦，同时保持累计计算量等价于一次完整骨干前向。作者论证了使用两个半尺寸的阶段专用专家的效果优于单一全尺寸单体学生。
AI.result: 在类别条件图像生成上，PVD 在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得 FID 1.48。在更复杂的文本到图像（T2I）任务上，基于 Stable Diffusion 3.5-Medium、FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image 蒸馏得到的模型结果可与多步教师模型竞争，显著优于先前的蒸馏方法。此外，在各评测 T2I 骨干上，PVD 相比对应教师模型将激活参数减少 49.10–50.89%，峰值显存降低 45.76–48.36%。
AI.conclusion: PVD 通过阶段化专家与平均速度建模，在保持单次全骨干前向计算预算的同时实现了高质量一步生成，验证了"两个半尺寸阶段专家优于单一全尺寸学生"的设计，并在类别条件生成与 T2I 任务上同时获得优越的质量与显著的参数、显存效率提升。代码与蒸馏模型已开源。

title: Benchmarking Label-Revealed Online Updates for EEG BCI Decoding
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) signals drift over time, which can cause static brain-computer interface (BCI) models to degrade in practice. We present a benchmark for online adaptation and compare two widely used pipeline families, Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) and Riemannian covariance-based methods, under time-ordered prequential (test-then-train) evaluation. We examine (i) which pipelines benefit most from label-revealed updates, (ii) whether controlled forgetting of older data improves robustness, and (iii) how a minimal-calibration cold start compares with starting from a pretrained model. Across four datasets (three motor-imagery datasets and one movement-decoding dataset), label-revealed online updates improve 13 of 14 model/dataset pairs on the two largest streams, with relative accuracy gains of up to about 18% over a frozen model. A Shapley-based data-valuation analysis over temporal blocks assigns the largest mean value to the most recent block in each of the three analyzed datasets, while older blocks retain positive value.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个脑机接口（BCI）在线自适应基准，在时间有序的preqential评估下比较CSP与黎曼协方差方法，发现标签揭示的在线更新能显著提升多数模型/数据集对的准确率。
AI.motivation: EEG信号随时间漂移，导致静态BCI模型在实际应用中性能下降，因此需要系统评估在线自适应方法的效果与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 构建在线自适应基准，采用时间有序的preqential（先测后训）评估，比较Common Spatial Patterns（CSP）与黎曼协方差两类流水线；考察标签揭示更新、对旧数据的受控遗忘以及最小校准冷启动与预训练模型启动的对比；并在四个数据集（三个运动想象数据集和一个运动解码数据集）上实验，另用基于Shapley的数据估值分析时间块贡献。
AI.result: 在最大的两个数据流上，标签揭示的在线更新使14个模型/数据集对中的13个得到提升，相对准确率最高提升约18%；Shapley数据估值显示三个分析数据集中最近时间块的平均价值最大，且较旧时间块仍保持正向价值。
AI.conclusion: 在线标签揭示更新对缓解EEG漂移有效，近期数据价值最高但历史数据仍有贡献，为BCI在线自适应策略提供了基准与实证依据。

title: Where Rules End and Judges Begin: Measuring the Judgment Boundary in Multi-Agent Systems Security
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) engage tools, share memory, and delegate tasks, often encountering adversarial content. Current defenses for MAS are typically evaluated in isolation, focusing on one attack type at a time, which can lead to costly and hard-to-audit outcomes. This study organizes defenses into five principles, implementing them as DEFER1 (DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment), which includes a cascade of 28 checks that blocks what it can and refers the rest to a panel of four judges. In independent testing across four domains, attack success rates drop from about 30.0% to approximately 3.0%, with 78% of blocked attacks handled by deterministic checks. Only a quarter of proposals reach the judges in the security-operations domain, illustrating that the rules provide security for attacks violating clear policies, while judges manage those that only misrepresent intent. Both systems have weaknesses, such as a risk-score approval gate that inaccurately approves most attack proposals but few legitimate ones, highlighting the challenges in assessing threats accurately.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DEFER1防御框架，用28项确定性检查加四位评审员的级联机制保护LLM多智能体系统，将攻击成功率从约30.0%降至约3.0%。
AI.motivation: 当前针对LLM多智能体系统（MAS）的防御通常在孤立场景下评估，一次只针对一种攻击类型，导致成本高昂且难以审计。作者希望建立统一的防御原则，以应对工具调用、记忆共享和任务委派中的对抗内容。
AI.method: 将防御整理为五项原则，并实现为DEFER1（确定性优先执行与残余判断，DEterministic-First Enforcement with Residual judgment）。该机制包含28项检查的级联：先尽可能拦截，其余交由四位评审员组成的评审小组判断。
AI.result: 在四个领域的独立测试中，攻击成功率从约30.0%降至约3.0%；78%被拦截的攻击由确定性检查处理，安全运营领域仅四分之一提案需要送交评审员。
AI.conclusion: 规则可为违反明确策略的攻击提供防护，评审员则处理仅意图误导的攻击，二者互补。但系统仍有弱点，例如风险评分审批门会错误批准多数攻击提案、却只批准少数合法提案，说明准确评估威胁仍具挑战。

title: Multi-Dataset Diagnostic Utility of Clinical Visual Concepts in AI Systems for Dermatology
comment: Accepted at the MICCAI ISIC Workshop 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Code and dataset: https://github.com/Digital-Dermatology/SkinLex
summary: The clinical integration of AI systems in digital dermatology relies heavily on human trust. Clinically interpretable visual concepts can act as intermediate representations enhancing trust and reliability. However, research in this domain is currently limited by scattered, heterogeneous dataset annotations. In this work, we introduce SkinLex, a harmonized dataset of 48 clinical morphological attributes across four public datasets (SkinCon, DermaCon-IN, MM-Skin, and PASSION) for a total of 20,411 records. Supervised nine-partition classification of skin conditions shows that limiting features to specific visual groups, like shapes or colors alone, reduces diagnostic accuracy. Bootstrapped backward elimination reveals that the set of 48 visual concepts has some degree of redundancy for algorithmic nine-partition diagnosis on the examined dataset. This demonstrates that coarse diagnosis on the selected dataset requires a relatively small but varied combination of clinical concepts, and motivates further research to improve concept taxonomy. Results can be translated into clinical benefits by reducing inputs for concept-based models, improving efficiency for annotation and modeling, and further enhancing interpretability. Code and prompt templates are available at https://github.com/Digital-Dermatology/SkinLex.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一数据集 SkinLex，整合四个公共数据集的48个临床形态学属性，共20,411条记录，并分析视觉概念在皮肤病AI诊断中的作用与冗余性。
AI.motivation: AI系统在数字皮肤病学中的临床整合高度依赖人类信任，临床可解释的视觉概念可作为中间表征增强信任与可靠性，但该领域研究受限于分散、异构的数据集标注。
AI.method: 构建 SkinLex 统一数据集，涵盖 SkinCon、DermaCon-IN、MM-Skin、PASSION 四个公共数据集，共48个临床形态学属性、20,411条记录；进行监督式九分类皮肤状况分类，并采用自助法（bootstrap）后向消除分析视觉概念的冗余性。
AI.result: 将特征限制在特定视觉组（如仅形状或仅颜色）会降低诊断准确率；后向消除显示48个视觉概念对算法九分类诊断存在一定冗余，表明粗粒度诊断仅需较少但多样的临床概念组合。
AI.conclusion: 该结果可转化为临床收益：减少基于概念模型的输入、提升标注与建模效率、进一步增强可解释性，并推动概念分类体系的改进研究。代码与提示模板已公开。

title: StaFIR: Convex Learning of Stationarity-Aware Causal Filters
comment: Accepted at the TS-LIMITS Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Reducing nonstationarity in a persistent time series entails deciding how much of its temporal dependence to remove. In finance, fractional differencing is often tuned using the Augmented Dickey--Fuller (ADF) test, limiting the search to a one-parameter family of lag profiles and addressing input preservation only indirectly. We propose StaFIR, a causal finite-impulse-response filter with a learned nonnegative mixture of exponential lag profiles. Its convex learning objective balances empirical stationarity with similarity to the input. We evaluate StaFIR on ARFIMA--GARCH controlled settings and rolling financial series, including a realized-volatility forecasting task. The experiments show that StaFIR adjusts its filtering strength to persistence while limiting unnecessary transformation in stationary regimes. In downstream forecasting, there is no clear accuracy difference from fixed half-order differencing, while StaFIR achieves higher measured similarity to the raw signal. A complementary direct forecasting experiment finds that greater input similarity is associated with smaller forecasting penalties, although the raw representation remains stronger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StaFIR——一种因果有限脉冲响应滤波器，通过学习指数滞后剖面的非负混合来调节时间序列的非平稳性，在保证平稳性的同时尽量保留输入信号。
AI.motivation: 在金融等时间序列分析中，降低非平稳性需要决定去除多少时间依赖。传统的分数差分法通常用ADF检验来调节，这限制了搜索空间（仅限单参数滞后剖面族），并且只是间接地处理输入信号保留问题。作者希望找到一种既能自适应调节滤波强度、又能直接平衡平稳化与输入相似性的方法。
AI.method: 提出StaFIR，一种因果有限脉冲响应（FIR）滤波器，其核为指数滞后剖面的可学习非负混合。学习目标为凸优化，同时权衡经验平稳性与与输入信号的相似度。在ARFIMA–GARCH受控设定以及滚动金融序列（包括已实现波动率预测任务）上进行评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，StaFIR能根据序列的持续性自适应调整滤波强度，在平稳区间限制不必要的变换。在下游预测中，其准确率与固定半阶差分无明显差异，但StaFIR与原始信号的相似度更高。另一项直接预测实验发现，输入相似度越高，预测惩罚越小，但原始表示仍然更强。
AI.conclusion: StaFIR提供了一种可学习、凸优化的分数式滤波方案，能够在平稳化与信号保留之间取得更好的平衡，相比固定半阶差分具有更高的输入相似度。不过其下游预测精度并未超越固定方法，原始信号表示在直接预测中仍表现最佳。

title: Massive Activation Gating Channel in Large Language Models
summary: Massive activations, a phenomenon in which a small number of hidden channels exhibit exceptionally large magnitudes, are pervasive in large language models (LLMs). However, the mechanism by which a token develops massive activations as it propagates through a pretrained LLM remains poorly understood. In this paper, we find that the emergence of massive activations is controlled by a single channel in the input embedding to a spike feed-forward network (FFN). The position of this channel is fixed for a particular LLM. We name this channel the massive activation gating channel (MAGC). When the value of the MAGC is sufficiently large (or small, depending on the LLM), the output of the spike FFN exhibits massive activations. Examining six LLMs across four model families and different model sizes, we verify the existence and effect of MAGC. We further provide a theoretical explanation of the mechanism by which MAGC induces massive activations. When the value of MAGC is sufficiently large (or small), the output of a spike FFN asymptotically reduces to a quadratic form that mixes a few columns of the down-projection matrix of the FFN. Since these columns exhibit the shape of massive activations, the output therefore exhibits massive activations.

AI.tldr: 论文发现大语言模型中的"大规模激活"现象由输入嵌入中一个固定通道（MAGC）门控，通过尖峰FFN的二次型机制产生，并在六个模型上验证。
AI.motivation: 大规模激活在LLM中普遍存在，但一个token在预训练LLM中传播时如何发展出大规模激活的机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 定位到输入嵌入中控制尖峰FFN（spike FFN）的单一通道，命名为MAGC，并对其诱导大规模激活的机制给出理论解释。
AI.result: 在四个模型家族、不同规模的六个LLM上验证了MAGC的存在与作用；当MAGC取值足够大（或小）时，尖峰FFN输出渐近退化为混合FFN下投影矩阵若干列的二次型，而这些列呈大规模激活形态。
AI.conclusion: MAGC是控制大规模激活出现的关键且位置固定的通道，其作用机制可由尖峰FFN输出的渐近二次型给出理论解释。

title: Beyond Training from Scratch: Foundation Models for Data-Efficient and Generalizable Cardiac MRI Reconstruction
summary: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging reconstruction aims to recover high-quality images from undersampled acquisitions, enabling faster scans while preserving diagnostic fidelity. Recent reconstruction methods are typically trained from scratch and often require large amounts of task-specific data, limiting their robustness under data scarcity and distribution shifts. In this work, we investigate whether pretrained vision foundation models can serve as effective priors for accelerated cardiac MRI reconstruction. We propose a reconstruction framework that integrates frozen and parameter-efficiently adapted visual encoders, including CLIP, BiomedCLIP, and DINOv2, within a transformer-based reconstruction architecture. Extensive experiments on the CMRxRecon2023 and CMRxRecon2024 benchmarks demonstrate that pretrained representations consistently outperform a transformer trained from scratch across multiple acceleration factors. We further evaluate performance under limited supervision and cross-dataset transfer, showing that foundation models provide superior data efficiency and generalization. While frozen representations are particularly effective in extreme low-data regimes, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) yields additional gains when moderate amounts of training data are available. Among the evaluated backbones, DINOv2 achieves the strongest overall performance. These findings highlight the potential of vision foundation models as robust and transferable priors for cardiac MRI reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 研究验证了预训练视觉基础模型（CLIP、BiomedCLIP、DINOv2）作为心脏MRI重建先验的有效性。实验表明，预训练表征在多个加速倍数下均优于从零训练的Transformer，且数据效率与泛化能力更佳。冻结表征在极端低数据下有效，LoRA在中等数据量时带来额外增益，DINOv2整体表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 心脏MRI重建需从欠采样数据恢复高质量图像以加速扫描。现有重建方法通常从零训练，需要大量任务特定数据，在数据稀缺和分布偏移下鲁棒性不足。作者因此探究预训练视觉基础模型能否作为加速心脏MRI重建的有效先验。
AI.method: 提出一个重建框架，在基于Transformer的重建架构中集成冻结及参数高效适配的视觉编码器（CLIP、BiomedCLIP、DINOv2）。在CMRxRecon2023与CMRxRecon2024基准上进行实验，并评估有限监督与跨数据集迁移下的表现，比较冻结表征与LoRA适配的效果。
AI.result: 在多个加速倍数下，预训练表征一致优于从零训练的Transformer；在有限监督和跨数据集迁移中展现出更优的数据效率与泛化能力。冻结表征在极端低数据情形下尤为有效，LoRA在中等训练数据量时带来额外增益。所评估的骨干中DINOv2整体性能最强。
AI.conclusion: 视觉基础模型可作为心脏MRI重建中稳健且可迁移的先验，凸显其在加速成像中的潜力。

title: Decoupling What from Where: How Should a Small GUI Grounding Model Receive the Action Type?
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code and per-example logs are available at https://github.com/aadcha/action-conditioned-gui-agent
summary: A GUI agent decides which action to take and where to take it; we ask how a small grounding model should receive the action type. Fine-tuning Qwen2-VL-2B with LoRA on Android in the Wild, we compare a flat baseline with five ways of supplying the type under matched data, compute, and decoding: an auxiliary loss, a hard-routed action word, an additive learned embedding, a prepended learned token, and the type written into the prompt. With five seeds, an episode-clustered bootstrap, and seed-level paired tests, the ranking on a mixed stream is clear: the auxiliary loss, the additive embedding, and the prompt word each gain five to seven hit@0.10 points over the baseline, while hard routing and the prepended token are not distinguishable from it. Much of that gain is protection from a preprocessing choice of ours rather than a spatial prior. Our serializer clamps the off-screen touch point AITW records for type events to the origin; that class degrades the baseline's click grounding, and removing it lifts the baseline by nearly seven points, after which no mechanism's hit rate beats it and the intervals exclude a two-point effect, though the auxiliary loss still shortens the average miss; on a stream of taps and swipes none helps. Whether this generalizes beyond one serialization is open. For deployment, the pipeline's margin over the baseline with predicted rather than gold types is not established (+0.016, 95% interval [-0.017, +0.052]), and a wrong type collapses every model conditioned at inference. The prepended token does not help at the shared learning rate, where its rows barely move from initialization; trained ten times faster it reaches the level of the other three, with a margin three seeds do not establish. We also document a silent failure: injecting conditioning through inputs_embeds makes Qwen2-VL fall back to 1-D positions for image tokens, costing nine points.

AI.tldr: 在AITW上微调Qwen2-VL-2B，系统比较五种注入动作类型的方式：辅助损失、加性嵌入和提示词各提升5–7个hit@0.10点，但增益多来自对序列化中的离屏点击处理，而非空间先验，泛化性与部署收益仍不明确。
AI.motivation: GUI智能体需要决定"做什么动作"和"在何处执行"。本文关注一个具体问题：小型grounding模型应如何接收动作类型信息，才能更好地定位点击/滑动位置。
AI.method: 在Android in the Wild上以LoRA微调Qwen2-VL-2B，匹配数据、算力与解码设置，对比一个平坦基线（flat baseline）与五种类型注入方式：辅助损失、硬路由动作词、加性学习嵌入、前置学习token、将类型写入提示词。采用五种子、按episode聚类的bootstrap与种子级配对检验。
AI.result: 混合流上排名清晰：辅助损失、加性嵌入、提示词各比基线高5–7个hit@0.10点；硬路由与前置token与基线无显著差异。移除被序列化器钳制到原点的离屏类型事件后，基线提升近7个点，此后没有机制能超过基线（区间排除2点效应），但辅助损失仍缩短平均miss；在纯tap和swipe流上均无帮助。部署时用预测类型替代gold类型，管线相对基线优势不成立（+0.016，95%区间[-0.017,+0.052]）。前置token在共享学习率下无提升，提速10倍后追平其他三种。另发现静默失败：通过inputs_embeds注入条件会使Qwen2-VL对图像token回退到一维位置编码，损失9个点。
AI.conclusion: 多数收益来自对预处理选择的防护而非真正的空间先验；类型条件化在部署中的稳健性存疑（错误类型会破坏所有模型），结论是否可推广到其他序列化方式仍未确定。

title: EIO-Agents: The Missing Semantic Layer for AI Agent Evaluation
summary: AI agents are entering production in increasingly consequential environments without a shared semantic standard for what their evaluations actually mean. Scores, traces, judge outputs, and multi juror findings are increasingly used to justify readiness and release decisions, yet they often do not specify what evidence supports a claim, what that evidence can establish, or how the claim leads to a decision. We introduce EIO-Agents, an open specification for interoperable AI agent evaluation built on two layers. The Evaluation Intelligence Ontology (EIO) provides the semantic layer through typed evidence, versioned behavioral predicates, evidence contracts, claims, witness rules, proof status, recurrence, and computable derivations for metrics, findings, controls, and PASS, REVIEW, or BLOCK decisions. The Portable Evaluation Record (PER) provides the system of record: a canonical, content addressed representation of one evaluation that preserves the evidence to decision chain and can be re derived, explained, and verified. Scores summarize, juries interpret, and traces record, but none of them define what the evidence means or what it can prove. EIO provides that missing semantic contract, while PER preserves the resulting evaluation as a portable and verifiable system of record. As AI agents assume greater operational responsibility, evaluation must become more than a collection of scores and verdicts; it must become an accountable artifact whose meaning, evidence, limitations, and decisions can be independently checked.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EIO-Agents 开放规范，通过评估智能本体（EIO）语义层与可移植评估记录（PER）系统记录层，为 AI 智能体评估建立可互操作的语义标准，使评估成为可独立核验的问责性制品。
AI.motivation: AI 智能体正进入高风险生产环境，但其评估缺乏共享语义标准。分数、轨迹、评判输出与多评审结论常被用于支持就绪与发布决策，却未说明支持主张的证据是什么、证据能确立什么、以及主张如何导向决策。即分数只做汇总、评审做解释、轨迹做记录，都无法定义证据的含义与其可证明的内容。
AI.method: 提出开放规范 EIO-Agents，包含两层：一是评估智能本体（EIO）作为语义层，提供类型化证据、带版本的行为谓词、证据契约、主张、见证规则、证明状态、复现性，以及针对指标、发现、控制项和 PASS/REVIEW/BLOCK 决策的可计算推导；二是可移植评估记录（PER）作为系统记录，是单次评估的规范化、内容寻址表示，保留从证据到决策的链条，可被再推导、解释与验证。
AI.result: EIO 补上了缺失的语义契约，PER 将评估结果保存为可移植、可验证的系统记录，使评估的证据—决策链条可再推导、可解释、可验证。
AI.conclusion: 随着 AI 智能体承担更大的运行责任，评估必须超越分数与裁决的集合，成为其含义、证据、局限与决策均可被独立核查的问责性制品。

title: Supermarket Product Detection and Recognition: Utilizing Deep Learning with Rectified Imagery
summary: Product Identification has sprung up to become one of the most challenging problems in the automation of the retail industry. With the new industry 5.0 standards, automated inventory management, and catalog creation tasks are vitally important. Object identification models have emerged as a viable answer with their unprecedented identification and localization accuracy. However, the close-knit rack design of supermarkets generates the problem of angle variation in capturing images. The angle-variant densely packed images(a single image contains many objects) become overwhelming for these models alone. In this paper, we try to supplement object detection models with traditional Hough transform (HT) and homogeneous estimation concepts. We study the effect of rectified images using homography estimation and hough transform and their limitations on the problem of grocery identification. We make a case for creating a new dataset to test the effects of such rectification and produce analytical results on different scenarios of angle variation and object densities per image. Extensive experiments on different object detection models suggest that image rectification of angled images improves the detection accuracy of grocery products in images. The results also highlight the limitation of rectification on the angle of image capture and the object density of the image.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究零售商品识别中角度变化图像的问题，尝试用霍夫变换和单应性估计对图像进行矫正，并分析矫正对检测精度的影响。
AI.motivation: 零售自动化中商品识别是关键难题，货架密集布局导致拍摄图像存在角度变化，密集堆放图像对目标检测模型造成很大挑战。
AI.method: 在目标检测模型基础上补充传统霍夫变换（HT）和单应性估计概念，利用单应性估计与霍夫变换对图像进行矫正，并构建新数据集测试矫正效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，对角度变化的图像进行矫正可提升商品检测精度；同时结果揭示了矫正方法在拍摄角度和图像物体密度方面的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 图像矫正有助于改善零售商品识别精度，但受拍摄角度和物体密度限制，需要进一步研究。

title: Fork-and-Flush: Escaping Idea Basins in Autoresearch Agents
summary: Autoresearch agents tackle open-ended problems by repeatedly proposing candidate solutions, evaluating them, and using feedback to guide subsequent experiments. We show that independent runs of the same agent on the same task often plateau at substantially different scores, with gaps that persist even after considerable additional compute. Embedding their candidate artifacts by functional similarity provides further evidence that trajectories remain in localized regions of the solution space, which we call idea basins. To help agents escape these basins, we study a simple periodic intervention, fork-and-flush. Our method forks the agent into parallel trajectories, each inheriting the accumulated workspace but starting with a fresh chat context. After running each trajectory for a fixed horizon, the agent continues from the highest-scoring one. Across 13 long-horizon research and engineering tasks, with individual agent runs lasting up to several days, fork-and-flush outperformed the single-run and best-of-N baselines by a relative improvement of 66.0% and 44.4%, respectively, on the min-max normalized average score under an equal compute budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 fork-and-flush 方法，通过周期性分叉智能体并刷新对话上下文来帮助其脱离"想法盆地"，在13个长周期任务上显著超越单次运行和 best-of-N 基线。
AI.motivation: 自动研究智能体在开放式问题上独立多次运行，即使增加算力，也常常停滞在差异显著的分数上；候选产物的功能相似度嵌入表明轨迹被困在解空间局部区域（想法盆地），难以自我突破。
AI.method: 提出 fork-and-flush 周期性干预：将智能体分叉为多条并行轨迹，各轨迹继承累积工作区但使用全新的对话上下文；每条轨迹运行固定时长后，智能体从得分最高的轨迹继续。
AI.result: 在13个长周期研究与工程任务（单次运行长达数天）上，在相同算力预算下，fork-and-flush 的 min-max 归一化平均分数相对单次运行基线提升 66.0%，相对 best-of-N 基线提升 44.4%。
AI.conclusion: 独立的智能体运行易陷入局部解空间（想法盆地），周期性地分叉并刷新上下文是一种简单有效的干预手段，能显著提升长周期任务的性能。

title: BluffJAX: Adversarial Imperfect Information Games in JAX
summary: We introduce BluffJAX: an open-source suite of adversarial imperfect information games in JAX. We provide canonical implementations of games designed for high simulation throughputs and parallelization on GPU accelerators. Our suite consists of well-studied benchmarks such as Texas Hold'Em Poker and Kuhn Poker, as well as games that have not been previously studied in reinforcement learning research, such as Bluff, Stud Poker, and Kemps. We hope that implementing a variety of game mechanics and difficulties will introduce new challenges and foster novel research directions in game-theoretic methods for RL. We benchmark the throughput performance and memory usage of our environments in single and multi-GPU settings, demonstrating scaling of up to hundreds of millions of samples per second, and motivating the usage of BluffJAX over related GPU and CPU-based libraries. We benchmark reinforcement learning, tree search, and game-solving algorithms in JAX in order to provide users with baseline results and facilitate future comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍BluffJAX：一个基于JAX的开源不完全信息对抗博弈套件，包含经典与新颖博弈环境，支持GPU并行高吞吐模拟，并提供强化学习、树搜索与博弈求解基线。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习研究中的博弈基准较为有限，多集中于少数经典博弈，缺乏多样化的博弈机制与难度，且现有GPU或CPU库在模拟吞吐与并行化方面存在不足，难以支撑大规模博弈论方法研究。
AI.method: 提出BluffJAX套件，采用JAX实现，针对GPU加速器的高模拟吞吐与并行化进行优化设计；包含德州扑克、Kuhn扑克等经典基准，以及Bluff、Stud Poker、Kemps等此前未在强化学习中研究过的博弈；并在单GPU与多GPU设置下对吞吐性能和内存使用进行基准测试，同时对强化学习、树搜索和博弈求解算法进行基准评估。
AI.result: 在单GPU与多GPU设置下实现了高达每秒数亿样本的吞吐扩展能力，验证了其相对相关GPU与CPU库的性能优势，并提供了强化学习、树搜索和博弈求解算法的基线结果。
AI.conclusion: BluffJAX通过多样化博弈机制与高吞吐并行模拟，为博弈论强化学习方法提供了新的挑战与研究平台，并借助基线结果促进未来比较与相关研究发展。

title: The Failure Is in the Readout: Fine-Grained Emotion Recognition Benchmarks Measure Elicitation, Not Perception
summary: Fine-grained emotion recognition supports therapy tools and social robots, but it needs facial data, which raises privacy and data-protection concerns. EmoNet-Face-HQ answers that with generated portraits, expert-rated over a $40$-category taxonomy far finer than the usual six to eight basic emotions. Under the protocol it ships with, vision-language models (VLMs) score poorly on that taxonomy, and the benchmark concludes that a dedicated fine-tuned model is necessary: Empathic-Insight-Face (EIF; Small/Large). We show that off-the-shelf VLMs match or beat that fine-tuned model when the answer is not generated but read from the logits, as one binary query per category. We keep the benchmark's images, taxonomy and ratings, and change only how the answer is read. Experts agree at $κ_w = 0.468$ on the five categories they measure most reliably. Generatively, no interval among eleven open-weight VLMs lies entirely above that anchor ($κ_w=0.268$-$0.486$). Under verification all eleven clear it, each of them significantly better at $κ_w=0.507$-$0.586$. Three also significantly beat EIF sitting at $κ_w = 0.551$ (Small; $0.534$ Large). The gain comes from the graded probability and not from asking a yes/no question: as a control, thresholding those same probabilities to yes/no costs 142% of the average gains and drops binarization below generative elicitation to $κ_w=0.254$-$0.423$. A replication on real photographs (FACES) is weaker and mixed: of the ten models that pass a validity gate, six gain, three are neutral to positive and one is negative, so the effect is not confined to synthetic data.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，在细粒度情绪识别基准 EmoNet-Face-HQ 上，只要把答案从"生成式回答"改为"读取 logits 做逐类别二值验证"，现成视觉语言模型（VLM）即可匹敌甚至超越专门微调的 EIF 模型，效果主要来自分段概率而非是否问 yes/no。
AI.motivation: 细粒度情绪识别对治疗工具和社交机器人有价值，但依赖面部数据会引发隐私与数据保护问题。EmoNet-Face-HQ 用生成肖像和专家标注的 40 类分类体系来规避这一问题，但其原协议下 VLM 表现很差，并据此得出结论：必须使用专门微调的模型（EIF Small/Large）。作者质疑这一结论的成因，认为问题可能出在"答案读取方式"而非模型能力本身。
AI.method: 保留基准的图像、分类体系和专家评分不变，只改变答案读取方式：不再生成答案，而是把每个类别当作一次二值查询，从 logits 中读取结果。评估 11 个开源权重 VLM，并与 EIF（Small/Large）对比。设置对照实验：对同样的概率做阈值化转成 yes/no，以检验增益是否来自分段概率而非问题形式。此外在真实照片数据集 FACES 上做复现。
AI.result: 专家的可参考一致性为 κ_w=0.468。生成式下，11 个 VLM 的一致性区间（κ_w=0.268–0.486）没有完全高于该参考值。在验证式读取下，11 个模型全部显著超过参考值，κ_w=0.507–0.586；其中 3 个还显著超过 EIF（Small 为 0.551，Large 为 0.534）。对照实验显示，对同样概率做阈值化会损失平均增益的 142%，并把二值化一致性降到 κ_w=0.254–0.423，低于生成式诱导。FACES 上的复现结果较弱且混合：通过有效性门槛的 10 个模型中，6 个提升、3 个中性偏正、1 个为负。
AI.conclusion: 现成 VLM 在细粒度情绪识别上并不必然弱于专门微调模型，之前的负面结论主要源于生成式答案读取方式。改用 logits 验证式读取可显著提升一致性，增益来源是分段概率信息而非 yes/no 提问形式。该效应在真实照片上存在但较弱且不一致，说明并非仅限合成数据，但需谨慎推广。

title: Active Feature Acquisition for Cost-Efficient Temporal Prediction with Reduced Participant Burden
summary: Accurate forecasting of pathological outcomes is a central problem in psychology. To do so, psychologists often collect intensive longitudinal data. However, in such studies, the desire to acquire a large number of variables for the sake of accurate prediction is often counteracted by the need to minimize participant burden. Acquiring more variables per occasion can yield better predictions, but having too many acquisitions increase the risk of non-response and attrition. Longitudinal Active Feature Acquisition (LAFA) is a principled approach to resolve this conundrum. Instead of requiring responses to every item at every acquisition occasion, LAFA produces a policy that seeks to optimally select dynamic subsets of items to be acquired at each timepoint while preserving our ability to forecast a specific outcome. However, existing LAFA methods are mostly based on Neural Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. In this work, we introduce a tree distillation method for learning an interpretable policy from NN-based LAFA networks. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy. Networks (NN) that are difficult to interpret in practice. In this work, we introduce a tree distillation method for learning an interpretable policy from NN-based LAFA networks. We validated our method through both a simulation and an empirical EMA dataset on forecasting daily alcohol consumption. In both cases, we find that we can meaningfully reduce the number of items acquired at each occasion with minimal loss in accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种树蒸馏方法，从基于神经网络的纵向主动特征获取（LAFA）网络中学习可解释策略，在模拟和真实EMA数据上实现了以极小精度损失大幅减少每次采集条目数量。
AI.motivation: 心理学中准确预测病理结果需要密集纵向数据，但采集变量越多，参与者负担越重，导致无响应和流失风险上升。纵向主动特征获取（LAFA）可动态选择每次采集的条目子集以缓解这一矛盾，但现有LAFA方法多基于神经网络，实际中难以解释。
AI.method: 提出一种树蒸馏方法，从基于神经网络的LAFA网络中学习可解释的策略，用于在保持预测特定结果能力的同时，动态选择每个时间点应采集的条目子集。
AI.result: 通过一个模拟实验和一个预测每日酒精消费的经验性EMA数据集进行验证，两种情况下均能在精度损失极小的情况下显著减少每次采集的条目数量。
AI.conclusion: 树蒸馏方法可为NN-based LAFA网络提供可解释策略，在降低参与者负担与保持预测精度之间取得良好平衡。

title: On the Boundary of Admission Gates: An Injected-Truth Study of Falsification-First Selection in Quantitative Strategy Research
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Code and data to reproduce every result: https://github.com/simplify23/quant-trading-agent
summary: Strategy research conflates two problems: finding a profitable rule, and establishing that the finding is not search luck. The latter calls for admission gates -- statistical criteria that must be satisfied before a conclusion is adopted -- yet whether gates work, and at what cost, remains untested. We introduce an injected-truth protocol with a random-admission control that adopts at the same rate as the gate; only if the gate beats this control does it carry information rather than merely raise a threshold. Across synthetic and real-calibrated panels, gates eliminate false discoveries in the weak-signal regime but cut adoption to 1--7%, and add nothing when signals are strong. Most importantly, criteria computed on absolute rather than excess returns silently reject every candidate, including true signals. Keywords: multiple testing, backtest overfitting, strategy admission, injected-truth validation, excess returns, false discovery rate

AI.tldr: 本文提出"注入真值"验证协议与随机准入对照，检验策略研究中的统计准入闸门是否真正携带信息。结果显示：弱信号下闸门能消除虚假发现但准入率骤降至1–7%，强信号下无增益；基于绝对收益（而非超额收益）计算的准则会静默拒绝所有候选，包括真实信号。
AI.motivation: 策略研究混淆了两个问题：找到可盈利规则，与证明该发现并非搜索运气。后者需要"准入闸门"（统计准则）在结论被采纳前予以把关，但这些闸门是否有效、代价几何，此前未经检验。作者还指出，仅以"提高阈值"来评价闸门是不够的，必须区分闸门是否真正携带信息。
AI.method: 提出注入真值协议（injected-truth protocol），并设置随机准入对照（random-admission control）：该对照以与闸门相同的比率采纳候选，只有当闸门优于该对照时，才说明闸门携带信息而非仅仅抬高了门槛。在合成面板与真实校准面板上进行检验。
AI.result: 在弱信号情形下，闸门能消除虚假发现，但将采纳率压缩至1–7%；在强信号情形下，闸门不带来任何额外价值。最关键的是，若统计准则基于绝对收益而非超额收益计算，会静默地拒绝所有候选，连真实信号也无法幸免。
AI.conclusion: 统计准入闸门并非免费的信息过滤器：其收益集中于弱信号区且以极低采纳率为代价，在强信号区失效，并可能因收益度量口径（绝对 vs. 超额）而系统性错误拒绝真信号。因此评估闸门需以随机准入为基准，并审慎对待其度量口径与成本。

title: View Matters: Keyframe-Guided Text-Driven 3D Gaussian Editing
summary: Text-driven 3D Gaussian editing commonly does not distinguish the editing reliability of rendered views, although different viewpoints provide supervision of substantially different quality. Views that clearly show the scene and match the edit instruction provide reliable guidance, while less informative views may weaken the edit when all views are treated equally. We present View Matters, a view-importance-aware framework that conducts editing around reliable keyframes. Keyframe Importance Estimation (KIE) identifies reliable views using geometric visibility, semantic distinctiveness, and edit relevance. Keyframe-Guided Editing (KGE) then propagates their editing signals asymmetrically to non-keyframes without noisy reverse influence, while Importance-Aware Optimization (IAO) preserves this reliability preference during 3DGS optimization. Across 23 scene-prompt pairs, View Matters achieves the highest average CLIP text-image similarity of 0.2822 and directional similarity of 0.2564 among the evaluated methods, with a four-minute editing time. Additional adjacent-view analysis indicates that the fidelity-oriented editing process maintains cross-view coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 View Matters，一种视图重要性感知的文本驱动 3D 高斯编辑框架，通过识别可靠关键帧并引导编辑，在 23 组场景-提示对上取得了最高的平均 CLIP 文本-图像相似度（0.2822）和方向相似度（0.2564），编辑时间约四分钟。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动的 3D 高斯编辑通常不区分渲染视图的编辑可靠性，而不同视角提供的监督质量差异显著：清晰展示场景且与编辑指令匹配的视图能提供可靠引导，信息量不足的视图若被同等对待则会削弱编辑效果。
AI.method: 提出视图重要性感知框架 View Matters，围绕可靠关键帧进行编辑。包含三个组件：关键帧重要性估计（KIE）利用几何可见性、语义显著性和编辑相关性识别可靠视图；关键帧引导编辑（KGE）将关键帧的编辑信号非对称地传播至非关键帧，避免噪声反向影响；重要性感知优化（IAO）在 3DGS 优化中保持这种可靠性偏好。
AI.result: 在 23 组场景-提示对上，View Matters 在所有评估方法中取得最高的平均 CLIP 文本-图像相似度 0.2822 和方向相似度 0.2564，编辑时间约四分钟；相邻视图分析表明，面向保真度的编辑过程保持了跨视图一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过对视图重要性建模并围绕可靠关键帧进行非对称引导与优化，View Matters 在保持跨视图一致性的同时显著提升了文本驱动 3D 高斯编辑的质量与效率。

title: AlignQuant: Tile-Aligned Mixed-Precision Quantization for Efficient LLM Generation
summary: Fine-grained mixed-precision quantization promises efficient large language model inference, but local precision choices can conflict with regular GPU storage and computation units. This precision-boundary mismatch limits the translation of compression into practical acceleration. We introduce AlignQuant, a post-training quantization method that uses GPU-compatible two-dimensional weight tiles as the common unit of precision allocation, compact storage, and execution. This shared partition lets precision follow sensitivity within output channels. Joint prefill/decode calibration scores precision reductions using projection-output perturbations weighted by language-model loss gradients under quantized activations. Phase-normalized scores prioritize higher precision for tiles important to either phase under a model-wide weight-storage budget. Each tile stores one selected representation, while phase-specialized kernels reuse the packed model and expand lower-bit weights for INT8 computation with 8-bit activations. Across four LLMs spanning 3B to 14B parameters, AlignQuant achieves up to $2.50\times$ generation speedup over BF16 while preserving model quality. Evaluations further cover three GPUs and contexts up to 64K tokens. These results show that local precision flexibility and regular GPU execution can coexist through a shared tile unit. The implementation is available at https://github.com/HanzhiZhang-Ulrica/AlignQuant.

AI.tldr: AlignQuant提出一种以GPU兼容的二维权重tile为统一单位的训练后量化方法，实现细粒度混合精度与规则GPU执行的对齐，达到最高2.50倍生成加速且保持模型质量。
AI.motivation: 细粒度混合精度量化虽有利于LLM推理，但局部精度选择会与GPU规则的存储和计算单元产生冲突，这种"精度边界不匹配"导致压缩难以转化为实际加速。
AI.method: 以GPU兼容的二维权重tile作为精度分配、紧凑存储和执行的共同单位；共享划分使精度能在输出通道内跟随敏感性。采用联合prefill/decode校准，用量化激活下由语言模型损失梯度加权的投影输出扰动来评估精度削减，并通过相位归一化评分在模型级权重存储预算下优先为任一阶段重要的tile分配高精度。每个tile存储单一选定表示，相位专用kernel复用打包模型，将低位权重扩展为INT8计算并配8-bit激活。
AI.result: 在4个3B至14B参数的LLM上，AlignQuant相比BF16实现最高2.50倍生成加速且保持模型质量；评测覆盖3种GPU及最长64K token的上下文。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过共享tile单位，局部精度灵活性与规则GPU执行可以共存。代码已开源。

title: AgentMemGate: Addressing Speculation Contamination in Conversational Assistant Memory
comment: Accepted at the PALM Workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: Conversational AI assistants with long-term memory extract facts from user messages into a store consulted in later conversations. A stated plan can enter that store as fact: a user who might move to Seattle may be recorded as already living there. We call this speculation contamination. Final-state memory benchmarks miss this error because they do not probe intermediate state and include few unresolved speculations. We present AgentMemGate, a write-time gate for profile-store memory that classifies extracted statements as speculation, completed event, correction, or other. Speculations remain outside memory, with conditions governing later promotion or deletion. We also contribute a dataset of multi-session conversations in which plans are confirmed, abandoned, or left unresolved. On our 147-conversation held-out set, Mem0 and Graphiti assert unresolved plans as current state for 35.2% and 27.3% of pending plans. On the core benchmark, AgentMemGate eliminates all observed contamination relative to the identical ungated pipeline (87.5% to zero for the most exposed extraction style) and raises task accuracy from 65% to 95%. On the harder held-out set, gated contamination is 3.4% to 5.7% and task accuracy rises by 9 to 13 percentage points. Our analysis identifies field matching as the main remaining bottleneck: realistic speculations often match no profile field and never reach the gate. We release our datasets, prompts, and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"推测污染"问题：长期记忆型对话助手会把用户未定计划当作事实写入记忆。作者构建数据集并提出写入时门控 AgentMemGate，区分推测、已完成事件、更正等类型，推测暂不入库。实验显示门控可消除核心基准上的污染并大幅提升任务准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆型对话助手会从用户消息中抽取事实并存入记忆库。当用户只说"可能会搬到西雅图"时，系统可能将其记录为"已住在西雅图"，形成推测污染。现有终态记忆评测无法发现此类错误，因为它们不探测中间状态，也很少包含未解决的推测场景。
AI.method: 提出 AgentMemGate，一种用于画像存储记忆的写入时门控机制，将抽取出的陈述分类为推测、已完成事件、更正或其他。推测被保留在记忆之外，并通过条件控制其后续的晋升或删除。同时贡献了一个多会话对话数据集，覆盖计划被确认、放弃或悬而未决的情形。
AI.result: 在147段对话的留出集上，Mem0 与 Graphiti 分别将35.2%和27.3%的待定计划断言为当前状态。在核心基准上，AgentMemGate 相对相同但无门控的流程将污染从87.5%降至零（最易暴露的抽取方式），任务准确率从65%提升至95%。在更难的留出集上，门控后污染率为3.4%至5.7%，任务准确率提升9至13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 写入时门控能有效抑制推测污染并提升任务表现。分析表明字段匹配是主要剩余瓶颈：现实中的推测常无法匹配任何画像字段，从而根本到不了门控。作者公开数据集、提示词与评测代码。

title: PIE-PS: Photometric Stereo from Physical Irradiance Event Streams
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers
summary: Event cameras record asynchronous log-image-irradiance changes with microsecond latency and high dynamic range. These properties are useful for photometric stereo under moving illumination, but raw events are sparse and depend on an unknown contrast threshold. We start from the event trigger model and derive a physical relation between adjacent events, light motion, and surface normals. This relation gives a direct physics-only solver, but the solver needs the threshold, enough events at each pixel, and independent per-pixel optimization. To address these limits, we introduce PIE-PS, a learning-based framework for dense surface normal reconstruction from raw event streams and known lighting. We form Physical Irradiance Events (PIEs) by pairing two adjacent events at the same pixel with their corresponding light directions. Each PIE provides a Physical Irradiance Event Feature (PIEF), defined as the signed event rate. PIEF does not require the unknown contrast threshold. To share spatial and temporal context across nearby PIEs, we introduce PIE-GNN, which treats each PIE as a graph node and encodes it with its light-pair geometry. Since the reliability of PIE observations can vary with local appearance, illumination geometry, and sensor noise, Reliability-Grading Attention (RGA) predicts reliability weights to down-weight unreliable PIEs. Pixel aggregation then produces dense normals. Experiments on synthetic and real data show that PIE-PS outperforms prior event-based photometric stereo methods and the direct solver baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIE-PS框架，从原始事件流与已知光照中重建稠密表面法向，通过将相邻事件配对为物理辐照事件（PIE）并与图神经网络结合，规避了未知对比度阈值问题，性能优于现有事件光度立体方法。
AI.motivation: 事件相机具备微秒级延迟、高动态范围等特性，适合运动光照下的光度立体，但原始事件稀疏且依赖未知的对比度阈值，使得直接基于事件的求解困难。论文旨在解决阈值未知、每像素事件不足及逐像素独立优化的局限，实现稠密表面法向重建。
AI.method: 从事件触发模型出发推导相邻事件、光照运动与表面法向间的物理关系，得到纯物理求解器作为基线；在此基础上提出学习的PIE-PS框架：将同一像素相邻两事件与其对应光照方向配对构成PIE，定义符号事件率作为PIEF特征（无需未知阈值）；用PIE-GNN将每个PIE视为图节点，结合光照对几何编码；再用可靠性评分注意力（RGA）预测可靠性权重以降低不可靠PIE的影响，最后经像素聚合得到稠密法向。
AI.result: 在合成数据与真实数据上的实验表明，PIE-PS优于先前基于事件的光度立体方法以及直接物理求解器基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过将事件配对为PIE并引入图神经网络与可靠性评分注意力，可在无需对比度阈值的情况下实现稠密表面法向重建，验证了物理建模与学习结合在事件光度立体中的有效性。

title: Interpretable Hypergraph Learning via Neural Additive Models
summary: Hypergraphs offer a natural framework for modeling networked data, where dependencies among entities are governed by higher-order interactions. While hypergraph learning methods such as hypergraph neural networks have demonstrated remarkable predictive performance, most existing approaches rely on black-box message-passing architectures, making it difficult to disentangle the contributions of node attributes and higher-order structural information. To address this challenge, we introduce the hypergraph neural additive network (HGNAN), an inherently interpretable framework for learning on hypergraph-structured data. HGNAN extends classical neural additive models to higher-order relational data by integrating feature-wise nonlinear decomposition with hypergraph-aware structural aggregation, enabling transparent prediction for both node- and hyperedge-level tasks. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that HGNAN achieves performance comparable with state-of-the-art hypergraph learning methods while providing intrinsic and meaningful interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出超图神经加性网络（HGNAN），一种内在可解释的超图学习框架，通过特征级非线性分解与超图结构聚合相结合，在节点级和超边级任务上实现与SOTA相当的性能并具备可解释性。
AI.motivation: 超图能自然建模高阶交互关系，但现有超图神经网络大多依赖黑盒消息传递架构，难以区分节点属性与高阶结构信息的贡献，缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 将经典神经加性模型（NAM）扩展到高阶关系数据，融合特征级非线性分解与超图感知的结构聚合，构建内在可解释的HGNAN，支持节点级和超边级预测任务。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HGNAN的性能与当前最先进的超图学习方法相当，同时提供内在且有意义的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: HGNAN在保持竞争力预测性能的同时实现了可解释性，为高阶关系数据上的透明学习提供了可行方案。

title: Evidence Before Sampling: Interpretable Implicit Negative Candidate Discovery for Recommendation
summary: Recommender systems learn from observed user-item interactions, but explicit negative feedback is often unavailable. Since deep learning models require negative signals for training, negative sampling methods typically treat selected unobserved interactions as negatives. However, a missing interaction does not explain why a user is uninterested in an item or whether there is sufficient evidence to label it negative. This is especially important in business recommendation, where negative signals should be interpretable and aligned with business objectives. We formulate implicit negative candidate discovery to identify unobserved interactions supported by observed customer behavior. We encode these patterns as symbolic rules, score them based on support, informativeness, and product relevance, and rank the retained rules by evidence. An LLM then interprets the retained rules using business objectives and domain knowledge; the interpretations are combined with the statistical evidence in the final report. We evaluate our method in an industrial B2B setting and across five public recommendation datasets. Candidate-quality evaluations in the industrial setting and three public datasets show higher precision than the evaluated baselines, while symbolic selection improves downstream test PR-AUC by 12.5% over random selection with four negatives per positive example in the industrial task. Our results show that negative candidate validity can be evaluated separately from downstream recommendation performance. This distinction enables evidence-based, business-aligned, and explainable negative selection, improving both interpretability and model training in sparse, skewed, real-world recommendation settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"隐式负样本候选发现"任务,用符号规则+统计评分+LLM解释来筛选有行为证据支撑的负样本,在工业B2B场景与五个公开数据集上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统训练需要负信号,但显式负反馈往往缺失;现有负采样方法默认把未观测交互当作负样本,却无法解释用户为何不感兴趣、也缺乏证据支撑该标记。在商业推荐场景中,负信号还需可解释并与业务目标一致,因此需要一种有证据依据的负候选发现方法。
AI.method: 提出隐式负候选发现:找出有用户行为模式支撑的未观测交互;将其编码为符号规则,按支持度、信息量和产品相关性打分,并按证据强度对保留规则排序;再由LLM结合业务目标和领域知识解释这些规则,解释结果与统计证据一起汇总到最终报告中。
AI.result: 在工业B2B场景及五个公开推荐数据集上评估;工业场景与三个公开数据集上的候选质量评估精度高于基线;在工业任务中,每正样本四个负样本设置下,符号化选择相比随机选择使下游测试PR-AUC提升12.5%。
AI.conclusion: 负候选的有效性可以与下游推荐性能分开评估,这一区分使负样本选择具备证据依据、业务对齐且可解释,在稀疏、偏斜的真实推荐场景中同时提升了可解释性与模型训练效果。

title: MacJEPA: Missingness-Robust Audio-Visual Recognition from Untrimmed Egocentric Videos
summary: Audio-visual models improve egocentric action recognition by exploiting complementary cues, yet typically assume that both streams remain available at inference. Existing missing-modality methods operate on trimmed, single-event clips in which a stream is entirely present or absent, whereas real sensors fail and recover within long, untrimmed observations. We redefine egocentric modality missingness as temporally localized sensor outages within untrimmed, multi-event observations, with whole-clip absence as the limiting case. We introduce \textbf{MacJEPA}, a missing-modality-robust \textbf{Ma}sked-\textbf{c}ontext query \textbf{JEPA} that recognizes visual actions and acoustic events from supplied interval queries over audio-visual context. Window-local modality dropout simulates these sensor outages during training. MacJEPA further repurposes masking in JEPA from a self-supervised pretext into a supervised robustness objective, aligning masked and clean latent representations of both multimodal content tokens and the task-conditioned queries. All objectives are optimized jointly with recognition in a single stage, requiring no test-time adaptation. Across Epic-Kitchens-100 and Epic-Sounds, a single checkpoint remains competitive under complete input and consistently surpasses published missing-modality baselines when either the dominant or auxiliary stream is removed. MacJEPA thus unifies strong full-input recognition with temporal missing-modality robustness in a single model operating on untrimmed multi-event videos.

AI.tldr: MacJEPA将自我中心模态缺失重新定义为长视频中的局部传感器中断，通过窗口级模态dropout和掩码-上下文查询JEPA，在单阶段训练下实现全输入识别与时序缺失模态鲁棒性的统一。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频模型虽利用互补线索提升自我中心动作识别，但通常假设推理时两路模态均可用；已有缺失模态方法仅针对裁剪后的单事件片段（模态整体存在或缺失），而真实传感器会在长时未裁剪观测中局部失效并恢复，因此需要新的问题设定与鲁棒方法。
AI.method: 提出MacJEPA（缺失模态鲁棒的掩码-上下文查询JEPA），基于音视频上下文中的区间查询识别视觉动作与声学事件。训练时采用窗口局部的模态dropout模拟传感器中断，并将JEPA中的掩码从自监督预训练任务改造为监督式鲁棒性目标，对齐多模态内容token与任务条件查询的掩码与干净潜表示；所有目标与识别任务在单阶段联合优化，无需测试时自适应。
AI.result: 在Epic-Kitchens-100和Epic-Sounds上，单一checkpoint在完整输入下保持竞争力，且在移除主导或辅助任一流时持续超越已发表的缺失模态基线。
AI.conclusion: MacJEPA在未裁剪多事件视频上，以单一模型统一了强全输入识别与时序缺失模态鲁棒性。

title: Efficient Multimodal Inference through Adaptive Acquisition and Sequential Fusion
summary: Multimodal systems often encode every available input, even when a subset suffices for prediction. Adaptive acquisition can reduce this cost by using predictions from incrementally fused evidence to decide which modality to encode next and when to stop. However, sequential fusion makes these predictions order-dependent, so decisions based on them may need to distinguish factorially many histories of the same acquired set. We introduce SemARC, which couples a Sequential Modality Aggregator (SeMA) with an Adaptive Runtime Controller (ARC) and uses acquired evidence to select each modality before its encoder runs. SeMA executes only selected encoder and fusion branches, updates a fixed-size state, and predicts after each acquisition without recomputing earlier branches. We supervise every acquisition prefix under randomized modality subsets and orders to encourage consistent predictions across acquisition orders. ARC combines a set-dependent marginal-utility prior with residual fitted-Q learning to select the next available modality or stop, without inspecting unacquired inputs or retaining acquisition order. Across six multimodal classification datasets and eleven baselines, SemARC achieves 3.2% higher macro-F1 and 61.4% lower total inference GFLOPs on average relative to each dataset's most accurate baseline. End-to-end latency falls by 44.0% across GPU and CPU and by 47.2% on Android INT8 relative to the fastest measured baseline, on average. Under varying runtime modality missingness, SemARC still skips available modalities, matching or exceeding the best baseline macro-F1 in 21 of 24 conditions with 14.8% lower total GFLOPs on average. SemARC thus offers a practical path toward efficient multimodal inference across heterogeneous devices.

AI.tldr: SemARC 通过顺序模态聚合器与自适应运行时控制器，实现按需选择并编码模态，在提升精度的同时大幅降低计算与延迟。
AI.motivation: 多模态系统常编码所有可用输入，即使部分模态已足够预测，造成不必要的计算开销。自适应获取可降低成本，但顺序融合导致预测依赖顺序，决策需区分同一已获取集合的阶乘级多种历史。
AI.method: 提出 SemARC，由顺序模态聚合器（SeMA）和自适应运行时控制器（ARC）组成。SeMA 仅执行被选中的编码器与融合分支，维护固定大小状态，每次获取后即可预测且不重算先前分支；在随机模态子集与顺序下监督每个获取前缀，保证跨顺序预测一致。ARC 结合集合相关的边际效用先验与残差 fitted-Q 学习，在不查看未获取输入、不保留获取顺序的前提下选择下一模态或停止。
AI.result: 在六个多模态分类数据集与十一个基线对比中，相对各数据集最准基线平均宏 F1 提高 3.2%，总推理 GFLOPs 降低 61.4%；端到端延迟在 GPU 与 CPU 上平均降低 44.0%，Android INT8 上降低 47.2%。在运行时模态缺失变化下，SemARC 仍能跳过可用模态，24 种条件中 21 种达到或超过最佳基线宏 F1，且平均总 GFLOPs 低 14.8%。
AI.conclusion: SemARC 为跨异构设备的高效多模态推理提供了实用路径。

title: PERSIST: Who-What-When Memory Across Sessions for Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue
summary: Modern voice assistants may be shared by multiple users and should be able to answer questions about earlier conversations such as "When did I originally plan to leave?" or adapt their behavior to individual users based on past interactions. This requires more than retrieving a topically similar passage: the assistant must identify the current speaker, recover the relevant past state, and distinguish it from later revisions. We present PERSIST, a persistent memory system for multi-session, multi-speaker spoken dialogue that explicitly models Who, What, and When. PERSIST structures cross-session histories into readable event records and retrieves them with a 3W joint scoring mechanism that combines semantic content, acoustic speaker identity, and temporal state. For real-time full-duplex interaction, PERSIST further reuses intermediate representations from the dialogue backbone, avoiding query-audio re-encoding and reducing retrieval latency from 578.42 ms to 7.03 ms. We also introduce SpokenTrace, a diagnostic benchmark that factorizes evaluation along memory tasks and speaker-query types, exposing failures in recall, speaker attribution, and temporal-state tracking. On SpokenTrace, PERSIST achieves 85.08% end-to-end task accuracy and improves all-support EM@3 from 49.01% with BGE-large to 82.10%.

AI.tldr: PERSIST：面向多会话多说话人语音对话的持久记忆系统，显式建模"谁、什么、何时"，并配合诊断基准SpokenTrace。
AI.motivation: 现代语音助手常被多用户共享，需回答关于过往对话的问题（如"我原计划何时出发"），并依据历史交互为不同用户适配行为。这不仅是检索话题相似的段落，还需识别当前说话人、恢复相关历史状态，并区分其与后续修订。现有方法难以满足这类多会话、多说话人场景的需求。
AI.method: PERSIST将跨会话历史组织为可读的事件记录，并采用3W联合打分机制进行检索，融合语义内容、声学说话人身份与时间状态。为支持实时全双工交互，系统复用对话主干网络的中间表示，避免对查询音频重复编码，将检索延迟从578.42 ms降至7.03 ms。同时提出诊断基准SpokenTrace，按记忆任务与说话人查询类型分解评估。
AI.result: 在SpokenTrace上，PERSIST端到端任务准确率达85.08%；all-support EM@3由BGE-large的49.01%提升至82.10%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模"谁、什么、何时"的持久记忆机制能有效提升多会话多说话人语音对话中的记忆检索与状态追踪能力，同时通过表示复用实现低延迟实时交互，SpokenTrace则揭示并量化了召回、说话人归属与时间状态追踪方面的失败模式。

title: RACE-FPP: A Robust AI-assisted Characterisation Enhancement for Fringe Projection Profilometry
summary: Fringe Projection Profilometry (FPP) requires precise system characterisation to achieve reliable three-dimensional (3D) reconstructions; however, characterisation accuracy strongly depends on robust checkerboard feature localisation, which can deteriorate under challenging imaging conditions such as lens blur and characterisation target orientations. Existing deep learning-based corner detectors are typically assessed using detection metrics and camera reprojection error alone, without considering their wider impact on projector characterisation, camera-projector stereo characterisation consistency, or overall measurement accuracy. In this work, we introduce a complete FPP characterisation pipeline that incorporates deep learning-based corner detection into the standard camera characterisation workflow. We also characterise the projector by sampling phase values at the centres of the white squares in the characterisation target. Rather than treating corner detection as an isolated task, the proposed framework explicitly analyses how localisation errors propagate throughout the entire FPP characterisation chain. Performance is evaluated using detection metrics (e.g., precision and recall), camera and projector reprojection errors, and the camera and projector stereo characterisation. Across a mixed dataset of clean and degraded images, the camera reprojection error is reduced from 1.237 pixels to 0.259 pixels, while the projector reprojection error is reduced by roughly 50%. Dimensional evaluation of reconstructed artefacts shows improved geometric accuracy compared with those resulting from the conventional pipeline. Overall, the findings indicate increased robustness of system-level characterisation under challenging imaging conditions, thereby enabling more reliable industrial FPP measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文将深度学习角点检测集成到完整的条纹投影轮廓术（FPP）系统标定流程中，系统分析角点定位误差在标定链中的传播，在混合数据集上将相机重投影误差从1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差降低约50%，并提升三维重建几何精度。
AI.motivation: FPP实现可靠三维重建依赖精确的系统标定，而标定精度高度依赖稳健的棋盘格特征定位；在镜头模糊、标定靶姿态变化等困难成像条件下定位精度会下降。现有深度学习角点检测器通常只用检测指标和相机重投影误差评估，未考虑其对投影仪标定、相机-投影仪立体标定一致性及整体测量精度的更广泛影响。
AI.method: 提出一套完整的FPP标定流程，将深度学习角点检测嵌入标准相机标定工作流；投影仪标定通过采样标定靶白色方格中心的相位值实现；框架不把角点检测视为孤立任务，而是显式分析定位误差如何在整个FPP标定链中传播。评估采用检测指标（精确率、召回率）、相机与投影仪重投影误差以及相机-投影仪立体标定结果，使用干净与退化图像混合的数据集。
AI.result: 在干净与退化图像混合数据集上，相机重投影误差由1.237像素降至0.259像素，投影仪重投影误差降低约50%；对重建工件的尺寸评估显示，相比传统流程几何精度提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在困难成像条件下系统级标定的鲁棒性得到增强，从而可实现更可靠的工业FPP测量。

title: Structure, Not Belief: Correlated Thompson Sampling from LLM-Derived Covariance in Combinatorial Semi-Bandits
comment: 15 pages. Accepted (poster) at DynaFront 2026: Dynamics at the Frontiers of Optimization, Sampling, and Games, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop
summary: Combinatorial Thompson sampling (CTS) draws independent posterior samples for every arm, so its exploration dynamics ignore any relation among arms. We study a minimal change to those dynamics: an LLM is queried once for a partition of the arms, the partition becomes a positive-definite correlation matrix $Σ$ through an RBF kernel on cluster ranks, and the per-round posterior sample is drawn with covariance $Σ$ while the Beta posteriors are updated from real rewards only, so the LLM shapes how the sampler moves, not what it believes. We give a self-contained Bayesian regret bound for the idealized Gaussian sampler whose information gain splits into a $K\log T$ term from the $K$-cluster structure and a ridge term that grows to $d\log T$: the $\sqrt{d/K}$ improvement over independent sampling is a finite-horizon transient, exact only as the within-cluster correlation tends to one. The correlated sampler reduces regret by 19% over CTS on 16 synthetic Bernoulli families at $T=2{,}500$ (6-7% at $T=25{,}000$ with data-adaptive kernels) and by 41% on the Microsoft MIND-small news benchmark ($d=200$ real articles), while pseudo-observation warm starts give nothing. An LLM-free ablation with a simulated oracle of controlled quality shows that on unstructured instances the gain is a property of the kernel shape (a random partition, or a plain tempering of the sampling noise, reproduces it), while belief injection at matched oracle quality never helps.

AI.tldr: 作者提出对组合汤普森采样（CTS）的最小改动：用一次LLM查询得到臂的分区，经RBF核转为正定相关矩阵Σ，按Σ采样后验样本，而Beta后验仅由真实奖励更新。理论上给出理想化高斯采样器的贝叶斯遗憾界，信息增益分为KlogT项与ridge项；实验显示相关采样器在合成与真实新闻基准上显著降低遗憾，且LLM-free消融表明增益来自核形状而非信念注入。
AI.motivation: CTS对每个臂独立采样后验，忽略了臂之间的任何关联，导致探索动态没有利用结构信息。作者希望在不大改算法、也不把LLM当作奖励信念来源的前提下，仅改变采样器的移动方式来引入臂间相关性以降低遗憾。
AI.method: 对CTS做最小改动：查询一次LLM得到臂的分区，通过基于簇排名的RBF核构造正定相关矩阵Σ；每轮后验样本以Σ为协方差抽取，而Beta后验仍只用真实奖励更新，使LLM只影响采样动态而非信念。同时给出理想化高斯采样器的自包含贝叶斯遗憾界，并进行合成Bernoulli族、Microsoft MIND-small新闻基准、伪观测热启动及LLM-free模拟oracle消融实验。
AI.result: 理论上信息增益分解为KlogT项与增长到dlogT的ridge项，相对独立采样的√(d/K)改进是有限时间瞬态，仅当簇内相关趋于1时精确。实验上，T=2500时在16个合成Bernoulli族上遗憾比CTS降低19%，T=25000时用数据自适应核降低6-7%；在MIND-small（d=200真实文章）上降低41%；伪观测热启动无增益。LLM-free消融显示，无结构实例上的增益来自核形状（随机分区或对采样噪声做简单退火即可复现），而在匹配oracle质量下注入信念从不带来帮助。
AI.conclusion: LLM引导的分区通过核形状改变采样动态可显著降低遗憾，但其收益并非来自LLM的信念注入，而是相关性核的形状效应；相对独立采样的理论改进只是有限时间瞬态，伪观测热启动无效。

title: How Well Do LLMs Reason with Noisy Evidence? An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark
summary: Real-world reasoning rarely reduces to static question answering: agents must actively gather information from tools and sensors that are often noisy and unreliable. Yet most existing active reasoning benchmarks assume that environmental feedback is trustworthy, or introduce noise without exposing an explicit, calibrated uncertainty signal, leaving open how LLMs should reason when the evidence itself is uncertain. We introduce VisualNoiseQA, a novel benchmark for active reasoning under noisy visual feedback. A text-only LLM must solve VQA problems by iteratively querying a fixed, off-the-shelf VLM treated as a stochastic visual sensor. For each query, we draw multiple samples and expose an empirical uncertainty signal via self-consistency, enabling the reasoner to probe from different angles and decide what to ask next and when to stop. Our construction is automatic and scalable: starting from diverse VQA sources and two noisy VLMs, we retain only questions where the sensor is inconsistent yet human-solvable. We evaluate multiple LLM reasoners on 1,000 instances spanning perception, chart understanding, and knowledge-intensive reasoning. VisualNoiseQA thus provides a controlled playground to study how different LLMs exploit uncertainty signals for robust reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VisualNoiseQA，一个在噪声视觉反馈下进行主动推理的新基准：纯文本LLM通过迭代查询固定的、现成VLM（视为随机视觉传感器）来解决VQA问题。
AI.motivation: 现实推理并非静态问答，智能体需从常含噪声、不可靠的工具和传感器中主动获取信息。然而多数现有主动推理基准假设环境反馈可信，或仅引入噪声却未提供明确且校准的不确定性信号，因此LLM在证据本身不确定时如何推理仍属空白。
AI.method: 构建过程自动且可扩展：从多样的VQA数据源和两个带噪VLM出发，仅保留那些传感器回答不一致但人类可解的题目。对每个查询，通过自一致性采样多次并给出经验不确定性信号，使推理器能从不同角度探查，并决定下一步问什么、何时停止。
AI.result: 在涵盖感知、图表理解和知识密集型推理的1,000个实例上，评估了多个LLM推理器。
AI.conclusion: VisualNoiseQA为研究不同LLM如何利用不确定性信号实现鲁棒推理提供了一个可控的实验平台。

title: TSRN-RTVD: Real-Time Video Deblurring System
summary:
As video capture moves to handheld and edge devices, motion blur from camera shake has become a pervasive degradation that lowers perceptual quality and harms downstream vision tasks. The strongest deblurring networks recover impressive detail, yet they remain computationally heavy and overwhelmingly complex, so their quality comes at a cost that consumer hardware cannot pay in real time. This gap between restoration quality and on-device speed is exactly what makes real-time deblurring difficult.
  We developed and implemented TSRN-RTVD, an efficient video deblurring system that explicitly reconstructs the underlying camera trajectory during exposure and uses the recovered motion to guide restoration. This approach turns the physical cause of blur into a signal that drives sharpening. Our system runs on a single consumer GPU and restores the video at 30 FPS while reaching 30.08 dB PSNR on the GoPro dataset. We demonstrate TSRN-RTVD on consumer devices with interactive side-by-side visualization of the blurry input and the deblurred output, live throughput, and an on-screen view of the recovered camera trajectory. Demo video is available at https://youtu.be/3alMwVrVALU.

AI.tldr: 提出TSRN-RTVD视频去模糊系统，通过重建曝光期间相机轨迹引导复原，在消费级GPU上以30 FPS实时运行，GoPro数据集PSNR达30.08 dB。
AI.motivation: 手持和边缘设备拍摄视频普遍存在相机抖动导致的运动模糊，降低感知质量并影响下游视觉任务。现有最强的去模糊网络虽能恢复丰富细节，但计算量巨大、结构复杂，消费级硬件难以实时运行，复原质量与设备端速度之间存在明显鸿沟。
AI.method: 开发并实现TSRN-RTVD高效视频去模糊系统，显式重建曝光期间的潜在相机轨迹，并利用恢复的运动信息引导复原，将模糊的物理成因转化为驱动锐化的信号。
AI.result: 系统在单块消费级GPU上以30 FPS复原视频，在GoPro数据集上达到30.08 dB PSNR；并在消费设备上展示交互式可视化，包括模糊输入与去模糊输出的并排对比、实时吞吐量以及恢复的相机轨迹屏幕视图。
AI.conclusion: 通过将相机运动信息显式引入去模糊流程，TSRN-RTVD在消费级硬件上实现了兼顾质量与速度的实时视频去模糊，并提供可交互的演示验证。

title: Adapting to Changes in Agent Behavior via Finite-Depth Policy Sensitivity
summary: Adapting a reinforcement learning policy to changes in another agent's behavior typically requires a large amount of new interaction data. Policy sensitivity provides a first-order prediction of how a locally optimal policy changes with a behavioral parameter, but its computation requires second-order derivatives whose effects propagate across future interactions. We develop a finite-depth framework to estimate this sensitivity by approximating the policy Hessian and mixed derivative using information from a reference environment. The method features an adjustable propagation depth which determines where derivative propagation along the trajectory is truncated. We characterize the derivative contributions omitted by finite-depth propagation and derive truncation-error bounds for the approximated derivatives and resulting policy sensitivity. The bounds are nonincreasing with propagation depth and vanish at full-horizon propagation. Using a belief-driven pursuit-evasion game as a validation scenario, the proposed method generally achieves lower derivative-estimation errors as the propagation depth increases and outperforms the baseline methods in both estimation accuracy and policy adaptation. The sensitivity-based initialization improves zero-shot return over direct transfer, and also shows advantages for the subsequent fine-tuning in the target environment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种有限深度框架，用参考环境信息近似策略Hessian与混合导数，从而估计策略敏感性，并给出截断误差界，在追逃博弈中验证了估计精度与适应性能的提升。
AI.motivation: 强化学习策略在适应其他智能体行为变化时通常需要大量新交互数据；策略敏感性可一阶预测局部最优策略随行为参数的变化，但其计算依赖二阶导数且影响会沿未来交互传播，直接计算代价高。
AI.method: 构建有限深度传播框架，通过近似策略Hessian和混合导数来估计策略敏感性，信息来自参考环境；引入可调传播深度，决定导数沿轨迹传播在何处截断，并刻画被有限深度传播忽略的导数贡献。
AI.result: 推导出近似导数及所得策略敏感性的截断误差界，误差界随传播深度非增并在全时域传播时消失；在信念驱动追逃博弈中，随深度增加估计误差总体降低，估计精度与策略适应均优于基线；基于敏感性的初始化在零样本回报上优于直接迁移，并在目标环境后续微调中展现优势。
AI.conclusion: 有限深度策略敏感性估计为跨行为适应提供了一种可调且具理论误差保证的方法，能在减少交互数据需求的同时提升零样本迁移与后续微调表现。

title: ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
summary: The rapid progress of LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) has shown that they largely outperform single agents on coding, math, and QA tasks, where executable tests provide a binary success signal. Whether this advantage transfers to real scientific data analysis remains untested. We introduce ST-Bench, a benchmark designed to answer two questions: whether MAS outperform single agents on complex scientific data analysis tasks, and if so, by how much and at what additional cost. ST-Bench contains 100 data science tasks adapted from published Earth science studies across hydrology, agriculture, and wetland methane research, expanded into 2,067 queries grounded in additional published studies and validated by domain experts. Using ST-Bench, we evaluate five recent MAS generation methods under two training protocols, against single-agent baselines on the same GPT-5 backbone. Nine of the ten MAS configurations exceed the cheapest single-agent baseline, with the strongest reaching nearly three times its composite score. This gain is primarily attributable to coverage: trained workflows produce realistic numerical metrics on a larger fraction of queries, while the quality of those metrics, conditional on producing realistic output, is comparable to that of the single-agent baseline. The strongest configuration requires approximately four times the single-agent inference time, whereas a more economical workflow captures the majority of the benefit at less than twice the cost. MAS specialization confers measurable benefit on scientific data analysis, but the benefit is conditional rather than universal.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ST-Bench，用于检验LLM多智能体系统（MAS）在真实科学数据分析中是否优于单智能体，并量化其增益与成本。
AI.motivation: MAS在编码、数学、问答等有可执行测试作为二值成功信号的领域已显著优于单智能体，但其优势能否迁移到真实科学数据分析尚属未知。
AI.method: 构建ST-Bench：包含100个改编自已发表地球科学（水文、农业、湿地甲烷）研究的数据科学任务，扩展为2,067条查询，并由领域专家验证。在相同GPT-5骨干下，用两种训练协议评估五种近期MAS生成方法与单智能体基线。
AI.result: 十种MAS配置中有九种超过最廉价的单智能体基线，最强配置综合得分接近其3倍；增益主要来自覆盖率（更多查询上产生合理数值指标），而条件于产出合理输出时指标质量与单智能体相当。最强配置约需4倍单智能体推理时间，更经济的方案以不到2倍成本获取大部分收益。
AI.conclusion: MAS专精化在科学数据分析上有可测收益，但该收益是条件性的而非普遍性的，需在性能与成本之间权衡。

title: Whose Face Is It Anyway? A Multi-Model Audit of Facial Affect Recognition on Children, and Why the Gap Is the Head, Not the Features
summary: Facial affect models are trained almost entirely on adults, yet are increasingly applied to children in education, health, and developmental research. We present a controlled, multi-model audit of five AffectNet-pretrained expression models (EmoNet, EmotiEffLib, DDAMFN++, OpenFace 3.0, LibreFace) on children, across four child image datasets, the AffectNet-8 validation set, and two spontaneous child video datasets, through one shared harness. Three findings emerge. First, the child gap is model-agnostic: every architecture degrades from posed to naturalistic faces and shares the fear$\rightarrow$surprise confusion. Second, it is concentrated and corroborated across all five models: open-mouth faces (read as surprise, correlating with the AU26 jaw drop) and South-Asian children degrade systematically, with a smaller averted-gaze penalty, while closed-mouth faces, White and Black children, and direct gaze do not; the bias tracks expression morphology and specific populations, not skin tone. Third, the gap is diagnosable: a linear probe on frozen features reaches 0.75-0.91 on unseen children versus 0.48-0.66 zero-shot, so it lies largely in the classifier head, not the representation, whereas dimensional valence/arousal regression degrades sharply under domain shift. Building on this, recalibrating only the head on a little target data recovers $+0.13$ to $+0.28$ on the two largest child sets across all five models at negligible adult cost, though the gain is in-distribution and does not transfer across child collections. We will release the harness, per-sample predictions, and analysis code; the child face data stays license-locked and is never redistributed.

AI.tldr: 对五个 AffectNet 预训练表情模型在儿童数据上的多模型审计发现：儿童性能差距与模型架构无关，集中于张口面孔和南亚儿童，且主要位于分类器头而非表征，仅重校准头部即可显著提升。
AI.motivation: 面部情感模型几乎完全用成人数据训练，却日益应用于儿童的教育、健康和发展研究，存在儿童适用性风险，因此需要系统审计其在儿童上的表现。
AI.method: 用统一测试框架，对五个 AffectNet 预训练表情模型（EmoNet、EmotiEffLib、DDAMFN++、OpenFace 3.0、LibreFace）在四个儿童图像数据集、AffectNet-8 验证集和两个儿童自发视频数据集上进行受控多模型审计；并采用线性探针诊断差距来源，再仅重校准分类器头。
AI.result: 三个发现：一，儿童差距与模型无关，所有架构从摆拍到自然面孔均退化，并共有恐惧→惊讶混淆；二，差距集中且被五个模型共同印证，张口面孔（被读作惊讶，与 AU26 下巴张开相关）和南亚儿童系统性退化，回避注视惩罚较小，而闭口面孔、白人及黑人儿童、直接注视无此问题，偏差随表情形态和特定人群而非肤色；三，差距可诊断，冻结特征线性探针在未见儿童上达 0.75-0.91，零样本仅 0.48-0.66，说明主要在分类器头而非表征，而维度效价/唤醒回归在域偏移下严重退化。仅用少量目标数据重校准头部，在两个最大儿童集上五个模型全部恢复 +0.13 至 +0.28，成人代价可忽略，但增益为分布内且不跨儿童集合迁移。
AI.conclusion: 儿童表情模型差距是可诊断、可部分修复的，主要源于分类器头；将发布测试框架、逐样本预测和分析代码，儿童人脸数据因许可限制不重新分发。

title: SpecBraM: What Should an EEG Foundation Model Predict? Masked Band-Power Prediction versus Waveform Reconstruction
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables; includes an appendix
summary: Self-supervised EEG models often reconstruct masked waveforms or predict discrete codes. We study a task-aligned alternative: masked band-power prediction (MBP), which predicts fixed narrow-band log spectral energy for masked channel-time patches. This target retains rhythm power relevant to sleep staging while avoiding phase-sensitive waveform reconstruction and a learned codebook. Across three pretraining seeds, we compare band-power and waveform targets with matched backbones, pretraining data (2,388 hours), and training steps, including a 2x2 tokenizer-by-target design. On ISRUC and HMC sleep staging, MBP exceeds raw- and band-waveform reconstruction by 1.6-2.8 balanced-accuracy points with all labels and 4.7-7.3 points with 1% of labels under a strict linear probe; the target effect exceeds the tokenizer effect. Its frozen features reach 0.7916/0.7425 balanced accuracy, versus 0.7636/0.7227 for a matched rich handcrafted spectral baseline, although the gap is about one point with 1% of labels. Full fine-tuning reaches 0.8107/0.7669. The gains do not extend to every task with spectral cues, including motor imagery, depression screening, and vigilance regression. These results support choosing pretraining targets to match the physical quantities and spatial and temporal scales relevant to downstream labels.

AI.tldr: 提出掩蔽频带功率预测（MBP）自监督任务，用于EEG睡眠分期，效果优于波形重建目标。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督EEG模型多重建掩蔽波形或预测离散码本，未针对下游任务相关的物理量设计目标，本文探索与任务对齐的替代方案。
AI.method: MBP预测被掩蔽通道-时间块的固定窄带对数谱能量，避免相位敏感的波形重建和学习码本；在三个预训练种子、匹配骨干、2388小时数据与训练步数下，比较频带功率与波形目标，并设计2x2 tokenizer-by-target实验。
AI.result: 在ISRUC和HMC睡眠分期上，MBP在全标签下比原始及频带波形重建高1.6-2.8平衡准确率点，1%标签下高4.7-7.3点；目标效应大于tokenizer效应。冻结特征达0.7916/0.7425，优于手工谱基线0.7636/0.7227，但1%标签时差距约1点；全微调达0.8107/0.7669。增益未扩展至运动想象、抑郁筛查和警觉度回归任务。
AI.conclusion: 预训练目标应匹配下游标签相关的物理量及空间时间尺度，MBP为任务对齐的EEG自监督提供有效方向。

title: OTel: Open Telco AI Datasets, Benchmarks, and Models
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, ED Track, Spotlight
summary: We present Open Telco (OTel), an open telecom AI resource that releases derived telecom datasets for retrieval, reranking, instruction tuning, and safety/abstention, together with 30 full-parameter post-trained baselines spanning 10 embedding models, 3 rerankers, and 17 language models. The community has already engaged substantially with the resource: as of May 3, 2026, the released models have been downloaded over 16 million times and the project has received 157+ pieces of media coverage worldwide. Building on prior open telecom datasets and benchmarks, OTel provides documented telecom data sources, held-out evaluation partitions, trained embedding models, rerankers, context-grounded LLMs, and safety/abstention data in one unified resource. Each baseline starts from an open-weight model and is post-trained on OTel-derived data using an open training recipe, then evaluated on held-out OTel evaluation partitions. OTel post-training improves performance across all three model families: embedding retrieval reaches 93.1% NDCG@10, reranking reaches 0.947 MRR@10, and language-model correctness reaches 87.8%. We release OTel as a reproducible starting point and invite the community to expand the data, improve embedding and reranking models, and build stronger context-grounded telecom LLMs.

AI.tldr: Open Telco (OTel) 是一个开放电信AI资源，发布派生数据集与30个全参数后训练基线，涵盖嵌入、重排、指令调优及安全/拒答任务，已在社区获得广泛使用。
AI.motivation: 为电信领域提供统一、可复现的开放资源，整合数据源、评估划分、训练模型与安全数据，弥补以往电信数据与基准分散的不足。
AI.method: 基于开放权重模型，使用开放训练配方在OTel派生数据上进行全参数后训练，构建10个嵌入模型、3个重排器和17个语言模型，并在留出的OTel评估集上评测。
AI.result: 三个模型族性能均提升：嵌入检索达93.1% NDCG@10，重排达0.947 MRR@10，语言模型正确率达87.8%；截至2026年5月3日模型下载超1600万次，获157+家媒体报道。
AI.conclusion: OTel作为可复现的起点发布，邀请社区扩展数据、改进嵌入与重排模型，并构建更强的上下文接地电信大语言模型。

title: Event Detection in Table Tennis Videos using 2D Keypoints
comment: Accepted at the 9th International ACM Workshop on Multimedia Content Analysis in Sports
summary: This paper addresses the challenge of automatic, frame-accurate event detection in table tennis videos. Current methods for estimating 3d ball trajectories and ball spin typically require that key events, such as ball-racket contacts, have already been identified in advance. This requirement makes it difficult to apply these methods to longer, unedited video recordings. To overcome this limitation, we propose EventNet, a two-stage pipeline to detect key events: (1) 2d keypoints are extracted of the upper-body poses for both players, table corners and ball center.
