title: OOPMAS: Object-Oriented Multi-Agent Systems for Query-Level Workflow Generation
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) powered by large language models have shown strong performance across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and question answering. However, existing methods for automating MAS design mostly operate at the task level, producing a single fixed workflow per benchmark that is applied uniformly to all queries. This assumption fails under realistic conditions. Query difficulty varies widely within a task, and real-world workloads mix heterogeneous task types. We introduce OOPMAS, a training-free framework that generates both the agent set and the coordination workflow at the granularity of individual queries. Agents are represented as object-oriented class definitions with dedicated roles, tools, and persistent state, and workflows are expressed as executable main functions over these agent objects. A dynamic skill library accumulates structured lessons from execution feedback across optimization rounds, enabling in-context improvement without any gradient updates or fine-tuning. On a mixed-task benchmark of queries spanning code, math, and QA, OOPMAS achieves 89.6% accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 18.1 percentage points. A model-swap study across four LLM backbones shows consistent scaling, reaching 92.4% with the strongest model.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架OOPMAS，在单查询粒度上生成智能体集合与协调工作流，实现多智能体系统的自动化设计。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统自动化设计方法多停留在任务级，为每个基准生成单一固定工作流并统一应用于所有查询；但现实场景中任务内查询难度差异大、工作负载混合多种任务类型，这种统一假设失效。
AI.method: OOPMAS将智能体表示为面向对象的类定义，具备专属角色、工具与持久状态；工作流表示为在这些智能体对象上可执行的主函数；通过动态技能库从多轮优化的执行反馈中积累结构化经验，实现上下文化改进，无需梯度更新或微调。
AI.result: 在涵盖代码、数学与问答的混合任务基准上，OOPMAS达到89.6%准确率，比最强基线高出18.1个百分点；跨四种LLM骨干的模型替换研究显示一致的可扩展性，最强模型达到92.4%。
AI.conclusion: OOPMAS通过查询级粒度的智能体与工作流生成，突破了任务级固定工作流的局限，为异构、难度差异大的现实工作负载提供了免训练、可扩展的多智能体系统自动化设计范式。

title: DIPrune: Task-Aware Token Pruning with Dual Importance for Efficient Multimodal Language Models
summary: Recent training-free pruning approaches for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) effectively cut computational overhead by exploiting visual redundancy or text-vision attention. However, they frequently suffer from semantic degradation due to their task-agnostic design or unreliable attention estimates. Based on our empirical analysis, we have found that this issue arises because salient tokens in shallow layers persistently suppress emerging semantic ones through numerical inertia, leading to premature discarding of signals crucial for deep reasoning. To address the aforementioned issue, from the task-oriented aspects, we first reformulate training-free pruning as a minimization of the distortion in the final task loss and derive a tractable, token-wise upper bound to serve as a surrogate objective. Specifically, this formulation inherently reveals a previously neglected inter-layer term that accounts for gradients across layers. Accordingly, for the implementation, we propose DIPrune, a rank-based framework that employs a dual importance scoring mechanism to jointly optimize intra-layer static feature saliency and inter-layer dynamic semantic evolution. Extensive experiments on LLaVA and Qwen-VL demonstrate that DIPrune consistently achieves state-of-the-art results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DIPrune，一种无需训练的多模态大模型剪枝框架，通过任务导向的损失失真最小化与双重重要性评分，同时优化层内静态显著性与层间动态语义演化，在LLaVA和Qwen-VL上取得SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练剪枝方法虽能降低计算开销，但因任务无关设计或不可靠的注意力估计，常导致语义退化。作者经验分析发现，浅层显著token会通过数值惯性持续压制新兴语义token，导致深层推理所需信号被过早丢弃。
AI.method: 从任务导向角度出发，将免训练剪枝重新表述为最终任务损失失真的最小化问题，并推导出可处理的token级上界作为代理目标；该表述揭示了一个被忽视的层间项（跨层梯度）。据此提出DIPrune，基于排序的框架，采用双重重要性评分机制，联合优化层内静态特征显著性与层间动态语义演化。
AI.result: 在LLaVA和Qwen-VL上的大量实验表明，DIPrune持续取得最先进（SOTA）结果。
AI.conclusion: DIPrune通过任务导向的剪枝目标与层内-层间联合重要性建模，有效缓解语义退化问题，为免训练MLLM剪枝提供了新思路。

title: Activation Denoising: A Robustness View on Parallel vs Sequential LLM Quantization
summary: Post-training quantization is a powerful tool for compressing large language models. The most scalable methods quantize every layer in parallel, but quantization errors then compound through the residual stream, as no layer corrects for the errors of the layers before it. Sequential quantization accounts for this error compounding by re-calibrating each layer on the already-quantized outputs of its predecessors, yielding stronger results but at the cost of a serial schedule that becomes a bottleneck at scale. As a solution, we propose parallel quantization with activation denoising, which recovers much of the sequential benefit while keeping quantization fully parallel. Rather than re-calibrating layer-by-layer, we take a robustness perspective and model the upstream error as noise, regularizing to be robust to it through a preprocessing step followed by metric-weighted rounding. Applied at every layer, this regularization forms a depth-compounding smoothness penalty that dampens how strongly quantization errors amplify through the model. Unlike orthogonal rotations commonly used in quantization, which must preserve the model's function, we multiply the weights by a more general linear transformation. We find that the two are complementary and their effects compound. Empirically, our robustness regularization recovers a significant part of sequential quantization's benefit in a single parallel pass, at a fraction of its time. Overall, by treating compounding quantization errors as a robustness problem, we offer a principled foundation for more efficient and accurate LLM quantization at scale.

AI.tldr: 提出"激活去噪的并行量化"，把上游量化误差视为噪声做鲁棒性正则，在保持全并行的情况下接近串行量化的效果。
AI.motivation: 并行量化可扩展性好，但各层误差在残差流中累积；串行量化虽通过逐层重校准缓解误差累积，但串行调度在规模上成为瓶颈。因此需要在并行框架下恢复串行量化的收益。
AI.method: 不逐层重校准，而是从鲁棒性视角将上游误差建模为噪声：先做预处理步骤，再结合度量加权重舍入进行正则化。该正则作用于每一层，从而形成随深度累积的平滑性惩罚，抑制量化误差沿模型的放大。此外用更一般的线性变换乘以权重（区别于需保持模型功能的常见正交旋转），并发现二者互补、效果可叠加。
AI.result: 鲁棒性正则化在单次并行量化中即恢复了串行量化相当一部分收益，且耗时仅为其一小部分；所提线性变换与正交旋转互补且效果可叠加。
AI.conclusion: 将可累积的量化误差视为鲁棒性问题，为大规模LLM更高效、更精确的量化提供了原则性基础。

title: Illusory Pattern Perception Drives Spurious Inference in Large Language Models
summary: Illusory pattern perception is a well-documented human cognitive tendency to infer meaningful relationships in data that is actually random. Such a tendency, often described as "connecting the dots" where none exist, can result in systematic reasoning errors. This paper investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit such perceptual tendencies, which can lead to systematic errors in downstream applications. To our knowledge, this work presents the first systematic study of illusory pattern perception in LLMs, adapting classic psychological paradigms to three tasks with direct empirical comparison to human behaviors. We find that LLMs frequently exhibit stronger illusory pattern perception than humans. In particular, models tend to over-associate frequent positive attributes with majority groups or large organizations, and show increased tendencies to construct causal narratives from ambiguous events. To uncover the mechanism behind these behaviors, we develop a feature interpretability framework based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to analyze internal representations. Our results reveal that holistic frequency perception and analytic cognitive orientation are linked to the emergence of illusory perceptions. These findings highlight a previously underexplored cognitive-like illusion that may affect the reliability of LLM reasoning. Code available at https://github.com/NusIoraPrivacy/illusory.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究大语言模型（LLM）中的"错觉模式感知"现象，发现LLM比人类更易在随机数据中臆造关联，并用稀疏自编码器揭示其内部机制。
AI.motivation: 错觉模式感知是人类一种有据可查的认知倾向，即在本质随机的数据中推断出有意义的关联（俗称"无中生有地连线"），这会导致系统性推理错误。本文关注LLM是否也具备这种感知倾向，因为这类倾向可能在下游应用中引发系统性错误。
AI.method: 作者将经典心理学范式改编到三项任务中，直接与人类行为进行实证比较；并构建基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的特征可解释性框架，分析模型内部表示以揭示机制。
AI.result: LLM常常表现出比人类更强的错觉模式感知：模型倾向于将高频正面属性过度关联到多数群体或大型组织，并更易从模糊事件中构建因果叙事。SAE分析显示，整体性频率感知与分析性认知取向与错觉感知的出现相关。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了一种此前较少被探讨的、类认知的错觉现象，它可能影响LLM推理的可靠性；代码已开源。

title: PolarScale: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Radiometrically Consistent RGB-to-Stokes Estimation
comment: 22 pages, 17 figures, 8 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Polarization imaging provides physical cues beyond intensity imaging but typically requires specialized hardware. Recent methods infer polarization from RGB-like inputs, yet predict only normalized Stokes components or relative descriptors, from which the radiometric scale needed for full Stokes reconstruction has been divided out. We introduce PolarScale, a benchmark that makes this scale an explicit prediction and evaluation target. Built on existing trichromatic full-Stokes measurements, PolarScale takes the per-scene normalized total-intensity image $s_0$ (a scene-referred linear image, not a consumer sRGB photograph) and asks models to predict normalized Stokes components, AoLP/DoLP/DoCP, and a per-scene scale. Because the scale is divided out of the input, it is not physically identifiable; PolarScale therefore evaluates dataset-conditioned semantic scale estimation against a constant-scale control, together with angular, self-consistency, and physical-bound metrics. Across seven restoration-based and generative backbones and three prediction strategies, the strongest restoration models estimate the scale with 3.6-4.3% mean relative error versus 5.7% for the constant control and violate physical bounds on fewer than 0.25% of pixels, whereas two generative baselines collapse to a near-zero scale; explicit descriptor supervision improves descriptor accuracy (23.66 vs. 18.88 dB PSNR for MAE). Predicted full-Stokes representations improve diffuse/specular separation, material segmentation, and glare classification, although in diffuse/specular separation the learned scale performs only on par with the constant control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolarScale 基准，将偏振推断中的辐射尺度作为显式的预测与评估目标，在七个恢复与生成骨干上系统评测尺度估计、描述符保真度及下游任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有从类 RGB 输入推断偏振的方法只预测归一化 Stokes 分量或相对描述符，把完整 Stokes 重建所需的辐射尺度整除掉了，导致该尺度既不显式预测也不被评估，物理信息不完整。
AI.method: 基于已有三色全 Stokes 测量构建 PolarScale：输入为逐场景归一化总光强图 s0（场景参考线性图像，非消费级 sRGB 照片），要求模型预测归一化 Stokes 分量、AoLP/DoLP/DoCP 以及逐场景尺度。由于尺度已从输入中除掉、物理上不可辨识，故采用数据集条件化的语义尺度估计，并与常数尺度对照进行对比，同时使用角度误差、自一致性和物理边界等指标；在七种基于恢复和生成的主干、三种预测策略上评测，并对描述符显式监督。
AI.result: 最强的恢复模型尺度估计平均相对误差为 3.6–4.3%，优于常数对照的 5.7%，物理边界违反像素比例低于 0.25%，而两个生成基线塌缩到接近零的尺度；显式描述符监督提升描述符精度（MAE 下 PSNR 23.66 对 18.88 dB）。预测的全 Stokes 表示改善漫反射/镜面分离、材质分割与眩光分类，但在漫反射/镜面分离任务上所学尺度仅与常数对照相当。
AI.conclusion: 将辐射尺度设为显式预测与评估目标具有可行性，恢复类模型能较好完成该任务并提升多项下游任务，但生成基线失效，且语义尺度相对常数对照的增益在有任务上并不显著，说明尺度估计仍具挑战。

title: Targeted search shows that random-device testing underestimates worst-case error in a simulated wave-based neural operator
comment: 50 pages (19 main text and references, 31 Supplementary Information), 5 figures, 1 table
summary: Wave-based processors promise fast, energy-efficient Fourier layers for neural operators. They are usually validated on randomly sampled devices, but using them requires knowing how large their error can become under fabrication and alignment variation. In a stylised numerical case study, a hybrid Fourier neural operator runs its four spectral layers on simulated coherent 4f processors with 32 toleranced knobs, whose half-widths are representative rather than calibrated. For 120 models (four tasks, six training methods, five seeds), we compared the worst of N random in-spec devices with a searched one. On a deterministic simulator with one frozen draw of the random static errors, the searched device's held-out error was 1.08-3.10 times the maximum over 200 Monte Carlo devices and 1.06-2.71 times that over 1000. With 20 fresh static draws, it still exceeded the maximum over 200 random devices in 116 of 120 models. Under uniform sampling, the probability of drawing such a device is at most 0.37% per model (two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson), which says nothing about how large its error is. The gap persisted with uniform or Sobol' sampling at the search's budget, shared knobs, a second crosstalk model, box scales of 0.25-2 and a pixel-level device model. Models trained only with random static errors reached 3.7-39.9 times their nominal error on searched devices, and fine-tuning on random and gradient-searched devices gave the lowest searched error of the six in all 20 task-seed pairs. For two heat-exchanger quantities, a search targeted at each exceeded the worst of 1000 random devices in all 39 models, and hence the Wilks 95/95 limit (worst of 59). For the mean pressure of 11 models, no random device exceeded a 1% error threshold, but the searched device did. Random testing estimates how often errors exceed a threshold; worst-device search gives a lower bound on how large they can be.

AI.tldr: 在含容差的相干4f波处理器的仿真中，通过“搜索最坏器件”得到的留出误差可超过200甚至1000个随机器件的最大误差，说明随机测试只能估计误差超阈值的频率，而最坏器件搜索给出了误差上界的下界。
AI.motivation: 波处理器有望为神经算子提供快速、节能的傅里叶层，但现有验证多基于随机采样的器件，无法回答在制造与对准偏差下误差可能变得多大。因此需要一个针对最坏器件（而非平均/随机器件）的评估方法，给出误差的上界下界。
AI.method: 在一个风格化数值案例中，将混合傅里叶神经算子的四个谱层放在带32个容差旋钮的模拟相干4f处理器上；对120个模型（4任务×6训练方法×5种子）比较N个随机合规器件中的最坏者与一个搜索得到的器件。在确定性仿真器（固定一组随机静态误差抽样）以及20组新静态抽样上评估；并测试均匀/Sobol'采样、共享旋钮、第二种串扰模型、0.25–2的box尺度、像素级器件模型。另用6种训练策略（含仅在随机静态误差上训练、在随机与梯度搜索器件上微调）比较搜索器件上的误差。
AI.result: 在固定抽样下，搜索器件的留出误差是200个蒙特卡洛器件最大值的1.08–3.10倍，是1000个器件最大值的1.06–2.71倍；在20组新静态抽样中，仍有116/120个模型超过200个随机器件的最大值。均匀采样下抽到此类器件的概率每模型最多0.37%（双侧95% Clopper-Pearson）。该差距在均匀/Sobol'采样、共享旋钮、第二种串扰模型、不同box尺度和像素级模型下持续存在。仅在随机静态误差上训练的模型在搜索器件上误差达标称的3.7–39.9倍；在随机与梯度搜索器件上微调在全部20个任务-种子对中给出最低搜索误差。对两个换热器量，针对性搜索在全部39个模型中超过1000个随机器件的最坏值，因此也超过Wilks 95/95限（59个的最坏值）。对11个模型的平均压力，无随机器件超过1%误差阈值，但搜索器件超过了。
AI.conclusion: 随机测试估计的是误差超过阈值的频率，而最坏器件搜索给出的是误差能达到多大（误差上界的下界）。对于波处理器上的傅里叶神经算子，必须在设计验证中引入最坏器件搜索，因为随机采样会让实际部署在最坏情况下的误差被严重低估。

title: Thin Evidence, Thick Priors: How Language Models Substitute Identity for Missing Financial Facts
comment: 49 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables; Submitted & Accepted to ICAIF'2026
summary: People increasingly ask large language models what to do with their money, yet seldom describe their finances in full. This paper asks what a model does with the gap. Holding finances fixed and changing only who the investor is said to be, we grade the financial evidence in the prompt from eight facts to none and measure how far the recommended equity allocation moves. Across 96,600 prompts to Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, built from 100 financial profiles, 138 personas and seven disclosure conditions, the average gap between two personas with identical finances rises from 4.78 percentage points at full disclosure to 10.34 points with no financial facts. A two-way cluster bootstrap counting duplicated prompts once places the ratio at 2.16 (95% interval 1.69 to 2.79), and the rise is already 1.69-fold with a single fact left. Identity explains 5% of within-profile variation in advice at full disclosure and 96% with no disclosure. Household size is the only attribute whose influence grows reliably as evidence is withdrawn. Once standard errors are clustered on the persona, the unit to which identity was assigned, most attribute-specific interactions reported in the conference version lose significance, and gender instead appears as a small standing gap that full disclosure does not close. Stating risk appetite alone brings the swing into the range seen with two to seven generic facts. With no facts, the model's one-line rationale cites incomes, debts and savings it was never told, and these invented finances turn adverse more often for larger households. Inside the network, gender is linearly decodable at every layer, and ablating the gender direction at five layers leaves the aggregate identity swing unchanged. Advisory systems built on such models should be audited at the disclosure levels users actually reach, and judged across the whole identity space rather than one attribute at a time.

AI.tldr: 当提示中财务事实被逐步撤除时，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 给出的股权配置建议受投资者身份影响显著放大：从完整披露时的4.78个百分点升至无事实时的10.34个百分点（比值2.16）。身份在无披露时可解释96%的profile内变异。作者呼吁在用户真实达到的披露水平上、跨整个身份空间审计此类顾问系统。
AI.motivation: 用户常向大语言模型寻求理财建议，却很少完整描述自身财务状况。论文旨在探究当提示中财务信息缺失时，模型如何用"身份"信息填补这一空白，从而考察身份对投资建议的潜在不当影响。
AI.method: 固定财务状况，仅改变投资者被描述的身份，将提示中的财务证据从八条事实逐步减少到零，测量推荐股权配置的变动幅度。构建96,600条提示，来自100个财务档案、138种人格和七种披露条件。采用双向聚类自助法（重复提示只计一次），并对标准误按人格聚类。
AI.result: 两个财务相同人格间的平均建议差距从完整披露的4.78个百分点升至无财务事实时的10.34个百分点，比值2.16（95%区间1.69–2.79），仅留一条事实时已达1.69倍。身份在完整披露时解释5%的profile内变异，无披露时解释96%。家庭规模是唯一随证据撤除而稳定增强影响的属性。按人格聚类标准误后，会议版本中多数属性交互失去显著性，性别则表现为完整披露也未能弥合的小型持续差距。仅说明风险偏好即可使波动进入二至七条通用事实的范围。无事实时，模型的一句话理由引用了从未告知的收入、债务和储蓄，且这些编造财务对较大规模家庭更常转为不利。网络内性别在各层线性可解码，但在五层消融性别方向后总体身份波动不变。
AI.conclusion: 基于此类模型的顾问系统应在用户真实达到的披露水平上接受审计，并跨整个身份空间而非逐属性评估。

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Quantized ViTs via Single-Pass Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration
summary: Post-training quantization is a standard route to fitting vision transformers (ViTs) into edge compute and memory budgets, yet quantized models become especially brittle under distribution shift. Test-time adaptation (TTA) addresses such shifts without labels, but most existing approaches are poorly aligned with the constraints of quantized inference. Prevailing TTA methods recover accuracy through backpropagation, while backprop-free methods often still incur overhead from extra forward passes or parameter updates, and lightweight feature- or logit-level methods recover only part of the loss. Across these approaches, a quantization-specific failure mode that amplifies the drop is not directly targeted: under shift, activations occupy frozen quantizers' calibrated ranges differently, distorting their code distribution. We propose Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR), a single-pass TTA method tailored to quantized ViTs that neither backpropagates nor updates any model parameters. QuAR recalibrates activations at the input to a frozen quantizer, mapping the test stream's running per-channel statistics back toward the source calibration. On ImageNet-C with ViT-B, QuAR achieves the highest mean accuracy among state-of-the-art backprop-free TTA methods at 3-, 4-, 6- and 8-bit weight/activation precision, outperforming the strongest baseline by 2.28 points at 8 bits and 4.00 at 3 bits, with 46% lower latency and a memory overhead of only 0.17 MB (0.01% of peak inference memory). Analysis and diagnostics trace the gain to a reduced per-channel mismatch at these quantizers, which restores the code distribution the baselines leave unchanged or distort further. A single fixed configuration remains ahead across continual streams, non-i.i.d. label shift, seven out-of-distribution suites, and three other backbones.

AI.tldr: 提出QuAR，一种针对量化ViT的单次前向、免反向传播的测试时自适应方法，通过将激活重新校准回源校准统计量，缓解分布偏移下的量化器失配。
AI.motivation: 训练后量化虽能将ViT塞入边缘设备预算，但量化模型在分布偏移下极度脆弱。现有测试时自适应（TTA）方法与量化推理约束不匹配：基于反向传播的方法开销大，免反向传播方法也需额外前向或参数更新，轻量特征/逻辑层方法仅恢复部分精度。而一个量化特有的失效模式未被直接针对：偏移下激活占据冻结量化器校准区间的分布不同，扭曲了码分布，进一步放大精度下降。
AI.method: 提出Quantizer-Aligned Recalibration (QuAR)：一种面向量化ViT的单次前向TTA方法，不反向传播、不更新任何模型参数。QuAR在冻结量化器输入端重新校准激活，将测试流的运行逐通道统计量映射回源校准统计量。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C与ViT-B上，QuAR在3、4、6、8位权重/激活精度下取得免反向传播TTA方法中最高的平均精度，8位下超过最强基线2.28个百分点，3位下超过4.00个百分点，延迟降低46%，内存开销仅0.17 MB（峰值推理内存的0.01%）。
AI.conclusion: 分析与诊断表明增益源于这些量化器处逐通道失配的降低，恢复了被基线保持不变或进一步扭曲的码分布。单一固定配置在持续流、非独立同分布标签偏移、七个分布外套件及三种其他骨干网络上仍保持领先。

title: Preserving Unstable Modes Through Inverse Dynamics in JEPA World Models
summary: Robotic systems often exhibit unstable modes, along which small perturbations and disturbances can cause unbounded growth unless corrected through feedback. Controlling such systems from high-dimensional visual observations requires representations that preserve these modes. Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) provide a natural framework for learning such representations and their dynamics from visual data. However, we demonstrate that next step prediction combined with anti-collapse regularization does not guarantee that controllable unstable modes are preserved: the training loss can be minimized while these modes are collapsed, making stabilization from the learned representation impossible. To address this, we augment world-model training with an action reconstruction objective (i.e., an inverse dynamics loss) that encourages control-aware representations, namely, visual representations that preserve crucial features for control. We prove that exact action reconstruction makes the encoder injective on the finite-horizon reachable subspace. Thus, the encoder cannot discard any state direction reachable by an action sequence within $H$ steps. Moreover, we show that, as $H$ grows, the dominant eigenspace of the finite-horizon controllability Gramian converges to the controllable unstable subspace. We establish our theoretical results for linear systems and demonstrate empirically that our findings extend to nonlinear visual control tasks (CartPole, Walker2D, and PointMaze), highlighting the benefits of control-aware representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文指出JEPA式下一帧预测加抗坍缩正则无法保证保留可控不稳定模态，提出加入动作重构(逆动力学)目标以学习"控制感知"表征，并从理论上证明其保持可达子空间，实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人系统常存在不稳定模态，微小扰动若无反馈校正会无界增长；从高维视觉观测控制这类系统，需要能保留这些不稳定模态的表征。JEPA可从视觉数据学习表征及动力学，但作者发现：仅用下一步预测配合抗坍缩正则，训练损失虽可最小化，可控不稳定模态却可能被坍缩，导致无法从学到的表征中稳定系统。
AI.method: 在世界模型训练中加入动作重构目标（即逆动力学损失），以鼓励控制感知的视觉表征，使其保留对控制至关重要的特征。理论上针对线性系统证明：精确动作重构使编码器在有限时域可达子空间上为单射，因此编码器不能丢弃任何在H步内由动作序列可达的状态方向；并证明随H增大，有限时域可控性Gramian的主特征子空间收敛到可控不稳定子空间。
AI.result: 在理论上给出了线性系统的可达子空间单射性与Gramian收敛性结论；在非线性视觉控制任务（CartPole、Walker2D、PointMaze）上通过实验表明这些结论可推广，验证了控制感知表征学习的收益。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠下一步预测与抗坍缩正则不足以保留可控不稳定模态；引入动作重构/逆动力学损失可获得控制感知表征，从理论上保证不丢弃可达状态方向，并在视觉控制任务中带来实证收益。

title: ThinkFuse: Trajectory-Aware Test-Time Fusion for Small Reasoning Models
summary: Small reasoning models (SRMs) have shown strong performance on complex reasoning tasks by generating extended chain-of-thought trajectories, but they often fail to recover once their reasoning enters an erroneous path. Existing test-time fusion methods rely on local fusion signals to determine when to trigger fusion, which can be misled by transient uncertainty fluctuations and may reinforce unstable reasoning trajectories. We propose ThinkFuse, a training-free test-time fusion framework that selectively intervenes in unreliable reasoning segments. ThinkFuse compares segment-level uncertainty shifts with trajectory-level uncertainty trends to identify unstable reasoning points and fuse auxiliary reasoning paths into the primary model's trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ThinkFuse outperforms baselines on mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks, with consistent gains across model-family combinations, and remains robust with a smaller primary model. Our analysis shows that ThinkFuse requires fewer fusion triggers and generates fewer tokens, highlighting the efficiency of selective triggering. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/ThinkFuse.

AI.tldr: ThinkFuse：一种免训练测试时融合框架，通过比较片段级与轨迹级不确定性来选择性干预不可靠推理片段。
AI.motivation: 小型推理模型（SRMs）虽能生成长链思维链完成复杂推理，但一旦进入错误推理路径便难以恢复；现有测试时融合方法依赖局部融合信号触发融合，易受短暂不确定性波动误导，可能强化不稳定推理轨迹。
AI.method: 提出 ThinkFuse，一种免训练的测试时融合框架，选择性干预不可靠推理片段。方法将片段级不确定性变化与轨迹级不确定性趋势进行对比，以识别不稳定推理点，并将辅助推理路径融合进主模型轨迹。
AI.result: 在数学与知识密集型推理基准上优于基线，在不同模型家族组合中取得一致提升，且在较小主模型下仍保持稳健。分析显示所需融合触发次数更少、生成token更少，体现选择性触发的高效性。
AI.conclusion: ThinkFuse 通过基于不确定性层级对比的选择性触发，实现高效且稳健的测试时融合，提升小型推理模型复杂推理表现。代码已开源。

title: A Stevens's Power Law Check-up of GPT-5.5's Image-Based Visualization Reading
comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, including supplementary material. Accepted by the VISxGenAI workshop at IEEE VIS 2026
summary: We adapt Stevens's power law to measure the innate ability of AI models to read visualizations, which can reveal the built-in perceptual mechanisms of algorithmic models. In our pilot study, models see no legend. A model first views a reference visual representation and estimates its magnitude, then estimates the magnitude of each subsequent image of the same representation relative to that reference. Our evaluation of twelve visual variables makes how algorithmic models read visual encodings measurable, comparable with human perception, and more interpretable to humans.

AI.tldr: 该研究将Stevens幂律应用于测量AI模型读取可视化图表的先天能力，通过无图例的参考-比较实验流程，评估了十二种视觉变量的感知机制，使算法模型的视觉编码读取过程可量化、可与人类感知对比、且更易解释。
AI.motivation: AI模型读取可视化图表的内在感知机制尚不明确，缺乏可量化、可与人类感知对比的评估方法。作者希望揭示算法模型内置的感知机制，并让模型对视觉编码的读取过程更加可测量与可解释。
AI.method: 借鉴Stevens幂律来度量AI模型读取可视化的先天能力。实验采用无图例设置：模型先观察一个参考视觉表示并估计其量级，随后针对同一表示的后续图像，估计其相对于参考图的量级。共评估十二种视觉变量。
AI.result: 对十二种视觉变量的评估表明，该方法使算法模型读取视觉编码的过程变得可测量、可与人类感知相比较，并且对人类更加可解释。
AI.conclusion: 将Stevens幂律引入AI可视化感知研究是可行的，能够揭示算法模型内置的感知机制，并为模型与人类感知的对比及可解释性提供新的量化途径。

title: Foundation Model-Aided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Random Access Network Optimization
comment: This paper has been accepted in ACM International Symposium on Theory, Algorithmic Foundations, and Protocol Design for Mobile Networks and Mobile Computing (MobiHoc) 2026
summary: Random access (RA) is one of the most foundational medium access control (MAC) layer scheduling schemes for handling unpredictable data traffic from multiple terminals. While multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) has been explored to optimize RA-based wireless networks, its reliance on experience-driven, distributed policy learning incurs significant training overhead for each optimization task, limiting its feasibility in real-world applications. In this work, we propose to leverage a foundation model (FM) to improve MARL efficiency across diverse RA network optimization tasks. Specifically, we design an FM-aided actor-critic algorithm within a consensus-based decentralized MARL architecture and provide its convergence analysis under local reward exchanges and nonlinear value function approximations to show that our algorithm achieves the same convergence order as the conventional MARL with critic model exchanges and linear approximations. Our numerical results show that our FM-based approach significantly enhances MARL speed for RA network optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用基础模型（FM）提升多智能体强化学习（MARL）在随机接入网络优化中的效率，设计了基于共识的分布式MARL架构下的FM辅助actor-critic算法，并给出收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: 随机接入（RA）是处理多终端不可预测数据流量的基础MAC层调度方案。虽然MARL已被用于优化RA无线网络，但其依赖经验驱动的分布式策略学习，导致每个优化任务训练开销巨大，限制了实际应用可行性。
AI.method: 在基于共识的分布式MARL架构中，设计了一种FM辅助的actor-critic算法；并在本地奖励交换与非线性价值函数近似条件下进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 收敛性分析表明，该算法达到与传统MARL（采用critic模型交换和线性近似）相同的收敛阶。数值结果表明，基于FM的方法显著提升了RA网络优化中MARL的训练速度。
AI.conclusion: 利用基础模型可有效提升MARL在多样化RA网络优化任务中的效率，在保持相同收敛阶的同时大幅加速训练，增强了实际应用可行性。

title: Do I Need the Cloud? Uncertainty-Aware Step-Level Handoff for Small Language Model Agents
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris, France, 2026
summary: Small language models (SLMs) are attractive as local agent controllers because they reduce remote inference, latency, and deployment footprint, yet structured tool errors can cause an agent step to fail. Existing routers typically select a model once per query. However, agents expose sequential decision points whose difficulty dynamically changes based on intermediate observations. We propose STEPGATE, an uncertainty-aware handoff framework that scores each local SLM action and selectively escalates challenging steps to a stronger model. On a 52-task held-out single-step BFCL-derived test split, the Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B pair attains 82.7% task success with 30.8% escalation, versus 67.3% local-only and 75.4% random escalation (which uses 33.8% escalation). In a separate multi-turn evaluation, STEPGATE achieves 69.0% trajectory success and 84.0% action success using only 30.0% cloud actions, compared with 48.0%/70.5% local-only, 60.0%/78.2% random escalation, and 57.0%/77.1% query-level routing (strong-only achieves 82.0% trajectory success at 100% cloud actions). These results suggest that step-level escalation recovers a large share of the performance gap to the stronger Qwen2.5-7B backend at a matched cloud-action rate while transmitting fewer tokens remotely. However, our evaluation is limited to one model family, a single stronger backend, and scripted tasks. Furthermore, the test sets are small, multi-turn comparisons rely on paired intervals and statistical tests, and our risk tiers serve as research annotations rather than formal safety guarantees.

AI.tldr: 提出STEPGATE，一种不确定性感知的逐步升级框架，对本地小模型(SLM)的每个动作打分并将困难步骤选择性升级到更强模型，在单步与多轮智能体任务中以更低云端调用率逼近强模型性能。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型作为本地智能体控制器可降低远程推理、延迟与部署开销，但结构化工具错误会导致智能体步骤失败。现有路由器通常每个查询只选一次模型，而智能体的顺序决策点难度会随中间观测动态变化，因此需要细粒度的逐步升级机制。
AI.method: 提出STEPGATE：对本地SLM的每个动作进行不确定性感知打分，并选择性地将困难步骤升级到更强的后端模型。使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B模型对，在基于BFCL衍生的52个留出单步测试任务上进行评估，并进行单独的多轮评估，与本地-only、随机升级和查询级路由进行对比。
AI.result: 单步测试中，STEPGATE达82.7%任务成功率、升级率30.8%，对比本地-only 67.3%、随机升级75.4%(升级率33.8%)。多轮评估中，STEPGATE以30.0%云端动作取得69.0%轨迹成功与84.0%动作成功，对比本地-only 48.0%/70.5%、随机升级60.0%/78.2%、查询级路由57.0%/77.1%；强模型-only在100%云端动作下轨迹成功82.0%。
AI.conclusion: 在匹配的云端动作率下，步骤级升级可挽回大部分与更强Qwen2.5-7B后端的性能差距，同时远程传输更少token。但评估仅限单一模型家族、单一强后端和脚本化任务，测试集较小，多轮比较依赖配对区间与统计检验，风险分级仅为研究性标注而非正式安全保证。

title: UniCounting: Instance-Aware Proposal Consolidation for Image-Query-Free Multi-Category Counting
summary: Visual counting is commonly formulated as counting a single specified target, with a model receiving an image-specific exemplar, text query, or target category and returning a single count. We instead study fixed-vocabulary image-query-free multi-category counting. A global vocabulary is fixed for each run, and, given only an RGB image, the model predicts a complete category--count vector without being told which categories appear. We present UniCounting, which casts counting as instance-aware structural inference over an over-complete proposal set. Generic segmenters produce duplicate masks, partial views, and proposals from neighboring instances; semantic scores can name them but cannot determine which denote the same object. Frozen SAM~2.1 generates masks, while frozen DINOv2 and OpenCLIP provide relation and category features. A 3,267-parameter category-shared relation head predicts same-instance affinities from instance-mask-derived supervision. Sparse graph construction, representative selection, labeling, and background-margin admission then convert each admitted component into one count with replayable group evidence. Only the relation head is trained, without count or density-map targets. On COCO clean500, UniCounting obtains lower point-estimate vector $\ell_1$ error and absent-class false mass than calibrated OWLv2-All80, with comparable micro presence F1. Under a matched decoder, the learned relation reduces both errors relative to mask containment, mask IoU, CLIP, and DINO, while revealing a fragmentation--merge trade-off. We also report transfer diagnostics on OmniCount-sub, FSC-147, and CARPK.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniCounting，将多类别计数建模为实例感知结构推理，仅训练一个 3267 参数的关系头，在无图像查询下输出完整类别–计数向量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉计数多针对单一指定目标，需依赖图像级示例、文本查询或目标类别，只输出一个计数；本文研究固定词表、无图像查询的多类别计数问题。
AI.method: 用冻结SAM 2.1生成候选掩码，冻结DINOv2与OpenCLIP提供关系与类别特征；训练一个类别共享的关系头预测同实例亲和度，结合稀疏图构建、代表选取、标注与背景边距准入，将每个组件转为一个计数，仅训练关系头。
AI.result: 在COCO clean500上，点估计向量ℓ1误差与缺失类假质量低于校准的OWLv2-All80，微观存在F1相当；匹配解码器下，所学关系相较掩码包含、掩码IoU、CLIP与DINO均降低两类误差；在OmniCount-sub、FSC-147与CARPK上给出迁移诊断。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠实例级关系学习即可实现无查询多类别计数，揭示碎片化–合并权衡，并具备一定跨数据集迁移能力。

title: Which and When to Admit: Gradient Admission for Data-Centric Small Language Model Finetuning
summary: LoRA fine-tuning adapts small language models (SLMs) to heterogeneous instruction data within a low-rank update subspace, making it vulnerable to three structural problems: conflicting gradients that cancel, static data selection that cannot track evolving learning dynamics, and subspace saturation that causes later updates to overwrite useful directions. We argue that effective adaptation therefore requires controlling which data-induced gradients enter the LoRA subspace and when. We propose GRADE (GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe), a data-centric framework combining two mechanisms: a state-aware selector that continually admits samples aligned with the evolving multi-task gradient field, and a self-calibrating step-level gate that rejects updates likely to cause destructive overwrite near saturation. Across three current-generation backbones and a heterogeneous seven-dataset instruction pool, GRADE outperforms strong data-selection and PEFT-stabilization baselines in accuracy and robustness. It is the only method to improve consistently over standard LoRA on every architecture, while producing more coherent gradient trajectories and less destructive overwrite. These results show that successful SLM adaptation depends not only on which data are selected, but also on which gradients are allowed to enter and persist in the constrained update subspace.

AI.tldr: 提出GRADE框架，通过状态感知数据选择器和自校准步级门控控制进入LoRA子空间的梯度，在三个骨干和七个数据集上稳定超越标准LoRA。
AI.motivation: LoRA微调SLM时存在三个结构性问题：梯度冲突相互抵消、静态数据选择无法跟踪学习动态变化、子空间饱和导致后续更新覆盖有用方向。因此有效适配需要控制哪些数据诱导梯度以及何时进入LoRA子空间。
AI.method: GRADE（GRadient-Aligned Data-centric rEcipe）是一个数据中心框架，包含两个机制：状态感知选择器（持续接纳与演化的多任务梯度场对齐的样本）和自校准步级门控（拒绝在接近饱和时可能造成破坏性覆盖的更新）。
AI.result: 在三个当代骨干网络和异构七数据集指令池上，GRADE在准确率和鲁棒性上优于强数据选择和PEFT稳定化基线；是唯一在所有架构上都一致优于标准LoRA的方法，并产生更连贯的梯度轨迹和更少的破坏性覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 成功的SLM适配不仅取决于选择哪些数据，还取决于允许哪些梯度进入并保留在受限的更新子空间中。

title: Agentic Semantic Sensing for Resource-Adaptive AI-RAN
summary: Semantic sensing (SemS) acquires task-relevant information rather than reconstructing complete physical information. Existing SemS formulations typically operate open loop: sensing configurations and observation schedules are fixed before inference and cannot respond to evolving task-level evidence. We propose Agentic SemS, a closed-loop framework for AI-enabled radio access networks (AI-RANs) that controls sensing within a communication-feasible profile set. A profile-conditioned causal Transformer updates the semantic belief from streaming observations, while key-value caching enables efficient state updates across profile changes without repeatedly processing the complete history. A semantic utility network estimates the task-level benefit of acquiring the next observation block under each feasible profile after accounting for sensing cost. The resulting continuation utilities jointly support next-profile selection and semantic early exit, adapting sensing configuration and duration to evolving evidence. The expected semantic gain is further related to conditional mutual information, providing a value-of-information interpretation of continued online sensing. Experiments on Widar3.0 with six emulated sensing profiles show that, in comparison with full-sequence High, the resource-efficient Agentic setting reduces normalized cumulative sensing cost by 25.33% while achieving 85.79% Macro-F1. At the same utility checkpoint, semantic early exit provides a further 12.35% cost reduction over adaptive sensing without early exit, with a 0.97-percentage-point Macro-F1 decrease.

AI.tldr: 提出Agentic SemS闭环语义感知框架，通过配置条件因果Transformer与语义效用网络，联合优化感知配置选择与语义早退，在AI-RAN中实现感知开销与任务性能的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有语义感知（SemS）多为开环：感知配置与观测调度在推理前固定，无法根据任务级证据动态调整，导致资源利用与任务性能难以兼顾。
AI.method: 面向AI-RAN提出闭环Agentic SemS框架，在通信可行配置集合内控制感知。采用配置条件因果Transformer从流式观测更新语义信念，并用KV缓存支持跨配置切换的高效状态更新；用语义效用网络估计各可行配置下获取下一观测块的任务级收益（扣除感知成本）；由延续效用联合支持下一配置选择与语义早退，从而自适应调整感知配置与时长。并将期望语义增益与条件互信息关联，给出在线感知的信息价值解释。
AI.result: 在Widar3.0的六种模拟感知配置上实验：相比全序列High方案，资源高效的Agentic设置将归一化累计感知成本降低25.33%，同时达到85.79%的Macro-F1；在相同效用检查点下，语义早退相比无早退的自适应感知进一步降低12.35%成本，Macro-F1仅下降0.97个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 闭环的Agentic SemS能够根据任务证据动态选择感知配置与终止时机，在显著降低感知开销的同时保持较高任务性能，为AI-RAN中的语义感知提供了可行且高效的设计范式。

title: UP-MOPD: Update Projection in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation from multiple teachers combines expertise from different domains in a single student, but conflicting gradients can hinder this integration. Gradient corrections directly constrain parameter updates under plain SGD. With optimizers such as AdamW, however, momentum, adaptive scaling, and weight decay can turn a corrected gradient into an update that increases a domain loss to first order. To address this gap, we propose Update Projection for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (UP-MOPD). UP-MOPD lets the original mixed gradient update the optimizer state and generate a candidate displacement, then projects only violating candidates before they are committed to the parameters. The projection gives the unique feasible update closest to the candidate in Euclidean distance. In experiments combining medical and general domains, UP-MOPD improves IFEval-loose accuracy late in training by 2.96 points over vanilla M-OPD. It achieves an average score of 60.03 across eight metrics, compared with 59.00 for gradient projection and 59.15 for update rejection. On a public benchmark covering mathematics, code, and instruction following, it achieves the best average across six tasks (32.67), leads on LiveCodeBench v5, and ties for the best IFEval result.These results support projecting optimizer updates to reduce interference between domains.

AI.tldr: 提出UP-MOPD方法，在多教师在线策略蒸馏中对优化器更新进行投影，缓解域间冲突，实验取得最优平均表现。
AI.motivation: 多教师在线策略蒸馏可整合不同领域专长，但梯度冲突会阻碍知识融合。梯度修正方法在SGD下有效，但AdamW的动量、自适应缩放和权重衰减会使修正后的梯度反而一阶增大某域损失，存在理论与实践的空白。
AI.method: UP-MOPD让原始混合梯度先更新优化器状态并生成候选位移，然后仅对违反约束的候选位移进行投影后再提交到参数；该投影给出欧氏距离下唯一最接近候选的可行更新。
AI.result: 在医学与通用领域实验中，UP-MOPD训练后期IFEval-loose准确率比原版M-OPD提升2.96点；八项指标平均60.03，优于梯度投影（59.00）和更新拒绝（59.15）。在数学、代码与指令遵循的公开基准上，六任务平均最优（32.67），LiveCodeBench v5领先，IFEval并列最佳。
AI.conclusion: 投影优化器更新可有效减少领域间干扰，验证了UP-MOPD在多教师在线策略蒸馏中的有效性。

title: Global Transport Couplings for Classifier-Free Guided Flows
summary: Optimal-transport couplings have been shown to reduce training variance in unconditional flow models, but their role in conditional generation remains unclear. A natural approach constructs separate couplings for each condition, but this is impractical for large or continuous conditioning spaces found in modern image foundation models. We introduce Global Transport (GT), a global class-agnostic optimal-transport coupling, computed without class labels. GT can associate different conditions with different regions of the source noise, and consequently worsens performance without guidance. However, when combined with classifier-free guidance (CFG), GT consistently improves generation across domains, model scales, and sampling budgets. This reversal suggests that couplings for conditional flows should be evaluated both empirically and theoretically under the guided flow used at inference, rather than on unguided generation. We evaluate GT over both discrete class and continuous text conditioned image generation across model scales, and investigate how coupling choice alters guided trajectories. These results identify coupling design in the guided flow setting as a simple training time axis to improve performance without modifying existing architectures, samplers, or guidance mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Global Transport (GT)——一种无需类别标签的全局类别无关最优传输耦合，发现在无引导时性能下降，但与CFG结合后能持续提升条件生成的性能。
AI.motivation: 最优传输耦合已被证明能降低无条件流模型的训练方差，但其在条件生成中的作用尚不明确。为每个条件单独构造耦合在现代图像基础模型的大规模或连续条件空间中不可行，因此需要一个可扩展的全局耦合方案。
AI.method: 提出Global Transport (GT)，一种在计算时不使用类别标签的全局类别无关最优传输耦合。该耦合能将不同条件关联到源噪声的不同区域。作者在离散类别和连续文本两种条件图像生成任务上、跨不同模型规模和采样预算进行评估，并结合CFG分析耦合如何改变引导轨迹。
AI.result: GT在无引导情况下会使性能变差，因为不同条件被关联到源噪声的不同区域；但在与classifier-free guidance结合时，GT在多个领域、模型规模和采样预算下都能持续提升生成质量。评估覆盖离散类别与连续文本条件的图像生成。
AI.conclusion: 条件流的耦合设计应在推理时所用的引导流下进行经验与理论评估，而非仅基于无引导生成。耦合设计因此成为一种简单的训练期优化维度，可在不修改现有架构、采样器或引导机制的前提下提升性能。

title: DHCG: Dynamic Construction of Hierarchical Collaboration Graphs for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Reasoning
summary: LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have demonstrated strong capabilities in solving complex problems across diverse domains. Recently, the dynamic orchestration of agent systems has become an important research direction. However, existing methods suffer from limited composition, misaligned dependencies, and inflexible scale, restricting their ability to adapt to reasoning requirements during execution. To address these limitations, we reframe MAS design as a partially observable Markov decision process, in which both the composition and scale of the MAS are dynamically determined. We propose DHCG, a novel framework that coordinates three modules (Planner, Worker, and Generator) to progressively construct a dynamic hierarchical collaboration graph from scratch based on the query and evolving execution feedback. At each step, guided by feedback, the Planner generates a set of distinct and complementary roles tailored to the current reasoning needs and selectively routes relevant information to each role. It can also finalize the hierarchical collaboration graph early or progressively expand it when additional reasoning is required. We further introduce action-aware preference optimization to train the Planner to make more effective decisions when constructing hierarchical collaboration graphs. We systematically evaluate DHCG across code generation, mathematical reasoning, and domain-specific reasoning benchmarks. DHCG achieves state-of-the-art average performance among the compared methods, improving over the single-agent baseline by 13.06 points and outperforming both static and dynamic MAS baselines by 2.77-8.02 points. Additional experiments further demonstrate its generalization across different Planner backbones and unseen Worker models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DHCG 框架，将多智能体系统设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，通过 Planner、Worker、Generator 三模块动态构建分层协作图，并引入动作感知偏好优化训练 Planner，在多项推理任务上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统编排方法存在组合能力受限、依赖关系错位、规模不灵活等问题，难以在执行过程中根据推理需求自适应调整，因此需要一种能动态确定智能体组成与规模的新方法。
AI.method: 将 MAS 设计重构为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，同时动态决定系统的组成与规模；提出 DHCG 框架，协同 Planner、Worker、Generator 三个模块，基于查询和演化中的执行反馈，从零逐步构建动态分层协作图；Planner 生成互补角色并选择性路由信息，可提前终止或渐进扩展图结构；并引入动作感知偏好优化训练 Planner。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理和领域特定推理基准上系统评估。DHCG 在对比方法中取得最优平均性能，较单智能体基线提升 13.06 分，较静态和动态 MAS 基线高出 2.77-8.02 分。额外实验证明其在不同 Planner 主干和未见 Worker 模型上具有泛化性。
AI.conclusion: DHCG 通过动态构建分层协作图并优化 Planner 决策，有效解决了现有 MAS 编排的局限，在多种推理任务上达到先进水平，并展现出良好的泛化能力。

title: GeoPID: Decomposing and Steering Visual Information in Vision-Language Models
summary: While recent vision-language models (VLMs) have shown outstanding performance across diverse applications, they tend to under-use visual information and over-rely on textual context. In this work, we propose \textsc{GeoPID}, a training-free framework that analyzes multimodal information within VLMs from a geometric perspective. \textsc{GeoPID} decomposes information into Redundant, Modality-Unique, and Synergistic components through the geometric relationships between visual and textual representation subspaces. Through an extensive analysis across 22 VLMs and 14 benchmarks, we confirm that correct predictions exhibit stronger vision-unique components when questions strongly require visual grounding. Building on this geometric analysis, we introduce a targeted intervention technique that selectively amplifies visual representations along the vision-unique subspace during inference. As a result, visual grounding capabilities were enhanced without any additional model parameter updates, achieving an average relative accuracy gain of 7.63\%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需训练的框架GeoPID，从几何视角分析VLM中的多模态信息，分解为冗余、模态独有、协同三类成分，并通过放大视觉独有子空间增强视觉定位能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽表现优异，但往往对视觉信息利用不足，过度依赖文本上下文。
AI.method: GeoPID利用视觉与文本表示子空间的几何关系，将信息分解为冗余（Redundant）、模态独有（Modality-Unique）和协同（Synergistic）成分；基于该分析，提出一种针对性干预技术，在推理时沿视觉独有子空间选择性放大视觉表示。
AI.result: 在22个VLM和14个基准上分析发现，当问题强烈依赖视觉定位时，正确预测表现出更强的视觉独有成分；该干预方法在无需更新模型参数的情况下提升视觉定位能力，平均相对准确率提升7.63%。
AI.conclusion: 从几何角度分析并放大视觉独有表征，可有效缓解VLM对文本的过度依赖，增强视觉定位能力，且无需额外训练。

title: TAFFY: A Task-Adaptive Tabular Foundation Model with In-Context Diversity
summary: Recent progress in tabular foundation models suggests that training on synthetic tasks can substantially improve in-context learning capabilities, with overall performance largely depending on how well models can infer task-specific predictive relationships from the available context during inference. In this paper, we introduce TAFFY, a tabular foundation model with an In-Context Diversity Prior and a Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer that strengthen this ability. Specifically, to construct each synthetic pretraining context, the In-Context Diversity Prior samples from multiple related environments derived via controlled interventions and distribution shifts on a shared causal process. This in-context diversity encourages the model to learn a more comprehensive and task-specific representation. Moreover, the Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer iteratively and selectively applies a shared group of Transformer blocks to refine contextual representations, with a task-conditioned gate modulating the final hidden-state update. This enables task-adaptive iterative refinement. Together, these components encourage the model to identify predictive relationships from contextual contrasts during pretraining and dynamically modulate context integration for each task. Across six classification and five regression benchmark datasets, TAFFY attains the lowest average rank.

AI.tldr: 本文提出表格基础模型 TAFFY，通过上下文多样性先验与任务条件循环 Transformer 增强从上下文推断任务特定预测关系的能力，在六个分类与五个回归基准上取得最低平均排名。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型的研究表明，合成任务上的训练能显著提升上下文学习能力，而整体性能很大程度上取决于模型在推理时能否从可用上下文中推断出任务特定的预测关系。因此，本文旨在强化模型这一核心能力。
AI.method: TAFFY 包含两个关键组件：（1）上下文多样性先验（In-Context Diversity Prior），在构建每个合成预训练上下文时，从共享因果过程上通过受控干预与分布偏移导出的多个相关环境中采样，以鼓励模型学习更全面、更任务特定的表示；（2）任务条件循环 Transformer（Task-Conditioned Looped Transformer），迭代且选择性地对一组共享 Transformer 块进行复用，以精炼上下文表示，并用任务条件门控调节最终隐状态更新，实现任务自适应的迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在六个分类和五个回归基准数据集上，TAFFY 取得了最低的平均排名。
AI.conclusion: 这些组件共同促使模型在预训练中从上下文对比中识别预测关系，并为每个任务动态调节上下文整合，从而提升表格任务的上下文学习性能。

title: RA-MoWE: Workflow-Affinity Embeddings for Query Clustering and Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: Agentic workflows enable large language models (LLMs) to solve complex tasks by coordinating reasoning, tool use, and verification. However, a workflow optimized for an entire task collection can overlook differences in the reasoning strategies that individual queries need, while searching for a new workflow for every query repeats costly optimization. To address this tradeoff, we introduce RA-MoWE, a framework that uses workflow-affinity embeddings to cluster queries and guide the generation of reusable expert workflows. Each embedding records how well a fixed set of reference workflows solves a query, revealing similarities in which reasoning strategies are effective. RA-MoWE uses each cluster's queries and average embedding to initialize and refine a specialized workflow through execution feedback. An embedding encoder predicts these embeddings from query text, allowing new queries to select a generated expert without first executing the reference workflows. On a 300-query test set drawn from four benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, and programming, RA-MoWE improves average task score by 4.04 percentage points over selecting among the reference workflows, while using 27.7% fewer language-model calls at inference.

AI.tldr: RA-MoWE利用"工作流亲和性嵌入"对查询聚类，为每类生成可复用的专家工作流，并由嵌入编码器预测嵌入以快速选路，在兼顾个体差异与优化成本的同时提升效果并减少推理调用。
AI.motivation: 针对LLM智能体工作流优化的两难：面向整个任务集合优化的单一工作流会忽视单个查询所需推理策略的差异；而为每个查询单独搜索新工作流又会带来高昂的优化重复成本。因此需要一种既保留可复用性、又能适配查询差异的方法。
AI.method: 提出RA-MoWE框架：1）用工作流亲和性嵌入记录一组固定参考工作流在各查询上的求解表现，揭示推理策略的有效性相似性；2）基于该嵌入对查询聚类；3）用每个簇的查询及其平均嵌入作为初始化，通过执行反馈迭代精炼出该簇的专用专家工作流；4）训练嵌入编码器从查询文本直接预测亲和性嵌入，使新查询无需先执行参考工作流即可选择合适的专家工作流。
AI.result: 在覆盖数学、科学、编程四类基准的300条查询测试集上，RA-MoWE相比"在参考工作流中选择"的基线平均任务得分提升4.04个百分点，同时推理阶段的语言模型调用次数减少27.7%。
AI.conclusion: 通过以工作流亲和性嵌入驱动的聚类与专家工作流生成，RA-MoWE在任务效果与推理成本之间取得更优权衡，验证了"按推理策略相似性复用专家工作流"这一思路的有效性。

title: Decoy and disclosure radii of invariant shape descriptors
summary: A recognizer that compares rotation-invariant descriptors sees a surface only up to the fiber of the descriptor. We measure this fiber by its radius in the orbit distance from the enrolled surface. A large radius admits decoys, that is, distant shapes that pass the matcher. A small radius discloses the enrolled shape to anyone who captures the stored value. For star-shaped surfaces truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most $L$, with $n$ coefficients, a descriptor of generic rank $r$ has generic fibers of dimension $n-3-r$ modulo rotations. The standard pool of band powers, even bispectra, and three invariants of the degree-three band therefore admits decoy families of dimension $5$, $13$, $20$ at $L=4,6,8$. Its rank first reaches $n-3$ at $L=16$, and a mirror decoy remains at every $L$. The odd bispectra remove the mirror decoy generically for $L \geq 4$. Yet at fixed mean radius the same pool determines the enclosed volume exactly, and it does not determine whether a surface meets a clearance requirement. We certify two cases by exact and interval arithmetic. At $L=6$ a decoy matches all $32$ invariants to relative precision $2 \cdot 10^{-18}$ at orbit distance at least $0.87$ times the norm of the enrolled tuple. For the radar shape model of asteroid (101955) Bennu, the pool recovers the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than $7 \, \mathrm{m}$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究旋转不变描述子的“纤维”几何，量化其在形状识别中的安全性。对截断到球谐度L的星形曲面，分析了标准不变量池的通用纤维维度与诱饵族维度，并给出确切与区间算术的验证案例，揭示诱饵、镜像与体积/间隙判定的问题。
AI.motivation: 旋转不变描述子只把曲面识别到其纤维层面，纤维半径大小带来两难：半径大则存在远距离诱饵形状通过匹配，半径小则存储值泄露原始形状。作者希望量化这种纤维的维度与诱饵族规模，评估常用不变量池的安全性。
AI.method: 将曲面截断到球谐度至多L（n个系数），用轨道距离定义纤维半径；对通用秩r的描述子给出纤维维度n-3-r（模旋转）；分析标准不变量池（带功率、偶双谱、三次带三不变量等）的秩与诱饵族维度；并用精确算术与区间算术认证具体案例。
AI.result: 标准不变量池在L=4,6,8时分别允许维度5、13、20的诱饵族；其秩首次在L=16达到n-3，且每个L都存在镜像诱饵。奇双谱在L≥4一般可去除镜像诱饵。固定平均半径时该池精确确定体积，但无法判定是否满足间隙要求。L=6时一个诱饵以相对精度2·10⁻¹⁸匹配全部32个不变量，轨道距离至少为登记元组范数的0.87倍；对Bennu小行星雷达形状模型，该池恢复体积、漏掉手性，并使禁入半径不确定度超过7米。
AI.conclusion: 常用的旋转不变描述子池在有限球谐截断下存在显著的安全与判定缺陷：存在高维诱饵族与镜像诱饵，且无法可靠判定间隙/禁入要求，尽管能精确恢复体积。这表明需要更谨慎地设计或验证此类形状识别描述子。

title: Learning a Mixture of GFlowNets
summary: Learning an ensemble of GFlowNets to sample from a discrete target distribution has become a common approach for achieving better state space exploration and convergence than that of a monolithic sampler. However, these methods often add a substantial runtime overhead to the base model, and their conceptual connection remains elusive. To address this, we first propose a general-purpose theoretical framework for describing a mixture of GFlowNets, which we specialize into continuously (CI) and discretely indexed (DI) collections. On the one hand, we show CI GFlowNets can be interpreted through the lens of a random features expansion, provably boosting the sampler's expressivity in graph-structured tasks and reducing learning instability via spectral shifting. On the other hand, we demonstrate DI GFlowNets encompass prior approaches for GFlowNet training and provide the foundation for the newly proposed Stratum-Conditioned (SC) GFlowNets. This method, which is inspired by the Doob's h-transform of Markov chains, decomposes the state space according to a prescribed modular function and restricts each component to sample from a distinct subset of it. Importantly, SC GFlowNets support centralized and component-wise embarrassingly parallel training, and we show both of them significantly speed up learning convergence and mode coverage without introducing any non-negligible extra computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出描述 GFlowNets 混合模型的理论框架，区分连续索引（CI）与离散索引（DI）集合，并据此提出分层条件（SC）GFlowNets，实现高效并行训练。
AI.motivation: 集成多个 GFlowNets 能提升离散目标分布的采样探索和收敛性，但现有方法运行开销大，且其概念联系尚不清晰，缺乏统一的理论解释。
AI.method: 提出通用理论框架刻画 GFlowNets 混合，分为连续索引（CI）和离散索引（DI）。CI 通过随机特征展开解释，提升图结构任务表达力并借频谱移动降低学习不稳定性；DI 涵盖已有训练方法，并支持新提出的分层条件（SC）GFlowNets。SC 受 Doob h-变换启发，按模块函数分解状态空间，各组件在子集上采样。
AI.result: CI GFlowNets 可证明提升图结构任务表达力并减少学习不稳定性；DI GFlowNets 统一了先前方法；SC GFlowNets 支持集中式和组件级并行训练，在不引入显著额外计算的情况下显著加快收敛和模式覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一了 GFlowNets 集成方法，SC GFlowNets 在保持计算效率的同时提升了收敛速度与模式覆盖。

title: WorkflowOps: Learning Agent Collaboration Priors for Multi-Agent Workflow Orchestration
summary: Multi-agent systems are increasingly deployed for complex knowledge work, yet their orchestration layers remain largely memoryless: each new task is decomposed, assigned, and executed from scratch with no benefit from prior successful executions. We present WorkflowOps, a multi-agent workflow orchestration framework that learns agent collaboration priors from historical workflows and expands its agent pool on demand to cover new capability requirements. Our approach introduces three coupled mechanisms. First, a transition probability matrix captures pairwise agent collaboration frequencies from past workflows and applies them as soft guidance during DAG workflow construction through intra-layer ordering optimization, probability-thresholded edge suggestion, and transitive reduction for parallelism maximization. Second, a sufficiency-driven agent creation loop detects capability gaps via semantic matching scores, generates specialized agents through an LLM, and simultaneously injects them into the collaboration matrix, so that newly created agents are immediately usable with predicted collaboration priors. Third, a layered semantic matching strategy uses pre-trained sentence embeddings for fast, deterministic capability matching as a first pass, invoking LLM verification only for low-confidence cases, thereby reducing LLM routing calls by over 80\% compared to pure-LLM approaches. Experiments on mixed code, math, and question-answering suites show that WorkflowOps improves end-to-end pass rates over recent workflow-construction baselines, with the largest gains on structured, decomposable tasks where past agent handoff patterns transfer.

AI.tldr: WorkflowOps是一个多智能体工作流编排框架，通过从历史工作流中学习智能体协作先验，并按需扩展智能体池，以提升复杂知识工作的端到端通过率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统的编排层大多"无记忆"：每个新任务都从零开始分解、分配和执行，无法利用以往成功执行的经验，导致重复劳动和效率损失。
AI.method: 提出三个耦合机制：(1)转移概率矩阵，从历史工作流捕获智能体间协作频率，通过层内排序优化、概率阈值化边建议及传递约简最大化并行度；(2)充分性驱动的智能体创建循环，通过语义匹配分数检测能力缺口，用LLM生成专用智能体并注入协作矩阵；(3)分层语义匹配策略，先用预训练句向量做快速确定匹配，仅对低置信度情况调用LLM验证。
AI.result: 在代码、数学和问答混合测试集上，WorkflowOps相比近期工作流构建基线提升了端到端通过率，在结构化、可分解任务上提升最大；相比纯LLM方案，LLM路由调用减少超过80%。
AI.conclusion: 历史协作先验可有效迁移至新任务的工作流构建，按需扩展智能体池与分层匹配策略能显著提升多智能体编排的效率与性能。

title: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding for Privacy-Friendly AIoT
summary: Image Bitstream Fine-grained Understanding (IBFU) aims to directly perform fine-grained classification and semantic description generation from encoded image byte sequences. In contrast to conventional pixel-domain visual understanding, IBFU conducts semantic analysis without fully decoding images into the pixel domain. Since pixel-level visual content is not explicitly reconstructed during inference, this paradigm reduces visual exposure within the processing pipeline and suits privacy-friendly Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT) applications. In this paper, we propose Bitstream Fine-grained Generator (BFG), a novel foundation model tailored for IBFU. BFG consists of two main components: a Bitstream Semantic Encoder (BSeE) and a Fine-grained Semantic Generator (FSeG). BSeE directly models semantic representations from encoded image bitstreams without explicit pixel reconstruction, while FSeG transforms the extracted bitstream semantics into detailed natural-language descriptions through autoregressive generation. To train BFG and comprehensively evaluate IBFU in practical AIoT scenarios, where image bitstreams may suffer corruption during transmission and storage, we construct a large-scale Corrupted-bitstream Fine-grained Understanding dataset (CFU-D), containing both intact bitstreams and corrupted variants across multiple corruption types and severity levels. Experiments show that BFG maintains stable fine-grained caption generation under bitstream corruption. For example, the performance only has slight change from 0.6339 to 0.6077 in terms of average CIDEr score on Stanford Dogs Caption dataset, while vision-language models, such as Qwen-VL-Chat, BLIP-2, GLM, Gemini, and GPT suffer severe performance decrease. This paper provides a practical paradigm for privacy-friendly fine-grained understanding in AIoT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图像比特流细粒度理解（IBFU）任务与基础模型BFG，直接从未完全解码的编码比特流中生成细粒度语义描述，兼顾隐私保护与抗比特流损坏能力。
AI.motivation: 传统像素域视觉理解需完整解码图像，增加视觉内容在流水线中的暴露风险，不适合隐私敏感的AIoT场景；且实际传输与存储中比特流易受损，现有视觉语言模型在该条件下性能严重下降。因此需要一种直接在比特流域进行语义分析、且对损坏鲁棒的方案。
AI.method: 提出基础模型BFG，包含两部分：比特流语义编码器（BSeE）直接对编码图像比特流建模语义表示，无需显式像素重建；细粒度语义生成器（FSeG）通过自回归生成将比特流语义转换为详细自然语言描述。同时构建大规模损坏比特流细粒度理解数据集CFU-D，涵盖完整比特流及多种损坏类型与严重程度的变体，用于训练与评测。
AI.result: BFG在比特流损坏下保持稳定的细粒度描述生成能力。在Stanford Dogs Caption数据集上，平均CIDEr仅从0.6339轻微变化至0.6077；而Qwen-VL-Chat、BLIP-2、GLM、Gemini、GPT等视觉语言模型性能严重下降。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为AIoT中隐私友好的细粒度理解提供了可行范式，验证了直接比特流域语义分析的鲁棒性与实用价值。

title: Complementary Feature Domains: Information Preservation Does Not Imply Predictive-Contribution Preservation
summary: Complementary Feature Domains (CFD) theory characterizes predictive value as a context-indexed contribution system induced jointly by representations and their realization family. We show that Shannon-information preservation does not imply preservation of this contribution system: an invertible representation transformation can leave target information unchanged while altering predictive contribution under a restricted decision family. We formalize the resulting transition through a CFD contribution defect that measures how contextual contributions change under controlled recoding. For bounded Lipschitz utility, we show that each coalition utility shift is bounded by the behavioral distance between the attainable action sets before and after recoding; consequently, every contextual contribution defect is bounded by the sum of the corresponding coalition incompatibilities. Exact behavioral closure yields invariance, while increasingly accurate compensation yields restoration. A controlled ECG experiment illustrates the mechanism: a nonlinear bijective recoding preserves the information in a frozen time-frequency representation but changes accuracy under a fixed affine learner; applying the exact inverse restores all tested coalition accuracies. The result separates information preservation from realization-dependent contribution and provides a quantitative transition law for multi-representation prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出互补特征域（CFD）理论，将预测价值刻画为由表示及其实现族共同诱导的、与上下文相关的贡献系统，并证明香农信息保持并不意味着该贡献系统的保持。
AI.motivation: 传统观点常将预测价值等同于信息量，但信息保持（如可逆变换）是否等价于预测贡献保持并不清楚。作者希望区分信息保持与实现相关的贡献，并给出二者转变的定量刻画。
AI.method: 形式化表示变换下的贡献变化，定义CFD贡献缺陷以度量上下文贡献在受控重编码下的改变；对有界Lipschitz效用，证明每个联盟效用偏移受重编码前后可达行动集之间行为距离的约束，进而将每个上下文贡献缺陷界定为相应联盟不相容性之和；分析精确行为闭包与补偿的两种极限。
AI.result: 每个联盟效用偏移被重编码前后可达行动集的行为距离所界定，因此每个上下文贡献缺陷被相应联盟不相容性之和所界定。精确行为闭包导致不变性，补偿越精确则恢复越充分。受控ECG实验表明：非线性双射重编码在冻结时频表示中保持信息，但在固定仿射学习器下改变准确率；施加精确逆变换可恢复所有测试联盟的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将信息保持与实现相关的预测贡献明确分开，并为多表示预测提供了定量的转变规律。

title: Self-Referenced Social Preferences: Cooperation without Observing Others Rewards
summary: Social preferences can promote cooperation in multi-agent reinforcement learning, but existing approaches often require agents to observe the rewards of their peers. In many real-world interactions, however, an agent can, as humans do, observe others' behavior and outcomes without access to their private reward signals. We introduce self-referenced social preferences, in which each agent learns a model of its own reward, applies it to other agents' observed transitions to assess their outcomes from its own perspective, and feeds these self-referenced assessments into standard social preferences. We study two ways to incorporate these assessments: modifying the learning reward, or using them to weight policy updates. We evaluate the approach on three sequential social dilemmas, Escape Room, Clean Up, and Commons Harvest, which require volunteering, public-good contribution, and resource restraint, respectively. Across all three environments, agents learn cooperative behavior without observing others' rewards, including in settings where independent learners fail to cooperate, and frequently achieve more equitable divisions of jointly produced returns than agents with access to true rewards. The effective integration point depends on the social preference: inequity aversion works best in the reward together with a value look-ahead, whereas a purely benevolent preference benefits from policy-update weighting. Under partial observability, the policy-update approach continues to support cooperation. These results show that explicit access to other agents' reward signals is not necessary for learning cooperative behavior: social preferences can instead be grounded in self-referenced assessments of others' outcomes derived from their observed behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"自参照社会偏好"方法，让智能体无需观察同伴的私有奖励信号，仅通过自身奖励模型评估他人行为结果，从而在多智能体强化学习中习得合作行为。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体强化学习中，社会偏好虽能促进合作，但通常要求智能体观察同伴的奖励，这在许多现实交互中难以实现。作者希望模拟人类仅凭观察他人行为与结果即可形成社会偏好的能力，摆脱对他人私有奖励信号的依赖。
AI.method: 提出"自参照社会偏好"：每个智能体学习自己的奖励模型，并将其应用于其他智能体观察到的状态转移，从自身视角评估他人结果，再把这些自参照评估输入标准社会偏好中。研究两种整合方式：一是修改学习奖励，二是用于加权策略更新。
AI.result: 在Escape Room、Clean Up和Commons Harvest三个序贯社会困境中，智能体在不观察他人奖励的情况下均学会了合作行为，包括独立学习失败的情境，且往往比能获取真实奖励的智能体实现更公平的联合收益分配。整合方式依社会偏好而异：不公平厌恶在"奖励+价值前瞻"中效果最佳，而纯粹利他偏好更适合策略更新加权。在部分可观测下，策略更新方法仍能维持合作。
AI.conclusion: 显式获取其他智能体的奖励信号并非学习合作行为的必要条件；社会偏好可以建立在对他人观察行为所得结果的自参照评估之上。

title: Ariadne's Thread of LipSync: Unraveling Forgeries via Inconsistency between Lip Motions and Head Poses
summary: Recent advances in LipSync generation technology have led to the creation of highly realistic videos, posing severe societal risks. However, existing defense strategies struggle against LipSync forgeries, as advanced LipSync generation methods not only achieve better lip synchronization but also eliminate visual artifacts. An important reason is that they overlook an inherent biological coupling between lip movements and head poses in natural speech videos. In this paper, we propose LipDA, a novel framework for joint LipSync Detection and Attribution, which takes advantage of the inconsistency between head and lip. For detection, the framework learns to quantify this discrepancy by contrasting lip and pose features from authentic versus forged videos. For attribution, our method is designed to capture the unique temporal dynamics and audio-visual synchronization patterns that act as the fingerprint of models, enabling source tracing. We conduct extensive experiments on two challenging LipSync datasets as well as our own proposed large-scale and multi-generator dataset. LipDA achieves over 97\% AUC in detection and 97.5\% accuracy in model attribution, significantly outperforming existing methods. Code and the proposed LipSync-A dataset are available at https://github.com/AnsonShe/LipDA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LipDA框架，利用自然说话视频中唇部运动与头部姿态之间的生物耦合关系的不一致性，实现LipSync伪造的联合检测与溯源归因，检测AUC超97%、归因准确率达97.5%。
AI.motivation: LipSync生成技术日益成熟，生成的伪造视频高度逼真，带来严重社会风险；而现有防御方法难以应对，因为先进生成方法在提升唇同步的同时消除了视觉伪影，导致传统线索失效。作者指出这些方法忽视了自然语音视频中唇部运动与头部姿态之间固有的生物耦合关系。
AI.method: 提出LipDA框架，进行联合的LipSync检测与归因。检测方面，通过对比真实视频与伪造视频中的唇部特征与姿态特征，学习量化二者之间的不一致性。归因方面，通过捕捉各生成模型独特的时间动态和音视频同步模式作为模型指纹，实现来源溯源。
AI.result: 在两个具有挑战性的LipSync数据集以及作者自建的大规模、多生成器数据集上进行广泛实验，LipDA在检测任务上AUC超过97%，在模型归因任务上准确率达97.5%，显著优于现有方法。代码与所提出的LipSync-A数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: 利用唇部与头部姿态之间的生物耦合不一致性，可有效突破现有防御方法在视觉伪影消失后失效的困境，为LipSync伪造的检测与来源溯源提供统一且高性能的解决方案。

title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Atmospheric Rivers in GraphCast
summary: While AI weather models now rival operational forecasts, how they represent the atmosphere internally remains an open question: feature attribution reveals which input patterns matter, not what the model computes or how it combines information internally. We train sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on GraphCast to uncover its learned concepts, using atmospheric rivers as our phenomenon of focus. Both standard and Matryoshka SAEs show GraphCast computes atmospheric river intensity, measured by integrated vapor transport (IVT), as a stable internal variable, despite IVT being neither an input nor a target. In contrast to the unstructured concept retrieval of the standard SAE, the Matryoshka SAE orders concepts by importance and exposes their relations. Atmospheric river concepts persist across depth and direct interventions confirm causality. This method offers a way to find internal variables and determine which of them the model actually relies on, which is a prerequisite for asking whether those variables remain meaningful as the phenomenon changes under a warming climate.

AI.tldr: 该论文在GraphCast上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），发现模型内部自发计算了"大气河强度"（以IVT衡量）这一稳定内部变量，尽管IVT既非输入也非预测目标，并通过干预实验确认其因果作用。
AI.motivation: AI天气模型预报能力已接近业务模式，但其内部如何表征大气仍是未解问题。特征归因只能揭示哪些输入模式重要，无法说明模型在内部计算了什么、如何组合信息。因此需要一种方法揭示模型的内部概念与变量。
AI.method: 在GraphCast上训练稀疏自编码器（SAE），包括标准SAE与Matryoshka SAE，以大气河为研究对象，用于提取模型学到的概念。Matryoshka SAE可按重要性对概念排序并揭示概念间关系；同时进行干预实验以检验因果性。
AI.result: 两种SAE均显示GraphCast将大气河强度（用积分水汽输送IVT度量）作为稳定的内部变量进行计算，尽管IVT既不是输入也不是预测目标。Matryoshka SAE相比标准SAE的无结构概念检索，能按重要性组织概念并展示其关系。大气河概念在模型各层深度中持续存在，干预实验确认了其因果作用。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提供了一种发现模型内部变量并确定模型实际依赖哪些变量的途径。这是进一步追问这些变量在气候变暖导致现象变化时是否仍有意义的前提条件。

title: ShanLiangRen: A Nutrition Agent for Personalized Daily Meal Planning
summary: Dietary nutrition planning plays an important role in chronic disease management and maintaining a healthy body. In applications, it must simultaneously satisfy personalized constraints and reasonable multidimensional nutritional goals. These two aspects often conflict, and user constraints evolve with feedback, resulting in a substantial gap between generic guidelines and executable plans. To bridge this gap, we first propose the personalized fully quantified multiobjective dietary planning problem (MDP). To tackle MDP, we develop a nutrition agent, ShanLiangRen. The system first transforms dietary specifications, nutrient data, user attributes and natural language requirements into an individualized constrained planning instance. It then employs an exact retrieval-augmented generation method to shrink the feasible candidate set from a large scale ingredient and recipe space. Finally, it adopts a refinement guided by Pareto principles, where an LLM iteratively revises candidate plans under deterministic nutrition computation and feedback from constraint verification. The system outputs fully quantified meal plans with explicit ingredients and portion sizes, together with reports on nutrition compliance that show constraint satisfaction and nutrient interval attainment. We have released the system online as a WeChat Program, ShanLiangRen. A demo video is available at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=652OtY5VlGA.

AI.tldr: 该文提出个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP），并构建营养智能体ShanLiangRen，通过约束规划建模、精确检索增强生成与Pareto原则引导的LLM迭代优化，输出全量化餐食方案及营养合规报告，并已上线微信小程序。
AI.motivation: 膳食营养规划在慢性病管理和健康维持中至关重要，但应用中需同时满足个性化约束与多维度营养目标，二者常相互冲突；且用户约束会随反馈动态变化，导致通用指南与实际可执行方案之间存在显著差距。
AI.method: 首先形式化定义个性化全量化多目标膳食规划问题（MDP）；构建营养智能体ShanLiangRen：将膳食规格、营养数据、用户属性与自然语言需求转化为个性化约束规划实例；采用精确检索增强生成方法从大规模食材与食谱空间中缩减可行候选集；最后采用Pareto原则引导的细化流程，由LLM在确定性营养计算与约束验证反馈下迭代修订候选方案。
AI.result: 系统输出包含明确食材与分量的全量化餐食方案，并附带营养合规报告，展示约束满足情况与营养区间达成度；系统已作为微信小程序ShanLiangRen在线发布，并提供演示视频。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过问题形式化、约束建模、检索缩减与Pareto引导的LLM迭代优化，弥合了通用营养指南与可执行个性化膳食方案之间的差距，并实现了可在线使用的落地系统。

title: From the Drosophila Visual Connectome to General-Purpose Computer Vision
summary: Biological connectomes encode structured solutions to visual computation that may provide reusable inductive biases for artificial vision. We develop ConnectomeX around FlyVision, a trainable architecture that preserves parallel ON/OFF processing, recurrent computation and population-level graph interaction while scaling model capacity across tasks. FlyVision reached 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters and 78.03% on CIFAR-10 with 81,408 parameters. On ImageNet-1K, FlyVision Base and Large reached 60.79% and 66.25% top-1 accuracy with 1.8 and 3.7 million parameters, while a Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch reached 66.53%, compared with 69.25% for ResNet18 with 11.7 million parameters. On a 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large achieved 63.78% accuracy and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.99 million parameters. In four-class chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reached 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, compared with 91.56% for ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 with 11.18 million. BrainAGE extends FlyVision to volumetric T1-weighted MRI by applying a shared ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder to 24 sagittal, coronal and axial slices per scan and combining slice-level age estimates by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting. On 433 held-out scans, three-axis fusion achieved a mean absolute error of 5.98 years and R^2 = 0.868. Across the 224x224 classification tasks, the best FlyVision configuration remained within three percentage points of ResNet18 on ImageNet-1K and skin-disease classification and exceeded it on chest radiography with substantially fewer parameters. These results show that a conserved connectome-informed computation can scale from compact recognition to large-scale natural and biomedical vision.

AI.tldr: ConnectomeX围绕FlyVision构建，一种保留果蝇视觉平行ON/OFF处理、循环计算和群体图交互的可训练架构，并在分类与医学影像任务上以更少参数取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 生物连接组编码了结构化的视觉计算方案，可能为人工视觉提供可复用的归纳偏置；作者希望把这一连接组启发的计算从紧凑识别扩展到大规模自然与生物医学视觉任务。
AI.method: 基于FlyVision设计可训练架构，保留平行ON/OFF通路、循环计算与群体级图交互，并通过不同规模（Base/Large、local-k7、低频分支）扩展容量。BrainAGE将共享的ImageNet预训练FlyVision Large编码器应用于每例扫描的24张矢状、冠状与轴状切片，并用置信度调制的Gaussian投票融合切片级年龄估计。
AI.result: MNIST达99.34%（80,608参数），CIFAR-10达78.03%（81,408参数）；ImageNet-1K上Base和Large分别达60.79%与66.25% top-1（1.8M与3.7M参数），Large local-k7加低频分支达66.53%，ResNet18为69.25%（11.7M参数）。22类皮肤病基准上Large达63.78%准确率与95.28% macro-AUROC（2.99M参数）；四类胸片，ImageNet预训练Base与Large分别达92.60%与92.76%（1.33M与2.97M参数），对比ResNet18的91.56%（11.18M参数）。BrainAGE在433例留出扫描上三轴融合MAE为5.98年、R²=0.868。
AI.conclusion: 在224×224分类任务中，最佳FlyVision配置在ImageNet-1K与皮肤病分类上距ResNet18不超过三个百分点，并在胸片任务上以远少参数超越它，表明保守的连接组启发计算可从紧凑识别扩展到大规模自然与生物医学视觉。

title: Hub for Outliers, Spokes for Inliers: Uniform Latent Space Construction for Dual-Mismatched Semi-Supervised Learning
comment: Equal contribution by Li Yuan and Yaxin Hou. Corresponding author: Yuheng Jia. Emails: {yuan-li,yaxin,230259148,yhjia}@seu.edu.cn, gaoyb@qlu.edu.cn. 18 pages
summary: Semi-supervised learning typically assumes that labeled and unlabeled data share an identical class distribution and label space. However, this setting is often violated: unlabeled data may be imbalanced and contain unknown class samples, causing mismatches in both class distribution and label space. Such dual mismatch leads to majority classes dominating the latent space and unknown class samples being overconfidently misclassified, degrading feature discriminability and pseudo-label quality. To address this, we propose a hub-spoke latent geometry, where known classes are uniformly distributed around a central hub and each class forms compact clusters around its prototype, while the hub provides an anchor for a low-evidence region specifically designed for high-uncertainty unknown class samples. Integrated with an evidence-based classifier, this geometry ultimately enhances feature discriminability and uncertainty separation by mitigating majority-class domination through structured feature organization and guiding high-uncertainty unknown class samples toward the hub. Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with a maximum improvement of 3.25% across various settings.

AI.tldr: 提出hub-spoke潜在几何结构解决半监督学习中类分布与标签空间的双重不匹配问题，实验提升最高3.25%。
AI.motivation: 半监督学习通常假设有标签与无标签数据共享相同类分布和标签空间，但现实中无标签数据可能不平衡且含未知类样本，导致类分布与标签空间双重不匹配，使多数类主导潜在空间、未知类样本被过度自信误分类，降低特征判别性与伪标签质量。
AI.method: 提出hub-spoke潜在几何：已知类均匀分布在中心hub周围，每类围绕其原型形成紧凑簇，hub为高不确定性未知类样本提供低证据区域锚点；结合基于证据的分类器。
AI.result: 在多种设置下超越现有最优方法，最大提升3.25%。
AI.conclusion: 该几何结构通过结构化特征组织缓解多数类主导，并将高不确定性未知类样本引导至hub，从而提升特征判别性与不确定性分离能力。

title: Textual Environmental Context and Spatial Graphs for LLM-Based Regional SST Forecasting
summary: Sea surface temperature (SST) forecasting depends on local temporal persistence, regional spatial dependence, and environmental conditions that evolve with the forecast date. We study how these heterogeneous conditions can be presented to a large language model (LLM) for regional multi-step forecasting without serializing the full SST grid as text. We formulate forecasting as conditional numerical generation: historical SST and anomaly sequences, date-aligned environmental records, and static ocean knowledge form a textual context, while regional spatial state is supplied through continuous graph-derived prefixes. A static graph encodes persistent geographic--climatological relations, and a dynamic graph encodes recent SST correlations and localized tropical-cyclone influence. Two graph neural networks produce a target-node representation that is mapped by a spatial-prefix fusion and injected into the LLM input. On SST forecasting in the South China Sea, the complete configuration achieves the best MAE and $\Rtwo$ among the compared methods over ten forecast steps. Alongside the numerical forecast, a rule-based module matches predicted trends and environmental-factor directions with knowledge entries to return source-linked, post-hoc contextual explanations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种图前缀增强的大语言模型框架，用于区域多步海表温度（SST）预报：将历史SST与异常序列、日期对齐的环境记录及静态海洋知识编码为文本上下文，并通过连续图派生前缀注入区域空间状态，避免整网格文本序列化。在南海SST预报的十个预测步上取得最优MAE与R²，并附规则库生成可溯源的事后解释。
AI.motivation: SST预报受局部时间持续性、区域空间依赖与环境条件随预报日期演变的影响，这些异质条件难以直接融入预测模型。同时，将完整SST网格序列化为文本交给大语言模型成本高、信息损失大，因此需要一种既能利用LLM的数值推理能力、又能有效注入区域空间结构的条件性数值生成方案。
AI.method: 将预报建模为条件数值生成：文本上下文由历史SST与异常序列、日期对齐的环境记录及静态海洋知识构成；区域空间状态以连续图派生前缀形式提供。构建静态图（持久的地理—气候关系）与动态图（近期SST相关性与局地热带气旋影响），由两个图神经网络生成目标节点表示，经空间前缀融合后注入LLM输入。另设规则模块将预测趋势与环境因子方向与知识条目匹配，输出带来源链接的事后情境解释。
AI.result: 在南海SST预报任务中，完整配置在十个预测步上相较于对比方法取得最佳MAE与R²；规则模块可返回带来源链接的事后情境解释。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，异构条件（时间、空间、环境、知识）可以通过文本上下文与图前缀的混合方式有效馈入LLM，实现区域多步SST预报，并在精度上优于对比方法，同时兼顾可解释性，为海洋环境数值预报与语言模型结合提供了可行路径。

title: Deformable CT-US Registration via Anatomy-Aware Implicit Neural Representations
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Advances in Simplifying Medical UltraSound (ASMUS 2026), held with MICCAI 2026; to appear in Springer LNCS 17276 (MICCAI 2026 Workshops and Challenges). Open-access camera-ready: https://papers.miccai.org/miccai-2026-sat/ASMUS_047.html
summary: Slice-to-volume registration between ultrasound (US) and preoperative computed tomography (CT) imaging would enhance many minimally invasive interventions, for example by locating soft tissue structures intra-operatively that are discernible in CT. While optical tracking enables initial rigid registration, contact from the probe induces soft tissue deformations that inhibit accurate alignment. In this work, we introduce a deformable CT-ultrasound registration framework that incorporates anatomical priors derived from CT to improve registration under deformation. Rigid registration is first established using a robot-assisted optical tracking system, after which a deformable transformation is estimated using a sinusoidal implicit neural representation (SIREN) optimized per frame. Tissue stiffness is approximated from CT-based HU values and used as spatially varying regularization, suppressing deformation in rigid structures such as bone while allowing more flexibility in soft tissue. Two additional constraints capture the physics of probe contact: a contact-zone displacement prior that drives the displacement field to compress tissue below the probe face, and a fan-geometry regularization term based on beam direction and convex transducer field of view. Model parameters are optimized with a normalized gradient field (NGF). The proposed approach improves alignment over rigid initialisation by 17% and outperforms classical deformable baselines while maintaining near-zero topological folding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合CT解剖先验的可形变CT-超声配准框架，利用SIREN隐式神经表示、基于HU值的组织刚度正则化及探针接触物理约束，在机器人辅助初始刚性配准基础上将配准精度提升17%，并保持近零拓扑折叠。
AI.motivation: 在微创介入中，将术中超声与术前CT配准有助于定位CT中可见的软组织。虽然光学追踪可实现初始刚性配准，但探针接触引起的软组织形变会破坏对齐精度，因此需要引入可形变配准方法。
AI.method: 先用机器人辅助光学追踪系统完成刚性配准；再用正弦隐式神经表示（SIREN）逐帧估计可形变变换。由CT的HU值近似组织刚度，作为空间变化正则化（骨骼刚性、软组织柔性）；并加入两个探针接触物理约束——接触区位移先验（使探针面下方组织压缩）与基于波束方向和凸阵探头视野的扇形几何正则项。模型参数以归一化梯度场（NGF）优化。
AI.result: 相比刚性初始化，配准对齐提升17%，优于经典可形变基线方法，同时保持近零的拓扑折叠。
AI.conclusion: 融合CT解剖先验与探针接触物理约束的可形变CT-超声配准框架能有效提升配准精度并保持良好拓扑性质，具有应用于微创介入的潜力。

title: AFA-BANDIT: Provably Near-Optimal Online Multi-Feature Classification Under Budget Constraints
summary: Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) is a classification problem in which an agent decides which costly features to acquire before predicting each sample's label. Unlike batch AFA, which trains a fixed policy and classifier offline on fully observed data, online AFA updates its predictor from revealed labels as samples arrive. Existing online methods either use deep reinforcement learning (RL) without performance guarantees or maximize cost-adjusted reward rather than enforce a global budget. We formulate online AFA as a combinatorial Bandits with Knapsacks (BwK) problem that couples acquisition and prediction. Unlike prior bandit-based AFA and classical BwK, our setting has combinatorial complexity, evolving rewards, a global budget, and structured side information. We obtain an improved regret upper bound over standard BwK bounds in this framework, leveraging a cardinality-aware confidence bound and the subset update structure. To avoid an exponentially large action space, we propose \emph{LP-Chain}, a variant that searches a cost-aware chain of feature subsets with a size that grows linearly with the number of features. While the regret upper bound is specific to the combinatorial framework, \emph{LP-Chain} empirically achieves comparable predictive performance. On synthetic data, \emph{LP-Chain} outperforms HEDGE-based BwK and deep RL-based online AFA baselines and scales favorably to more features.

AI.tldr: 本文将在线主动特征获取（AFA）建模为组合式带背包的赌博机（BwK）问题，联合优化特征获取与预测，提出改进遗憾上界及可扩展的 LP-Chain 算法。
AI.motivation: 在线 AFA 需在样本到达时利用揭示的标签更新预测器，但现有方法或缺乏性能保证（深度强化学习），或仅最大化成本调整收益而未强制全局预算约束。
AI.method: 将在线 AFA 形式化为组合 BwK 问题，刻画其组合复杂性、奖励动态变化、全局预算与结构化边信息；利用基数感知置信界与子集更新结构推导遗憾上界；为避免指数级动作空间，提出 LP-Chain，在随特征数线性增长的代价感知特征子集链上搜索。
AI.result: 在该框架下获得优于标准 BwK 界限的遗憾上界；LP-Chain 在合成数据上预测性能与基线相当，并优于 HEDGE 型 BwK 与基于深度强化学习的在线 AFA 基线，且在特征数增加时可良好扩展。
AI.conclusion: 将在线 AFA 归约为组合 BwK，可同时获得理论性能保证与实用的可扩展算法，LP-Chain 在实践中表现优异。

title: Isotropic Yet Undecodable: The Sequential Content-Sufficiency Gap in Latent-Predictive Text Representations
summary: We study sequential content sufficiency by investigating whether a representation retains the ordered target information available in its input. An information-theoretic decomposition separates input ambiguity, representation loss, and readout mismatch. We construct recoverable views where perfect agreement and joint isotropic Gaussianity coexist with zero target information, and establish limits imposed by deterministic canonical anchors. Token log-loss provides a one-sided information-loss bound; a fixed-penalty ridge analysis shows why rank alone cannot determine prediction risk. These results motivate CANOPE, a nonautoregressive framework with ordered latent canvases, canonical-token supervision, and geometric regularization. On 40,000 validation sequences, latent-agreement (PL0) and token-grounded (PL2) have nearly identical pooled ranks but reach 13.5% and 98.8% positional Recall@1, respectively, under strong natural corruption when the correct target length is provided. On 3,930 LJSpeech validation utterances, frozen PL2 with a trained MatchaTTS readout yields 21.54% word error rate (WER) on corrupted text, versus 99.22% for frozen PL0, while end-to-end MatchaTTS reaches 10.93%. These results show that geometric regularity alone does not guarantee recoverable sequential content or effective downstream access in the text settings studied here.

AI.tldr: 本文研究序列内容充分性，即表示是否保留输入中的有序目标信息，并用信息论分解将其分为输入歧义、表示损失与读出失配三部分。作者构造可恢复视图说明完美一致性与联合各向同性高斯性可与零目标信息共存，并提出CANOPE框架；实验显示几何规律性本身不足以保证可恢复的序列内容或有效的下游访问。
AI.motivation: 现有表示学习常以潜在表示之间的一致性（latent agreement）或几何规律性作为质量指标，但这些指标未必能保证表示真正保留了输入中的有序目标信息，也难以说明下游任务的可访问性。因此需要从信息论角度厘清表示充分性的来源与边界。
