AI.method: 通过信息论分解将序列内容充分性拆分为输入歧义、表示损失与读出失配；构造可恢复视图，使完美一致性与联合各向同性高斯性同时成立却零目标信息，并给出确定性规范锚点带来的限制。提出token log-loss的单侧信息损失界，并用固定惩罚岭回归分析说明仅凭秩无法决定预测风险。据此设计CANOPE：非自回归框架，包含有序潜在画布、规范token监督与几何正则化。
AI.result: 在40,000条验证序列上，当给定正确目标长度时，潜在一致性（PL0）与token落地（PL2）的合并秩几乎相同，但在强自然扰动下位置Recall@1分别为13.5%与98.8%。在3,930条LJSpeech验证语音上，冻结PL2配合训练好的MatchaTTS读出在受损文本上WER为21.54%，而冻结PL0为99.22%，端到端MatchaTTS为10.93%。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的文本设定下，几何规律性本身并不能保证可恢复的序列内容，也不能保证有效的下游访问；表示的一致性指标可能掩盖目标信息的缺失，需要结合token落地监督与读出设计来确保序列内容充分性。

title: HuC-VideoMAE: Human-Centric Video Masked Autoencoding from synthetic data
summary: Modern action recognition models rely on video transformers pretrained on massive collections of web-crawled videos, such as Kinetics-700. However, the use of such data raises ethical concerns, as subjects' consent is typically not obtained. Recent high-quality synthetic video datasets generated from motion-capture data, such as BEDLAM2.0, offer a promising ethical alternative. In this work, we investigate self-supervised pretraining of video transformers on synthetic human-motion datasets. We first show that directly applying the standard VideoMAE masking strategy leads to substantially worse performance than pretraining on Kinetics. To address this limitation, we propose a human-centric masking scheme that leverages body keypoints and person bounding box regions. Our approach encourages the model to focus on the structure and dynamics of human motion during pretraining. Experiments on NTU RGB+D and Toyota-Smarthome demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms standard VideoMAE pretraining on synthetic data, closing 49% of the gap to Kinetics pretraining on NTU RGB+D cross-view-subject without using a single real frame during pretraining. To promote the use of ethical action recognition models, we will publicly release our pretrained models.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在合成人体运动数据集上自监督预训练视频Transformer，提出以人体关键点和边界框为中心的人本掩码方案，显著提升性能并缩小与Kinetics预训练的差距。
AI.motivation: 现代动作识别模型依赖大规模网络爬取视频（如Kinetics-700）预训练，但这类数据通常未获得被拍摄者同意，存在伦理问题。近期基于动作捕捉数据生成的高质量合成视频数据集（如BEDLAM2.0）提供了有前景的伦理替代方案，但直接迁移标准预训练方法效果不佳。
AI.method: 作者首先验证标准VideoMAE掩码策略在合成数据上预训练效果远差于Kinetics预训练；随后提出一种以人为中心的掩码方案，利用人体关键点和人体边界框区域进行掩码，引导模型在预训练阶段关注人体运动的结构与动态。
AI.result: 在NTU RGB+D和Toyota-Smarthome数据集上的实验表明，该方法显著优于在合成数据上的标准VideoMAE预训练；在NTU RGB+D跨视角-跨被试设置下，预训练阶段完全不使用真实帧的情况下，将合成数据与Kinetics预训练之间的差距缩小了49%。
AI.conclusion: 以人体关键点和边界框为中心的自监督掩码可有效利用合成人体运动数据进行视频Transformer预训练，为构建符合伦理的动作识别模型提供了可行路径；作者将公开预训练模型以促进相关研究与应用。

title: Stateless Language Agents: Scaling Long-Horizon Automated Research
summary: Automated research systems increasingly run LLM agents over long horizons, but more inference does not by itself produce more progress: agents replay growing histories, duplicate one another's work, or stop experimenting while token consumption continues. Yet most evaluations use short budgets or benchmarks that saturate early, leaving these failure modes untested. We trace these failures to two choices: where research state lives and who decides what to try next. We introduce Stateless Language Agents (SLAs), built on the principle of stateful search with stateless agents: no agent carries its conversation across invocations; instead, the harness owns the research state (candidate solutions and measured outcomes) and reconstructs a fresh and role-specific context for every invocation. What each agent sees becomes an explicit design choice rather than a history that grows with the run. We implement this principle in the SLA framework, where a stateless Advisor reads harness-summarized evidence across search directions and assigns concrete experiments to parallel Workers. We evaluate SLA against three recent frameworks on software engineering, kernel optimization, and algorithm design at budgets of up to one billion tokens. SLA achieves the best final result on every task and reaches the strongest kernel baseline's final performance with over 84% fewer tokens. Ablations from shared checkpoints show that focused contexts and explicit assignments each contribute to SLA's progress, with effects that can compound over full runs, while the Advisor consumes less than 0.6% of tokens. These results argue for SLAs, which keep durable research state out of agent conversations, and show that short evaluation horizons can misjudge research systems and their components.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Stateless Language Agents（SLA）框架，通过"有状态搜索+无状态智能体"原则解决LLM自动研究系统中重复劳动、历史膨胀等问题，并在多项任务上以更少token取得更优结果。
AI.motivation: 自动化研究系统让LLM智能体进行长程推理，但更多推理并不等于更多进展：智能体会重放不断增长的历史、重复彼此的工作，或在token持续消耗时停止实验。而多数评估预算短、基准过早饱和，无法暴露这些失败模式。作者将失败归结为两个选择：研究状态存放在哪里，以及谁决定下一步尝试什么。
AI.method: 提出Stateless Language Agents（SLA），基于"有状态搜索+无状态智能体"原则：智能体调用之间不携带对话；由harness持有研究状态（候选解与测量结果），并为每次调用重建全新且角色特定的上下文。在SLA框架中实现：无状态Advisor读取harness汇总的各搜索方向证据并分配具体实验给并行的Workers。
AI.result: 在软件工程、内核优化和算法设计三类任务上，预算最高达十亿token，与三个近期框架对比：SLA在每个任务上取得最佳最终结果，并以减少84%以上的token达到最强内核基线的最终性能。从共享检查点做的消融显示，聚焦上下文与明确任务分配各自都对进展有贡献，且效果可在完整运行中累积；Advisor消耗不足0.6%的token。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持采用SLA，即将持久研究状态置于智能体对话之外；并表明短评估周期可能误判研究系统及其组件。

title: Continuous Memory Machines
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Personalized, Aligned, Long-Term Memory for AI Systems (PALM)
summary: Recurrent neural networks typically compress information into a single vector-valued recurrent state, forcing short-term computation and long-term retention to share the same representation. Past extensions alleviate this bottleneck by increasing the memory capacity or separating timescales, but lack the combination of rapid neuron-level processing and longer-term retention found in biology. To that end, we introduce the Continuous Memory Machine (CMM), a recurrent architecture with matrix-valued short- and long-term memory states serving distinct functional roles. Building on the Continuous Thought Machine (CTM), the CMM's short-term memory tracks recent neural activity, with uniquely parameterized neuron-level models learning to use these activity patterns for computation. A persistent long-term memory stores information for later use, with a Transformer jointly updating both memory stores, providing an expressive bidirectional read--write mechanism such that each store can reorganize its own contents and both read from and write to the other. Across algorithmic, in-context learning, and recurrent reasoning tasks, the CMM outperforms a broad suite of baselines, exhibiting stronger generalization than prior memory-augmented networks while preserving the CTM's interpretable attention patterns. Code is available at https://github.com/SakanaAI/continuous-memory-machines.

AI.tldr: 提出连续记忆机器（CMM），一种具有矩阵值短期和长期记忆状态的循环架构，分别承担不同功能角色，在多种任务上超越基线。
AI.motivation: 传统循环神经网络将信息压缩为单一的向量值循环状态，迫使短期计算与长期保留共享同一表征，形成瓶颈。已有扩展虽增加记忆容量或分离时间尺度，但缺乏生物学中同时具备神经元级快速处理与长期保留能力的结合。
AI.method: 基于连续思维机器（CTM）构建CMM。短期记忆跟踪近期神经活动，由独特参数化的神经元级模型学习利用这些活动模式进行计算；持久性长期记忆储存信息供后续使用。一个Transformer联合更新两个记忆库，提供富有表达力的双向读写机制，使每个记忆库能重组自身内容，且相互读取与写入。
AI.result: 在算法任务、上下文学习和循环推理任务中，CMM均优于广泛的基线方法，相比先前的记忆增强网络展现出更强的泛化能力，同时保留了CTM可解释的注意力模式。
AI.conclusion: CMM通过分离的矩阵值短期与长期记忆状态及双向读写机制，有效缓解了传统RNN的单状态瓶颈，兼顾快速神经元级处理与长期保留，并在多类任务上实现更优性能与泛化。

title: Knee3DVLM: Dual-Sequence Full-Volume Vision-Language Modeling for Comprehensive Knee MRI Assessment
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly being applied to three-dimensional medical imaging, but their application to knee MRI remains limited, particularly for interpreting the complementary sequences used in clinical practice. We introduce Knee3DVLM, a sequence-aware VLM that uses full-volume DESS and fluid-sensitive TSE MRI to predict 57 anatomically resolved binary diagnostic targets derived from the MRI Osteoarthritis Knee Score (MOAKS) for structured reporting. We evaluated DESS-only, TSE-only, and paired DESS-TSE configurations using subject-disjoint Osteoarthritis Initiative partitions. In a held-out cohort of 1,074 examinations, the fused model achieved 72.98% average accuracy, 71.17% balanced accuracy, 78.96% mean ROC-AUC, and 78.74% macro ROC-AUC, the highest values among the three configurations. In a secondary multiclass analysis aligned with the released 3DReasonKnee cohort, Knee3DVLM was numerically higher than the strongest reported 3DReasonKnee configuration across five pathology categories. These findings support dual-sequence full-volume modeling for comprehensive knee MRI assessment.

AI.tldr: 提出序列感知视觉语言模型Knee3DVLM，联合DESS与TSE全容积膝MRI预测MOAKS衍生的57个二分类诊断目标。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在三维医学影像中应用渐增，但在膝MRI领域应用有限，尤其难以处理临床中互补的多序列信息。
AI.method: 基于DESS与液体敏感TSE全容积MRI构建序列感知VLM，预测57个解剖定位的MOAKS二分类诊断目标；在受试者不重叠的OAI数据划分上比较DESS单序列、TSE单序列与DESS-TSE配对融合三种配置。
AI.result: 在1,074例留出队列中，融合模型平均准确率72.98%、平衡准确率71.17%、平均ROC-AUC 78.96%、宏平均ROC-AUC 78.74%，均为三种配置中最高；在与3DReasonKnee队列对齐的次级多分类分析中，五类病变指标数值上优于已报道的最强配置。
AI.conclusion: 双序列全容积建模有助于实现全面的膝关节MRI评估。

title: Complementary Supervised and Self-Supervised Representations for Out-of-Distribution Graph Learning
summary:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization remains challenging for graph neural networks (GNNs), as graph distributions can vary substantially across time and domains. Supervised and self-supervised graph representation learning are guided by distinct objectives and offer different perspectives on graph representations. In this work, we study whether self-supervised representations (SSL) can provide complementary signals to improve supervised OOD node classification. We develop two backbone-agnostic frameworks that exploit such information at different stages of learning and prediction. Co-Train jointly learns supervised and SSL representations and adaptively integrates them during training, while Dual-Space Retrieval performs non-parametric prediction in the two representation spaces and combines their predictions through confidence-aware fusion at inference time. The supervised and SSL encoders are separately parameterized and need not share the same GNN architecture.
  We evaluate multiple GNN backbones and two distinct SSL objectives, DGI and GRACE, on four graph benchmarks spanning temporal and cross-domain distribution shifts. Extensive experiments show that Co-Train consistently outperforms strong supervised OOD baselines, while Dual-Space Retrieval achieves competitive performance as a flexible non-parametric alternative. Results across different backbones and SSL objectives, together with representation analyses and ablations, demonstrate that SSL representations provide complementary information to supervised representations and can improve OOD node classification across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种框架（Co-Train 与 Dual-Space Retrieval），利用自监督表示（SSL）为监督式图神经网络的分布外（OOD）节点分类提供互补信号。
AI.motivation: 图分布随时间和领域变化显著，GNN 的 OOD 泛化仍具挑战。监督与自监督图表示学习目标不同、视角互补，因此探索 SSL 表示能否提升监督式 OOD 节点分类。
AI.method: 提出两种与骨干无关的框架：Co-Train 在训练中联合学习监督与 SSL 表示并自适应融合；Dual-Space Retrieval 在两个表示空间做非参数预测，并在推理时进行置信度感知融合。两个编码器独立参数化，无需共享同一 GNN 架构。
AI.result: 在四个涵盖时间与跨域分布偏移的图基准上，评估多种 GNN 骨干及 DGI、GRACE 两种 SSL 目标。Co-Train 稳定优于强监督 OOD 基线，Dual-Space Retrieval 作为灵活的非参数方案取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 跨骨干与 SSL 目标的实验结果、表示分析及消融研究表明，SSL 表示为监督表示提供互补信息，可在多种设定下改善 OOD 节点分类。

title: SIGMA: Self-Improving Alignment Generalization from a Model Spec
summary: LLM agents are increasingly capable of executing complex tasks and of recursively improving themselves on easy-to-verify objectives such as software engineering and mathematics. Since alignment is much harder to verify, this creates a growing risk of capabilities increasing without appropriate safety alignment, especially as capabilities expand to auto-research and cybersecurity. Existing approaches focus on capability self-improvement using verifiable feedback or on alignment training with supervision from stronger models or curated data, creating an external supervision bottleneck for alignment. We ask whether current models can improve their own safety alignment, and propose SIGMA, a data generation and training pipeline enabling alignment self-improvement that generalizes to out-of-distribution settings. Given only a "Model Spec" stating the model's desired behavior, SIGMA leverages a model's reasoning capabilities to strengthen its own safety reasoning. SIGMA first performs spec-guided task synthesis, using the candidate model as a task designer agent to generate diverse alignment dilemma scenarios and convert them into training tasks that stress-test its understanding of the Model Spec. Next, SIGMA conducts self-judged alignment training through supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning with the model itself as the reward model. Despite training only on single-turn chat data, SIGMA improves safety alignment in multi-turn agentic environments (AgentHarm harmfulness decreases from 22.6 to 14.8; Agentic Misalignment decreases from 79.1 to 3.8), outperforms Deliberative Alignment and Constitutional AI baselines, and retains general capability. Analyses show that a Model Spec balancing harmlessness and helpfulness, test-time reasoning for safety deliberation, and high-quality rubrics from SIGMA's task designer agent are crucial for effective self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SIGMA，一种无需外部监督的自我对齐改进数据生成与训练流程，仅凭 Model Spec 即可利用模型自身推理能力强化安全推理，并在多轮智能体场景中显著提升安全对齐且保留通用能力。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在软件工程、数学等易验证目标上可自我递归改进，但对齐目标难以验证，导致能力增长可能超过安全对齐，形成外部监督瓶颈。作者希望探索当前模型能否在无需更强模型或人工数据的外部监督下，自行改进安全对齐。
AI.method: SIGMA 只需要一份描述期望行为的 Model Spec，包含两个阶段：一是规范引导的任务合成，将候选模型作为任务设计者智能体，生成多样化的对齐困境场景并转化为压力测试任务；二是自我评判的对齐训练，通过监督微调与基于评分标准的强化学习，由模型自身充当奖励模型进行训练。
AI.result: 仅用单轮对话数据训练，SIGMA 仍提升多轮智能体环境中的安全对齐：AgentHarm 有害性从 22.6 降至 14.8，Agentic Misalignment 从 79.1 降至 3.8，优于 Deliberative Alignment 与 Constitutional AI 基线，并保留通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明，平衡无害性与有用性的 Model Spec、用于安全审议的测试时推理，以及来自任务设计者智能体的高质量评分标准，是有效自我改进的关键要素。该工作表明在缺乏外部监督的情况下，模型具备自我提升安全对齐的潜力。

title: 2D Spatial Reasoning with Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Many modern learning approaches are still struggling with spatial reasoning tasks, i.e. they lack the ability to utilize geometric information of perceived entities and their spatial relation to each other to solve problems. We introduce a novel Adaptive Neural Cellular Automata (aNCA) architecture which uses deformable convolutions to dynamically adapt the perceptive field and iteratively reason over 2D spatial relations on grid-like data structures (e.g. images). Empirical results on public benchmarks show state of the art comprehensible results with high generalization abilities for solving image based puzzles like Sudoku or finding the shortest path in a maze.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应神经细胞自动机（aNCA）架构，利用可变形卷积动态调整感受野，在类网格二维数据结构上迭代推理空间关系，在数独、迷宫最短路径等图像谜题任务上取得当前最优且可解释、泛化性强的结果。
AI.motivation: 许多现代学习方法仍难以处理空间推理任务，缺乏利用感知实体的几何信息及其相互空间关系来解决问题的能力。
AI.method: 提出一种新的自适应神经细胞自动机（aNCA）架构，采用可变形卷积动态适应感知/感受野，并在类网格的二维数据结构（如图像）上迭代地推理空间关系。
AI.result: 在公开基准上取得当前最优（state of the art）且可理解的实验结果，对图像类谜题（如数独、迷宫最短路径）具有很高的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: aNCA 通过可变形卷积实现自适应感受野与迭代空间推理，能够有效求解网格型图像谜题，兼具优异性能、可解释性与泛化性。

title: Does On-Policy Distillation for Safety Pose Backdoor Risks?
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has attracted growing attention as an effective way to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models. Recent studies further explore OPD as a tool for improving large language model safety with promising results. However, these approaches typically assume that the teacher and training data are trustworthy. In this paper, we uncover an overlooked threat to OPD for safety: a safety-aligned but backdoored teacher can propagate its hidden malicious behavior to an initially clean student. Under our threat model, a poisoning rate as low as 3% results in an attack success rate (ASR) of up to 70% on the distilled student. We further identify two training choices that can amplify this risk. First, increasing the number of training epochs can lead to high ASR even at low poisoning rates. With only 10 poisoned samples, ASR reaches 67% after 16 epochs. Second, the commonly used top-k KL can accelerate backdoor transfer, causing trigger-conditioned harmful behavior to emerge earlier than sampled-token KL in most settings. Alongside these findings, we explore a simple mitigation, Lazy Defense, which clips KL rewards to make student updates less aggressive, limiting aggressive updates and slowing backdoor learning. Experiments show that Lazy Defense delays backdoor transfer in low poisoning rate settings. Together, our findings reveal that OPD can propagate backdoors, highlighting the need to address the safety risks of OPD.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示 on-policy distillation (OPD) 用于安全对齐时的一个被忽视威胁：一个安全对齐但植入后门的教师模型能把隐藏恶意行为传给原本干净的学生模型，并发现两个放大风险的因素以及一个简单缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 近期研究将 OPD 作为提升大语言模型安全的手段并有可观效果，但这些方法通常假设教师模型和训练数据是可信的。作者要揭示这一被忽视的安全风险。
AI.method: 在设定的威胁模型下，使用安全对齐但被植入后门的教师模型对初始干净的学生模型进行 on-policy distillation。考察不同投毒率、训练轮数，以及 top-k KL 与 sampled-token KL 两种蒸馏目标的影响；并提出 Lazy Defense，通过裁剪 KL 奖励使学生更新更温和。
AI.result: 投毒率低至 3% 时，蒸馏学生模型的攻击成功率 (ASR) 可达 70%。增加训练轮数可在低投毒率下产生高 ASR：仅 10 个中毒样本，16 轮后 ASR 达 67%。常用的 top-k KL 会加速后门迁移，使触发条件有害行为在多数设置下比 sampled-token KL 更早出现。Lazy Defense 在低投毒率设置下可延缓后门迁移。
AI.conclusion: OPD 能传播后门，凸显了需要重视并解决 OPD 的安全风险。

title: Confidence Reasoning Graphs: Structured Confidence Estimation for LLM Agents
summary: When using an LLM agent in a consequential domain, making an informed decision about whether to trust its output or intervene requires calibrated confidence in the agent's success. Confidence estimation for agents is difficult because evidence about success is distributed across heterogeneous, interdependent steps of an agent's trajectory. Practical agentic deployments introduce further challenges: frontier LLMs often provide limited access to internal signals, agent roll-outs are costly, and training data may be unavailable or quickly become outdated. To address these challenges, we introduce Confidence Reasoning Graphs (CRGs), an inference-time framework that estimates the probability an agent accomplished its task from a single trajectory, without privileged model access or training data. Rather than compressing an execution into a single holistic judgment, a CRG begins with the claim that the agent accomplished its task, decomposes it into contextualized sub-claims grounded in trajectory evidence, estimates confidence for each terminal claim, and finally aggregates these into an overall confidence estimate. Across three agentic benchmarks, three backbone models, and three agent frameworks, CRGs yield better-calibrated confidence and stronger risk-aware decision making than verbalized, sampling-based, and white-box surrogate baselines. We further find that calibration error alone can be misleading: a white-box surrogate baseline appears well calibrated while providing near-chance discrimination. Ablations attribute CRG's improvements to claim-level confidence estimation and aggregation rather than graph construction alone. Finally, a CRG exposes the claims and trajectory evidence underlying each confidence estimate, enabling it to be audited at decision time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出置信推理图（CRG），一种无需特权模型访问或训练数据的推理时框架，通过将"智能体完成任务"这一主张分解为基于轨迹证据的子主张并逐级估计与聚合置信度，在多个基准与模型上实现了更好的置信校准与风险感知决策。
AI.motivation: 在关键领域使用LLM智能体时，判断是否信任其输出或进行干预需要对其成功概率有校准的置信估计。然而，成功证据分散在异质、相互依赖的轨迹步骤中；同时实际部署面临前沿LLM内部信号访问受限、roll-out成本高、训练数据不可用或迅速过时等挑战。现有方法（口语化置信、采样法、白盒代理）难以胜任。
AI.method: 提出Confidence Reasoning Graphs（CRGs），一种推理时框架：从单条轨迹估计智能体完成任务概率，无需特权模型访问或训练数据。CRG以"智能体完成了任务"为根主张，将其分解为基于轨迹证据的上下文子主张，为每个终端主张估计置信度，最后聚合为整体置信估计，而非压缩为单一整体判断。
AI.result: 在3个智能体基准、3个骨干模型和3个智能体框架上，CRG在置信校准和风险感知决策上优于口语化、基于采样和白盒代理基线。研究还发现单看校准误差可能具有误导性：一个白盒代理基线看似校准良好，但辨别力接近随机水平。消融实验表明改进来自主张级置信估计与聚合，而非仅图构建。此外CRG公开每个置信估计背后的主张与轨迹证据，可在决策时审计。
AI.conclusion: CRG为智能体置信估计提供了一种无需特权访问与训练数据、可审计且校准更优的推理时方案，并提示评估时不应仅依赖校准误差，还需结合辨别力等指标。

title: MedCORE: Criteria-Grounded Clinical Reasoning for Interpretable Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently a structured reasoning process, yet existing deep learning models often bypass this structure by mapping image features directly to disease labels without explicitly interrogating the morphological and textural criteria that clinicians systematically evaluate. This limits diagnostic transparency and may compromise safe clinical deployment. We present MedCORE (Medical Criteria-Oriented Reasoning and Evidence), a structured diagnostic framework that operationalizes clinical reasoning within a vision-language architecture. For each input image, MedCORE decomposes the diagnostic process into clinically defined criteria, spatially localizes each criterion to diagnostically relevant image regions, encodes evidence through multi-scale representations that capture macro-structural and micro-textural pathological characteristics, and refines criterion representations using a Graph Attention Network that explicitly models inter-criteria dependencies. Criterion representations are further aligned with clinical text descriptors, reinforced through class-wise visual prototypes, and aggregated using uncertainty-calibrated weighting that proportionally discounts low-confidence diagnostic evidence. MedCORE is validated across three clinically heterogeneous imaging modalities, including dermoscopic lesion classification on ISIC 2018, breast ultrasound lesion characterization on BUSI, and diabetic retinopathy grading on IDRiD. Quantitatively, MedCORE achieves 89.2% accuracy, 85.7% macro-F1, and 96.4% AUC on ISIC 2018; 96.1% accuracy, 95.2% macro-F1, and 98.4% AUC on BUSI; and 84.3% accuracy, 80.2% macro-F1, and 92.8% AUC on IDRiD. These results demonstrate consistent improvements over strong CNN, transformer, biomedical vision-language, concept-based, and prototype-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MedCORE，一个将临床结构化推理嵌入视觉-语言架构的诊断框架，通过准则分解、空间定位、多尺度证据编码与图注意力建模，在三种医学影像任务上取得了一致优于强基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型通常绕过临床诊断的结构化推理过程，直接将图像特征映射为疾病标签，未显式考察医生系统评估的形态学与纹理学准则，从而限制了诊断透明度，并可能影响临床安全部署。
AI.method: MedCORE 将诊断过程分解为临床定义的准则，对每个准则在图像上空间定位到相关区域，用多尺度表示编码宏观结构与微观纹理证据，并通过图注意力网络显式建模准则间依赖关系；同时将准则表示与临床文本描述对齐，用类别视觉原型强化，并采用不确定性校准加权聚合，按比例降低低置信度证据的影响。
AI.result: 在 ISIC 2018 上达到 89.2% 准确率、85.7% macro-F1、96.4% AUC；在 BUSI 上达到 96.1% 准确率、95.2% macro-F1、98.4% AUC；在 IDRiD 上达到 84.3% 准确率、80.2% macro-F1、92.8% AUC。结果一致优于 CNN、Transformer、生物医学视觉-语言、基于概念及基于原型的强基线。
AI.conclusion: MedCORE 通过在视觉-语言架构中操作化临床推理，实现了跨三种异质影像模态的稳定性能提升，表明结构化、准则导向且带不确定性校准的推理框架可提升医学影像诊断的透明度与效果。

title: MS-ECG-FM: Towards a More Universal Electrocardiogram Foundation Model for Health Monitoring using Multi-source Contrastive Learning
comment: Andrew C. Miller, Joseph Futoma: equal contribution. 52 pages, 4 figures, 20 tables, including supplementary information
summary: Electrocardiography (ECG) records the electrical activity of the heart, aiding diagnosis by detecting abnormalities in cardiac function. ECG foundation models have demonstrated promising results, but are limited by a reliance on ECG interpretation reports as their sole supervision. Because interpretation reports only capture the subset of waveform information routinely recognized by clinicians, this constrains representation learning to overlook the broader diagnostic signals present in ECG. We introduce a new ECG foundation model --- MS-ECG-FM --- that is trained through contrastive alignment to multiple distinct clinical note types, including ECG, echocardiography, radiology, and discharge reports. We evaluate MS-ECG-FM on an extended set of ECG detection benchmarks, showing that it comprehensively outperforms existing methods on the full span of conditions that ECG can detect, including in reduced-lead configurations. Different reports improve representations for different diagnostic domains, while multi-source alignment captures their complementary information and produces consistently strong representations across clinically diverse tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出MS-ECG-FM心电图基础模型，通过与多种临床报告（心电图、超声心动、放射、出院报告）对比对齐训练，在更广泛的心电检测基准上全面超越现有方法，并在减少导联配置下仍表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有心电图基础模型仅依赖心电图解读报告作为唯一监督信号，而解读报告只涵盖临床医生常规识别的部分波形信息，导致表示学习忽略了心电图中更广泛的诊断信号，限制了模型的诊断能力。
AI.method: 提出MS-ECG-FM心电图基础模型，通过对比对齐方式，将心电图表示与多种不同临床记录类型（心电图报告、超声心动图报告、放射报告、出院报告）进行多源对齐训练。
AI.result: 在扩展的心电检测基准上评估，MS-ECG-FM在心电图可检测的全部病症范围内全面优于现有方法，包括在减少导联配置下。不同报告改善不同诊断领域的表示，多源对齐能捕获其互补信息，并在临床多样化任务上产生稳定强健的表示。
AI.conclusion: 多源临床报告对齐能有效克服单一解读报告监督的局限，捕获互补诊断信息，使心电图基础模型在临床多样化任务上获得更全面、稳健的表示。

title: Can Agents Work for Everyone? Cross-User Reliability for Mobile GUI Agents in Personalized User Interfaces
summary: Mobile GUI agents increasingly operate on interfaces influenced by users' histories and preferences, but their reliability across different users remains underexplored. We introduce PAIR (Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering), a pipeline for constructing user-conditioned application states that enables controlled evaluation of the same task across different users. We further introduce RePAIR (Reinforcement learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards), a training approach that learns from cross-user differences in subgoal outcomes to improve reliability across user-conditioned mobile environments. Across six agents, we find substantial variation in task success across users and consistently lower subgoal achievement in user-conditioned UI contexts (6.98 to 15.4 pp). This gap further increases for personal targets drawn from each user's own content (8.77 to 22.0 pp). Failures in these contexts frequently involve selecting another item instead of the intended target, particularly before target exposure. Finally, RePAIR improves user-conditioned SAR (+5.87 pp), all-success (+7.50 pp), and overall Task SR (+9.42 pp) over its supervised fine-tuning parent on unseen users, providing initial evidence that explicitly learning from cross-user variation can improve GUI-agent reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PAIR流程构造用户条件化的应用状态以实现跨用户受控评测，并发现移动GUI智能体在个性化界面下可靠性显著下降；进一步提出RePAIR训练方法，利用跨用户子目标结果差异进行强化学习，在未见用户上提升了任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 移动GUI智能体越来越多地在受用户历史与偏好影响的界面上运行，但其在不同用户之间的可靠性尚未被充分研究。现有评测缺乏对不同用户条件下同一任务的受控比较手段。
AI.method: 提出PAIR（Personalized Application-state Instantiation and Rendering）流程，用于构造用户条件化的应用状态，从而对同一任务在不同用户间进行受控评测；提出RePAIR（Reinforcement Learning with Personalization-Aware Interaction Rewards），一种利用跨用户子目标结果差异进行学习的训练方法，以提升用户条件化移动环境中的可靠性。
AI.result: 在六种智能体上，任务成功率在不同用户间差异显著；用户条件化UI场景下的子目标达成率一致更低（下降6.98至15.4个百分点）；当目标来自用户自身内容时差距进一步扩大（8.77至22.0个百分点）。此类失败常表现为选择了其他条目而非目标条目，尤其在目标暴露之前。RePAIR相比其监督微调基线在未见用户上提升了用户条件化SAR（+5.87 pp）、all-success（+7.50 pp）和整体Task SR（+9.42 pp）。
AI.conclusion: 显式地从跨用户差异中学习可以提升GUI智能体的可靠性，为个性化移动环境下智能体的评测与训练提供了初步证据。

title: Beyond Perturbation Magnitude: Direction-Dependent Responses in Multimodal Geometric Representations
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM). 12 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables
summary: Geometric alignment scores based on Gram determinants provide a compact way to model higher-order consistency among modalities, yet how such scores respond to modality degradation is poorly understood. This paper asks whether the response of a multimodal geometric score is determined primarily by the magnitude of the perturbation-induced displacement. Using frozen cohorts from MSR-VTT (N=878) and DiDeMo (N=980), we apply controlled video blur and audio noise and analyze the response in the relational geometry on which the score is defined. Displacement magnitude explains at most 15% of the out-of-sample variance in the absolute response, and magnitude-matched pairs respond systematically differently, so scalar magnitude does not organize the response. The closed-form first-order expansion of the Gramian volume yields the Directional Geometric Response (DGR): the projection of the displacement onto the local volume gradient, which jointly captures the clean operating point, displacement magnitude, and displacement direction. The absolute first-order DGR term explains the observed response with out-of-sample R^2 of 0.838-0.969, matched-magnitude ranking accuracies of 0.864-0.963, and response-sign accuracies of 0.909-0.989, whereas the tested direction-free alternatives remain weak or unstable under the corresponding evaluation protocols. A pre-specified gain-normalization candidate, V/(g_V+eps), fails its predictability and clean-order gates. DGR uses the observed degraded-state displacement and is therefore an explanatory quantity, not a deployment-time predictor: geometric response depends on where the representation operates, how far degradation moves the relational geometry, and in which direction it moves.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态几何分数（基于Gram行列式）对模态退化的响应机制，提出方向性几何响应（DGR），证明响应由“工作点+位移幅度+位移方向”共同决定，而非仅由位移幅度决定。
AI.motivation: 基于Gram行列式的几何对齐分数虽能紧凑建模模态间高阶一致性，但其对模态退化的响应机制尚不清楚。本文追问：这种几何分数的响应是否主要由扰动引起的位移幅度决定。
AI.method: 使用MSR-VTT（N=878）和DiDeMo（N=980）的冻结队列，施加可控的视频模糊与音频噪声，分析分数所定义的关系几何的响应。通过Gramian体积的闭式一阶展开导出方向性几何响应（DGR），即位移在局部体积梯度上的投影，联合刻画干净工作点、位移幅度与位移方向。另测试一个预先设定的增益归一化候选 V/(g_V+eps)。
AI.result: 位移幅度最多只能解释绝对响应样本外方差的15%，幅度匹配的配对响应系统性不同，说明标量幅度无法组织该响应。DGR的绝对一阶项解释观测响应，样本外R²为0.838–0.969，匹配幅度排序准确率0.864–0.963，响应符号准确率0.909–0.989；而无方向的替代方案在相应评估协议下表现弱或不稳定。增益归一化候选 V/(g_V+eps) 未通过可预测性与干净序门槛。
AI.conclusion: 几何响应取决于表征在何处运作、退化将关系几何移动多远、以及朝哪个方向移动。DGR使用观测到的退化态位移，因而是解释性量而非部署时的预测器。

title: Exact-Solution Volume and Length Generalization in Transformers
summary: Research on transformer expressivity shows whether a transformer is capable of solving a given task, but gives little indication of whether the solution, if learned, is generalizable to longer input lengths. We study this question through normalized exact-solution volume (NESV): the fraction of a bounded parameter region that achieves an exact solution on every input of length $n$. For fixed-width, single-layer transformers with $\log n$-scaled attention, we establish asymptotic bounds on NESV for four tasks: FIRST ($Θ(1)$), MAJORITY ($Θ(1/(n\log n))$), INDEX ($Θ(1/n^3)$), and PARITY ($0$). These results are consistent with previous empirical results: the faster the exact-solution volume decays with input length, the harder it is to length-generalize on that task. Looking deeper into INDEX, our volume analysis reveals two error sources that grow with $n$. Consequently, we study a transformer model that would structurally eliminate one of the terms, theoretically improving the NESV bound to $Θ(n^{-1})$, and empirically achieving 85% accuracy when tested at $10\times$ the training length, compared with the 60% accuracy of the original model. We conclude that volume analysis may be a useful approach to identify concrete sources of length sensitivity and thus provide insights into task-specific model refinements.

AI.tldr: 论文提出归一化精确解体积（NESV）指标，通过渐近分析固定宽度单层Transformer在四个任务上的长度泛化能力，并识别INDEX任务的误差来源以改进模型。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer表达性研究只关注是否能解决任务，却无法说明学到的解是否能泛化到更长输入长度，因此需要一种量化长度泛化难度的方法。
AI.method: 定义NESV为在有界参数区域内、对所有长度n输入都取得精确解的参数比例。针对带log n缩放注意力的固定宽度单层Transformer，对FIRST、MAJORITY、INDEX、PARITY四个任务建立NESV渐近上下界；并对INDEX任务做体积分析以定位随n增长的误差源，进而设计结构上消除其中一项误差的Transformer模型。
AI.result: NESV渐近界分别为：FIRST为Θ(1)，MAJORITY为Θ(1/(n log n))，INDEX为Θ(1/n^3)，PARITY为0。改进模型理论上将INDEX的NESV界提升到Θ(n^{-1})，在10倍训练长度上测试准确率达85%，而原模型为60%。
AI.conclusion: NESV衰减越快，任务越难长度泛化，这与以往实证结果一致。体积分析可用于识别长度敏感性的具体来源，从而指导针对性的模型改进。

title: Learning from Revision Consequences: Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation for Self-Improving Agents
summary: As agents continuously improve by generating and revising Skills, the process that discovers and refines those Skills becomes a learnable object in its own right. Task-Skills directly act on task execution, whereas Meta-Skills govern how agents discover and improve future Skills; their value therefore emerges through the subsequent search processes they induce. Existing approaches improve Meta-Skills from observed raw Skill-search trajectories and branch outcomes. However, branch performance entangles the effects of the initial discovery state and the Meta-Skill revision that generated the search process, making it difficult to characterize what a particular revision actually changed, and pushing updates toward revisions that benefit from favorable states rather than those that improve the process. We introduce HMED (Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation), a mechanism for constructing Meta-Experience for self-improving agents. HMED revisits the completed event from which a revision originates and re-executes the incumbent and revised Meta-Skills from the same restored discovery state, so that the changes associated with the revision can be observed under a shared condition. Each comparison is distilled into a Meta-Experience, a structured record that can be reused by future updates, so that even revisions that are not ultimately retained still contribute a learning signal. Across three interactive agent benchmarks and both open-source and closed-source models, HMED consistently improves Skill discovery performance over strong baselines, shifting Meta-Skill learning beyond branch outcomes toward the consequences of changing the improvement process.

AI.tldr: 提出HMED机制，通过从相同恢复的发现状态重执行新旧Meta-Skill，将修订带来的变化蒸馏为可复用的Meta-Experience，提升自改进智能体的Skill发现性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法从原始Skill搜索轨迹和分支结果中改进Meta-Skill，但分支性能混杂了初始发现状态与Meta-Skill修订的共同影响，难以刻画某次修订究竟改变了什么，导致更新偏向受益于有利状态的修订，而非真正改进过程的修订。
AI.method: HMED（Hindsight Meta-Experience Distillation）回溯修订所源自的已完成事件，从同一恢复的发现状态重新执行旧版与修订后的Meta-Skill，使修订相关的变化在共享条件下被观察；每次对比被蒸馏为结构化的Meta-Experience记录，可供未来更新复用。
AI.result: 在三个交互式智能体基准上，使用开源与闭源模型，HMED在Skill发现性能上持续优于强基线，使Meta-Skill学习从关注分支结果转向关注改进过程本身带来的影响。
AI.conclusion: 即便未被最终保留的修订也能贡献学习信号，HMED将Meta-Skill学习推进到对改进过程后果的刻画，为自改进智能体提供了更可靠的Meta-Skill学习范式。

title: RSJEV: Discriminative Remote Sensing Scene Classification with Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Remote sensing scene classification is a fundamental task in Earth observation and geospatial analysis. Existing approaches mainly follow three paradigms: task-specific visual classification, vision-language similarity matching, and autoregressive multimodal generation. However, visual classifiers rely on predefined label spaces, CLIP-based methods perform recognition through static image-text alignment, and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) introduce unnecessary token-level generation for classification tasks with explicit candidate categories. To address these limitations, we propose RSJEV, a one-pass multimodal decision framework for remote sensing scene classification. Unlike conventional MLLMs that formulate classification as autoregressive text generation, RSJEV reformulates scene classification as a candidate-conditioned multimodal discriminative decision process, where visual representations, task instructions, and candidate category semantics are jointly modeled. Specifically, we introduce a OnePass Decider that extracts multimodal decision states and directly estimates category probabilities within the candidate category space, eliminating autoregressive decoding while preserving vision-language interactions. Extensive experiments on three widely used remote sensing scene classification benchmarks, including UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45, demonstrate that RSJEV achieves superior classification performance compared with representative CNN-, Transformer-, Mamba-, CLIP-, and MLLM-based methods. Moreover, RSJEV significantly reduces inference costs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off with only a compact 0.8B-parameter model. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of state-conditioned multimodal decision making for efficient remote sensing image understanding. The code will be available at https://github.com/Dongtcs/RSJEV.

AI.tldr: 提出RSJEV，一种单次前向的多模态判别式决策框架，将遥感场景分类从自回归文本生成重构为候选条件化的概率估计，仅用0.8B参数即在三个基准上取得更优性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感场景分类方法存在三类局限：任务专用视觉分类器依赖预定义标签空间；CLIP类方法仅做静态图文对齐；多模态大模型（MLLM）在候选类别已知的分类任务中仍进行不必要的逐token自回归生成，效率低。
AI.method: 将场景分类重新表述为候选条件化的多模态判别决策过程，联合建模视觉表示、任务指令与候选类别语义；设计OnePass Decider提取多模态决策状态，并在候选类别空间中直接估计类别概率，去除自回归解码但保留视觉-语言交互。
AI.result: 在UC Merced、AID、NWPU-RESISC45三个常用遥感场景分类基准上，性能优于代表性CNN、Transformer、Mamba、CLIP及MLLM方法；同时显著降低推理开销，以0.8B参数的小模型取得更好的精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 状态条件化的多模态决策方式对高效的遥感图像理解是有效的，为遥感场景分类提供了一条摒弃自回归生成的新范式。

title: Adaptive Model Inversion Attacks Generalize a Privacy-Robustness Tradeoff
summary:
In this paper, we show that standard evaluations of high-resolution Model Inversion Attacks (MIAs) significantly underestimate training-data privacy leakage. State-of-the-art privacy defenses, standard training techniques such as MixUp and Adversarial Training, and undefended models all leak training images at rates 1.16 to 6.59 times higher on FaceScrub under simple adaptive changes to the attack, with the largest increases among defenses reporting the strongest privacy. We further show that measured leakage depends on the feature basis of the external classifier used to evaluate reconstructions: for the same reconstructed images, an adversarially trained Inception evaluator identifies the targeted identity at different rates than the standard Inception evaluator. Our results suggest that standard MIA evaluation can mistake optimization and measurement failures for privacy.
  These underestimated leakage rates also concealed a broader relationship between privacy and adversarial robustness. Once we adapt the attack and vary the evaluator, reconstruction leakage closely tracks adversarial robustness across recent defenses and standard training regimes, suggesting that robustness provides an attack-agnostic proxy for reconstruction vulnerability that applies far more broadly than previously theorized. This raises an open question: can a practical defense reduce training-data reconstruction without paying a corresponding cost in adversarial robustness?

AI.tldr: 标准的高分辨率模型逆向攻击（MIA）评估严重低估了训练数据隐私泄露，简单的自适应攻击改动可使泄露率提高1.16至6.59倍，且泄露程度还取决于评估分类器的特征基；经修正后，隐私泄露与对抗鲁棒性呈现广泛相关性。
AI.motivation: 现有高分辨率模型逆向攻击的评估方法可能低估了真实的训练数据隐私泄露程度，导致对隐私防御效果的判断出现偏差，甚至将优化失败或测量失败误认为隐私保护成功。
AI.method: 对最先进的隐私防御、标准训练技术（如MixUp、对抗训练）以及无防御模型，在FaceScrub数据集上施加简单的自适应攻击改动；同时更换用于评估重建结果的外部分类器特征基（如对抗训练Inception评估器与标准Inception评估器对比），系统比较泄露率。
AI.result: 自适应攻击改动使泄露率提高1.16至6.59倍，且声称隐私最强的防御反而增幅最大；不同评估器对同一重建图像的识别率不同；修正评估后，重建泄露与对抗鲁棒性在近期防御和标准训练方案中高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 标准MIA评估会混淆优化/测量失败与隐私保护；对抗鲁棒性可作为重建脆弱性的攻击无关代理，适用范围比以往理论更广；由此提出开放问题：能否设计出在不牺牲对抗鲁棒性的前提下降低训练数据重建泄露的实用防御。

title: Learning in Dreams, Winning in Reality: A Continuous Dyna Loop for a Ten-Hero MOBA
comment: 15 pages, 11 figures. Code, policies, evaluation and videos: https://github.com/JordyKieto/puffermoba-dyna
summary: World models are usually judged from the inside: by prediction loss, by the return a policy earns in imagination, or by how convincing their frames look. We judge one from the outside. We learn a structured, multi-agent world model of a complete ten-hero MOBA (206 units, every hero acting every tick, games of up to 6,000 ticks), train a policy only inside it with 1,400-tick free-running imagined episodes, and measure that policy in the real game against the opponent the game ships with. The real game never provides a gradient; it provides the policy's own games as training data for the world model, and an online evaluation that selects and anchors the policy. Run as a continuous asynchronous Dyna loop, the policy wins 70.2% of real games as radiant (421 of 600; 95% CI 66.4-73.7) on seeds never used for any decision, up from 0% for dream training alone and 33.7% before the loop. It wins none as dire, and neither does the shipped opponent when it plays itself. Four findings explain the result. Model exploitation is invisible from inside the dream: every unanchored run collapsed within a few updates while no in-dream metric tracked the collapse. A world model that is accurate on its training corpus is badly wrong on the policy's own games, and Dyna repairs it there, which is worth +9.2 points of real win rate with the policy recipe held fixed. Finally, the policy inherits its world model's fidelity profile mechanic by mechanic: the model represents the macro game but not crowd control, cast timing or lethality, and the policy wins by map-wide pressure with almost no coordinated fighting. We release the world model, the dream-PPO harness, a world-model debugger, the evaluation protocol, and every policy and log.

AI.tldr: 本文从"外部"评判世界模型：构建完整十英雄MOBA的多智能体世界模型，仅在其中训练策略，再放到真实游戏中评测，最终以"光辉"方赢得70.2%的真实对局（600局中421胜，95% CI 66.4–73.7）。
AI.motivation: 以往世界模型多从内部指标（预测损失、想象回报、画面逼真度）来评判，缺乏对其"外部实用性"的检验。作者希望回答一个更根本的问题：在想象中训练出的策略，究竟能否在真实环境中（真实游戏从不提供梯度）有效获胜。
AI.method: 构建结构化、多智能体的完整十英雄MOBA世界模型（206个单位，每英雄每tick行动，对局最长6000 tick）；仅在世界模型内用1400-tick自由运行想象回合训练策略（dream-PPO）。真实游戏只提供策略自身对局作为世界模型的训练数据，并通过在线评测筛选与锚定策略，形成持续异步的Dyna循环。
AI.result: 在未用于任何决策的种子集上，策略作为"光辉"方赢得70.2%真实对局（421/600），远超仅梦境训练的0%和引入循环前的33.7%；作为"天辉"方则0%胜率，出厂对手自我对弈时亦0%。四项发现：①模型利用在梦境内部不可见，未锚定训练均在数步内崩溃且无内部指标能追踪；②世界模型在训练语料上准确却在策略自身对局上严重失准，Dyna可修复并带来+9.2个百分点真实胜率；③策略逐机制继承世界模型的保真度特征（能表征宏观大局，但不能表征控制、施法时机与致命性），故靠全图压制取胜、几乎无协同团战。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型应从外部、以真实任务表现为标准来评判；在线Dyna循环可使仅在内想象训练的策略在真实环境中具备显著竞争力，但其能力上限受世界模型保真度的机制级限制所约束。作者开源了世界模型、dream-PPO框架、世界模型调试器、评测协议以及全部策略与日志。

title: Have I Seen Enough? Frozen Video-Language Models Encode Evidence Readiness
summary: Streaming video-language models must decide not only what to answer, but whether the evidence needed for the current question has arrived. Existing systems learn that decision as a separate trigger; we ask whether an unmodified model already computes it. We show that frozen VideoLLMs carry a linearly readable evidence-readiness signal, labelled from timestamped evidence rather than from model output. It decodes in all seven models of a shared byte-identical evaluation (AUROC 0.733-0.905 under the strictest not-ready sampling, where a fitted clock is near chance), and a probe fitted without any of a benchmark family's footage still reads that family. It is question-conditioned: on byte-identical windows, changing only the question reverses the readout on 66.1% of pairs, while every question-blind control is at chance by construction. The model can answer incorrectly and still encode readiness: AUROC remains 0.722 among wrong answers. Readiness also beats uncertainty estimators and their supervised combination on latency-matched answer selection, and tracks independent human judgments more closely than confidence. Released streaming triggers are also linear readouts, yet a trained trigger read on its own base model's activations is approximately orthogonal to readiness and decodes it far less accurately than a probe. We turn the readout into Readiness Gating, an answer-timing policy that improves accuracy by up to +9.75 pp at matched video duration with negligible computational overhead. How much it gains varies with the accuracy headroom the task makes available: across 26 configurations the gain tracks that headroom, and an intervention that moves it over identical pixels moves the gain with it.

AI.tldr: 冻结的流式视频语言模型内部已线性编码"证据就绪度"信号，可被探针读出，并可用于改进回答时机。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频语言模型把"证据是否已到达"这一判断作为单独的触发器来学习，作者想探究未经改动的模型本身是否已经计算了该信号。
AI.method: 在字节完全一致的评测条件下，用基于时间戳证据（而非模型输出）标注的标签，对七个模型的冻结激活做线性探针；进行问题条件化对照、错误答案分析、与不确定性估计器比较，并将读出信号转化为 Readiness Gating 的回答时机策略。
AI.result: 就绪度信号在七个模型中均可解码（最严格的未就绪采样下 AUROC 0.733-0.905，拟合时钟近乎随机）；跨基准族仍可读出；具问题条件性（66.1% 的问题对调换后读数反转）；错误答案中 AUROC 仍达 0.722；优于不确定性估计器及人类判断追踪；其增益随任务可用准确率空间变化（26 种配置）。
AI.conclusion: 冻结 VideoLLM 已内蕴线性可读的就绪度信号，据此构建的 Readiness Gating 可在几乎无计算开销下将准确率最高提升 +9.75 个百分点，且增益取决于任务的准确率提升空间。

title: Improving Synthetic Data Generation for Argument Mining via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning
summary: Argument Mining (AM) is fundamentally constrained by the scarcity of high-quality structure-annotated datasets. While LLMs have shown promise in synthetic data generation, producing synthetic AM data that is both structurally accurate and sufficiently diverse remains a challenging problem. To address this problem, we revisit synthetic data generation for AM from a new perspective and propose a novel adversarial reinforcement learning framework for data synthesis. The proposed framework jointly optimizes the generator and the discriminator in an adversarial loop, in which the generator produces structured AM instances, and the discriminator provides learning signals by distinguishing real data from synthetic candidates. This enables the generator to progressively improve both the structural accuracy of generated argument data while maintaining diversity through adversarial feedback. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves AM performance on three benchmark datasets in both full-data and low-resource settings, validating its effectiveness and scalability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于论证挖掘数据合成的新型对抗强化学习框架，通过生成器与判别器的对抗循环，联合优化结构准确性与多样性，在三个基准数据集上均提升了全数据与低资源设定下的性能。
AI.motivation: 论证挖掘（AM）受限于高质量结构标注数据的稀缺。尽管大语言模型在合成数据生成方面显示出潜力，但生成既结构准确又足够多样的合成 AM 数据仍是一个难题。
AI.method: 作者从新视角重新审视 AM 的合成数据生成，提出一种对抗强化学习框架。该框架让生成器与判别器在对抗循环中联合优化：生成器产生结构化的 AM 实例，判别器通过区分真实数据与合成候选提供学习信号，从而使生成器在对抗反馈下逐步提升结构准确性并保持多样性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该框架在三个基准数据集上，无论是在全数据设定还是低资源设定下，都持续提升了 AM 性能，验证了其有效性与可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 该对抗强化学习框架能够有效生成结构准确且多样的合成论证数据，缓解 AM 标注数据稀缺问题，并具备良好的有效性与可扩展性。

title: Same Feedback, Different Answer: Measuring Run-to-Run Instability in Frontier-Model Customer Feedback Analysis
summary: AI agents are increasingly being programmed to automate knowledge work over large collections of unstructured data. Such automation requires repeatability: when the underlying evidence is unchanged, the agent's categories, priorities, and counts should not shift materially between runs, even if each individual answer appears plausible. We introduce a repeat-run evaluation framework that aligns semantically equivalent categories and focuses on two operating metrics: theme churn, the normalized change in the returned category set, and volume disagreement, the change in counts for categories that persist. We evaluate three recurring customer-feedback tasks across eight frontier models, corpus sizes from 100 to 5,000 records, multiple prompts, and three execution designs: raw generation, taxonomy-free hierarchical decomposition, and a taxonomy-grounded agent (TGA) using persistent themes, subthemes, and record-level predictions. With Claude Opus 4.8 and the 1,000-record corpus fixed, TGA reduces theme churn by 86--88% relative to both raw generation and hierarchical decomposition, while matched-theme volumes have zero disagreement. The taxonomy-grounded agent is more stable than every raw model in the screen, remains more stable at each corpus size, and keeps this advantage when theme matching is made stricter or looser. Although evaluated on customer feedback, the framework targets repeated synthesis of unstructured corpora more broadly, including financial reports, legal documents, incident records, and scientific literature. Overall, these results show that taxonomy grounding produces more consistent and repeatable outputs for recurring knowledge work.

AI.tldr: 论文提出重复运行评估框架，用主题变动率和数量分歧两个指标衡量AI代理在处理非结构化数据时的可重复性，并证明基于分类体系的代理（TGA）显著更稳定。
AI.motivation: AI代理被越来越多地用于自动化处理大规模非结构化数据的知识工作，这类自动化需要可重复性：当底层证据不变时，代理返回的分类、优先级和计数不应在多次运行间发生实质变化，即使单个答案看起来合理。但现有评估缺乏对重复运行一致性的衡量。
AI.method: 提出重复运行评估框架，对语义等价的类别进行对齐，并聚焦两个运行指标：主题变动率（返回类别集合的归一化变化）和数量分歧（持续存在类别的计数变化）。在三个重复性客户反馈任务上评估八个前沿模型，语料规模100至5,000条，使用多种提示词和三种执行设计：原始生成、无分类体系的层次分解，以及使用持久主题、子主题和记录级预测的基于分类体系的代理（TGA）。
AI.result: 在Claude Opus 4.8和1,000条语料固定的条件下，TGA相比原始生成和层次分解将主题变动率降低86%–88%，匹配主题的数量分歧为零。TGA比所有原始模型更稳定，在各语料规模下均保持稳定，且在主题匹配更严格或更宽松时仍保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 分类体系锚定能为重复性知识工作产生更一致、更可重复的输出。该框架虽在客户反馈上评估，但可广泛适用于金融报告、法律文件、事件记录和科学文献等非结构化语料的重复综合任务。

title: Sparse2comm: Towards Robust Cooperative 3D Object Detection
summary: Cooperative perception improves autonomous driving by sharing complementary observations among vehicles and roadside infrastructure for 3D object detection. However, practical deployment is constrained by limited bandwidth and unreliable cooperation, where packet loss, transmission delay, and spatial misalignment jointly degrade the cooperative feature stream. Existing methods often reduce communication cost or compensate for one degradation type, leaving coupled disturbances insufficiently addressed. To address this problem, we propose Sparse2comm, a bandwidth-efficient and robust cooperative 3D object detection framework that treats unreliable cooperation as progressive restoration over degraded cooperative features. Sparse Feature Encoding first encodes communication as randomly mask-sampled foreground features transmitted by collaborating agents, from which the ego vehicle reconstructs dense semantic representations. This sparse-to-dense mechanism learns to infer missing object-centric content from sparse observations, enabling ultra-low-bandwidth communication and packet-loss recovery within the same representation. On the semantically restored features, Latency-Aware Alignment predicts motion flow to compensate delayed messages, and Self-Calibrating Fusion estimates residual spatial offsets in a self-supervised manner before adaptive cross-agent fusion. Sparse2comm therefore restores semantic completeness, temporal consistency, and spatial alignment in an ordered pipeline. Extensive experiments on DAIR-V2X, OpenV2V, and V2V4Real show that Sparse2comm maintains competitive clean accuracy and consistently improves robustness under individual and mixed real-world degradations. Compared with the selective feature communication baseline Where2comm, Sparse2comm improves mixed-setting AP@0.5/AP@0.7 by +20.15/+11.79, +12.66/+11.07, and +15.36/+12.61 on the three datasets, respectively.

AI.tldr: Sparse2comm将不可靠协同感知视为对退化特征流的渐进式修复，通过稀疏特征编码、延迟感知对齐与自校准融合，实现低带宽且鲁棒的协同3D目标检测。
AI.motivation: 协同感知虽能通过车辆与路侧设施共享互补观测提升自动驾驶3D检测性能，但实际部署受限于有限带宽与不可靠协同：丢包、传输延迟与空间错位会同时退化协同特征流。现有方法通常只降低通信开销或只补偿单一退化类型，对耦合扰动处理不足。
AI.method: 提出Sparse2comm框架，把不可靠协同建模为渐进式修复流程。稀疏特征编码将通信表示为协作方发送的随机掩码采样前景特征，自车据此重建稠密语义表征，实现超低带宽通信与丢包恢复的统一表示；随后在语义修复特征上，延迟感知对齐预测运动流以补偿延迟消息，自校准融合以自监督方式估计残差空间偏移，再进行自适应跨智能体融合，依次恢复语义完整性、时序一致性与空间对齐。
AI.result: 在DAIR-V2X、OpenV2V和V2V4Real上实验表明，Sparse2comm保持有竞争力的干净精度，并在单一及混合真实退化下持续提升鲁棒性。相比选择性特征通信基线Where2comm，在混合设置下AP@0.5/AP@0.7分别提升+20.15/+11.79、+12.66/+11.07、+15.36/+12.61。
AI.conclusion: Sparse2comm通过稀疏到稠密的重建、延迟感知对齐与自校准融合的有序流水线，统一应对带宽限制与多种耦合退化，实现带宽高效且鲁棒的协同3D目标检测。

title: WASD: Wasserstein-based Knowledge Distillation for Large Language Models
summary: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) have rapidly advanced in capability, but their increasing scale comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference time. Knowledge distillation (KD) offers a practical solution by transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student model via alignment of discrete probability distributions. However, existing KD methods for LLMs primarily rely on divergences that evaluate discrepancies through probability values at each vocabulary index, without explicitly leveraging token-level semantic information. We propose Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation (WASD) for LLMs, which incorporates token-level semantic information via the Wasserstein-based distance with a cost matrix derived from token embeddings. To ensure computational tractability, we adopt the Sinkhorn divergence and derive a gradient-equivalent objective that can be efficiently optimized without introducing additional networks. Experiments across multiple LLM families and scales show that WASD consistently improves distillation performance on diverse tasks, including instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and code generation. Our results highlight the importance of semantic information encoded in the token space for effective distribution alignment in LLM distillation. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD .

AI.tldr: 本文提出WASD，一种面向大语言模型的知识蒸馏方法，通过引入基于词元嵌入的Wasserstein距离，将词元级语义信息纳入分布对齐过程，在多个模型族与规模上取得一致的蒸馏性能提升。
AI.motivation: 自回归大语言模型能力不断提升，但推理时的计算与内存开销随规模增长而显著增加。知识蒸馏可将大教师模型的知识迁移到小学生模型以降低成本，但现有LLM蒸馏方法主要依赖逐词表索引上概率值差异的散度度量，未显式利用词元级语义信息。
AI.method: 提出WASD（Wasserstein-based knowledge distillation）。其核心是采用基于Wasserstein的距离，并以词元嵌入构造代价矩阵，从而在分布对齐中融入词元级语义信息。为保证计算可行性，采用Sinkhorn散度，并推导出梯度等价的目标函数，可在不引入额外网络的情况下高效优化。
AI.result: 在多个LLM家族与不同规模模型上的实验表明，WASD在指令遵循、数学推理和代码生成等多样任务上均能稳定提升蒸馏性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了词元空间中编码的语义信息对于LLM蒸馏中有效分布对齐的重要性。实现已公开于 https://github.com/aailab-kaist/WASD 。

title: DAEDALUS: Bootstrapping Agent Memory from Self-Generated Tasks
comment: 9 pages (31 including Appendix), 8 figures (11 including Appendix). We release the code and artifacts, including generation and inference traces, at https://github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus
summary: LLM agents often lack the operational knowledge to act reliably in new environments, as they must discover specific tool behaviors or environment conventions on their own. Without memory of past attempts, they repeat the same mistakes across tasks, leading to more task failures and longer trajectories. To address this, agentic systems typically rely on human-written guidelines or on procedural memory built from training tasks and an oracle verifier, both of which require prior knowledge of the environment. We present DAEDALUS, a method for bootstrapping reusable agent memory from self-generated practice without existing tasks or oracle verifiers. DAEDALUS pairs two agents: an explorer that interacts with the environment to generate challenging yet solvable tasks, and a solver that attempts them. A heuristic is derived from each solver failure and accepted only after the solver repeatedly succeeds with that heuristic in context. These outcomes also provide feedback for the explorer to refine the difficulty of future tasks. Accepted heuristics are then consolidated into a memory bank for test-time use. Across AppWorld, $τ^2$-bench, and AutomationBench, DAEDALUS improves mean success rates by up to 15.9 points and pass^5 by up to 2.2x over a no-memory baseline, and is competitive with methods using training tasks, at a lower inference cost than most. We show that performance gains already emerge with a small exploration budget, and that its heuristics also benefit agents from other model families. Our ablations further reveal that solver traces provide the key information needed to derive effective heuristics, while factorizing early discoveries makes exploration more cost-efficient. Beyond memory construction, we find that the tasks generated by DAEDALUS can serve as a proxy for benchmark tasks when ranking models by performance. Code and artifacts: www.github.com/illuin-tech/daedalus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAEDALUS，一种无需已有任务或oracle验证器，从自生成练习中引导可复用智能体记忆的方法，通过探索者与求解器协作生成任务并提炼启发式规则，构建记忆库以提升测试时表现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在新环境中缺乏操作知识，必须自行发现工具行为或环境约定；若无过往尝试的记忆，会在不同任务中重复犯错，导致任务失败率升高、轨迹变长。现有系统依赖人工编写指南或基于训练任务和oracle验证器的过程性记忆，均需先验环境知识。
AI.method: DAEDALUS将两个智能体配对：探索者与环境交互，生成有挑战性但可解决的任务；求解器尝试这些任务。每次求解失败后导出启发式规则，仅当求解器在上下文中反复成功使用该规则后才被接受。这些结果也为探索者提供反馈以调整后续任务难度。被接受的启发式规则整合进记忆库，供测试时使用。
AI.result: 在AppWorld、τ²-bench和AutomationBench上，DAEDALUS相比无记忆基线平均成功率提升最多15.9个百分点，pass^5提升最多2.2倍，与使用训练任务的方法相当，且推理成本低于多数方法。小探索预算下即可获得性能增益，其启发式规则也能惠及其他模型家族的智能体。消融实验表明求解器轨迹是导出有效启发式的关键信息，而分解早期发现可让探索更具成本效率。此外，DAEDALUS生成的任务可作为基准任务的代理，用于按性能对模型排序。
AI.conclusion: DAEDALUS无需先验环境知识即可从自生成练习中构建可复用记忆，提升智能体在新环境中的可靠性与成功率，并具备跨模型泛化能力和较低推理成本。

title: FedDermaSeg: Federated Learning for Dermatological Image Segmentation
summary: Skin cancer is a major global health concern, and early detection and accurate lesion delineation are important for effective diagnosis and treatment planning. Automated skin lesion analysis can assist dermatologists, with lesion segmentation serving as a fundamental step in computer-aided diagnostic systems. Conventional deep learning-based segmentation models typically rely on centralized training, where images and their corresponding segmentation masks are collected on a central server. Such data aggregation raises privacy concerns in medical applications and requires substantial centralized computational resources. To address these limitations, we investigate the feasibility of federated learning for privacy-preserving skin lesion segmentation. The training and validation sets of the ISIC 2018 Skin Lesion Segmentation Challenge dataset are used to simulate a distributed learning environment and develop a federated segmentation model. The resulting model is evaluated on the ISIC 2018 test set and the PH2 dataset to assess its performance and generalizability. Experimental results demonstrate that the federated model achieves performance comparable to centralized training while consistently improving upon the locally trained models. These findings demonstrate the potential of federated learning for collaborative skin lesion segmentation without requiring centralized aggregation of medical images.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨联邦学习在皮肤病变分割中的可行性，实验表明联邦模型性能接近集中式训练，且优于本地模型，可在无需集中医学图像的情况下实现隐私保护的协作分割。
AI.motivation: 皮肤癌是全球重大健康问题，早期检测与精确病变勾画对诊断和治疗计划至关重要，病变分割是计算机辅助诊断的基础步骤。传统深度学习分割模型依赖集中式训练，需将图像和分割掩码汇集到中心服务器，这在医学应用中引发隐私问题，并需要大量集中计算资源。
AI.method: 采用 ISIC 2018 皮肤病变分割挑战赛数据集的训练集和验证集模拟分布式学习环境，开发联邦分割模型；在 ISIC 2018 测试集和 PH2 数据集上评估模型性能与泛化能力。
AI.result: 联邦模型的性能与集中式训练相当，并持续优于本地训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 联邦学习在无需集中聚合医学图像的前提下，具有实现协作式皮肤病变分割的潜力。

title: Neuromotor Hierarchy Network: Physiological Inductive Biases for Robust Generalization in sEMG Decoding
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, noninvasive interface to neuromuscular activity for movement decoding and human-computer interaction. Population-scale decoding remains difficult because the relationship between sEMG and neuromuscular activity varies across users and sessions, while task-relevant dynamics span channels and multiple timescales. Learning waveform-to-output mappings from task labels leaves the distinction between recording variability and coordinated motor activity implicit. We introduce the Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN), which learns a compact latent neuromotor state from task supervision to represent task-relevant neuromuscular coordination. NHN constructs this latent state through a hierarchy inspired by neuromotor organization.It adapts recording statistics while preserving relative intensity.Its spatiotemporal encoder uses parameter-efficient channel interactions and modulates features with multi-timescale history. The resulting features yield candidate activations of learned motor primitives, which are temporally integrated and continuously weighted to form the state. Theoretical analysis characterizes the efficiency, temporal behavior, and optimization of NHN's core mechanisms. We evaluate the architecture for both continuous hand-pose estimation on emg2pose and touch-typing recognition on emg2qwerty. On emg2pose, NHN reduces user-averaged angular error by 0.52% to 2.84% across all three generalization splits in both Regression and Tracking relative to Hadidi et al.'s best task-specific variants, using 48.42% to 48.51% fewer parameters. On emg2qwerty, NHN reduces beam-search character error rate by 19.40% zero-shot and 30.42% after fine-tuning relative to SplashNet-Upscale, using 65.86% fewer parameters. Physiology-guided inference of a latent neuromotor state supports parameter-efficient sEMG decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuromotorHierarchyNetwork(NHN)，从任务监督中学习紧凑的潜在神经运动状态，以分层结构（自适应记录统计、参数高效通道交互、多时间尺度历史调制、运动基元时序整合）建模sEMG的任务相关神经肌肉协调，实现参数高效且跨用户/跨会话泛化的解码。
AI.motivation: sEMG可穿戴、非侵入地为运动解码与人机交互提供接口，但群体规模解码困难：sEMG与神经肌肉活动的关系因用户和会话而异，任务相关动态横跨多通道与多时间尺度；而直接从任务标签学习波形到输出的映射，无法显式区分"记录变异性"与"协调运动活动"。
AI.method: 提出Neuromotor Hierarchy Network (NHN)，在任务监督下学习紧凑的潜在神经运动状态。其分层设计受神经运动组织启发：自适应记录统计同时保留相对强度；时空编码器采用参数高效的通道交互，并用多时间尺度历史调制特征；所得特征产生学习到的运动基元的候选激活，经时间整合与连续加权形成状态。并对核心机制的高效性、时间行为与优化进行理论分析。评估任务：emg2pose连续手部姿态估计，emg2qwerty触屏打字识别。
AI.result: emg2pose上，在Regression与Tracking两种设置、全部三种泛化划分下，用户平均角度误差相对Hadidi等人最优任务特定变体降低0.52%–2.84%，参数减少48.42%–48.51%。emg2qwerty上，相对SplashNet-Upscale，beam-search字符错误率零样本降低19.40%，微调后降低30.42%，参数减少65.86%。
AI.conclusion: 由生理学引导推断潜在神经运动状态，可支撑参数高效的sEMG解码；NHN在多项任务与泛化设置下同时提升精度并大幅压缩参数量，验证了显式建模神经肌肉协调表征的有效性。

title: SpeedrunBench: Challenging LLM Agents with Video Game Speedrunning
summary: Frontier LLM agents have been shown to be capable of solving increasingly complex tasks for which humans have measurable solutions. This begs the pertinent question of whether LLM agents can go beyond what humans have already solved. The ability to develop sophisticated strategies to tackle consequential problems becomes paramount as well-trodden, human-developed solutions become insufficient for problems for which we lack context or enough training data. We study agents' capability of such strategy formation through the communal practice of video game speedrunning. In speedrunning, practitioners compete to find the fastest way to complete a video game under certain conditions, and in so doing uncovering interesting unorthodox play styles that require a thorough understanding and mastery of the underlying game mechanics. We introduce SPEEDRUNBENCH, a benchmark that evaluates frontier LLM agents across 9 different games. To perform well in this benchmark, agents must repeatedly improve their strategy, reflect on their performance, exploit their gained knowledge, and reason across a long-horizon of actions to improve on an increasingly difficult problem: being faster than themselves and everyone else. Our experiments show that while frontier agents approach human world records in simple platformer games, they remain behind human performance on longer, more complex games under practical budgets. These results suggest that SPEEDRUNBENCH is a useful testbed for studying agents' strategy formation capabilities as well as being a saturation-resistant evaluation measure, as there is almost always a faster completion time waiting to be discovered.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPEEDRUNBENCH 基准，通过 9 款游戏的速通任务评估前沿 LLM 智能体的策略形成能力。
AI.motivation: 前沿 LLM 智能体已能解决人类有可测答案的复杂任务，但能否超越人类已有解法尚不明确。当缺乏背景或训练数据时，人类既有方案不足，智能体需自主形成复杂策略。速通要求深入理解并精通游戏机制、发掘非常规玩法，是研究策略形成的天然场景。
AI.method: 构建 SPEEDRUNBENCH 基准，覆盖 9 款不同游戏。智能体须反复改进策略、反思表现、利用已有知识，并在长程动作序列上推理，以求在"比自己与他人更快"这一不断变难的目标上持续提升。
AI.result: 实验中，前沿智能体在简单平台游戏中接近人类世界纪录，但在更长、更复杂的游戏上，即便在实用预算下仍落后于人类表现。
AI.conclusion: SPEEDRUNBENCH 是研究智能体策略形成能力的有效测试平台，同时因总有更快的通关时间待发现，具备抗饱和的评估特性。

title: LiDAR Resolution Recovery via Foundation-Model-Guided Diffusion
summary: High-beam-count LiDAR sensors are costly, yet many perception pipelines require dense angular sampling. Using a pretrained Stable Diffusion model as the backbone, we fine-tune a LiDAR-conditioned depth model with pseudo-depth targets from a 2D foundation model. During training, the LiDAR conditioning is randomly decimated at different beam budgets. We then investigate how much of a LiDAR scan can be recovered from heavily decimated input and characterize performance across the input beam budget. We evaluate against physically held-out real beams on nuScenes and report recovery separately from fit accuracy. Our model yields its largest advantage in very sparse regimes, achieving a $δ_{1.25}$ accuracy of $66.8$% from $4$-beam input where scattered interpolation reaches only $45.1$%. A class-stratified error breakdown further reveals that planar surfaces recover first while objects introducing depth discontinuities degrade earliest. Together, these results quantify the recovery/resolution trade-off for foundation-model-guided LiDAR enhancement.

AI.tldr: 用预训练Stable Diffusion作骨干，微调激光雷达条件深度模型，并随机抽取不同波束预算的输入，研究稀疏激光雷达扫描的恢复能力与分辨率权衡。
AI.motivation: 高线数激光雷达成本高，但许多感知流程需要密集角度采样，因此需要探索如何从高度稀疏的激光雷达输入中恢复稠密深度信息。
AI.method: 以预训练Stable Diffusion为骨干，利用二维基础模型的伪深度目标微调激光雷达条件深度模型；训练时在不同波束预算下随机抽取激光雷达条件输入；在nuScenes上对物理留出的真实波束进行评估，并将恢复与拟合精度分开报告。
AI.result: 在极稀疏条件下优势最大：4波束输入达到66.8%的δ1.25精度，而散点插值仅45.1%；按类别分层的误差分析显示平面表面最先恢复，而引入深度不连续性的物体最早退化。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了基础模型引导的激光雷达增强中的恢复/分辨率权衡。

title: Cite What You Explore: Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning over Medical KGs with Verifiable Evidence
summary: Post-discharge risk prediction from electronic health records (EHRs) is difficult because many dependencies that link discharge-time observations to downstream complications, such as comorbidity cascades and drug-disease interactions, are absent from the record. External medical knowledge graphs (KGs) can supply these missing dependencies, but tracing them demands three properties: KG exploration must remain cost-bounded, retrieved evidence must be differentiated by source quality, and the resulting rationale must be citable for retrospective review. Large language models (LLMs) can plan and verify over structured evidence, making them natural candidates for KG reasoning, but existing LLM-based methods do not satisfy these three properties jointly. In this paper, we propose BAR, a Budget-Aware LLM Reasoning framework over medical KGs with three contributions. First, BAR refines the raw KG into disease-specific evidence graphs whose edges carry support scores and provenance records, turning the KG into a quality-annotated reasoning space rather than a static feature source. Second, an LLM then reasons over this graph through a plan-navigate-verify loop that decomposes the question into steps, retrieves evidence under a patient-specific budget, and revises when verification fails. Third, a reasoning policy is trained with a reward that compares predictions with and without acquired evidence, combined with acquisition cost and citation-integrity terms. Across 8 diseases and 3 prediction horizons on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV, BAR improves AUPRC by 3.4 points over the strongest baseline, raises citation precision from 59.8% to 77.9%, and consumes only 62-65% of the budget cap.

AI.tldr: 提出BAR框架，通过预算感知的LLM推理在医疗知识图谱上实现出院后风险预测，在MIMIC数据集上提升AUPRC和引用精确度并降低预算消耗。
AI.motivation: 电子健康记录中缺少连接出院时观测与后续并发症的依赖关系（如共病级联、药物-疾病交互），而外部医疗知识图谱可补充这些依赖，但追溯需要三个特性：KG探索成本有界、检索证据按来源质量区分、推理依据可引用以供回溯审查。现有LLM方法无法同时满足这三点。
AI.method: BAR将原始KG细化为疾病特异性的证据图，边携带支持分数和来源记录；LLM通过计划-导航-验证循环在图上推理，在有患者特定预算下检索证据并在验证失败时修正；用比较有无获取证据的预测、结合获取成本和引用完整性项的奖励训练推理策略。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-III和MIMIC-IV上，8种疾病、3个预测时间跨度，BAR比最强基线AUPRC提升3.4个点，引用精确度从59.8%提升到77.9%，仅消耗预算上限的62-65%。
AI.conclusion: BAR通过预算感知的LLM推理框架，联合满足成本有界、证据质量区分和可引用追溯三特性，有效提升出院后风险预测性能。

title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) turns agent experience into learning signals primarily through scalar outcome rewards after interaction. For group-relative objectives, however, this signal vanishes when all rollouts receive the same reward, even though their trajectories may reveal useful information about what the task requires and how the agent fails. We ask a complementary question: can hindsight teach an agent what it could have anticipated before acting? We introduce prospective learning, which uses post-hoc experience to supervise foresight predictions from the pre-interaction view, and instantiate it with Self-Retrospection Distillation (SRD). Intuitively, a completed trajectory reveals knowledge that would have been useful and pitfalls that should be avoided; SRD distills this privileged hindsight into trajectory-blind foresight of the same policy. Foresight serves only as a training target and need not be explicitly generated at inference time. Across 10 tool-integrated reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks, SRD complements RLVR and self-distillation baselines with gains of up to $24.2$ pp. Its advantage is especially pronounced when reward contrast is scarce: when $37$--$98\%$ of rollout groups are reward-uniform across model scales, yet SRD can still exploit learning signal from sampled trajectories. In the 2B setting, where $98\%$ of groups are all-failure, the RLVR training ends up at $0.0\%$ success, while adding SRD reaches $60.6\%$ under the same rollout budget. Our results suggest that post-hoc agent experience is useful not only for evaluating or improving behavior, but also for shaping predictive representations before available interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出"前瞻性学习"及自省蒸馏(SRD),用事后轨迹经验监督交互前的前瞻预测,弥补组相对RLVR在奖励无对比时的信号缺失,在10个智能体任务上最高提升24.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: 组相对RLVR依赖交互后的标量结果奖励,当一组rollout奖励全部相同时,学习信号消失,而这恰恰是常见情况(37%–98%的组奖励无对比,2B设置下98%为全失败),但轨迹本身仍蕴含任务要求与失败模式的信息。
AI.method: 引入prospective learning:用事后经验监督来自交互前视角的前瞻预测。实例化为Self-Retrospection Distillation(SRD),将已完成轨迹的特权后见知识蒸馏进同一策略的"轨迹盲"前瞻预测中;前瞻仅作训练目标,推理时无需显式生成。
AI.result: 在10个工具集成推理与长时程智能体任务上,SRD优于RLVR与自蒸馏基线,最高增益24.2个百分点;奖励无对比时优势尤其明显;2B设置下98%组为全失败,纯RLVR成功率0.0%,加入SRD后达60.6%。
AI.conclusion: 事后智能体经验不仅可用于评估或改进行为,还能在交互前塑造预测性表征,为稀疏奖励对比场景提供补充学习信号。

title: Forensic Reserve: Eliciting Latent Knowledge for Image Forgery Detection
summary: As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information. However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection. To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation. Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions. Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites. Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses. Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation. Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE) 框架，将预训练模型中稀疏的、对来源敏感的内部组件视为“取证储备”，并将其定位转化为结构约束以指导轻量适配，实现高效生成图像伪造检测。
AI.motivation: 生成图像日益逼真，可靠的伪造检测对维护视觉信息信任至关重要。现有方法主要依赖任务特定监督来适配视觉基础模型表示，未能充分利用模型内部的取证知识来指导检测，存在局限。
AI.method: 首先用 Forensic Lens (F-lens) 将各层与 token 组的激活分解为独立组件，并依据真实与生成图像间的响应差异全局筛选，识别储备位点与方向；随后将这些方向映射回隐藏状态空间构建固定的储备子空间，仅在识别位点插入 Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA)；最后固定主干参数、已拟合的参考分类器与子空间基，仅训练 FRA 系数图，生成约束于对应子空间的输入相关残差更新。
AI.result: 仅用 500 张标注训练图像、可训练参数预算低于主干 0.2%，在三个检测基准上无需目标基准适配即取得有竞争力性能；在八种自监督与视觉语言预训练编码器上，均稳定优于对应的冻结检测器。
AI.conclusion: RGE 能激发预训练视觉模型中广泛共享的潜在取证能力，为生成图像伪造检测提供高效且通用的方案。

title: Adversarially Trained Linear Transformers Are Optimal Robust In-Context Learners for Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Adversarial training is one of the most reliable defenses against adversarial attacks, but its high computational cost must generally be paid anew for each task. Robust foundation models offer a promising alternative: adversarially pretrain a model once and then transfer its robustness to downstream tasks through lightweight adaptation. However, a fundamental question remains open: can robustness acquired during pretraining transfer to unseen tasks without further adversarial training? In this study, we answer this question affirmatively. A single model adversarially pretrained at scale can achieve optimal robustness on new tasks without additional task-specific training. Specifically, we show that, for a family of Gaussian-mixture classification tasks, a sufficiently deep linear transformer adversarially trained across tasks can asymptotically attain the robust Bayes error on previously unseen tasks through in-context learning from clean demonstrations. By contrast, a standardly trained model cannot. We further analyze convergence under gradient flow, an accuracy--robustness trade-off, and demonstration complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对抗预训练得到的鲁棒性是否能零样本迁移到未见任务，并在高斯混合分类任务族上给出肯定的理论证明。
AI.motivation: 对抗训练是最可靠的防御手段之一，但每个新任务都需重新付出高昂的计算代价。鲁棒基础模型提供了新思路：一次性对抗预训练后通过轻量适配迁移鲁棒性。然而，预训练获得的鲁棒性能否在不进行额外对抗训练的情况下迁移到未见任务，仍是一个未解的核心问题。
AI.method: 针对一族高斯混合分类任务，作者使用足够深的线性 Transformer，在跨任务对抗训练后，通过上下文学习（in-context learning）从干净示例中处理新任务，并在梯度流下分析收敛性、精度—鲁棒性权衡以及示例复杂度。
AI.result: 大规模对抗预训练的单一模型无需任务特定的额外训练即可在新任务上达到最优鲁棒性；具体地，充分深的线性 Transformer 可渐近达到未见任务上的鲁棒贝叶斯误差，而标准训练的模型无法做到。
AI.conclusion: 对抗预训练获得的鲁棒性可以迁移到未见任务，且无需进一步对抗训练；这为鲁棒基础模型范式的可行性与理论边界提供了支持。

title: POLAR: Ontology-Guided Risk Prevention for Tool-Calling LLM Agents
summary: LLM tool-use agents operate in dynamic environments where many actions carry operational risk. However, most safety mechanisms react only after errors manifest. Existing pre-emptive approaches either fine-tune the agent on chain-of-thought deliberation or compile natural-language guardrails into runtime checks, but they do so without exposing a structural, auditable verdict. We propose POLAR, a guardrail framework for small tool-calling agents that assesses reversibility through a structured two-layer ontology. POLAR assigns each action a graded reversibility score by deriving a candidate inverse sequence; calls failing a threshold are pruned before execution. Evaluated on $τ^2$-bench across six agent models, POLAR improves mean task reward by 0.11 to 0.18 points on airline for four of six agents, but only eight of eighteen model--domain cells improve overall; retail and stronger agents often regress. POLAR provides an auditable structural check and characterizes its task-utility trade-offs. Reward is not a direct measure of prevented harm.

AI.tldr: 提出POLAR护栏框架，通过对工具调用动作的可逆性进行两层本体结构评分，在动作执行前剪枝高风险操作，提升部分智能体的任务奖励并实现可审计的判决。
AI.motivation: LLM工具使用智能体在动态环境中执行动作时存在操作风险，但多数安全机制仅在错误发生后响应；现有预防性方法要么微调智能体进行思维链推理，要么将自然语言护栏编译为运行时检查，但都缺乏结构化、可审计的判决。
AI.method: POLAR通过结构化两层本体评估动作的可逆性，为每个动作推导候选逆操作序列并赋予分级可逆性分数；未达阈值的调用在执行前被剪枝。
AI.result: 在τ²-bench上的六个智能体模型评估中，POLAR在airline领域中使六个中的四个智能体平均任务奖励提升0.11至0.18分，但十八个模型-领域单元中仅八个整体改善，retail领域及较强智能体常出现回退。
AI.conclusion: POLAR提供了可审计的结构化检查并刻画了其任务效用权衡；但奖励并非防止伤害的直接衡量指标。

title: Stable Scores, Unstable Answers: Frame Phase and Option Order in Video Multiple-Choice Evaluation
summary: Video-language models are ranked by multiple-choice accuracy on frames from a uniform grid. The grid has two parameters, a rate and a phase, and benchmarks report only the rate. The phase moves answers: two deployed samplers differing only by a half-step phase offset answer 23.6% of questions differently while scoring within a point, and across four releases from two families shifting only the phase changes roughly one answer in five after controlling option order. PHASEFUSION decodes three offset grids and averages the option posteriors. The grids are the polyphase components of the dense grid. Fusion matches a 32-frame single pass in accuracy within a prespecified margin (logit-scored) and cuts the answers a half-step shift of all three grids changes from 18.2% to 10.1%. Option order, which changes only the presentation, is flagged instead by a one-pass answer margin. Report the phase convention with the budget, or marginalize it.

AI.tldr: 视频语言模型的评测基准只报告均匀采样网格的"采样率"而忽略"相位"，但相位会导致约五分之一的答案改变；PHASEFUSION 通过融合三个相位偏移网格的后验概率，在不增加帧数预算的情况下提升了答案稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语言模型基准通过均匀网格采帧并以选择题准确率排名，网格仅报告采样率而忽略相位参数。仅相位偏移半步的两个采样器分数几乎相同，却有 23.6% 的问题答案不同，说明评测结果对未被报告的相位高度敏感，存在评估不可复现与不公平的问题。
AI.method: PHASEFUSION 将密集网格的多个相位偏移网格视为其多相分解（polyphase）分量，解码三个偏移网格的选项后验概率并取平均；同时用单次前向的答案边际（answer margin）来标记仅影响呈现形式的选项顺序效应。
AI.result: 两个仅差半步相位的采样器答案差异达 23.6% 而分数差距在 1 分内；跨两个家族四个版本，仅改相位在控制选项顺序后约改变五分之一答案。PHASEFUSION 在预定误差范围内（logit 打分）达到与 32 帧单次前向相当的准确率，并将三网格半步偏移所改变的答案比例从 18.2% 降至 10.1%。
AI.conclusion: 相位是视频语言模型评测中被遗漏的关键变量，显著影响答案却几乎不影响分数。作者建议在报告预算时同时给出相位约定，或对相位进行边缘化处理（如 PHASEFUSION），并将保持答案稳定的能力作为评测维度。

title: TRACE: Rollout-Guided Quantization-Aware Training for FP4 Reinforcement Learning of MoE Language Models
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for post-training large language models (LLMs) incurs substantial computation and memory overhead during rollout generation, which motivates low-precision rollout for efficient RL training. However, existing FP4 RL methods suffer from a key limitation: they primarily optimize quantization accuracy on the training and rollout paths independently rather than directly reducing the discrepancy between the two quantized execution paths. In this work, we propose TRACE (Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE), an FP4 quantization framework for RL training of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models that addresses the limitation of existing FP4 RL methods. TRACE incorporates rollout-guided quantization-aware training that uses rollout-side quantization outcomes to guide training-side FP4 rounding decisions, directly reducing train-rollout discrepancy. Moreover, TRACE adopts an efficient quantization-information caching scheme that selectively retains mantissa and scale information from deeper layers to reduce the storage and communication overhead introduced by rollout guidance. We evaluate TRACE on four large-scale MoE language models across reasoning, coding, and long-horizon RL tasks. Our results demonstrate that TRACE enables joint FP4 weight/activation and FP4 KV-cache rollout with RL performance comparable to BF16 rollout, while achieving up to 5.4xrollout speedup and strong final FP4 performance compared with post-hoc FP4 quantization of BF16-trained policies.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE框架，通过训练-推演量化对齐，实现MoE大模型RL训练的FP4低精度推演，性能接近BF16且推演加速最高5.4倍。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型后训练的强化学习在推演生成阶段存在巨大计算与内存开销，低精度推演是高效RL训练的方向。但现有FP4 RL方法仅在训练路径和推演路径上各自优化量化精度，未直接缩小两条量化执行路径之间的差异，导致训练-推演不一致问题。
AI.method: 提出TRACE（Train-Rollout Quantization Alignment via Compact GuidancE），面向MoE语言模型RL训练的FP4量化框架。包含：1）推演引导的量化感知训练，用推演侧量化结果指导训练侧FP4舍入决策，直接降低训练-推演差异；2）高效的量化信息缓存方案，选择性保留深层尾数与scale信息，降低推演引导带来的存储与通信开销。
AI.result: 在四个大规模MoE语言模型上，覆盖推理、代码与长时程RL任务评估。TRACE支持FP4权重/激活与FP4 KV-cache联合推演，RL性能与BF16推演相当，推演加速最高达5.4倍，相比对BF16训练策略做事后FP4量化具有更强的最终FP4性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接对齐训练与推演两条FP4量化路径，并配合高效的量化信息缓存，TRACE在保持RL性能的同时显著降低推演开销，为MoE大模型RL训练的高效低精度推演提供了可行方案。

title: Natural Language Questions as an Interface for Knowledge Graphs: QRAKEN Graph Distillation and Semantic Self-Healing
summary: Natural-language access to RDF knowledge graphs is a core Semantic Web ambition. Large language models (LLMs) have advanced Text-to-SPARQL, yet on unfamiliar graphs they often generate valid queries that misrepresent the populated data model. QRAKEN is a training-free, ontology-agnostic neurosymbolic pipeline grounding generation in empirical graph evidence rather than schema expectations. An offline distiller produces TTQL, a compact description of populated multi-hop patterns, conditional frequencies and path-conditioned literal examples, plus a class-property co-occurrence matrix. Online, TTQL guides the LLM, while deterministic syntax, vocabulary and data-model checks provide diagnostics for iterative refinement. On CK25 (First International Text2SPARQL Challenge), under matched-condition recomputation on a QLever snapshot, QRAKEN achieves strict F1 of 0.643 $\pm$ 0.026 with GPT-4.1 mini and 0.652 $\pm$ 0.012 with GPT-5.4: relative gains of 30% and 32% over the strongest recomputed participant, outperforming systems using the same base model family. Ablations identify TTQL patterns as the dominant driver (+0.31 strict F1 over a shape-only baseline); the refinement loop provides a cheap safety net, rejecting triple patterns unsupported by the co-occurrence matrix. Compared with auto-derived SHACL, TTQL yields 64% higher strict F1, supporting the value of empirical patterns beyond schema exposure. With two local 35B 4-bit open-weight models at zero marginal cost, the same pipeline matches the strongest recomputed participant, and TTQL advantages over shape-only and SHACL baselines persist. Results on a single, relatively small benchmark provide an initial empirical signal; monolithic TTQL injection on very open cross-domain graphs remains the main limitation.

AI.tldr: QRAKEN 是一种免训练、与本体无关的神经符号流水线，通过从图中提取实证模式（TTQL）来引导 LLM 生成 SPARQL 查询，在 CK25 基准上取得显著优于同类系统的严格 F1。
AI.motivation: 自然语言访问 RDF 知识图谱是语义网的核心目标。LLM 虽推进了 Text-to-SPARQL，但在陌生图上常生成语法有效却与真实数据模型不符的查询，导致结果偏离实际填充的数据结构。
