AI.method: 方法基于实证图证据而非模式预期。离线蒸馏器生成 TTQL，紧凑描述已填充的多跳模式、条件频率、路径条件下的字面量示例及类-属性共现矩阵。在线阶段用 TTQL 引导 LLM，并通过确定性的语法、词汇和数据模型检查提供诊断，支持迭代精炼。与自动推导的 SHACL 方案不同，TTQL 强调实证模式。
AI.result: 在 CK25（首届 Text2SPARQL 挑战赛）上按匹配条件于 QLever 快照重算，QRAKEN 使用 GPT-4.1 mini 达严格 F1 0.643±0.026，GPT-5.4 达 0.652±0.012，分别比最强重算参赛者相对提升 30% 和 32%，并优于同基座模型家族的系统。消融显示 TTQL 模式为核心驱动（较仅形状基线 +0.31 严格 F1），精炼循环作为低成本安全网拒绝共现矩阵不支持的跳模式。相比自动 SHACL，TTQL 严格 F1 高 64%。两个本地 35B 4-bit 开源模型零边际成本下匹配最强重算参赛者，优势持续。
AI.conclusion: 结果在单一相对较小基准上提供初步实证信号，验证了实证模式优于单纯模式暴露的价值。主要局限是在非常开放的跨域图上，整体式 TTQL 注入仍面临挑战。

title: Selective Transfer of RL Updates for Visual Reasoning
summary: Model merging provides a training-free way to transfer reasoning capabilities from language models to vision-language models (VLMs), but endpoint-based transfer can conflate pre-existing model differences with changes acquired during reasoning post-training. We instead formulate capability transfer around the training-stage update, isolating the parameter changes induced by reinforcement learning (RL). Yet transferring this update in full remains suboptimal: we find that its components differ substantially in cross-model transferability, with dominant directions transferring more effectively than the complete update. Based on this finding, we introduce Selective-RL, which isolates the RL-stage update, retains its dominant matrix-wise directions with magnitude preservation, and transfers them to the language modules of a VLM. Across three model families and five visual-reasoning benchmarks, Selective-RL improves full-update interpolation in 12 of 15 comparisons, including an 8.55 percentage-point MathVision gain on the Qwen recipient. Matched controls show that update magnitude or arbitrary low rank alone does not reproduce these gains. These results highlight a distinction between what is acquired during post-training and what remains transferable across models, providing a training-stage perspective on cross-model capability transfer. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/selective-rl.

AI.tldr: 本文将能力迁移重新定义为训练阶段更新的迁移，提出Selective-RL方法，仅保留RL阶段更新中的主导矩阵方向并保持幅度，将其迁移到VLM的语言模块，在多个模型族和基准上优于完整更新迁移。
AI.motivation: 基于端点的迁移会混淆模型原有差异与推理后训练带来的变化，难以精确刻画能力来源，因此需要从训练阶段的角度隔离RL引起的参数更新来研究迁移性。
AI.method: 先隔离强化学习阶段的参数更新，发现其各成分的跨模型可迁移性差异显著；据此提出Selective-RL，保留该更新的主导矩阵级方向并保持幅度，迁移到VLM的语言模块。
AI.result: 在三个模型族和五个视觉推理基准上，Selective-RL在15组比较中有12组优于完整更新插值，Qwen受体上MathVision提升8.55个百分点；对照实验表明仅靠更新幅度或任意低秩无法复现该增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了后训练中"习得的内容"与"可跨模型迁移的内容"，提供了从训练阶段视角理解跨模型能力迁移的新思路。

title: Towards One-for-All Foundation Model for Attributed Graph Clustering
summary: Attributed graph clustering aims to discover node groups by jointly exploiting node attributes and graph topology, yet its unsupervised nature makes model selection and adaptation inherently difficult. Existing methods typically train and tune a separate model for each input graph, leading to costly and fragile pipelines that often fail to transfer across graphs with different feature spaces, structural patterns, and attribute-structure correlations. In this paper, we study a one-for-all alternative: can a single model be trained once and directly applied to diverse attributed graphs without graph-specific training, fine-tuning, or hyperparameter search? We propose OFAG, a foundation model for attributed graph clustering. Building upon Prior-data Fitted Networks, OFAG learns a reusable clustering inference strategy from synthetic attributed graphs generated under broad priors over latent clusters, node attributes, and graph structures. To handle incompatible feature spaces across graphs, OFAG adopts a dimension-agnostic signal-wise graph encoder that treats each feature channel as a graph signal and models its response to shared graph filters. The model is trained with a hyperspherical clustering objective, producing clustering-friendly node representations in a single forward pass at inference time. On ten datasets, one frozen OFAG model achieves the best mean performance and average rank across NMI, ACC, ARI, and F1, while completing all ten datasets in 12.43 minutes total---over 6* faster than the second-fastest baseline and nearly 28* faster than the second-best on clustering quality. Our code and pretrained checkpoint are available at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/OFAG, allowing practitioners to directly apply OFAG to their own attributed graph datasets without additional training or tuning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出OFAG，一个面向属性图聚类的"一次训练、通用适用"基础模型，无需针对具体图进行训练、微调或超参搜索即可直接应用于多样化的属性图聚类任务。
AI.motivation: 属性图聚类兼具无监督特性，导致模型选择与迁移困难。现有方法需针对每个输入图单独训练和调参，流程昂贵、脆弱，且难以跨越特征空间、结构模式及属性-结构相关性不同的图进行迁移。因此作者探索"一个模型通用"的替代方案。
AI.method: OFAG基于Prior-data Fitted Networks（PFN），从在潜在簇、节点属性和图结构的广泛先验下生成的合成属性图学习可复用的聚类推理策略；采用维度无关的信号级图编码器，将每个特征通道视为图信号并建模其对共享图滤波器的响应，以应对不兼容的特征空间；并以超球面聚类目标训练，推理时单次前向传播即生成聚类友好的节点表示。
AI.result: 在十个数据集上，单一冻结的OFAG模型在NMI、ACC、ARI、F1四项指标上取得最佳平均性能与平均排名，全部十个数据集总耗时12.43分钟，比第二快的基线快6倍以上，比聚类质量第二好的方法快近28倍。
AI.conclusion: OFAG验证了属性图聚类基础模型的可行性，实践者可直接将其应用于自有属性图数据集而无需额外训练或调参，代码与预训练权重已开源。

title: Beyond Corrected Memory: Execution Consistency in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Shared memory coordinates agents' actions, but correct records do not establish that those actions satisfy task requirements. Memory governance and failure diagnosis regulate or inspect recorded information; they do not by themselves establish whether it is sufficient to judge task duties. We define execution consistency through duties governing state use, information handoffs, and final-state agreement, with explicit evidence conditions for judging fulfillment. Our core claim is that identical retained records can correspond to compliant and violating executions under the same task rule. Controlled removal of evidence such as receipt, action dependence, or response validity leaves 82.4% of opposite-label pairs indistinguishable; restoration separates 97.9% of the merged pairs. Natural-log annotations identify the defined violations in actual executions. However, existing logs do not always explicitly represent the execution relationships needed for these judgments. To assess the definition's practical value, we use CAVERT, a framework for consistency diagnosis and recovery, to extract supported relationships from logs and apply these criteria. It consistently outperforms contract-prompted LLM and rule-based baselines in diagnosis across all 12 benchmark-executor settings. Under the same gate and executor limits, it also outperforms rule-guided recovery in all four evaluated environments. These findings identify execution evidence that agent-memory and execution interfaces should preserve for reliable judgment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"执行一致性"概念，以职责（状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致）及证据条件来判定代理执行是否满足任务要求，并指出相同记录可对应合规与违规执行；开发CAVERT框架实现诊断与恢复，表现优于基线。
AI.motivation: 共享内存可协调代理行动，但正确记录并不等同于行动满足任务要求；现有记忆治理与故障诊断只监管或检查记录信息，无法判断其是否足以判定任务职责，因此需要新的判定标准与证据条件。
AI.method: 定义执行一致性：通过状态使用、信息交接、最终状态一致的职责及明确证据条件来判定职责履行；进行受控证据移除实验（回执、动作依赖、响应有效性）；使用自然日志标注；提出CAVERT框架从日志中抽取支持的关系并应用该标准进行一致性诊断与恢复，与合同提示LLM、规则基线和规则引导恢复对比。
AI.result: 受控移除证据使82.4%的对立标签对无法区分，恢复证据后97.9%的合并对可分离；自然日志标注能识别实际执行中的违规；CAVERT在全部12个基准-执行器设置中诊断优于合同提示LLM与规则基线，并在四个环境中恢复优于规则引导恢复。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出代理记忆与执行接口应保留的执行证据，以实现可靠判定；相同保留记录在不同证据条件下可对应合规或违规执行，证据的显式表示对一致性判断至关重要。

title: Knowing When to Trust a Prior: Reliability-Gated Cue Fusion for Video Gaze Prediction
summary: Video gaze prediction is led by gaze-trained models, yet gaze-free priors carry signal those models have not absorbed, if one knows when to trust them. We propose FocusGate, a gated ensemble of gaze-free priors whose members may abstain. A per-frame gate reads three shape statistics of a defocus map and selects the frames on which the estimator is above chance on average, so rejected frames reduce to the base exactly, while midrank normalisation lets an all-zero prior abstain at zero parameters. Gated fusion is significantly positive on film, sports and web video, whereas unconditional fusion is harmful on sports and null on web. Added to four supervised predictors, the NTIRE 2026 champion among them, FocusGate improves all sixteen model-domain cells in shuffled AUC, fifteen significantly, one domain pre-registered and scored once, while adding only 1% to the champion's latency. Alone, it surpasses TASED-Net and UNISAL in shuffled AUC on film with a 16-frame causal mean.

AI.tldr: 提出 FocusGate：一种成员可弃权的无注视先验门控集成方法，通过逐帧门控选择性融合先验，显著提升视频注视预测性能。
AI.motivation: 无注视先验包含注视训练模型尚未吸收的信号，关键在于判断何时信任它们；无条件融合在部分领域有害或无效。
AI.method: 逐帧门控读取散焦图的三个形状统计量，挑选估计器平均高于随机的帧，被拒帧精确退化为基线；采用中秩归一化使全零先验以零参数弃权，实现门控融合。
AI.result: 门控融合在电影、体育和网络视频上显著为正，无条件融合在体育上有害、网络上空效；加入四个监督预测器（含 NTIRE 2026 冠军）后，十六个模型-领域单元在 shuffled AUC 上全部提升（十五个显著），仅增加冠军 1% 延迟；单独使用时在电影上以 16 帧因果均值超越 TASED-Net 和 UNISAL。
AI.conclusion: 门控式无注视先验融合是一种高效且可泛化的增强手段，能稳定提升多种监督模型且开销极小。

title: Extending Pathwise Gradients to Discrete Random Variables via Finite-Order Relaxation
summary: Pathwise gradients are preferred for continuous random variables because they are unbiased, low variance, and work with a single sample. For discrete variables, however, the pathwise identity cannot generally be exact for every differentiable function. We propose a general framework to construct finite-order exact pathwise gradient estimators for a range of common discrete variables such as Poisson. The estimator is the least-norm solution among all solutions that are unbiased for polynomials of degree at most. The resulting estimators preserve the hard forward sample, require no temperature tuning, and can be implemented in a few lines of codes. Against other admissible solutions, our estimator is unique and minimizes weight variance; in contrast, prior works use categorical variables or augmented representations to approximate non-categorical variables that induces excess variance and computations. To understand approximation bias for functions beyond the prescribed class, we also derive a non-asymptotic bias bound. In experiments our low order methods match or improve tuned baselines across linear, nonlinear and hierarchical latent-variable models, while out-speeding competitors in every runtime benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用框架，为Poisson等常见离散随机变量构造有限阶精确的路径式梯度估计器，在硬前向采样下无需温度调参，且实现简单。
AI.motivation: 路径式梯度对连续随机变量具备无偏、低方差、单样本可用等优点，但对离散变量而言，路径式恒等式一般无法对任意可微函数精确成立。现有方法多使用类别变量或增广表示来近似非类别变量，导致额外方差与计算开销。
AI.method: 提出通用框架，构造有限阶精确路径式梯度估计器。该估计器是在对至多某阶多项式无偏的所有解中取最小范数解，从而在保持硬前向样本的同时获得唯一且权重方差最小的解；并针对超出指定函数类的近似偏差推导了非渐近偏差界。
AI.result: 在与其他可允许解的对比中，该估计器唯一且最小化权重方差。实验中，低阶方法在线性、非线性及层次隐变量模型上达到或优于调优基线，并在所有运行时基准测试中速度快于竞争者。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为离散变量提供了无需温度调参、易于实现的精确路径式梯度估计方案，兼具低方差与高效率，并可推广至更一般的离散分布。

title: DSV-Mem: Evaluating Multimodal Memory in Professional Workflows for MLLM Agents
summary: Conversational MLLM agents are increasingly expected to assist in professional workflows, from AI research and engineering design to product management and business operations. Yet this capability remains underexplored: existing benchmarks largely focus on informal, everyday interactions and personal-life scenarios featuring photographic natural images, isolated static artifacts, and recall-oriented questions. In contrast, professional scenarios often involve structured, information-heavy artifacts that undergo frequent revisions and authority updates, and compositional queries requiring reconciliation of many artifact versions while tracking state precisely. To address these challenges, we introduce DSV-Mem, a benchmark for evaluating Dense Stateful Visual Memory. DSV-Mem comprises expert-reviewed scenarios and 1,000 questions across five user-oriented categories (Current State, Past State, Derived State, Change History, and Conflict/Refusal). A Hartley-inspired criterion favors questions with broader visual-evidence inspection demands. We also introduce a generation harness that produces evaluation suites by decoupling state-transition synthesis from conversation filling. Evaluation over 27 configurations spanning frontier and open-weight models and memory management methods reveals that the strongest baseline scores below 45% on DSV-Mem. Analysis surfaces findings: 1) multimodality and information density both contribute to difficulty, but state evolution, particularly the number of governing updates, is the dominant tested factor. Raw conversation/haystack length, OCR, and arithmetic are not the primary bottlenecks; 2) models often fail to verify user premises against prior state updates before answering; 3) increased reasoning effort and memory management methods yield limited gains, whereas state-aware designs prove more effective. The benchmark and code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DSV-Mem基准，用于评估对话式MLLM智能体在专业工作流中处理"密集有状态视觉记忆"的能力，揭示现有模型在状态演化追踪上的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多聚焦非正式的日常交互、个人生活场景，包含自然照片图像、孤立静态物件和以回忆为导向的问题。而专业场景涉及结构化、信息密集的物件，需频繁修订与权威更新，并需对多版本物件进行组合式查询、精确追踪状态。这一能力尚缺乏评估，故需专门基准。
AI.method: 提出DSV-Mem基准，包含专家审阅的场景和1000个问题，覆盖五类用户导向类别（当前状态、过去状态、派生状态、变更历史、冲突/拒绝）。采用受Hartley启发的准则，偏向需要更广视觉证据检验的问题。同时提出一种生成框架，将状态转换合成与对话填充解耦，以生成评估套件。评估覆盖27种配置，涵盖前沿与开源权重模型及记忆管理方法。
AI.result: 最强基线在DSV-Mem上得分低于45%。分析发现：1）多模态与信息密度均增加难度，但状态演化（尤其是支配性更新的数量）是测试中最主要的因素；原始对话/大海捞针长度、OCR与算术并非主要瓶颈；2）模型常在回答前未能对照先前状态更新核验用户前提；3）增加推理努力与记忆管理方法收益有限，而状态感知设计更为有效。
AI.conclusion: DSV-Mem填补了专业工作流中有状态视觉记忆评估的空白，表明当前模型在状态追踪与前提核验上存在根本缺陷，状态感知设计比单纯增加推理或记忆管理更有效。基准与代码将公开发布。

title: PDB: Point-Based Deformation Blending for Facial Animation Retargeting
summary: Mesh-agnostic facial animation retargeting transfers expressions across meshes with different structures, but preserving facial motion without surface artifacts remains challenging. To address this, we present PDB, Point-Based Deformation Blending for facial animation retargeting. PDB predicts a compact set of deformed control points from a source neutral-expression pair and blending weights from the target neutral mesh. The weights are computed once per target and reused across frames, while the control points vary with each source expression. ReLU enforces non-negative weights and permits exact zeros, followed by row-wise normalization. The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.

AI.tldr: 提出PDB（基于点的形变混合），一种免网格结构的表情重定向方法，通过预测控制点与混合权重直接重建目标网格，无需笼状结构、预计算坐标或全局求解。
AI.motivation: 跨不同结构网格的表情重定向需保留面部运动且不产生表面伪影，但现有方法依赖预定义结构或复杂求解，难以兼顾运动保真与表面质量。
AI.method: PDB从源中性-表情对预测紧凑的变形控制点，从目标中性网格预测混合权重；权重每目标计算一次并跨帧复用，控制点随源表情变化。ReLU保证权重非负并可精确为零，再做行归一化，通过权重与控制点相乘直接重建目标网格。仅用自重定向重建监督训练。
AI.result: 实验显示重定向准确、推理快速，学习到的权重具有局部支撑；联合评估表情精度与局部表面保真度，相比稠密位移方法减少表面伪影并保留预期运动；感知评估支持自重定向与跨身份重定向的表情保真度和视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: PDB以轻量、无需配对跨身份训练的方式实现高质量面部动画重定向，在运动保持与表面伪影抑制间取得良好平衡。

title: ServeLearnBench: How Well Can Agents Self-Improve from Serving Experience?
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed to perform complex tasks in real-world environments. However, the knowledge required for correct behavior in these environments is often implicit, undisclosed, and subject to change over time. Recent continual-learning harnesses seek to address this challenge by enabling agents to improve from serving experience. Yet the effectiveness and limitations of these methods are not yet well characterized. Existing benchmarks provide only partial coverage: some explicitly provide the target knowledge, others assume a static environment, and those that support continual adaptation remain limited in scale and knowledge diversity. To enable systematic evaluation, we formalize an evolving-environment streaming dataset (EESD), in which agents must infer, apply, and revise latent environment knowledge from interaction and outcome feedback as hidden policies evolve, and introduce ServeLearnBench, spanning retail support, banking, and sales-pitch generation with 53 environment windows and 7,718 tasks. We evaluate five learning harnesses (RAG, Mem0, SkillOpt, Continual Harness, and Prime) across six models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5, Kimi K3, GLM-5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, and GLM-5.3 Flash), covering 28 model-harness pairs and 252 learning runs. Our evaluation reveals three main findings: a substantial gap remains between task capability and learning from experience; continual adaptation is costly and can degrade already-correct behavior; and insufficient exploration emerges as a key bottleneck to effective adaptation. Overall, ServeLearnBench provides a controlled testbed for diagnosing these limitations and tracking progress toward agents that continually and reliably improve through serving experience.

AI.tldr: 论文提出演化环境流式数据集(EESD)与基准ServeLearnBench，覆盖零售、银行、销售场景，含53个环境窗口、7718个任务，评测5种学习框架与6个模型共28个模型-框架组合、252次学习运行，揭示经验学习的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 大模型智能体被越来越多地部署到真实环境中执行复杂任务，但正确行为所需的知识往往是隐性的、未公开的，且随时间变化。现有持续学习测试基准覆盖不足：有的直接提供目标知识，有的假设静态环境，支持持续适应的又规模与知识多样性有限，导致这类方法的有效性与局限尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 形式化提出"演化环境流式数据集"(EESD)：智能体需在隐藏策略演化过程中，从交互与结果反馈中推断、应用并修正潜在环境知识。据此构建ServeLearnBench基准，涵盖零售客服、银行、销售话术生成三类场景，共53个环境窗口、7718个任务。评测5种学习框架(RAG、Mem0、SkillOpt、Continual Harness、Prime)与6个模型(GPT-5.6 Terra、Opus 5、Kimi K3、GLM-5.3、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、GLM-5.3 Flash)，共28个模型-框架组合、252次学习运行。
AI.result: 评测得出三项主要发现：(1)任务能力与"从经验中学习"的能力之间存在显著差距；(2)持续适应代价高昂，且可能损害原本已正确的行为；(3)探索不足是阻碍有效适应的关键瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: ServeLearnBench为诊断上述局限提供了可控测试平台，可用于追踪智能体在服务经验中持续可靠改进的进展。

title: ChartBmkAgent: Harness-Governed Multi-Agent Construction of Chart QA Benchmarks from Sparse Error-Taxonomy Specifications
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance rapidly, while conventional benchmark development lags behind, delaying investigation of newly observed capability gaps. Such investigation requires an expressive task format and an on-demand construction process: information-rich charts make chart question answering (Chart QA) suitable for probing coupled perception and reasoning. Automated Chart QA construction is intended to shorten the benchmark-development cycle by turning identified gaps into targeted samples on demand. Current methods, however, commonly separate target guidance from scratch generation: target-guided systems often require prepared data, charts, or templates, while scratch-generation systems primarily ensure artifact validity, without explicitly controlling whether newly synthesized requirements and content remain aligned with an externally specified diagnostic target. We introduce ChartBmkAgent, which turns an identified capability gap into targeted diagnostic evidence by constructing complete Chart QA samples from sparse error-taxonomy specifications. Throughout construction, a central harness governs specialized agents, requires stage-specific evidence of alignment with the original error category, and records the basis for each acceptance decision. On 300 taxonomy-wide samples, MLLM accuracies ranged from 32.7% to 84.3% with distinct category profiles, showing that generated samples reveal capability differences. Across three source-model comparisons, targeted follow-ups scored 50.0% versus 82.2% on matched controls ($p=8.96\times10^{-6}$); all six cross-model comparisons had the same direction, demonstrating targeted validation and diagnostic-data generation. Multiple evaluator models assessed whether each sample tested its specified error category; 86.4% met this criterion, providing empirical evidence of target preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出ChartBmkAgent，用稀疏错误分类规范自动构建图表问答基准样本，实现针对性诊断与跨模型验证。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型发展迅速，但基准开发滞后，无法及时探查新出现的能力缺口。探查需要表达力强的任务格式与按需构建过程。现有自动化Chart QA构建方法将目标引导与从零生成分离：有的需预置数据/图表/模板，有的仅保证产物有效性，未显式控制合成内容是否与外部诊断目标对齐。
AI.method: ChartBmkAgent从稀疏的错误分类规范出发构建完整Chart QA样本。构建过程中由中央harness统管专用智能体，要求每个阶段提供与原始错误类别对齐的证据，并记录每次接受决策的依据。
AI.result: 在300个分类全覆盖样本上，MLLM准确率介于32.7%至84.3%，且各类别分布不同。三次源模型对比中，针对性后续样本得分50.0%，匹配对照82.2%（p=8.96×10^-6）；六次跨模型对比方向一致。多评估模型判定86.4%样本确实测试了其指定错误类别。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够将识别出的能力缺口转化为有针对性的诊断证据，实现目标保持的诊断数据生成与针对性验证。

title: EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出事件链检索增强生成（EC-RAG），一种免训练框架，将视频组织为显式事件链以提升长视频理解，在多个基准上优于帧级检索基线。
AI.motivation: 当前大型视频语言模型处理长视频时，帧通常被独立处理，难以捕捉跨事件的时间依赖；已有检索增强方法多在帧或片段级别操作，难以建模事件的演化与相互关系。
AI.method: EC-RAG 无训练，先做视频语义连贯分段，用多模态信号表示每个片段，再将其链接为保留时间顺序、刻画事件关系的结构化事件链；针对查询定位相关事件并汇聚多模态证据。
AI.result: 在 Video-MME、MLVU、LongVideoBench 上，事件中心设计持续优于帧级检索基线。
AI.conclusion: 事件级抽象更契合视频自然结构，事件级多模态融合更有效利用互补信息，且可即插即用兼容现有 LVLM，无需训练，说明时间结构建模对长视频理解很重要。

title: The Geometry of Empowerment
summary: Empowerment captures the capacity for an agent to actively control its environment. While conceptually appealing as an information-theoretic quantity, the connection between empowerment and structurally central states that provide broad access to future outcomes has remained an open question. In this work, we link empowerment maximization and skill-learning methods to provide new geometries for interpreting and analyzing empowerment. Our analyses answer longstanding open questions on the connections between empowerment and structural centrality. Our analyses also reveal distinctions between information and reward geometries, highlighting important theoretical implications to build scalable empowerment-maximization methods. Website and code can be found at https://empowerment-geometry.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文从几何视角研究赋能（empowerment）最大化与技能学习之间的联系，为理解与分析赋能提供了新的几何结构。
AI.motivation: 赋能被定义为智能体主动控制环境的能力，作为信息论量在概念上颇具吸引力，但其与"能广泛通向未来结果的结构中心状态"之间的联系仍是未解问题。
AI.method: 将赋能最大化与技能学习方法联系起来，构建新的几何框架来刻画和分析赋能。
AI.result: 回答了赋能与结构中心性之间关系的长期开放问题，并揭示出信息几何与奖励几何之间的区别。
AI.conclusion: 这些分析为构建可扩展的赋能最大化方法提供了重要的理论启示。

title: Test-Time Agent Evolution for Long-Horizon Legal Reasoning
summary: Legal intelligence aims to support reliable decision-making across long-horizon legal processes involving evolving case states and multiple roles. However, real-world legal deployment exhibits substantial case heterogeneity in facts, evidence, and procedural contexts, exposing the limitations of static agent strategies. Moreover, legal reasoning is inherently interdependent across roles and procedural stages, making global reliability fundamentally different from isolated role competence. To address these challenges, we study training-free test-time agent adaptation, where agents continuously exploit deployment-time signals from preceding cases and ongoing interactions without updating model parameters. We propose \method, which introduces \emph{Test-Time Memory Evolution} to retrieve reusable experience from previous cases, adapt it to the current factual and procedural context, and consolidate accumulated experience for subsequent decision-making. Further, \emph{Rubric-Aligned Collaboration} verifies and revises role-specific actions according to behavioral and procedural requirements, enabling coordinated decision-making across roles and stages. Extensive experiments on J1-EVAL and LegalWorld across five backbone models demonstrate consistent improvements over representative reasoning and agent baselines with reasonable interaction and computational costs. Ablation and case studies further show that the two components provide complementary benefits in experience adaptation and cross-role coordination, improving the reliability and efficiency of long-horizon legal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无需训练的测试时智能体自适应方法（\method），通过"测试时记忆演化"与"评分标准对齐协作"两大机制，提升长周期法律推理的可靠性与效率。
AI.motivation: 法律智能需在案件状态演化、多角色参与的长期流程中支持可靠决策。但真实法律部署中案件在事实、证据和程序语境上高度异质，静态智能体策略难以应对；同时法律推理在角色与程序阶段间相互依赖，全局可靠性与单一角色能力存在本质差异。
AI.method: 研究免训练的测试时智能体自适应：智能体不更新模型参数，而是持续利用先前案件与当前交互中的部署期信号。方法包含两部分：（1）测试时记忆演化——从以往案件检索可复用经验，适配当前事实与程序语境，并整合累积经验用于后续决策；（2）评分标准对齐协作——依据行为与程序要求验证并修正各角色动作，实现跨角色与跨阶段的协同决策。
AI.result: 在 J1-EVAL 与 LegalWorld 两个基准、五个主干模型上，方法相较代表性推理与智能体基线取得一致提升，且交互与计算成本合理。消融与案例研究表明两个组件在经验适配与跨角色协同上具有互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 测试时记忆演化与评分标准对齐协作相辅相成，可在不更新参数的前提下提升长周期法律推理的可靠性与效率，为异质、多角色、多阶段的法律决策场景提供了有效的自适应方案。

title: RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins
summary: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RenderBench，一个包含 12 个重建真实场景的基准，用于评估"渲染到真实"的视频生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现代视频模型能从外观参考和代理渲染生成逼真视频，但评估这种"渲染到真实"能力需要同一场景演化的真实目标视频，以及可编辑、几何配准的 3D 副本，而这类数据传统上需大量人工建模、标定和动画工作。
AI.method: 构建流程结合视觉几何、神经重建和辅助 3D 编辑，将场景分解为静态物体和动态演员并配准到采集相机，经多视图几何与时间验证后收录。每个评估单元包含外观参考图、留出的真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配的代理渲染和渲染器原生场景标注。
AI.result: 首个版本保留 12/14 个配准样本（85.7%），含 1,496 对真实-代理帧。所有发布场景通过文件完整性和环境编辑审计，代理诊断得到深度 si-RMSE 0.2170、实例 mIoU 0.3673。
AI.conclusion: RenderBench 提供了配对的真实观测和可编辑场景状态，可同时评估外观保真度以及几何与动态的保持能力。

title: Adaptive Mean Estimation by In-Context Learning: A Gradient-Flow Analysis
summary: Prior Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as TabPFN now rival established statistical procedures across prediction and estimation tasks. A natural explanation is that PFNs have the property of statistical adaptivity, that is, they perform nearly as well as a method tailored to the true data-generating model for a heterogeneous set of models, while not being told which model the data comes from. We study how such adaptivity is learned in a controlled location-estimation problem. Each task is an unlabeled sample whose family is hidden: Gaussian data call for averaging, with error of order $n^{-1}$, whereas uniform data are best estimated from their extremes, at the faster rate $n^{-2}$. We also provide the example of a symmetric Gaussian mixture, for which a rate of $σ^2_n/n$ can be attained. On scalar inputs, softmax attention computes the derivative of the empirical cumulant-generating function. A single primitive therefore both supplies features that distinguish the families and forms estimators interpolating between the sample mean and the mid-range. We combine attention experts through either a softmax mixture of experts or a gated linear unit (GLU), and analyze stagewise gradient flow. With $\widetildeΩ(n^{1+ε})$ pretraining tasks, the learned estimator is asymptotically efficient on Gaussian tasks, within a factor $n^ε$ of the minimax rate on uniform tasks, and order-optimal on mixtures in a shrinking-variance regime. These guarantees extend to new locations and longer contexts. A risk decomposition separates expert error, routing error and normalization error, which clarifies the architectural contrast. Softmax gating enforces normalization and exact translation equivariance, whereas the GLU must learn it: its dynamics separate into fast bias removal followed by slow expert selection. End-to-end experiments recover the predicted specialization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Prior Fitted Networks（如TabPFN）的"统计自适应性"是如何学到的。作者在受控的位置估计问题中展开分析：高斯数据应用均值估计（误差阶n^{-1}），均匀分布数据应用极值估计（更快阶n^{-2}），对称高斯混合可达σ²_n/n的速率。研究发现标量输入上的softmax注意力恰好计算经验累积生成函数的导数，这一单一原语既提供区分分布族的特征，又构造出在样本均值与中程数之间插值的估计器。
AI.motivation: Prior Fitted Networks（PFNs）如TabPFN已在预测与估计任务上媲美经典统计方法。一个自然解释是PFNs具有"统计自适应性"，即对异质模型集合，其表现几乎与针对真实数据生成模型定制的方法一样好，且无需被告知数据来自哪个模型。然而这种自适应性如何被学习尚不清楚，本文力图在受控的位置估计问题中揭示其机制。
AI.method: 作者构造了受控的位置估计问题，每个任务是一个未标注样本，其分布族（高斯/均匀/对称高斯混合）是隐藏的。理论上证明标量输入上softmax注意力计算经验累积生成函数的导数，从而既提供区分族别的特征，又形成在样本均值与中程数之间插值的估计器。通过softmax专家混合或门控线性单元（GLU）组合注意力专家，并分析分阶段梯度流动态。
AI.result: 在约Ω̃(n^{1+ε})个预训练任务下，学到的估计器在高斯任务上渐近有效，在均匀任务上达到minimax rate的n^ε因子以内，在收缩方差机制下的混合分布上达到阶数最优。这些保证可推广到新位置与更长上下文。风险分解将专家误差、路由误差与归一化误差分离，揭示架构差异：softmax门控强制归一化与精确平移等变性，而GLU需学习该性质，其动态分为快速偏差消除阶段和缓慢专家选择阶段。端到端实验证实了预测的专家专门化现象。
AI.conclusion: softmax注意力作为计算经验累积生成函数导数的单一原语，天然具备统计自适应性：它同时提供族间判别特征与插值估计器。softmax门控的归一化与平移等变性使其优于需要自学该性质的GLU。研究从风险分解角度阐明了架构对比，并通过实验验证了理论学习到的专家专门化。

title: Partially Observable Zero-shot coordination by Predicting Intention of Partner
summary: Zero-shot coordination in embodied settings requires acting while the partner is intermittently out of view, leaving existing methods with ambiguous partner representations and uncertainty over hidden partner states. We propose Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP) to jointly address these challenges. PIP uses a Joint-view VAE to distill richer training-time evidence from the union of both agents' local observations into a partner representation available from local observations alone. Partner-state Belief networks further infer the partner's hidden location and behavioral tendencies from the ego agent's interaction history. We evaluate PIP in Burrito-PO, Overcooked-PO, and a Melting Pot substrate, together with a human evaluation in Burrito-PO. PIP attains the highest mean performance among the compared methods across all three benchmarks. Human evaluation and diagnostic analyses further support coordination with unseen partners and the contributions of both components under partner occlusion.

AI.tldr: PIP 通过联合视角 VAE 与伙伴状态信念网络，解决具身零样本协作中伙伴时隐时现导致表征模糊与隐藏状态不确定的问题，在多个基准与人类评测中均取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 具身零样本协作要求智能体在伙伴间歇性离开视野时仍能行动，现有方法因此面临伙伴表征模糊、隐藏伙伴状态不确定的困难。论文希望同时应对这两类挑战。
AI.method: 提出 Predicting Intention of Partner (PIP)，包含两个组件：联合视角 VAE（Joint-view VAE）在训练时从双方局部观测的并集中提炼更丰富的证据，生成仅凭自身局部观测即可获得的伙伴表征；伙伴状态信念网络（Partner-state Belief networks）从自我智能体的交互历史推断伙伴的隐藏位置与行为倾向。
AI.result: 在 Burrito-PO、Overcooked-PO 及一个 Melting Pot 环境中评估，并在 Burrito-PO 上进行人类评测。PIP 在三个基准上的平均表现均优于对比方法；人类评测与诊断分析进一步支持其与未见伙伴的协作能力以及两个组件在伙伴被遮挡情形下的贡献。
AI.conclusion: PIP 能有效应对具身协作中的伙伴遮挡问题，联合视角表征学习与伙伴状态信念推断二者均发挥重要作用，提升与陌生伙伴的零样本协作表现。

title: SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning
summary: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

AI.tldr: SpaTime是一个流式视觉语言模型，将因果几何token融入语言模型，并引入响应时间损失来监督回答时机，在流式3D空间推理任务上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要在视频流仍在到达时进行3D空间推理，并在观察足够后尽快作答。现有融入3D几何先验的VLM推理能力强但只能离线运行（需完整视频），而流式VLM虽能因果处理帧并自主决定何时响应，却缺乏显式3D表示。
AI.method: 提出SpaTime，一种流式VLM，在每一帧将因果几何token融合进语言模型，且仅使用目前已观察到的帧。为监督回答时机，设计响应时间损失，将每帧的响应概率映射为可微的期望响应时间，并惩罚其与真实帧的距离。此外构建StreamVSTI-Bench和StreamVSI-Bench两个流式评测基准。
AI.result: 在StreamVSTI-Bench上，SpaTime总体准确率达49.2%，相比最强流式基线将平均响应时间误差降低66%。
AI.conclusion: SpaTime证明可将因果3D几何表示与流式语言模型结合，并通过可微响应时间损失有效学习何时作答，在流式3D空间推理中兼顾准确性与响应及时性。

title: MASKerade: Token-Routed Mask Experts for Dense-to-MoE Upcycling
summary: Sparsely activated Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-token computation. Dense-to-MoE upcycling reuses pretrained dense models to construct such systems, commonly by copying feed-forward networks (FFNs) into independently trained experts. We introduce MASKerade, a dense-to-MoE training method that instead learns experts as sparse subnetworks of a frozen pretrained FFN. Each expert is defined by a learned binary mask, and a token-level router selects which masked FFNs to execute and combine. The router and mask scores are optimized jointly, while the underlying FFN weight values remain unchanged. This formulation supports neuron-structured, semi-structured, and unstructured experts within the same routing architecture. Our main configuration uses four 2:4 experts with top-2 routing, where two half-dense expert passes have the nominal FFN arithmetic of one dense pass, without requiring independent expert weight matrices. On five vision-language benchmarks with Qwen and Gemma backbones, this configuration achieves the highest performance among the compared baselines. Comparisons across mask granularities, routing interventions, and compute-matched controls distinguish the effects of learned connectivity from expert activation count. These results establish mask learning over frozen weights as a practical alternative for constructing token-routed MoE experts.

AI.tldr: MASKerade 通过在被冻结的预训练 FFN 上学习稀疏二值掩码来构造 MoE 专家，路由器与掩码联合优化而权重保持不变，在视觉-语言基准上取得优于基线的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 dense-to-MoE 升级方法通常将 FFN 复制为多个独立训练的专家，需要额外的专家权重矩阵且计算成本较高。作者希望找到一种更高效、无需独立权重矩阵的方式，在保留预训练知识的同时构建 token 路由的 MoE 专家。
AI.method: 提出 MASKerade：将专家定义为冻结预训练 FFN 的稀疏子网络，每个专家由可学习的二值掩码指定，token 级路由器选择要执行并组合的掩码 FFN。路由器与掩码分数联合优化，底层 FFN 权重保持不变。该框架支持神经元结构化、半结构化与非结构化专家，主配置为四个 2:4 专家配合 top-2 路由，两次半稠密专家前向即相当于一次稠密前向的标称 FFN 运算量，且无需独立专家权重矩阵。
AI.result: 在 Qwen 与 Gemma 骨干的五个视觉-语言基准上，该主配置在对比基线中取得最高性能。通过掩码粒度、路由干预和计算量匹配的对照实验，区分了学习到的连接结构与专家激活数量各自带来的效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在冻结权重上学习掩码是构建 token 路由 MoE 专家的一种实用替代方案。

title: Which alloy composition,what process parameters? Inferring the recipe from optimized metallic microstructure and texture
summary: The mechanical properties of a metallic alloy are set by its microstructure and texture: the size and shape of its grains and the orientation of their crystals. That structure is in turn set by a recipe, the alloy composition together with the processing parameters. Alloy development runs this chain forwards, tuning the structure until a target property is met. Running it backwards, from an optimized structure to the recipe that would produce it, still relies on expert knowledge. We ask whether this backwards step can be learned. On an in-house dataset of 107 magnesium alloy extrusion conditions across 14 alloys, each with optical micrographs and an X-ray texture measurement, we compare three descriptors of microstructure and texture: conventional grain and texture statistics, a vision embedding from a pretrained image encoder, and a graph neural network on the grain network. Each is paired with prediction heads for two tasks: the alloy composition given the process (Task A), and the process parameters given the composition (Task B). Under 5-fold cross-validation, the conventional descriptors identify the correct alloy for 65% of held-out conditions, against 17% for always guessing the most common alloy, while the learned embeddings stay below 30%. The process parameters are recoverable but noisier: compared with using the composition alone, the microstructure roughly halves the temperature error. Because only a few alloys were cast and only a few press settings were used, both answers are discrete, and heads that pick from these known options, while respecting their order, worked better than heads that predict a free value.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨能否用机器学习从镁合金的微观组织与织构"反推"其成分与加工参数，发现在小规模数据下，传统晶粒与织构统计量优于图像嵌入和图神经网络，且有序离散预测头效果更好。
AI.motivation: 合金开发通常正向进行：由成分和工艺参数决定微观组织与织构，进而决定力学性能。而从目标组织反向推导出能产生该组织的"配方"仍依赖专家经验。作者希望检验这一逆向步骤是否可被学习，从而推动合金的逆向设计。
AI.method: 使用包含14种合金、107种挤压条件的内部数据集，每种条件配有光学显微照片和X射线织构测量。比较三种微观组织与织构描述符：传统晶粒与织构统计量、预训练图像编码器的视觉嵌入、以及晶粒网络上的图神经网络。每种描述符搭配预测头完成两项任务：由工艺反推合金成分（Task A），以及由成分反推工艺参数（Task B），并进行5折交叉验证。
AI.result: 传统描述符在留出条件下识别正确合金的准确率为65%，远高于始终猜最常见合金的17%基准，而学习型嵌入均低于30%。工艺参数可被恢复但噪声更大：相比仅用成分，加入微观组织可将温度误差大致减半。由于铸造合金种类和压机设置有限，两个答案都是离散的，能按已知选项并尊重其顺序进行选择的预测头优于预测自由数值的预测头。
AI.conclusion: 在有限数据条件下，从微观组织与织构反推成分和工艺是可行的，但传统统计描述符表现优于更复杂的深度学习方法。离散且保序的预测策略更适合此类任务，为合金逆向设计提供了初步证据与基线。

title: Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment
summary: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

AI.tldr: 本文提出将路径-流对齐作为流匹配的统一训练目标，联合训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络，并诊断出“路径过拟合”失效模式，提出随机路径正则化以抑制低熵瓶颈，在ImageNet-256×256上提升FID且推理架构与采样器不变。
AI.motivation: 传统流匹配固定插值路径、只学习速度场。本文希望将路径本身也纳入可学习对象，通过路径-流联合对齐获得更优的流匹配目标。然而作者发现仅用对齐损失指导路径学习不可靠，会出现“路径过拟合”：对齐损失下降但样本质量变差，因此需要诊断原因并施加有效正则化。
AI.method: 提出统一的路径-流对齐目标：联合训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络，共用同一对齐损失——流匹配路径速度，路径将自身速度对齐到当前流。诊断出路径过拟合与诱导概率路径中的低熵瓶颈（中间边缘分布过度集中）相关。为此引入随机路径正则化：在保持精确端点的前提下，向路径网络隐藏部分源信息，为随机训练路径边缘分布提供显式熵下界，从而抑制采样器中的瓶颈。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-256×256上使用SiT骨干，方法在不同模型规模上一致提升FID，并可扩展到model-guidance训练，同时不改变推理时架构与采样器。
AI.conclusion: 路径-流对齐可作为流匹配的有效统一训练目标，但需配合随机路径正则化以避免路径过拟合与低熵瓶颈；该方法在不改动推理架构与采样器的前提下稳定提升生成质量。

title: SIFT: Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer for Multi-Task Personalized Filter Ranking at Airbnb
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Accepted at GRAIL 2026: Workshop on Generative, Retrieval-augmented, and Agentic Intelligence for Personalization, co-located with CIKM 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Search filters help guests navigate vast catalogs in two-sided marketplaces like Airbnb, and recommending the right filters can meaningfully lift booking conversion. Many such production filter-ranking systems, however, represent the guest through hand-engineered, pre-aggregated features generated by ETL pipelines. This makes it expensive to maintain and difficult to extend for new filter types or contextual dimensions (trip length, group size). We present SIFT (Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer), a ranking model built on transformers that learns guest preferences directly from raw behavioral sequences. SIFT replaces manual feature engineering with a unified guest representation that feeds multiple prediction tasks, including booking likelihood, filter engagement, and ordinal capacity thresholds (e.g., 2+ bedrooms) -- a general framework for filter ranking in two-sided marketplaces that accommodates both boolean and numeric-range filter types. Extending SIFT to new filters requires only adding a new head, not a new feature pipeline. To keep serving fast, this guest representation is computed offline on a daily cadence rather than at request time. Offline, SIFT improves booking and amenity-engagement PR-AUC by +51.9% and +62.8% respectively over the production baseline. In online A/B testing, SIFT increased engagement with recommended filters by +20.0%, overall filter usage among searchers by +0.72%, and usage of the newly-supported bedroom, bathroom, and bed filters by +3.9%, +10.7%, and +0.52% respectively. Demonstrating the system's extensibility, we rapidly integrated a novel hotel-intent filter using the same shared representation, driving a +3.8% lift in uncancelled hotel bookings and a +0.76% lift in overall marketplace bookings. SIFT is now fully deployed in production, serving scalable personalization to millions of guests.

AI.tldr: SIFT是一个基于Transformer的搜索筛选器排序模型，直接从原始行为序列学习用户偏好，替代手工特征工程，已全量部署于生产环境。
AI.motivation: 在Airbnb这类双边市场中，搜索筛选器能帮助用户浏览庞大目录，推荐合适筛选器可显著提升预订转化。但现有生产系统依赖ETL管道生成的手工设计、预聚合特征来表示用户，导致维护成本高，且难以为新筛选器类型或上下文维度（行程长度、团体规模）扩展。
AI.method: 提出SIFT（Search Intent-to-Filter Transformer），基于Transformer的排序模型，直接从原始行为序列学习用户偏好。用统一的用户表征替代手工特征工程，该表征同时服务于多个预测任务：预订可能性、筛选器互动，以及有序容量阈值（如2+卧室）。该框架可同时支持布尔型和数值区间型筛选器，扩展新筛选器只需增加一个预测头而非新建特征管道。为加快服务速度，用户表征按每日节奏离线计算，而非在请求时计算。
AI.result: 离线方面，SIFT相比生产基线将预订和设施互动的PR-AUC分别提升51.9%和62.8%。在线A/B测试中，推荐筛选器的互动提升20.0%，搜索者整体筛选器使用提升0.72%，新支持的卧室、浴室和床筛选器使用分别提升3.9%、10.7%和0.52%。此外，快速集成了新的酒店意图筛选器，共享同一表征，带来未取消酒店预订+3.8%、整体市场预订+0.76%的提升。
AI.conclusion: SIFT已全量部署于生产环境，为数百万用户提供可扩展的个性化服务，验证了统一表征框架在双边市场筛选器排序中的可扩展性和实际效果。

title: LFHE: Local-First Heuristic Evolution for Bounded Local Topology Search in Decentralized Learning with Non-IID Data
summary: Decentralized learning is highly sensitive to communication topology under non-IID data. Adaptive peer-selection methods can exploit local model information, but broader peer discovery may require increasingly large control state, whereas direct spectral optimization typically relies on graph-wide information. We study the intermediate setting of bounded local topology search and propose Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a representation-driven rewiring framework whose candidate discovery and scoring use only ego-neighborhood and friend-of-a-friend (FoF) information. The structural score admits an exact interpretation through graph Dirichlet energy: its sum across clients equals twice the representation Dirichlet energy, which under standard linear consensus dynamics governs the instantaneous dissipation of representation disagreement. LFHE combines this state-dependent structural signal with early exploration and degree control, while algebraic connectivity remains an offline graph diagnostic. Under bounded sparse degree, its FoF candidate state remains local rather than expanding toward population-wide peer tracking. Across four image, speech, and text benchmarks, LFHE achieves competitive decentralized learning performance. Matched-protocol controls identify the structural term as the principal empirical topology-selection signal, while comparison with broader peer discovery exposes a trade-off between predictive performance and discovery-state locality. Together, these results motivate state-aware bounded local topology search between pairwise peer selection and globally informed topology optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出 Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE)，一种仅用 ego-邻域和 FoF 信息的有界局部拓扑搜索重连框架，用于去中心化学习。
AI.motivation: 去中心化学习在非 IID 数据下对通信拓扑高度敏感。自适应对等选择可挖掘局部模型信息，但更广的 peer discovery 需要越来越大的控制状态，而直接谱优化通常依赖全图信息。因此作者研究介于两者之间的“有界局部拓扑搜索”设定。
AI.method: LFHE 是表示驱动的重连框架，候选发现与打分仅使用 ego-邻域和 friend-of-friend (FoF) 信息。其结构分数可由图 Dirichlet 能量精确解释：各客户端求和等于两倍的表示 Dirichlet 能量，在标准线性共识动力学下控制表示分歧的瞬时耗散。LFHE 将状态相关结构信号与早期探索、度控制结合，代数连通度仅作为离线图诊断。
AI.result: 在有界稀疏度下，其 FoF 候选状态保持局部，不会扩展为群体级对等追踪。在四个图像、语音、文本基准上取得有竞争力的去中心化学习性能。匹配协议对照表明结构项是主要的经验性拓扑选择信号，而与更广 peer discovery 的比较揭示了预测性能与发现状态局部性之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在成对对等选择与全局信息拓扑优化之间，采用状态感知的有界局部拓扑搜索。

title: Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error
summary: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种针对3D Gaussian Splatting模型的后训练多视角提升（lifting）方法，按目标类逐一融合所有视角信息，通过双重阈值筛选高斯并转移到网格顶点评估，在Replica与ScanNet++上取得较高mIoU，并分离三类误差来源。
AI.motivation: 同一高斯在多个视角下可能被遮挡，检测器置信度也随视角变化，且不同训练运行产生的高斯不一致，因此真值以标注网格给出。需要一种能综合所有视角信息、并可与网格真值对齐的语义提升方法。
AI.method: 对每一目标类，同时累积目标与非目标证据，按高斯在各视角的可见性加权；随后用两个阈值过滤高斯：主阈值β选出高置信种子，较低阈值γβ加入其周围连通分量。评估时将标签从高斯转移到既可见又被标注的网格顶点，从而分离2D检测器、提升过程与表示转移三类误差；阈值与转移算子在Replica验证场景上确定后固定用于全部场景与类别。
AI.result: Replica验证集平均mIoU在使用数据集标注掩码时为0.93，使用YOLO掩码时为0.65；ScanNet++测试集上分别为0.80与0.54。相比逐视角阈值处理，新方法在测试mIoU上提升0.24，并实现所有类别与场景共用单一阈值。
AI.conclusion: 该后训练提升方法能有效融合多视角信息并统一阈值设置，误差分析表明剩余误差主要来源于2D检测器。

title: $α$Transfer: Coefficient Transfer for Efficient Model Merging
summary: Model merging offers a promising solution for combining multiple fine-tuned checkpoints into a single model through parameter arithmetic. However, finding optimal merging coefficients requires an extensive search that becomes prohibitively expensive as models scale in both size and number, due to high memory requirements and combinatorial growth in the search space. We show that, within the same model family, models exhibit highly congruent performance distributions over merging coefficients across different model sizes. This distributional similarity enables a practical paradigm we call \textit{$α$Transfer}: searching for optimal coefficients on a small proxy model, then directly transfer them to larger target models. We verify $α$Transfer across multiple merging methods, model families, and tasks. Experimental results demonstrate a 6$\times$ speedup and 70\% memory reduction on vision transformers, and a 20$\times$ speedup and 85\% memory reduction on large language models, while maintaining comparable performance. Our findings establish $α$Transfer as an efficient and generalizable approach to scaling model merging.

AI.tldr: 提出αTransfer范式：在同家族模型间，合并系数的性能分布高度一致，可先在小代理模型上搜索最优系数再迁移到大模型，显著提速并降低内存。
AI.motivation: 模型合并需通过参数算术将多个微调checkpoint合成单一模型，但寻找最优合并系数需大量搜索；随模型规模与数量增长，内存需求高、搜索空间组合爆炸，导致搜索代价过高。
AI.method: 发现同模型家族内不同规模模型在合并系数上的性能分布高度相似（congruent），据此提出αTransfer：在小代理模型上搜索最优合并系数，然后直接迁移到更大的目标模型。在多种合并方法、模型家族和任务上验证。
AI.result: 在视觉Transformer上实现6倍加速、70%内存降低；在大语言模型上实现20倍加速、85%内存降低，同时保持相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: αTransfer是一种高效且可泛化的模型合并扩展方法。

title: Mathematical Proof Assistants for Teaching Logic: The LogiKEy Methodology
summary: We report on an approach to teaching logic to mixed groups of computer science, mathematics, and philosophy students, based on the logico-pluralistic LogiKEy methodology, used for more than a decade in courses, summer schools, and tutorials. LogiKEy uses classical higher-order logic (HOL) as a universal metalogic in which object logics, classical and non-classical alike, are encoded by defining their semantics; through these semantical embeddings a single proof assistant (e.g. Isabelle/HOL), with its automated theorem provers and (counter-)model finders, becomes one environment in which students learn, experiment with, and compare logics. After making the pedagogical case for proof assistants in the logic classroom, we present a graded sequence of classroom examples, each transition motivated by a limitation of the preceding representation, by a need for more explicit modelling resources, or by a new application. A liars-and-truth-tellers puzzle leads from propositional to modal logic; the Wise Men puzzle leads on to dynamic epistemic logic; Boolos's curious inference illustrates what a higher-order meta-logic buys, even for automated proof search; Chisholm's paradox takes the sequence into deontic logic, and from standard to dyadic deontic logic; and Gödel's ontological argument brings it to a research-level metaphysical argument. We then rebut the objection that embedding everything in classical HOL is monism rather than pluralism, reflect on three years of teaching such a course, and sketch the portability of the approach beyond Isabelle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于 LogiKEy 方法论的逻辑教学法，以经典高阶逻辑(HOL)为通用元逻辑，通过语义嵌入在单一证明助手(如 Isabelle/HOL)中教授并比较多种对象逻辑，并用分级课堂案例加以说明。
AI.motivation: 面向计算机科学、数学与哲学混合学生群体的逻辑教学需要一个统一环境，既能学习、实验又能比较经典与非经典逻辑，同时论证证明助手在逻辑课堂中的教学价值。
AI.method: 采用逻辑多元主义的 LogiKEy 方法论，以经典高阶逻辑(HOL)作为通用元逻辑，通过定义语义对对象逻辑进行编码；借助单一证明助手(Isabelle/HOL)及其自动定理证明器和(反)模型查找器开展教学，并设计逐级递进的课堂示例序列。
AI.result: 给出分级案例序列：说谎者与诚实者谜题引导从命题逻辑到模态逻辑；智者谜题引出动态认知逻辑；Boolos 奇特推论展示高阶元逻辑对自动证明搜索的价值；Chisholm 悖论引入道义逻辑并从标准走向二元道义逻辑；Gödel 本体论论证延伸至研究级形而上学论证。
AI.conclusion: 反驳了"将一切嵌入经典HOL是独断论而非多元论"的质疑，反思了三年教学经验，并概述了该方法在 Isabelle 之外的移植性。

title: Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap
comment: paper accepted for presentation at IEEE-WHISPERS
summary: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于图块的HSI分类中随机训练-测试采样导致的同类空间重叠与数据泄漏问题，提出两种重叠度量（OP与AOR），实验表明随机采样会大幅高估深度模型性能。
AI.motivation: 基于图块的学习利用局部光谱-空间信息提升了高光谱图像分类效果，但从同一图像中随机划分训练/测试样本会造成空间图块重叠，从而产生数据泄漏和过于乐观的性能评估。论文旨在量化并揭示这一问题。
AI.method: 提出两种度量：重叠百分比（OP）衡量全局被重叠的测试图块像素比例；平均重叠比（AOR）衡量受影响测试图块中的局部重叠严重程度。在Pavia University数据集上，使用SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT和MorpMamba对比随机与非随机空间采样，并进行图块尺寸分析（5x5至19x19）。
AI.result: 随机采样下深度图块模型准确率高，3D-CNN达96.17% OA；非随机空间采样下性能大幅下降，3D-CNN降至55.20%，ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点。图块尺寸由5x5增至19x19时，随机采样重叠百分比从23.28%升至77.02%。
AI.conclusion: 基于随机图块的评估会显著夸大分类性能，尤其是强烈利用空间上下文的模型；需要采用空间上独立的采样策略以获得可靠评估。代码已开源。

title: TTNet: Multi-Task Deep Learning for Table Tennis Player Analysis with Smart Racket
summary: The AI CUP 2025 Precise Analysis of Table Tennis Smart Racket Data Competition introduced smart table tennis rackets that collect extensive player swing data, enabling research on table tennis big data. These data support in-depth analysis of players' return techniques and swing-force consistency, improving the accuracy of player skill assessment. This study focuses on six-axis sensor data collected by smart table tennis rackets and proposes TTNet, a novel deep learning model with multitask learning capabilities, to advance table tennis data analysis and related applications. TTNet combines convolutional neural networks (CNNs), residual networks (ResNet), and self-attention mechanisms to simultaneously predict four player attributes: gender, playing hand, years of experience, and skill level. We adopt a two-stage training strategy that incorporates data augmentation and task-specific loss functions to improve generalization on imbalanced data. Our approach achieved second place on the official competition leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对AI CUP 2025乒乓球智能球拍竞赛的六轴传感器数据，提出多任务深度学习模型TTNet，同时预测性别、持拍手、球龄和技能水平四项属性，在官方榜单上获得第二名。
AI.motivation: 智能乒乓球拍可采集大量挥拍数据，为乒乓球大数据研究提供支持，有助于深入分析回球技术与挥拍力量一致性，并提升球员技能评估的准确性，因此需要有效的建模方法推进相关数据分析与应用。
AI.method: TTNet融合卷积神经网络（CNN）、残差网络（ResNet）与自注意力机制，具备多任务学习能力，可同时预测性别、持拍手、球龄和技能水平四个球员属性。训练采用两阶段策略，结合数据增强与任务特定损失函数，以提升在不平衡数据上的泛化能力。
AI.result: 该方法在官方竞赛排行榜上取得第二名。
AI.conclusion: TTNet展现了多任务深度学习在智能球拍六轴传感器数据分析中的有效性，可支撑球员技能评估等乒乓球大数据应用。

title: Learn2Play Bench: How Well Do LLM Agents Learn from Experience in Unfamiliar Environments?
summary: Learning from experience is essential for LLM agents to adapt to unfamiliar and dynmaic environments. Evaluating this ability is therefore important for understanding how effectively agents acquire and use new knowledge. Existing benchmarks have sought to evaluate this ability, but they primarily evaluate tasks whose rules are provided in the instructions or already familiar to pretrained models, making it difficult to distinguish learning from interactions from reasoning with existing knowledge. To address this, we introduce Learn2Play Bench, a benchmark of newly designed text-based games, whose rules are novel or counterintuitive, requiring agents to acquire knowledge through interaction rather than rely solely on pretrained knowledge. These games provide reproducible feedback and automatic scoring, enabling controlled evaluation of learning across repeated attempts. We also vary game instances to test whether agents can apply what they have learned to new situations. Therefore, we evaluate how backbone models, self-evolving methods, and agent harnesses affect agents' learning ability, revealing three findings: (1) Experience retention: Retaining complete records of actions and feedback can support more effective learning than summarizing these experiences into rules or strategies. (2) Human agent gap: Top-performing human players achieve higher peak scores than the evaluated agents. Human explore more varied strategies, and repeat actions less. (3) Harness matters: With the backbone fixed, changing the harness can improve performance while reducing estimated inference cost. Together, these findings provide insights into how LLM agents learn from experience and suggest directions for future work to improve their learning ability. Project website: https://liushiliushi.github.io/learn2play-bench-website/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Learn2Play Bench，一个由规则新颖或反直觉的文本游戏组成的基准，用于评估 LLM 智能体从交互经验中学习的能力，并发现经验保留方式、人类与智能体差距以及 harness 设计三方面关键结论。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估规则已在指令中给出或预训练模型已熟悉的游戏，难以区分智能体是从交互中学习还是仅凭已有知识推理，因此需要一个能剥离预训练知识、专门考察经验学习能力的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建由新设计文本游戏组成的基准 Learn2Play Bench，游戏规则新颖或反直觉，迫使智能体通过交互获取知识；提供可复现反馈与自动评分，支持重复尝试下的受控评估；并通过变换游戏实例测试知识迁移能力。随后系统评估骨干模型、自进化方法和智能体 harness 对学习能力的影响。
AI.result: 得到三项发现：(1) 经验保留方面，完整保留动作与反馈记录比将其总结为规则或策略更利于学习；(2) 人机差距方面，顶尖人类玩家峰值得分高于被评估智能体，人类探索更多样策略、重复动作更少；(3) harness 方面，固定骨干模型时，更换 harness 可提升性能并降低估算推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了 LLM 智能体从经验中学习的机制与不足，为未来提升其学习能力指明方向，并提供公开项目网站以便复现与使用。

title: Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: BASA是一种后端无关的稀疏注意力方法，通过跨DiT块的移位局部窗口注意力实现全局信息交换，在消除窗口伪影的同时获得接近理论值的实际加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）在图像和视频生成中表现优异，但全注意力的二次复杂度使高分辨率生成的计算开销巨大。窗口注意力是一种高效替代方案，但现有方法面临两难：分区窗口注意力计算效率与理论复杂度一致，但孤立的窗口阻断了跨窗口交互，常产生可见的网格状伪影；细粒度滑窗注意力能恢复相邻窗口交互、改善视觉质量，但其不规则计算模式导致理论与实际加速之间存在巨大差距，且需要针对每种硬件后端定制专用核。因此需要一种兼顾视觉质量与实际加速的方法。
AI.method: BASA用移位局部窗口注意力替换视觉自注意力。通过在DiT块之间引入结构化的窗口移位方案，使某一层中被窗口边界分隔的token能在后续层中相互通信，从而实现全局信息交换并消除窗口引起的视觉伪影。该设计不引入额外的非规则算子或定制核，可直接部署在现有注意力后端上，缩小理论稀疏性与实际加速之间的差距。
AI.result: 实验表明，BASA在FLUX上实现了超过理论估计90%的实测加速，在Wan上实现了4.52倍注意力加速，同时保持具有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: BASA作为一种后端无关的稀疏注意力方法，结合了移位局部窗口注意力，在保持生成质量的同时实现了接近理论值的实际加速，且易于在现有后端部署，为高分辨率DiT生成提供了高效的注意力解决方案。

title: CANDLE: Cortical Null-Space Decomposition for Noninvasive Brain Source Imaging
summary: Electrophysiological source imaging (ESI) aims to estimate cortical source activity from noninvasive electrophysiological measurements such as electroencephalogram (EEG). However, ESI is fundamentally ill-posed because source activity is substantially higher-dimensional than sensor observations, resulting in non-unique solutions. Recent learning-based approaches address this ambiguity by learning data-driven source priors, yet they often struggle to generalize across subject-specific cortical geometries. To address this, we propose CANDLE, a learning-based ESI model that estimates source activity on subject-specific cortical geometries. CANDLE learns a prior over the null space induced by the source-to-sensor mapping derived from T1-weighted MRI, restricting learning to unobservable source components while preserving geometric constraints. To train CANDLE, we develop a whole-brain simulator spanning over 1,100 subject-specific cortical geometries with source configurations derived from over 26,000 statistical brain maps. Trained exclusively on simulated data, CANDLE outperformed prior ESI methods on simulated source activity estimation and generalized to two empirical tasks: (i) intracranial stimulation localization from simultaneously recorded scalp EEG and (ii) epileptogenic zone estimation from presurgical interictal EEG. Our project page is available at https://candle-esi.pages.dev}{https://candle-esi.pages.dev.

AI.tldr: CANDLE 是一种基于学习的电生理源成像（ESI）模型，通过在由源到传感器映射导出的零空间上学习先验，实现受试者个体化皮层几何上的源活动估计，并在仿真与两项真实任务中超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: ESI 本质上是病态反问题，源活动维度远高于传感器观测，解不唯一。现有基于学习的方法依赖数据驱动的源先验，但难以泛化到个体特异的皮层几何结构。
AI.method: 提出 CANDLE：在由 T1 加权 MRI 导出的源到传感器映射所诱导的零空间上学习先验，仅对不可观测的源成分建模以保持几何约束；构建覆盖 1100+ 个体化皮层几何、源配置来自 26000+ 统计脑图的全脑模拟器，仅用仿真数据训练。
AI.result: 仅在仿真数据上训练的 CANDLE 在仿真源活动估计上优于既有 ESI 方法，并泛化到两项实证任务：(i) 由同步头皮 EEG 进行颅内刺激定位；(ii) 由术前发作间期 EEG 进行致痫区估计。
AI.conclusion: CANDLE 通过零空间先验学习有效缓解 ESI 的病态性与跨受试者几何泛化难题，展示了仿真训练模型向真实临床任务迁移的潜力。

title: Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN): Resource-Aware Hybrid Vision-Language Fusion via Trainable Entanglement
summary: Multimodal vision-language systems typically fuse image and text embeddings through classical operators such as concatenation, attention, bilinear pooling, or tensor interactions. We propose Quantum Entangled Multimodal Fusion Networks (QEMFN), a hybrid quantum-classical framework that introduces parameterized entanglement as a structured inductive bias for multimodal fusion. Pretrained visual and textual features are projected into compact latent spaces, encoded as angle-parameterized quantum states, processed through intra-modal and paired cross-modal entangling circuits, and measured to produce fused representations for retrieval. Under matched parameter budgets and identical frozen CLIP backbones, QEMFN outperforms classical fusion baselines on COCO-5k and Flickr30k, including multilayer perceptron, tensor fusion, FiLM, cross-attention, compact transformer, and a dequantized paired-topology analogue. An ablation suite isolates the quantum module's contribution from the surrounding classical projections, and quantum-centric analyses report Meyer-Wallach entangling capability, expressibility, gradient variance against barren-plateau bounds, and entropy-performance correlation under controls for training progress alongside an intervention study on the entangling component. QEMFN is executed under shot-based estimation, a noise-modeled fake backend, and a real superconducting device with zero-noise extrapolation. This work does not claim quantum computational advantage; the contribution is the framework together with a controlled empirical and quantum-centric evaluation that positions trainable entanglement as an interpretable, hardware-executable fusion mechanism at scales accessible on contemporary devices.

AI.tldr: 提出量子纠缠多模态融合网络QEMFN，将参数化纠缠作为归纳偏置用于图文融合，在检索任务上超越经典融合基线，并在真实量子设备上执行。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态视觉-语言系统多用拼接、注意力、双线性池化或张量交互等经典算子融合图像与文本嵌入，缺少一种结构化的、可解释的融合归纳偏置。作者希望探索将可训练的量子纠缠作为多模态融合机制。
AI.method: 提出混合量子-经典框架QEMFN：将预训练视觉与文本特征投影到紧凑潜在空间，编码为角度参数化量子态，经模态内及成对跨模态纠缠电路处理，再测量得到融合表示用于检索。在相同参数预算和相同冻结CLIP主干下与多种经典融合基线对比。
AI.result: 在COCO-5k和Flickr30k上优于多层感知机、张量融合、FiLM、交叉注意力、紧凑Transformer及去量子化的成对拓扑对照模型。消融实验分离量子模块贡献；量子分析报告Meyer-Wallach纠缠能力、可表达性、相对贫瘠高原界的梯度方差及熵-性能相关性，并含纠缠组件干预研究。在散粒估计、噪声建模假后端及带零噪声外推的真实超导设备上执行。
AI.conclusion: 作者不主张量子计算优势，贡献在于该框架及受控的经验与量子评估，将可训练纠缠定位为一种可解释、可由硬件执行的融合机制，且规模适用于当代设备。

title: CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching
summary: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的CtrlCache控制感知缓存框架，根据控制序列动作变化对视频块进行分级调度与复用，在无需重训的前提下实现DiT骨干1.21x–1.41x加速并提升WBench分数。
AI.motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需高效生成视频块并忠实响应用户控制。现有块级自回归加少步去噪仍存在多次昂贵的去噪迭代；免训练缓存虽可降本，但现有策略主要依赖模型内部去噪动态做复用决策，未显式考虑控制变化，忽略了"控制先于去噪到达"这一零前向开销的可用信号。
AI.method: 作者分析不同控制状态下相邻块的相似性，发现动作切换处结构相似性下降，且低频结构比高频细节更持久。据此提出CtrlCache：动作感知调度与刷新策略跨块和块内检测动作变化，将块标记为initial、transition、turning、steady；在某个内部去噪步，initial与transition块保留完整计算，turning与steady块复用同一块内最近一次完整计算步的transformer残差。此外引入频率混合历史先验引导，在无需额外DiT前向的情况下融合前一干净latent的互补信息。
AI.result: 在Matrix-Game 2.0和LingBot-World v1/v2上评估，CtrlCache在无需模型重训下实现DiT骨干1.21x–1.41x加速，且在三个模型上均提升WBench总体分数。
AI.conclusion: 利用控制信号进行免训练缓存调度，可在提升交互视频生成效率的同时改善生成质量，验证了控制感知复用策略的有效性。

title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Refreshing Memory for Frozen Time-Series Forecasters
summary: Retrieval-augmented time-series forecasting uses the continuations of historical segments similar to the current context as references for a forecaster. Most existing methods build the retrieval memory once from the training segment, leaving observations revealed after deployment unavailable as references, and generally do not calibrate how much the retrieved information should influence a frozen forecaster. We identify two key determinants of retrieval utility for a frozen forecaster: whether the history still reflects the current state, and whether the correction it induces aligns with the forecaster's residual errors, an alignment that can shift between validation and deployment when the memory becomes stale. We propose FreshCast, a plug-in retrieval framework that keeps the forecaster frozen, continuously updates a non-parametric memory with new observations, forms a memory forecast through relational kernel regression, and calibrates its weight in closed form on the validation segment. Under a simplified generative model, we characterize the optimal combination gain through the second-order relation between forecaster error and memory correction, and show that a sufficiently long look-back can make periodic memory information redundant. Across seven benchmarks and ten forecasting architectures, FreshCast reduces average MSE for every evaluated forecaster and input length, by 14.6% and 5.6% at input lengths 96 and 720, and achieves lower MSE than the evaluated retrieval-augmented and online baselines in their comparison settings. Ablations show that freezing the memory at the end of training removes most of the gain, identifying post-training observations as a primary source of improvement. For a frozen forecaster, useful historical references must remain timely and provide information that helps correct its remaining errors.

AI.tldr: 提出 FreshCast，一种插件式检索增强框架，在保持预测器冻结的同时持续更新非参数记忆并用闭式解校准其权重，在七个基准与十种预测架构上降低 MSE。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强时间序列预测方法多在训练阶段一次性构建记忆，部署后新观测无法作为参考；且一般不校准检索信息对冻结预测器的影响权重。作者识别出决定检索效用的两个关键因素：历史是否仍反映当前状态，以及检索带来的修正是否与预测器残差对齐（该对齐在验证到部署间会因记忆陈旧而漂移）。
AI.method: FreshCast 保持预测器冻结，用新观测持续更新非参数记忆，通过关系核回归形成记忆预测，并在验证段上以闭式解校准其组合权重。作者在简化生成模型下刻画了最优组合增益与预测器误差、记忆修正之间的二阶关系。
AI.result: 在七个基准和十种预测架构上，FreshCast 对每个预测器和输入长度都降低了平均 MSE，在输入长度 96 和 720 时分别降低 14.6% 和 5.6%，并在其比较设置下优于所评估的检索增强与在线基线。消融实验显示，在训练结束时冻结记忆会消除大部分增益。
AI.conclusion: 对冻结预测器而言，有用的历史参考必须保持时效性，并提供有助于修正其剩余误差的信息；训练后的新观测是性能提升的主要来源。

title: Confidence-Ordering Reversal under Contextual Priors in Neural Decoding
summary: Contextual priors improve neural-to-language decoding by reshaping candidate scores. However, confidence is read from the same reshaped scores, so the errors a prior leaves behind can become more confident with no change in accuracy to reveal it. We study how a prior shapes confidence in speech retrieval on MEG-MASC and MOUS using local decoding scores, a contextual prior combined by additive shallow fusion, and the fused top-two margin as confidence. Among initially incorrect predictions, we find a confidence-ordering reversal: a larger margin makes a repair more likely when the correct candidate starts near the top of the local ranking, but less likely when it starts lower. On MEG-MASC, pooled correctness AUROC is 0.87, yet AUROC separating repairs from residual errors falls from 0.70 at initial ranks 2-3 to 0.39 at ranks 21-50. Errors starting beyond rank 20, inside the reversed region, make up 46.6% of all post-fusion errors. We propose a score-level account: a repair must first close the correct candidate's initial deficit, limiting its final margin, whereas a residual error can build a large margin between two incorrect candidates. A causal intervention that changes only the fusion weight moves the reversal to deeper ranks as predicted. Under a word-level LM prior, it keeps moving after accuracy gain peaks, so a weight chosen for accuracy does not settle confidence. Reading local and prior scores separately improves selective decoding: the decoder answers on 74.5% of windows instead of 56.7%, while 92% of output sets still contain the correct candidate. Confidence after contextual fusion should retain the local and contextual evidence behind each prediction, not just the fused scores. Project website: https://confidencereversal.github.io/; Code: https://github.com/AmadeusFake/NeuDecodingConfReversal

AI.tldr: 上下文先验通过重塑候选分数来提升神经到语言解码，但置信度也从同一分数读出，导致先验残留的错误可能变得更自信而准确率却保持不变。本文以融合后的top-two margin作为置信度，发现了"置信度排序反转"现象，并提出了仅改变融合权重的因果干预加以验证。
AI.motivation: 上下文先验能改善神经解码的候选排序，但由于置信度与先验共享同一套重塑后的分数，先验未能修正的错误会在准确率不变的情况下获得更高置信度，从而使选择性解码的可靠评估失效。作者希望弄清先验究竟如何塑造置信度，尤其是错误预测的置信度如何随初始排序位置变化。
AI.method: 在MEG-MASC和MOUS数据集上研究语音检索，使用局部解码分数、通过加性浅层融合（shallow fusion）结合上下文先验，并用融合后的top-two margin作为置信度。分析初始错误预测中margin与"被修复"概率的关系，比较不同初始排名的AUROC。进一步用只改变融合权重的因果干预，检验反转位置随权重的移动情况，并提出分数层面的解释。
AI.result: 发现置信度排序反转：当正确候选初始接近榜首时，margin越大越可能被修复；初始靠后时则相反。MEG-MASC上整体正确性AUROC为0.87，但区分修复与残留错误的AUROC从初始排名2-3的0.70降至排名21-50的0.39。初始排名20以后的错误位于反转区，占所有融合后错误的46.6%。因果干预改变融合权重可将反转移到更深的排名，且在词级LM先验下，这种移动在准确率增益达到峰值后仍继续。分别读取局部分数与先验分数可提升选择性解码：回答窗口比例从56.7%升至74.5%，同时92%的输出集仍包含正确候选。
AI.conclusion: 上下文融合后的置信度不应只依赖融合分数，而应保留每个预测背后的局部证据与上下文证据。原因是修复需要先弥补正确候选的初始排名赤字，从而限制其最终margin；而残留错误可在两个错误候选之间积累出大margin，导致反转现象。分开读取局部与先验分数能显著改善选择性解码。

title: ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing
summary: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

AI.tldr: ALIVE 提出一个视频编辑框架，使插入的视频对象能与原始内容产生连贯交互（如被拿起、被操作），仅需编辑后的首帧和一条命名新增对象的指令即可实现。
AI.motivation: 现有视频编辑器能插入对象，但难以让插入对象参与交互（例如被拿起或被操作），因此需要一种能让插入对象"活起来"、与源视频内容协调互动的框架。
AI.method: 构建了35,800个编辑配对数据，融合3D渲染、模型生成、真实世界视频以及ROSE的通用编辑配对；每对数据仅在目标对象是否存在上有差异，同时保留周围动作，从而教会编辑器协调的对象行为与源内容保持。此外训练一个视觉语言模型（VLM），从相同输入中预测交互引导信息。
AI.result: 在无VLM引导下，ALIVE在ALIVE-interaction基准与通用视频对象插入基准上的Overall指标分别比最强基线提升43.9%和4.4%；加入VLM预测的引导后，ALIVE-interaction分数进一步提升0.95分，且无需额外用户输入。
AI.conclusion: ALIVE通过精心构建的编辑配对数据和VLM交互引导，有效提升了插入对象与源视频的交互保真度、源内容保持和视觉连贯性，并提出了统一的VLM评估协议。

title: Privileged Context as Drift in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a language model to match a copy of itself conditioned on privileged context. Existing work varies what privileged context contains and how it is produced while also changing models, data, and training setups, making the effects of privileged context design difficult to isolate. Motivated by efforts in continual learning to reduce catastrophic forgetting, we study how the choice of privileged context affects policy drift. Specifically, we vary two axes: content (a demonstration, feedback, or rephrase) and source (external, self-generated with a verifier, or self-generated without a verifier). We train Qwen2.5-7B with OPSD across these nine combinations and three datasets, measuring target-task accuracy, prior-task retention, reverse KL from the base policy, and parameter-update geometry. Holding source fixed, changing content spans a wider median KL range than holding content fixed and changing source. The ratio between these ranges is $5.1\times$ for per-token KL and $2.2\times$ for per-sequence KL. Parameter-update geometry shows the same pattern: updates from adapters that share content are more closely aligned (mean cosine $0.571$) than updates from adapters that share source ($0.255$). For continual learning, these findings suggest that privileged context should be treated as part of OPSD's stability design because it is associated with how far and in what direction the policy moves.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究on-policy self-distillation (OPSD)中特权上下文设计对策略漂移的影响，发现内容维度的选择比来源维度更能决定策略偏移的距离与方向。
AI.motivation: 现有OPSD研究在特权上下文内容、生成方式以及模型、数据、训练设置上各不相同，导致特权上下文设计的效果难以被单独分离出来。受持续学习中减少灾难性遗忘工作的启发，作者希望厘清特权上下文的选择如何影响策略漂移。
AI.method: 作者沿两个维度变化特权上下文：内容（演示、反馈、复述）与来源（外部提供、带验证器的自生成、不带验证器的自生成），共九种组合。在Qwen2.5-7B上以OPSD训练，覆盖三个数据集，并测量目标任务准确率、先前任务保留率、相对基础策略的reverse KL，以及参数更新几何。
AI.result: 固定来源时改变内容所带来的KL中位数范围，比固定内容时改变来源更宽：每token KL为5.1倍，每序列KL为2.2倍。参数更新几何呈现相同模式：共享内容的adapter更新对齐度更高（平均余弦0.571），共享来源的则较低（0.255）。
AI.conclusion: 对于持续学习而言，这些发现表明特权上下文应被视为OPSD稳定性设计的一部分，因为它与策略移动的距离和方向相关。

title: OSFP4: Joint Optimization of Diagonal Smoothing and Block Scales for NVFP4 Quantization
summary: NVFP4 is an attractive datatype for large language model (LLM) inference, offering compact storage and native tensor-core acceleration. However, preserving accuracy using NVFP4 requires careful quantization. In this work we develop a novel quantization scheme called Optimized Smoothing and Scaling for NVFP4 (OSFP4). For each linear projection it uses a diagonal smoothing matrix whose entries are optimized to minimize the squared matrix-product quantization error under NVFP4, taking into account the rounding procedure that is used (either round-to-nearest, or GPTQ-style successive interference cancellation). This requires performing joint optimization on the smoothing entries as well as the block scales, which is facilitated by analyzing a multiplicative-dither FP4 quantizer instead of the fixed deterministic one. Experiments show that OSFP4 achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated competitors in the corresponding quantization settings, while retaining approximately 94-97\% of vendor NVFP4 prefill throughput on the measured workloads. Our code is available in https://github.com/neriahbd/OSFP4

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSFP4，一种面向NVFP4数据类型的量化方案，通过优化对角平滑矩阵与块缩放因子来最小化线性投影的量化误差，在保持高效吞吐的同时实现更高精度。
AI.motivation: NVFP4虽具备紧凑存储与原生张量核加速优势，但用它保持LLM推理精度需要精细的量化处理，现有方法精度不足。
