This paper introduces Mu-DisCoCat: a multimodal variational quantum learning framework for DisCoCat that achieves CoCoGen. The framework first learns stable object representations from single-object image-text pairs, then fixes these and uses them to learn the relations between them in multi-object situations. In classical simulations, the model used Uhlmann state fidelity to compute the overlap between the multimodal circuit representations and achieved higher relational OOD accuracy than the evaluated CLIP baseline. Its deployment was evaluated using the destructive SWAP test across noisy quantum emulators, including a range of IBM fake backends, IQM FakeAphrodite, and the IBM Marrakesh quantum processor. Despite real-world device noise, the hardware-executed models maintained a strong positive correlation with simulated fidelities, reliably distinguishing unseen similar and dissimilar pairs. Our work establishes a framework for executing CoCoGen on VQCs, demonstrating a viable use case for near-term quantum hardware.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Mu-DisCoCat，一个多模态变分量子学习框架，实现组合概念泛化（CoCoGen），并在经典模拟与含噪量子硬件上验证了其可行性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 组合概念泛化（通过重组已学原语理解新情境）是人工智能的根本挑战。组合分布语义（DisCoCat）通过将向量推广为张量来提供解决方案，但在学习张量时存在扩展瓶颈；将其映射到变分量子电路（VQC）虽能缓解文本场景的局限，但尚未扩展到 CoCoGen 所涉及的多模态情境。
AI.method: 提出 Mu-DisCoCat 多模态变分量子学习框架：首先从单物体图文对中学习稳定的物体表示，然后固定这些表示，用于学习多物体情境中物体之间的关系。在经典模拟中使用 Uhlmann 态保真度计算多模态电路表示之间的重叠；在含噪量子模拟器（多种 IBM 假后端、IQM FakeAphrodite）与 IBM Marrakesh 量子处理器上，采用破坏性 SWAP 测试评估部署效果。
AI.result: 在经典模拟中，模型在关系 OOD 准确率上超过所评估的 CLIP 基线。在含噪量子模拟器与真实量子处理器上，尽管存在真实设备噪声，硬件执行的模型与模拟保真度之间仍保持强正相关，能够可靠区分未见过的相似与不相似配对。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了一个在变分量子电路上执行 CoCoGen 的框架，展示了近-term 量子硬件的可行用例。

title: SepsisLens: Structure-Preserving Sequence Modelling for Decomposable Early Sepsis Warning
summary: Early sepsis warning from ICU records can be cast as a structure-preserving prediction problem. A model needs to detect deterioration from irregular measurements while keeping each alert connected to the physiological signals that support it. Many temporal models fuse clinical variables into a patient-level representation, supporting scalar risk prediction but weakening the structure needed for clinical decomposition. We present SepsisLens, which preserves variable-indexed temporal states until risk composition. Observation-aware representations encode each variable's dynamics and measurement history, while a shared temporal encoder models each trajectory without collapsing the variable axis. The StructuredRiskHead composes multi-horizon risk from explicit variable-level and organ-level components. We evaluate SepsisLens on three public ICU cohorts and one private-hospital cohort under a common pre-onset protocol. SepsisLens achieves strong discrimination on all four cohorts and lower alert burden at matched event recall on MIMIC-IV. Structural ablations support the design, while input-side masking shows that the ranked components reflect variables with greater influence on prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出SepsisLens，一种结构保持的脓毒症早期预警模型，在风险合成前维持变量索引的时序状态，实现可分解的预警。
AI.motivation: ICU早期脓毒症预警需从非规则测量中检测恶化，同时保持每个警报与支持它的生理信号关联。但许多时序模型将临床变量融合为患者级表示，支持标量风险预测却削弱了临床可分解性所需的结构。
AI.method: SepsisLens在风险合成前保留变量索引的时序状态：观察感知表示编码各变量的动态与测量历史，共享时序编码器在不压缩变量轴的情况下建模各轨迹，StructuredRiskHead从显式的变量级和器官级组件合成多时间跨度风险。
AI.result: 在三个公共ICU队列和一个私立医院队列上采用统一的发病前协议评估。SepsisLens在四个队列上均取得强判别性能，并在匹配事件召回率下于MIMIC-IV上降低警报负担。结构消融支持该设计，输入侧掩码显示排序组件反映了对预测影响更大的变量。
AI.conclusion: SepsisLens通过结构保持设计实现了可分解且高性能的脓毒症早期预警，兼顾判别能力与警报负担控制，并具备临床可解释性。

title: AnyBottle: A Recipe to Only Keep the Concepts You Really Need
summary: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) make predictions inspectable and intervenable by routing them through human-interpretable concepts, but originally required concept annotations. Annotation-free variants remove this requirement, but typically use large concept vocabularies, static at both training and inference, producing bottlenecks larger than any task or prediction needs and harder to inspect. We propose AnyBottle, a single recipe for building compact, task-specific CBMs. AnyBottle assumes only a frozen backbone and an unsupervised concept pool, such as a sparse autoencoder. A black-box teacher trained on the same backbone then guides selection: each round adds the concept that best explains the bottleneck's current failures, with candidates restricted to regions of teacher/student disagreement. Trained with nested dropout over this selection order, the final bottleneck predicts accurately from any concept prefix, so inference spends fewer concepts on inputs it is confident about early and more on hard ones. Since no stage is modality-specific, a new domain and task requires swapping only the backbone and concept pool. Across six vision and two text datasets and two teacher paradigms, AnyBottle yields bottlenecks with fewer concepts and higher concept consistency than annotation-free baselines, while staying close to the black-box reference. Overall, AnyBottle shows that going annotation-free need not mean going large: a small, discovered vocabulary can be as expressive as a much larger, fixed one.

AI.tldr: AnyBottle 提出一种通用方案，在无概念标注条件下，通过黑盒教师引导选择任务相关概念，构建紧凑且可干预的概念瓶颈，实现小而高效的可解释模型。
AI.motivation: 原始概念瓶颈模型需要人工概念标注，而无标注变体虽免去标注，却采用庞大且固定的概念词表，导致瓶颈规模远超任务或预测需要，难以检验和干预。作者希望解决"无标注是否必然意味着大规模概念"这一问题。
AI.method: AnyBottle 仅需一个冻结骨干网络和一个无监督概念池（如稀疏自编码器）。在同骨干上训练黑盒教师，通过多轮选择逐步加入最能解释当前瓶颈失败的概念，候选概念限定在师生模型分歧区域。训练时按选择顺序采用嵌套 dropout，使最终瓶颈在任意概念前缀下都能准确预测，从而在推理时可对置信输入使用更少概念、对困难输入使用更多概念。该方法不依赖特定模态，仅需替换骨干与概念池即可迁移到新领域。
AI.result: 在六个视觉数据集和两个文本数据集、两种教师范式下，AnyBottle 相比无标注基线产生概念数更少、概念一致性更高的瓶颈，同时性能接近黑盒参考模型。
AI.conclusion: 无标注方法不必然意味着大概念词表：一个通过自动发现得到的小词表，可以与更大规模的固定词表同样具有表达力，从而获得紧凑、任务特定且可检验、可干预的概念瓶颈模型。

title: Less Is More: A Leakage-Controlled Study of Dermoscopic Preprocessing for Joint Skin Lesion Classification and Segmentation with YOLO26
summary: Handcrafted preprocessing is widely employed in automated dermoscopic analysis to suppress imaging artifacts and enhance lesion visibility. Nevertheless, its actual contribution to modern real-time models remains unclear, particularly when evaluation protocols do not adequately control correlations among images of the same lesion. This study presents a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint evaluation of dermoscopic preprocessing and augmentation for joint multi-class lesion classification and instance segmentation using a fixed nano-scale YOLO26 segmentation model (YOLO26n-seg). From HAM10000 (10,015 images), quality control yields 10,013 valid image-mask pairs from 7,468 unique lesions, partitioned into mutually exclusive sets by lesion identity. With the architecture, resolution, training budget, and evaluation protocol held fixed, we compare minimally processed images plus online augmentation against offline class balancing, DullRazor-CLAHE preprocessing, and raw-processed hybrid views, over three random seeds. On the lesion-disjoint test set, the raw baseline achieves a mask mAP$_{50:95}$ of $0.5636 \pm 0.0234$, a Dice score of $0.9356 \pm 0.0024$, and a macro-F1 score of $0.6917 \pm 0.0202$. Offline augmentation does not improve the mean performance, while the combined and hybrid strategies reduce both class-aware segmentation and classification accuracy. At only 2.69 million parameters, the model runs at approximately 50 frames per second. Under a leakage-controlled, lesion-disjoint protocol with all non-input factors held fixed, minimally processed dermoscopic images combined with standard online augmentation deliver a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than increasingly complex deterministic preprocessing, which yields no consistent joint benefit across three seeds on HAM10000.

AI.tldr: 在无泄漏、病灶不相交的评估协议下，对YOLO26n-seg固定设置进行对比，发现极少预处理的皮肤镜图像配在线增强，在分类与分割联合任务上的精度—效率权衡优于复杂预处理。
AI.motivation: 手工预处理在皮肤镜自动化分析中被广泛使用，但其对现代实时模型的真实贡献不明；现有评估协议常未控制同一病灶图像间的相关性，导致数据泄漏，结论存疑。
AI.method: 基于HAM10000（10,015张），质控得10,013对图像—掩码，来自7,468个病灶，按病灶身份划分为互斥集合。固定YOLO26n-seg架构、分辨率、训练预算与评估协议，比较极简处理+在线增强、离线类别平衡、DullRazor-CLAHE预处理及原图—处理混合视图，运行三个随机种子。
AI.result: 病灶不相交测试集上，原图基线掩码mAP50:95为0.5636±0.0234，Dice为0.9356±0.0024，macro-F1为0.6917±0.0202。离线增强未提升平均性能；组合与混合策略反而降低类别感知分割与分类精度。模型仅2.69M参数，约50 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 在控制泄漏、病灶不相交且非输入因素固定的条件下，极少预处理图像配合标准在线增强，比日益复杂的确定性预处理具有更好的精度—效率权衡，且三个种子上无一致联合收益。

title: A Riemannian Geometry for Low-rank Adaptation
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is widely used as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning technique for pre-trained deep neural networks, which approximates the weight update via full fine-tuning by a low-rank matrix $BA^\top$. This parameterization leads to the equivalence relation $(B, A) \sim (BG^{-1}, AG^\top)$ for any invertible matrix $G$ because $BA^\top = BG^{-1}(AG^\top)^\top$ and thus both pairs yield the same loss value. This relation induces a quotient manifold where matrices $(BG^{-1}, AG^\top)$ for all $G$ are identified, eliminating redundant directions along which the loss value remains unchanged. To respect the geometry of this manifold, the original search space is endowed with a Riemannian metric that is invariant under the equivalence relation. Such a metric induces preconditioning at each gradient step and ensures that each weight update via LoRA changes the loss value, leading to efficient optimization. In this paper, we propose a new Riemannian metric that is specifically tailored to LoRA to close the gap to full fine-tuning at the weight level. We theoretically show that LoRA with our preconditioning induced by this metric satisfies the following two properties at each iteration: (i) The weight update follows the direction closest to the gradient of full fine-tuning within the subspace of first-order weight changes allowed by the LoRA parameterization. (ii) The updated weight matrix is closer in Frobenius norm to that of full fine-tuning than the updated weight matrices of LoRA with conventional preconditioning and without preconditioning. These theoretical insights suggest that our preconditioning makes LoRA better approximate full fine-tuning, thereby leading to more efficient optimization. Experiments show the effectiveness and efficiency of our preconditioning for LoRA on fine-tuning tasks with language and vision domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种专为LoRA定制的黎曼度量，通过诱导预条件优化使LoRA的权重更新更接近全量微调，从而提升微调效率与效果。
AI.motivation: LoRA用低秩矩阵BA^T近似全量微调的权重更新，其参数化存在等价关系(B,A)~(BG^{-1},AG^T)，形成商流形并带来冗余方向。现有预条件方法未充分针对LoRA结构，导致与全量微调在权重层面存在差距，优化效率受限。
AI.method: 在LoRA参数空间中引入对等价关系不变的黎曼度量，设计一种专门针对LoRA结构的预条件方案。该度量在每个梯度步诱导预条件，保证每次LoRA权重更新都改变损失值，并在理论上刻画其更新方向与全量微调梯度的关系。
AI.result: 理论上证明：在每次迭代中，(i)权重更新方向在LoRA参数化所允许的一阶权重变化子空间内最接近全量微调的梯度；(ii)更新后的权重矩阵在Frobenius范数上比使用传统预条件及无预条件的LoRA更接近全量微调结果。语言与视觉领域微调实验验证了该方法的高效性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该黎曼预条件方法使LoRA更好地逼近全量微调，弥合权重层面的差距，实现更高效的优化，并在语言和视觉微调任务上均表现有效。

title: Adaptive Power Sampling for LLM Reasoning
summary: Sequence-level power sampling has recently emerged as a training-free approach to reasoning by sampling from a sharpened output distribution of a base large language model (LLM). Nevertheless, existing methods typically sharpen the base model distribution uniformly across queries, overlooking variations in query difficulty and in how well the base model already handles each query. The goal of this work is to equip power sampling with query adaptivity. Theoretically, we show that the benefits of further sharpening are determined by the self-reward gap between correct and incorrect responses. Based on this insight, we propose \emph{Adaptive Power Sampling} (APS), which adjusts the sharpening exponent on a per-query basis at test time using the relationship between answer agreement and the model's self-reward. Experiments across diverse reasoning tasks, including MATH500, HumanEval, and GPQA, show that APS consistently outperforms power sampling with a fixed sharpening exponent, without additional training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应幂采样（APS），在测试时根据查询难度与自奖励差异，逐查询调整锐化指数，无需训练即可提升大模型推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有序列级幂采样方法对所有查询采用统一的锐化程度，忽略了查询难度以及基座模型自身处理能力上的差异，因此需要为幂采样引入查询自适应性。
AI.method: 理论分析表明进一步锐化的收益由正确与错误回答之间的自奖励差距决定；据此提出APS，在测试时利用答案一致性与模型自奖励之间的关系，对每个查询单独调整锐化指数。
AI.result: 在MATH500、HumanEval、GPQA等多种推理任务上，APS均稳定优于固定锐化指数的幂采样方法。
AI.conclusion: APS以无需额外训练的方式实现了查询自适应的幂采样，验证了按查询调整锐化程度的有效性与通用性。

title: Detecting a Shift Is Not Enough: Exact Minimax Limits of Linear Representation Repair
summary: A mean shift between two data sources can be easy to detect but hard to remove without substantially changing their representations. We cast its removal as a statistical decision problem: from noisy differences between paired calibration measurements in $\mathbb{R}^d$, learn one linear map, applied to both sources under a hard distortion budget, that leaves as little of the shift as possible on fresh data. We derive the exact finite-sample minimax risk over all such maps, $(d-k) \mathbb{E}[1/(d+2J)]$ with $J\sim\mathrm{Pois}(κ/2)$, where the budget allows deleting $k$ directions and $κ$ is the calibration signal-to-noise ratio. Projecting out the mean calibration difference attains it without knowing $κ$ or the noise scale. This exposes a detection-repair gap: detecting the shift needs only $κ\gg\sqrt d$, whereas removing a fixed fraction of it at constant distortion needs $κ\asymp d$, as for estimating its direction. Standard linear concept erasers (MP, SAL, LEACE) remove the same calibration difference, so the formula gives, before fitting, exactly how much shift they leave on fresh data and how much calibration a target requires. The limit is robust: pairing keeps it exact for non-Gaussian shared content, the projection keeps its guarantee under anisotropic noise, and selective abstention cannot close the gap. On paired clinical and wearable sleep EEG, where differences between participants act as calibration noise, the formula predicts the device shift left in new participants, and more recordings per person soon stop helping. Together, these results tell whether a correction that falls short needs a better method, more recordings, or more participants.

AI.tldr: 该论文将两数据源间均值漂移的去除建模为统计决策问题，在硬失真预算下推导出精确的有限样本极小极大风险公式 (d-k)E[1/(d+2J)]，揭示检测漂移与修复漂移之间存在显著的样本复杂度差距，并解释了标准线性概念擦除器的行为极限。
AI.motivation: 两数据源之间的均值漂移容易被检测但难以在不大幅改变表示的情况下移除。现有线性概念擦除方法虽能去除校准差异，但缺乏对"在新鲜数据上残留多少漂移"以及"需要多少校准数据"的理论刻画，因此作者希望建立一个精确的统计理论来指导校正实践。
AI.method: 将漂移去除建模为统计决策问题：从配对校准测量在R^d中的含噪差异出发，学习一个同时作用于两个数据源的线性映射，在硬失真预算下最小化新鲜数据上残留的漂移。作者推导了所有此类映射的精确有限样本极小极大风险，并证明直接投影掉均值校准差异可在不知κ和噪声尺度的情况下达到该风险上界。
AI.result: 极小手极大风险为 (d-k)E[1/(d+2J)]，其中J~Pois(κ/2)，k为可删除方向数，κ为校准信噪比。检测漂移仅需κ≫√d，而在常数失真下移除固定比例漂移需要κ≍d。投影方法无需知道κ或噪声尺度即可达到该界限，且在配对非高斯共享内容、各向异性噪声下保持稳健，选择性弃权无法弥合差距。在配对的临床与可穿戴睡眠EEG上，公式能预测新被试中残留的设备漂移，并表明增加每人记录数很快不再有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 该理论给出了漂移去除的精确极限，并揭示检测-修复差距。标准线性概念擦除器（MP、SAL、LEACE）去除相同的校准差异，因此该公式可在拟合前精确预测它们在新鲜数据上残留多少漂移以及目标所需校准量。这些结果可用于判断校正不足时应改进方法、增加记录还是增加被试数量。

title: MINDSET: Energy-based Schema Evolution for Long Conversational Agent Memory
summary: Long conversational agents have become essential in our daily lives. They must remember what was said long back in order to help us efficiently complete a task without needing the user to repeat instructions and context repeatedly. However, the main issue is that instructions and context change over time and so the agents must be able to adapt accordingly. A useful memory system should preserve both current and historical states, distinguish stale information from active knowledge, retrieve evidence appropriate to the query and avoid repeatedly invoking a large language model to rewrite prior interactions. We introduce MINDSET, a memory controller that stores a conversation as immutable episodes and organizes them into versioned schemas through minimum-energy state transitions. Each incoming episode may reinforce, supersede, split or create a schema. The transition decision balances representation distortion, contradiction, historical damage, fragmentation and internal inconsistency, while hysteresis prevents isolated contradictions from prematurely rewriting stable memory. We evaluate MINDSET against 5 memory systems on a reproducible sample of 850 questions (700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench). MINDSET obtains the highest observed LoCoMo answer F1 while significantly improving retrieval ranking (Recall@8, MRR and nDCG@8) over the second best method LightMem (p<0.01 after Holm correction). It obtains the highest observed scores on MemoryAgentBench although the relative difference is low. Ablations identify controlled fragmentation and schema-aware assignment as the largest contributors to answer quality. Additionally, a 700-question cross-model evaluation with GLM-4.7 and Gemma-4-31B supported model independence. These results show that long-term memory can be better handled as constrained state management rather than continual summarization.

AI.tldr: MINDSET 将长对话记忆视为受限状态管理：把对话存为不可变 episode，并通过最小能量状态转移组织成版本化 schema，在 LoCoMo 与 MemoryAgentBench 上取得最优或领先表现。
AI.motivation: 长对话代理需记住久远信息以高效完成任务，但指令与上下文会随时间变化，代理必须自适应。理想记忆系统需同时保留当前与历史状态、区分过时与有效知识、按查询检索证据，并避免反复调用大模型重写历史交互。
AI.method: 提出 MINDSET 记忆控制器：将对话存储为不可变 episode，通过最小能量状态转移组织为版本化 schema。每个新 episode 可强化、取代、拆分或新建一个 schema；转移决策权衡表示失真、矛盾、历史损害、碎片化与内部不一致，并用滞回机制防止孤立矛盾过早改写稳定记忆。
AI.result: 在 850 个问题（700 LoCoMo + 150 MemoryAgentBench）的可复现样本上对比 5 个记忆系统。MINDSET 取得最高 LoCoMo 答案 F1，并显著提升检索排序（Recall@8、MRR、nDCG@8），优于第二名 LightMem（Holm 校正后 p<0.01）；在 MemoryAgentBench 上得分最高但相对差异较小。消融显示受控碎片化与 schema 感知分配对答案质量贡献最大。700 题跨模型评估（GLM-4.7 与 Gemma-4-31B）支持模型独立性。
AI.conclusion: 长期记忆更适合作为受限状态管理来处理，而非持续摘要。MINDSET 通过版本化 schema 与最小能量状态转移，在保留历史、区分过时信息与高效检索之间取得平衡，并展现跨模型稳定性。

title: Recursive Game Creator: An Agentic Product-Level Experience-Oriented Game Harness
summary: Recent game design agents have made substantial progress in generating playable games. However, program correctness does not ensure an enjoyable experience for players. We present Recursive Game Creator, an experience-oriented harness to advance agentic game development from rough game prototypes into entertaining games. Recursive Game Creator organizes recursive development around four components: Designer, Builder, Player, and Reviewer. The Designer translates user instructions and Reviewer's feedback into detailed plans. The Builder turns these plans into candidate games. The coding-native Player creates and executes reusable policies through programmatic interfaces to efficiently collect diverse gameplay trajectories, mitigating evaluation bias caused by slow GUI-based collection. The Reviewer uses carefully designed trajectory-based metrics to induce player preferences, integrating with visual evidence and explicit textual preferences to evaluate games against game-specific criteria. Finally, the Reviewer accepts the better version and provides improvement reviews for the next round, closing the recursive loop. Our method achieves state-of-the-art overall performance of 77.89 on GameCraft-Bench. On GameASG-Bench, it achieves a strict task success rate of 53.2%, a 34.1% improvement over the same-model baseline, and the highest mean runtime-check pass rate at 93.4% among compared methods. A user study shows longer playtime and higher ratings. Code is coming soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Recursive Game Creator，一个面向体验的智能体游戏开发框架，通过 Designer、Builder、Player、Reviewer 四个组件的递归循环，将游戏原型迭代为具有娱乐性的游戏，并在多个基准与用户研究中取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏设计智能体虽能生成可运行的游戏，但程序正确并不代表玩家能获得愉悦体验，因此需要从"可玩原型"进一步推进到"有趣的游戏"。
AI.method: 框架围绕四组件递归展开：Designer 将用户指令与 Reviewer 反馈转化为详细计划；Builder 将计划生成为候选游戏；编码原生的 Player 通过程序化接口创建并执行可复用策略，高效收集多样化游戏轨迹，避免基于 GUI 的慢速采集带来的评估偏差；Reviewer 利用精心设计的轨迹指标推断玩家偏好，并结合视觉证据与显式文本偏好，按游戏特定标准进行评估，随后接受更优版本并给出下一轮改进评审，闭合递归循环。
AI.result: 在 GameCraft-Bench 上取得 77.89 的最先进总体性能；在 GameASG-Bench 上严格任务成功率达 53.2%，相比同模型基线提升 34.1%，平均运行时检查通过率为 93.4%，为对比方法中最高；用户研究显示更长游玩时长与更高评分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过体验导向的递归智能体框架，有效提升了智能体生成游戏的娱乐性与任务成功率，验证了以玩家体验为核心进行迭代开发的有效性。

title: Enhancing Diffusion Language Models with Autoregressive Post-Training Weights
summary: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) language models, offering flexible token-update orders and parallel decoding. Recent dLLMs are often initialized from pretrained AR models before diffusion conversion in order to inherit their learned representations. After the conversion, however, they typically ignore the extensive post-training ecosystem of their AR ancestors. In this work, we show that these existing AR post-training weight updates can instead be effectively recycled to enhance diffusion models. Despite the changes by AR-to-diffusion conversion, directly adding an AR post-training weight update to a diffusion base model remains effective, bringing its performance close to that achieved by direct diffusion post-training. Notably, AR and diffusion post-training updates are nearly orthogonal in weight space, yet induce substantially more aligned representation changes in the diffusion model. Their distinct updates are also complementary: composing their weights can retain gains from both regimes and further improve the post-trained diffusion model. Based on these findings, we propose A2D, a simple training-free framework for enhancing diffusion models with existing AR post-training resources. A2D can transfer capabilities from AR post-trained models to diffusion base models, and further improve already post-trained diffusion models by composing AR and diffusion post-training updates. Across various dLLMs, including Dream, DreamReasoner, DiffuCoder, Dream-Coder, Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion, and DiffusionGemma, A2D reliably improves instruction following, mathematical reasoning, and coding with both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning updates, without additional training, or inference-time computation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的A2D框架，通过复用AR后训练权重更新来增强扩散语言模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通常由预训练AR模型转换而来以继承其表示，但转换后往往忽视了AR祖先丰富的后训练生态资源，造成浪费。
AI.method: 发现直接将AR后训练权重更新加到扩散基础模型上仍然有效；AR与扩散后训练更新在权重空间近乎正交，但在扩散模型中引起高度一致的表示变化，且二者互补。基于此提出A2D，一种免训练框架，将AR后训练能力迁移到扩散模型，并通过组合AR与扩散更新进一步提升已后训练的扩散模型。
AI.result: 在Dream、DreamReasoner、DiffuCoder、Dream-Coder、Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion、DiffusionGemma等多种dLLM上，A2D在指令跟随、数学推理和代码任务上稳定提升，且适用于监督微调与强化学习更新。
AI.conclusion: 现有AR后训练权重更新可被回收利用以增强扩散模型，A2D无需额外训练或推理时计算即可有效迁移和组合AR能力。

title: Parallel Predictive World Models for Accurate and Efficient Long-Horizon Planning
summary: Long-horizon world-model planning typically relies on autoregressive rollouts, where predicted states are repeatedly fed back into the model. This preserves temporal structure but creates a horizon-length sequential path and exposes later predictions to recursive decoded-state feedback. We introduce Parallel Predictive World Models (PPWM), which predict a finite-horizon trajectory in parallel while retaining causal interaction among future representations. Each horizon is conditioned on its causal action prefix, and future representations interact before decoding, separating temporal causality from state-by-state output recursion. We formalize this distinction by viewing autoregressive rollout as a causal trajectory map and identifying the decoded-state feedback pathway removed by PPWM. Across four visual-control tasks, PPWM achieves the lowest long-horizon prediction error and the highest Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) simulator success among the evaluated predictive interfaces. Meanwhile, PPWM achieves more than a 3$\times$ average CEM planning speedup over the autoregressive LeWM baseline. These results suggest that accurate and efficient long-horizon world-model planning does not require state-by-state autoregression, but can instead be achieved through parallel causal trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并行预测世界模型（PPWM），以并行方式预测有限时域轨迹并保留未来表示间的因果交互，避免了逐步自回归滚动，在长时域预测与控制任务上取得更低误差和更高规划效率。
AI.motivation: 传统长时域世界模型规划依赖自回归滚动：预测状态被反复反馈进模型。这虽保留了时间结构，却产生了与时域长度成正比的串行路径，并使后期预测暴露于递归解码状态反馈之下，带来误差累积和效率瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出并行预测世界模型（PPWM）：一次性并行预测有限时域轨迹，同时保留未来表示间的因果交互。每个时域以因果动作前缀为条件，未来表示在解码前相互作用，从而将时间因果性与逐状态输出递归解耦。作者将自回归滚动形式化为因果轨迹映射，并识别出 PPWM 所移除的解码状态反馈路径。
AI.result: 在四个视觉控制任务上，PPWM 在所评估的预测接口中取得最低的长时域预测误差和最高的 CEM 模拟器成功率，同时相比自回归 LeWM 基线实现平均超过 3 倍的 CEM 规划加速。
AI.conclusion: 准确且高效的长时域世界模型规划并不需要逐状态自回归，而可以通过并行因果轨迹预测实现。

title: Attenuated in-context identification in time-series foundation models: diagnosis under counterfactual inputs and repair by synthetic forced-system fine-tuning
summary: Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) promise training-free what-if answers for instrumented plants: the change in output that a different future input would cause. We test this on forced engineering systems with exact counterfactuals, comparing Chronos-2, TimesFM-2.5 and TabPFN-TS with classical system identification fitted to the same context. Through their default covariate interfaces, TimesFM-2.5 and TabPFN-TS are memoryless: the predicted effect of an input change is a same-time function of that change ($R^2 = 1.000$ for TimesFM-2.5). Chronos-2 identifies dynamics in context but attenuates them. Its predicted effect is 0.33-0.80 of the true effect, its recovered impulse response has the wrong shape, and its error on a one-degree-of-freedom oscillator levels off at 0.57 with 8192 context samples, where ARX fitted to 256 samples reaches 0.02. Context dither at inference lowers the what-if error on all six synthetic classes without training. A 26-minute fine-tune on synthetic forced systems restores the response magnitude (sensitivity 0.83-0.96) and outperforms structure-agnostic identification on Wiener-Hammerstein and a held-out friction class. A specialised in-context identifier trained on the same data comes close, so the forced-system data carry most of the gain. On three of four measured plants classical identification remains clearly better, and the fine-tuned model loses part of its univariate forecasting skill. Paired counterfactual inputs, together with shuffled future inputs on measured records, test two properties: whether the covariate interface can represent dynamics and whether the pretraining prior covers the plant's time scale. Only the counterfactual pairs expose the attenuation.

AI.tldr: 该论文测试了协变量感知时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在工程受迫系统中的反事实预测能力，发现默认接口下模型多为无记忆或动态衰减，需微调才能恢复响应幅度，但经典系统辨识在多数实测装置上仍更优。
AI.motivation: 协变量感知TSFM被寄望于对仪器化装置提供免训练的"what-if"答案，即预测不同未来输入导致的输出变化。作者希望通过具有精确反事实的受迫工程系统来严格检验这一能力，并与经典系统辨识方法对比。
AI.method: 在受迫工程系统上，利用精确反事实，对比Chronos-2、TimesFM-2.5和TabPFN-TS与拟合于相同上下文的经典系统辨识（如ARX）。通过默认协变量接口、上下文抖动（dither）、合成数据微调（26分钟）以及在四个实测装置上的评估来测试模型。使用配对反事实输入与打乱未来输入来区分两个性质：协变量接口能否表达动态，以及预训练先验是否覆盖装置的时间尺度。
AI.result: 默认接口下，TimesFM-2.5和TabPFN-TS是无记忆的（输入变化的影响是同一时刻的函数，TimesFM-2.5的R²=1.000）；Chronos-2能识别动态但会衰减，预测效应仅为真实效应的0.33-0.80，脉冲响应形状错误，单自由度振子误差在8192上下文样本时停在0.57，而ARX仅用256样本就达0.02。推理时上下文抖动可在六个合成类别上降低what-if误差。26分钟合成微调恢复了响应幅度（敏感度0.83-0.96），在Wiener-Hammerstein和留出摩擦类别上优于结构无关辨识。专用上下文识别器接近该表现，说明增益主要来自受迫系统数据。在四个实测装置中的三个上，经典辨识仍明显更好，且微调后模型损失了部分单变量预测能力。只有配对反事实才能暴露衰减问题。
AI.conclusion: 协变量感知TSFM的默认接口尚不能可靠表达受迫系统动态，反事实预测存在衰减；微调虽能恢复响应幅度但在实测装置上仍不及经典系统辨识，且牺牲部分预测能力。配对反事实是关键诊断手段。

title: SquidAgent: Parallelize Wisely, Coordinate Efficiently
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 37 pages, including appendices
summary: LLM-based agents solve complex multi-step tasks, but sequential execution incurs substantial latency. In principle, parallelizing work across multiple agents should yield near-linear speedups. Yet existing parallel multi-agent systems often run slower than a single-agent baseline. We attribute this gap to two hidden costs that parallel execution incurs but a serial agent avoids. First, there is a re-exploration cost: redundant effort spent by parallel workers reconstructing context that the orchestrator already possesses, such as prior decisions, that would otherwise be inherited implicitly in a serial execution. Second, there is an alignment cost: the overhead required to reconcile inconsistencies across independently generated outputs. We thus derive a principled decision criterion: a layer should be parallelized only when its critical-path cost, plus re-exploration and alignment overheads, is lower than the corresponding serial cost. While this criterion is naturally expressed in wall-clock time, we observe that LLMs are poorly calibrated when asked to estimate task duration. To address this, we instead measure cost in predicted output tokens, which we empirically find LLMs can estimate substantially more reliably than wall-clock time. Building on this token-based criterion, we propose SquidAgent. It estimates all token budgets in a single planning step, forks each worker directly from the orchestrator's session to eliminate re-exploration cost, and replaces post-hoc reconciliation with a pre-generated shared convention block that converts alignment into a bounded upfront cost. A deterministic scheduler then applies the criterion layer by layer. Empirically, SquidAgent achieves a 2.2$\times$ mean throughput improvement and a 2.6$\times$ mean wall-time speedup over Claude Code, and a 2.0$\times$ throughput improvement over the strongest multi-agent baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文针对并行多智能体系统反而慢于串行基线的问题，指出其源于"重探索成本"与"对齐成本"，提出以预测输出token为度量、按层判断是否并行的决策准则，并据此设计SquidAgent，实现吞吐量与墙钟时间的大幅提升。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体虽能完成复杂多步任务，但串行执行延迟高。理论上并行化应带来近线性加速，然而现有并行多智能体系统常比单智能体基线更慢。作者认为这一差距源于串行执行被隐式规避、而并行执行必须承担的两项隐藏成本：重探索成本（并行worker重复重建编排器已拥有的上下文，如先前决策）与对齐成本（协调独立生成输出间不一致的开销）。
AI.method: 作者推导出原则性决策准则：仅当某层的关键路径成本加上重探索与对齐开销低于对应串行成本时，才应并行化该层。由于该准则自然以墙钟时间表达，但LLM对任务时长估计校准很差，作者改用预测输出token作为成本度量，并经验性发现LLM估计token比估计墙钟时间可靠得多。基于此token准则提出SquidAgent：单次规划步骤中估计所有token预算；每个worker直接从编排器会话分叉以消除重探索成本；用预生成的共享约定块替代事后协调，将对齐转化为有界的前置成本；再由确定性调度器逐层应用该准则。
AI.result: 实验表明，SquidAgent相比Claude Code取得2.2倍的吞吐量平均提升和2.6倍的墙钟时间平均加速，相比最强的多智能体基线取得2.0倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别并量化并行执行的重探索与对齐两项隐藏成本，并以LLM更易可靠估计的输出token作为成本度量，SquidAgent以逐层决策的方式实现了有效的并行多智能体调度，验证了该成本准则与实现方案在提升吞吐与降低延迟上的有效性。

title: Do LLMs Act on What They Know? From Partner Representations to Cooperative Actions
summary: Cooperation with unfamiliar partners requires adapting to communication conventions that are not known in advance. We study this problem in a controlled Hanabi-derived environment with scripted hint generation, LLM-controlled receiving decisions, and frozen model weights. Across eight LLMs, linear probes recover intent conventions substantially more accurately than target conventions, yet receiving choices do not consistently agree with the sender's convention. We compare probe-predicted and ground-truth conventions presented either as general rules or as externally computed action recommendations. Rule statements yield modest and model-dependent changes in cooperation, whereas action translation produces larger gains on average. In a Qwen3-8B case study, matched-state statement reversals reveal much greater sensitivity to action recommendations than to rule statements. Activation transfers from oracle-action and non-oracle hint-restatement donors improve intent accuracy on both action classes, but the tested alternatives do not reliably reproduce these benefits. Together, these results distinguish convention decodability, sensitivity to convention information, and cooperative performance, and highlight limitations in turning available partner information into receiving decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究在Hanabi衍生的受控环境中，考察八个LLM接收方能否适应陌生伙伴的沟通约定。线性探针更能解码意图约定而非目标约定，但接收选择并不总与发送方约定一致；以行动建议形式呈现约定信息比一般规则更能提升合作表现，但现有替代方案无法可靠复现该收益。
AI.motivation: 与陌生伙伴合作时，需要适应事先未知的沟通约定。现有LLM是否能够解码伙伴约定、对约定信息作出敏感反应并据此做出接收决策，这三者的关系尚不清晰。
AI.method: 使用Hanabi衍生环境，提示生成被脚本化，由LLM控制接收决策，且模型权重冻结。对八个LLM进行线性探针分析，对比探针预测与真实约定在“一般规则”和“外部计算行动建议”两种呈现方式下的效果；并在Qwen3-8B上进行匹配状态陈述反转案例研究，以及oracle行动与非oracle提示重述供体的激活迁移实验。
AI.result: 线性探针恢复意图约定的准确率显著高于目标约定，但接收选择与发送方约定并不一致。规则陈述仅带来有限且依赖模型的变化，行动翻译平均收益更大。Qwen3-8B案例中，匹配状态陈述反转显示对行动建议的敏感度远高于规则陈述。oracle行动与非oracle提示重述供体的激活迁移能提升两类行动的意图准确率，但测试的替代方案不能可靠复现该收益。
AI.conclusion: 研究区分了约定可解码性、对约定信息的敏感性与合作表现三个层面，并指出LLM在将可用伙伴信息转化为接收决策方面仍存在局限。

title: ParanoiaEval: Benchmarking Unnecessary Defensive Work in Agentic Coding
summary: As coding agents increasingly undertake real-world work autonomously, judging whether their risk treatments are warranted has become important. Existing work evaluates related agent behaviors from separate perspectives, but lacks a systematic framework for unifying these behaviors. To bridge this gap, we introduce ParanoiaEval, the first benchmark for unified evaluation of risk-treatment capabilities in coding agents. Grounded in the well-established Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance framework in software engineering risk management, ParanoiaEval operationalizes its 4 fundamental treatments for coding-agent settings and contains 200 evidence-controlled repository-level task pairs, each differing only in treatment-defining evidence. We further introduce dedicated metrics for risk-treatment violations and evidence responsiveness, using a human-calibrated agentic judge for reliable evaluation. Large-scale experiments on 8 representative models and a post-hoc human study reveal that (I) unnecessary risk treatment occurs in 11.2%-58.7% of runs despite explicit evidence, with substantial variation across agent configurations; (II) stronger task capability does not ensure more appropriate risk treatment, while treatment violations substantially harm developers' experience, establishing risk treatment as an independent capability dimension; and (III) agents exhibit systematic patterns consistent with established risk-management findings, suggesting that knowledge from human practice can guide the diagnosis and improvement of this capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ParanoiaEval，首个用于统一评估编码智能体风险处理能力的基准，基于软件工程风险管理中的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 框架，包含200个证据控制的仓库级任务对，并在8个模型上验证了风险处理是独立的能力维度。
AI.motivation: 随着编码智能体日益自主地承担真实世界工作，判断其对风险的处理是否合理变得重要。现有工作从相互分离的视角评估相关智能体行为，缺乏系统性框架来统一这些行为。
AI.method: 基于软件工程风险管理中成熟的 Avoidance-Transfer-Mitigation-Acceptance 框架，ParanoiaEval 将该框架的4种基本处理方式操作化到编码智能体场景中，构建了200个证据控制的仓库级任务对，每对任务仅在定义处理方式的关键证据上存在差异。同时引入针对风险处理违规和证据响应性的专门指标，并使用经人工校准的智能体评判器进行可靠评估。
AI.result: 在8个代表性模型上的大规模实验及事后人工研究显示：(I) 即使存在明确证据，仍有11.2%-58.7%的运行出现不必要的风险处理，且不同智能体配置间差异显著；(II) 更强的任务能力并不保证更恰当的风险处理，而处理违规会显著损害开发者体验，确立风险处理为独立的能力维度；(III) 智能体展现出与既有风险管理研究发现一致的系统性模式。
AI.conclusion: 风险处理应被视为编码智能体的一项独立能力维度，且人类风险管理实践中的知识可指导该能力的诊断与改进。

title: Coupled but Late: Turn-Taking Between Full-Duplex Speech Models in Unscripted Dialogue
summary: Full-duplex speech models are trained to converse with a person, but they are increasingly made to converse with each other, in self-play data generation, agent societies, and model-based evaluation. In that loop no human absorbs a timing error: each model's turn-taking is the other's input. We ask what timing the loop settles into. Two PersonaPlex-7B instances exchange audio tokens on a shared clock in unscripted conversation, and one floor-transfer rule is applied to them and to Switchboard. Their timing is coupled: re-pairing speakers across conversations destroys it. But the floor changes hands late, at a median of 400-560 ms against 137 ms for humans, and the last 120 ms of the partner's turn, where human projection places a tenth of its transfers, holds 1% of theirs. Delaying one direction of the channel shifts the response one-for-one and leaves the run-up to it empty, consistent with a reactive wait after the perceived end rather than the turn-end projection human timing requires.

AI.tldr: 两个PersonaPlex-7B全双工语音模型在共享时钟上进行非脚本自我对话，其轮流时机相互耦合，但换手明显晚于人类，呈"先等后应"的反应式模式而非人类式的话轮结束预测。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型原本用于与人对话，如今越来越多地被用于模型间自我对话（自博弈数据生成、智能体社会、基于模型的评估）。在这一循环中，没有人类来吸收时序误差，每个模型的轮流行为都直接成为对方的输入，因此需要考察这种对话循环最终稳定在什么样的时序上。
AI.method: 让两个PersonaPlex-7B实例在共享时钟上以音频token进行非脚本对话，并对该模型与Switchboard数据应用同一条话轮转移规则；通过跨对话重新配对说话人来检验耦合性，并通过延迟信道一个方向来观察响应时机的变化。
AI.result: 模型间时序存在耦合：跨对话重新配对说话人会使该时序特征消失。但换手较晚，中位数为400-560 ms，而人类为137 ms；在伙伴话轮最后120 ms——人类预测性转移中约十分之一发生于此——模型中仅占1%。单向信道延迟会使响应一一对应地整体偏移，且其前的准备区间为空。
AI.conclusion: 模型间对话的时序符合"感知到话轮结束后再反应性等待"的机制，而非人类轮流所需的话轮结束预测机制；这揭示了自我对话循环中值得关注的时序偏差。

title: Symphony for Text Generation: Benchmarking Clinical Note Generation
summary: Ambient documentation systems are rapidly gaining adoption, yet their impact on clinical note quality remains poorly characterized. We introduce MedConv, a multilingual dataset of 300 clinical encounters in English, Danish, and German, and use it alongside the Ambient Clinical Intelligence benchmark (ACI-BENCH) to compare Corti, a clinical AI platform, with two leading, accessible ambient scribe software applications built on general-purpose AI. We present a controlled clinical evaluation framework that combines entailment metrics with LLM-judged pairwise comparisons across eight dimensions adopted from PDSQI-9. Results show that Corti's API-based text-generation infrastructure is on par with or outperforms leading commercial scribes. We further show that Corti's configurable API provides the flexibility necessary to fine-tune quality dimensions for specific documentation use cases. We present the evaluation methodology and release a dataset to support future reproducible comparison of ambient documentation systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出多语言数据集 MedConv（英/丹/德 300 例临床问诊），并结合 ACI-BENCH，构建结合蕴涵指标与大模型成对比较（8 个 PDSQI-9 维度）的临床评估框架，用于对比 Corti 临床 AI 平台与两款主流环境记录软件。结果显示 Corti 的 API 文本生成基础达到或优于主流商业记录工具，且其可配置 API 能针对特定文档场景微调质量维度；论文公开方法论与数据集。
AI.motivation: 环境文档系统快速普及，但其对临床病历质量的影响尚缺乏系统刻画；同时缺少可复现的多语言对比评测基准。
AI.method: 构建 MedConv 多语言数据集（英语、丹麦语、德语共 300 例临床问诊），并联合 ACI-BENCH 基准；提出受控临床评估框架，融合蕴涵（entailment）指标与基于大模型的成对比较，覆盖取自 PDSQI-9 的八个质量维度；对比 Corti 平台与两款基于通用 AI 的主流环境记录软件。
AI.result: Corti 基于 API 的文本生成基础设施在质量上达到或优于领先商业记录工具；其可配置 API 提供必要灵活性，可针对特定文档使用场景微调质量维度。
AI.conclusion: 论文提供了可复用的评估方法论并公开数据集，以支持未来对环境文档系统的可复现比较，表明可配置 API 架构在临床文档质量上具备竞争力与适配性。

title: ScienceClaw: Benchmarking Continual Self-Evolution of AI-for-Science Agents Across the Natural and Social Sciences
summary: Large language model agents are accelerating scientific automation, yet verified executions rarely become persistent program-level improvements, and existing evaluations do not examine this process across sequential tasks in both the natural and social sciences. We formalize ScienceClaw as fixed-parameter program self-evolution that unifies task solving, scientific verification, and program updates. ScienceClaw-Eval spans 23 disciplines and measures scientific correctness, evolutionary gain, retention, cross-dataset transfer, and evolution cost through sequential streams and independent reset evaluation. Our framework repairs executable workflows through multi-turn interaction, converts re-execution-verified failure--success trajectories into linked Skill and Operator candidates, and retains an update only when source-task replay reproduces the repair and independent scientific tasks improve. Code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ScienceClaw，将科学自动化中的程序自我进化形式化为固定参数程序进化，统一任务求解、科学验证与程序更新，并在ScienceClaw-Eval上跨23个学科评估科学正确性、进化增益、保持性、跨数据集迁移与进化成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体正在加速科学自动化，但经验证的执行很少转化为持久的程序级改进，且现有评估未考察自然与社会科学中顺序任务间的这一过程。
AI.method: 将ScienceClaw形式化为固定参数程序自我进化，统一任务求解、科学验证和程序更新；通过多轮交互修复可执行工作流，把经重执行验证的失败—成功轨迹转化为关联的Skill与Operator候选，仅当源任务重放能复现修复且独立科学任务有改进时保留更新。
AI.result: ScienceClaw-Eval覆盖23个学科，通过顺序流与独立重置评估衡量科学正确性、进化增益、保持性、跨数据集迁移与进化成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为科学智能体的程序级持续进化提供了形式化框架与多维度评估基准，代码已开源于 https://github.com/beita6969/ScienceClaw。

title: Align, Then Correct: Training-Free Two-Stage Low-Rank Compensation for Extremely Quantized Large Language Models
summary: Low-rank quantization error compensation (LQEC) recovers the accuracy lost under aggressive weight quantization by attaching a closed-form rank-$r$ adapter beside each frozen quantized weight, without any training. We show that existing compensators are limited by two shared simplifications. They calibrate symmetrically, evaluating the full-precision and compensated weights on the same activation, which yields a compensation target that is inherently high-rank -- so a fixed rank budget captures only a small fraction of it. And they minimize only the second-order term of the loss, although the compensated model is not stationary: a first-order descent direction larger than the applied compensation itself remains in every layer, and no reconstruction objective can absorb it. We propose a two-stage closed-form framework that removes both simplifications. Stage 1 aligns each layer's output with the full-precision model under a Fisher-weighted asymmetric objective, concentrating the rank budget on a rank-compressible target. Stage 2 re-measures statistics on the compensated model and applies a rank-constrained natural-gradient step that absorbs the remaining first-order signal. Every adapter is the result of a single truncated SVD; backward passes serve only to collect statistics. At 2 bits under QuIP#, our method reduces WikiText-2 perplexity from 12.43 to 10.26 on Qwen3-8B and from 21.11 to 13.22 on Qwen3-4B. On the held-out C4 corpus, it recovers 51% and 84% of the gap to FP16, versus 31% and 63% for the strongest baseline, with consistent gains in the seven-task zero-shot average, at higher bit-widths, and under a distinct quantizer.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段闭式框架，消除现有低秩量化误差补偿中的对称校准与仅最小化二阶损失两项简化，显著提升低比特量化模型精度。
AI.motivation: 现有低秩量化误差补偿（LQEC）通过在每个冻结的量化权重旁附加闭式 rank-r 适配器来恢复精度，但存在两个共同简化：其一，对称校准在相同激活上评估全精度与补偿权重，导致补偿目标本质上是高秩的，固定秩预算只能捕捉其中一小部分；其二，仅最小化损失的二阶项，而补偿后的模型并非驻点，每层仍残留比所施加补偿更大的first-order下降方向，任何重建目标都无法吸收它。
AI.method: 提出两阶段闭式框架。阶段1在 Fisher 加权非对称目标下，使每层输出与全精度模型对齐，将秩预算集中于可秩压缩的目标；阶段2在补偿后的模型上重新测量统计量，并施加秩约束的自然梯度步以吸收剩余的一阶信号。每个适配器均由一次截断 SVD 得到，反向传播仅用于收集统计量。
AI.result: 在 QuIP# 下 2 bit 量化时，WikiText-2 困惑度在 Qwen3-8B 上从 12.43 降至 10.26，在 Qwen3-4B 上从 21.11 降至 13.22。在留出的 C4 语料上，分别恢复了对 FP16 差距的 51% 和 84%，而最强基线为 31% 和 63%，并在七任务零样本平均、更高比特宽度及不同量化器下均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过去除对称校准与仅二阶最小化两项简化，所提两阶段闭式框架在不训练的前提下显著改善了低比特量化的精度恢复效果，并在多种设置下优于现有基线。

title: nanoMuse: An Open-Source Personal Agent for Every Device You Own
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Project page: https://nanomuse.cn ; Code: https://github.com/nano-muse/nanoMuse
summary: Assistants from 2011 answered and waited, and agents from 2023 did a task and stopped. In September 2026 Meta's Muse showed an agent for one person, with accounts, devices, memory and a conversation that lasts, closed, in a vendor's cloud, in one country. Such an agent is expected to act on a person's accounts and devices, remember them across weeks, speak first when it is worth it, and answer for what it did. It is a kind of software, not a model, and until now had no open counterpart. This report defines the personal agent in five questions and three horizons. It reads how Muse is built from Meta's public record and a copy of its production prompt, each statement marked by its source. It then presents nanoMuse, the open-source counterpart under the GPL-3.0, one agent on every device a person owns, with hands on the phone's screen and the computer's. They share one conversation over a relay anyone can run; every action goes through a Sentinel, memory is files the person can read, and the model is their choice. Its size and cost are given as estimates. What is open, memory with provenance, an evaluation suite for the hands and an open model for them, is set out as a roadmap.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了"个人智能体"这一新软件形态，通过五个问题与三个时间视野加以刻画；以Meta的Muse为封闭案例（依据其公开资料与生产提示词副本，逐条标注来源），并提出开源对应物nanoMuse（GPL-3.0），实现跨设备、跨周记忆与可达性，但现阶段为设计与估算，非实测结果。
AI.motivation: 从2011年的助手到2023年的任务型智能体，智能体只做一件事便停止，且真正意义上的"个人智能体"此前没有开源对应物。Meta的Muse展示了单人专属、带账号、设备、记忆与持续会话的封闭形态，但被锁定在厂商云与单一国家中，因此有必要定义这一形态并提供开放替代方案。
AI.method: 以五个定义性问题和三个时间视野来界定个人智能体；基于Meta公开记录与一份生产提示词副本，对Muse的构建方式做逐条标注来源的解读；随后提出nanoMuse：每人每台设备各有一个智能体，可直接操作手机屏幕与电脑，通过任何人都能自建的relay共享同一段对话，所有动作经由Sentinel把关，记忆为可读文件，模型由用户自选。其规模与成本以估算形式给出。
AI.result: 论文未给出实验或基准测试结果，主体为定义、对Muse的溯源式解读，以及nanoMuse的架构设计与规模成本估算，并附路线图。
AI.conclusion: 个人智能体是一种软件而非模型，其开放性体现在四方面：开放源码、带来源溯源的记忆、面向"动手能力"的评测套件、以及适配这些能力的开放模型。这构成了后续路线图，旨在为封闭的厂商云智能体提供可验证的开源替代。

title: On the Intrinsic Limited Robustness of Latent-Based Watermarking
summary: Existing latent-based watermarking methods for diffusion models have overestimated their robustness to image distortions, including geometric transformations such as rotation, scaling, and translation (RST). Moreover, this paradigm of watermarking approaches may suffer from inherent limitations arising from the domain in which the watermark is embedded. In this paper, we provide the first theoretical analysis explaining why these methods lack invariance to perturbations. By relaxing the invariant relation, we derive a maximum perturbation bound that characterizes the relationship between pixel-space perturbations and their corresponding effects in latent space. In addition, we present the first analytical formulation that captures all components of practical detection mechanisms. Finally, we conduct experiments to validate the theoretical findings and the limitations of latent-based watermarking methods. Our theoretical and empirical results indicate that, under the current design paradigm, latent-based watermarking methods intrinsically exhibit limited robustness. We conclude by providing the analytical tool and design guidelines that future research could follow.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从理论上分析了扩散模型潜空间水印方法对图像扰动（如旋转、缩放、平移）缺乏不变性的原因，通过放宽不变关系推导出像素空间扰动与潜空间效应的最大扰动界，并给出首个涵盖检测机制所有成分的解析形式。实验验证了潜空间水印方法鲁棒性有限的固有缺陷，并提供了分析工具与设计指南。
AI.motivation: 现有基于潜空间的扩散模型水印方法高估了其对图像失真（包括旋转、缩放、平移等几何变换）的鲁棒性，且该范式因水印嵌入域而存在固有局限，但缺乏对此的理论解释。
AI.method: 提供首个理论分析，解释这些方法为何缺乏对扰动的不变性；通过放宽不变关系，推导出刻画像素空间扰动与其潜空间对应效应之间关系的最大扰动界；并给出首个捕获实际检测机制所有成分的解析公式，辅以实验验证。
AI.result: 理论与实证结果表明，在当前设计范式下，基于潜空间的水印方法本质上鲁棒性有限。
AI.conclusion: 本文为未来研究提供了分析工具与设计指南，指出潜空间水印方法的固有局限。

title: WorldSolver: Can LLM Agents Simulate the Physical Dynamics via Solver Generation?
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly advancing scientific and engineering problem solving, with physics simulation emerging as a challenging yet practical testbed for reproducing complex physical phenomena with application in embodied AI, games and films. As the workhorse of such simulation, a solver computes how the state of a dynamic system evolves over time. Building such solvers requires physical understanding to identify appropriate models, mathematical reasoning to formulate the underlying dynamics, and software engineering to implement them as executable code, yet this capability of LLM agents remains underexplored. To this end, we introduce WorldSolver, a benchmark of 168 simulation tasks derived from physical phenomena in 61 classic computer graphics papers, spanning 7 physical domains. Each task contains a code scaffold that provides a fixed simulation environment for the scene, with the solver implementation left for the agent to complete. Specifically, we evaluate them along three dimensions: Execution Checks for successful execution, Visual Fidelity for reproducing the intended dynamic behavior in the rendered simulation, and Physical Plausibility for physics-grounded verification of the generated dynamics. Experiments on frontier agents reveal that producing executable solvers is difficult itself, and satisfying visual and physical correctness is even harder. GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5 perform comparatively better than the other evaluated agents, yet achieve overall scores of only 48.7% and 46.7%, respectively. WorldSolver is an early step toward agentic solver generation, and we hope it helps drive progress toward agents that can faithfully simulate the dynamic physical world. Code is available at https://github.com/sirujiang/WorldSolver.

AI.tldr: WorldSolver：面向LLM智能体的物理求解器生成基准，含168个任务，覆盖7个物理域，评估执行、视觉保真与物理合理性，前沿智能体总分不足50%。
AI.motivation: 物理仿真是具身AI、游戏与影视的重要应用场景，而求解器编写需同时具备物理理解、数学推理与软件工程能力，但LLM智能体在此方面的能力尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建WorldSolver基准，从61篇经典计算机图形学论文中提取168个仿真任务，覆盖7个物理域；每个任务提供固定仿真环境的代码脚手架，由智能体补全求解器实现；从执行检查、视觉保真度、物理合理性三个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 前沿智能体表现不佳：生成可执行求解器本身已很困难，满足视觉与物理正确性更难；GPT-5.6-Sol与Claude-Opus-5相对较好，但总体得分仅48.7%和46.7%。
AI.conclusion: WorldSolver是智能体求解器生成的早期尝试，旨在推动能够忠实模拟动态物理世界的智能体研究。

title: Finding the Heads and the Neurons Responsible for Network Information Retrieval in Language Models
summary: We ask whether specific attention heads, and more finely specific neurons inside those heads, are responsible for recognizing that a language model's context contains network infrastructure information (a hostname paired with its IP address), and whether that responsibility can be validated causally rather than by correlation alone. At the head level the answer is yes, across five models spanning three architecture families: in every model, a small set of heads (1 to 9 out of 128 to 1152 candidates), found by causal ablation screening and tested for selectivity against matched negative and context-free controls, supports a detector with 99.5--100\% held-out accuracy. We then ask whether a head's responsibility concentrates into one neuron or stays spread across its dimensions; this is model-specific. In one model, the top head's signal concentrates into a single neuron, found independently by both a causal intervention and a correlational ranking, which agree exactly (AUC = 1.000, matching the full head). In another, the single clean head works as a whole (AUC = 1.000) but the best causally ranked neuron inside it does not (AUC = 0.665), so the responsibility there is spread across the head. The remaining three models fall in between. On an independent dataset collected by a different institution (reverse-DNS records rather than the discovery data), every model's full-head detector flags 100\% of positive records; the single-neuron versions transfer less reliably, and in one model score below chance. Causal head-finding for a specific network-information entity works across models and architectures; how far that finding can be pushed down to individual neurons varies, and needs to be checked for each model.

AI.tldr: 本文探究语言模型是否由特定注意力头及其内部神经元负责识别网络基础设施信息（主机名与IP地址配对），并用因果消融而非相关性验证。结果表明：头级别责任跨5个模型、3类架构普遍成立；神经元级别则因模型而异，且单神经元检测器迁移性较差。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多依赖相关性来定位模型内部的功能单元，缺乏因果验证；且"责任是否能从注意力头进一步下推到单个神经元"这一问题尚无系统答案。本文希望在网络信息实体识别这一具体任务上，跨模型、跨架构地检验头级与神经元级责任的可验证性与可迁移性。
AI.method: 1）用因果消融筛选候选注意力头，并与匹配的负样本及无上下文对照做选择性测试；2）对头部责任的集中度，分别用因果干预与相关性排序两种方式定位头内关键神经元并比较二者一致性；3）在另一机构采集的独立数据集（反向DNS记录）上验证全头检测器与单神经元检测器的迁移表现。
AI.result: 头级别：5个模型中均只存在少量关键头（1–9个，候选128–1152个），检测器留出准确率99.5–100%。神经元级别：一个模型中顶级头的信号集中于单个神经元，因果干预与相关性排序完全一致（AUC=1.000，与整头相同）；另一模型中整头有效（AUC=1.000）但最佳因果神经元无效（AUC=0.665），责任分散于全头；其余3个模型介于两者之间。迁移性：独立数据集上所有模型的全头检测器对正样本的召回均为100%，单神经元版本迁移不稳定，其中一个模型低于随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 针对特定网络信息实体的因果头定位跨模型与跨架构均成立；但将责任下推到单个神经元的可行性因模型而异，需要逐模型检验，且单神经元检测器的泛化可靠性明显弱于整头检测器。

title: Does an Agent's History Tell You When Compaction Will Hurt? A Modest, Bounded Effect on the TRACE Paired-Replay Corpus
comment: Accepted at the IAB Workshop (Interpreting Agent Behavior) at NeurIPS 2026 (non-archival). 20 pages
summary: Many long-horizon agents compact their context on a global rule, usually a token budget, blind to what the agent was doing. We ask whether the agent's recent behaviour predicts when a compaction will hurt. TRACE's public corpus of 590 harness-triggered AppWorld compaction boundaries replays each boundary from a re-executed prefix state under the pre-compaction context and under the summary, and records the burden of the next actions: calls that error or repeat a call already made. We find that pre-boundary history predicts post-compaction harm only weakly. An internally prespecified contrast by prefix placement is a wide null, and the naive "has-written" label behind it turns out to measure trajectory phase. The best extension-protocol trigger reaches held-out AUROC 0.66 (0.64 on the replicate's own label) against a same-boundary replicate of 0.72; the best frozen, interpretable trigger avoids 21% of harmful (positive-burden) boundaries while keeping 84% of compaction opportunities, and exceeds the random-rule expectation on count but not on burden mass (a post hoc comparison). Whether the best trigger beats a token-budget rule at matched retention cannot be evaluated on the release. We state what corpora should ship to answer it.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究智能体的近期行为能否预测上下文压缩（compaction）造成的危害。基于TRACE公开语料库（590个AppWorld压缩边界），研究发现压缩前的历史仅能弱预测压缩后的危害：位置对比为宽零结果，"已写入"标签实际度量的是轨迹阶段；最佳触发器的AUROC为0.66（复现为0.64/0.72），可在保留84%压缩机会的同时避免21%有害边界，但复现语料无法评估其相对token预算规则的优越性。
AI.motivation: 许多长时程智能体按全局规则（通常是token预算）压缩上下文，对智能体正在执行的任务不敏感。作者提出核心问题：智能体近期行为是否能预测压缩何时会造成危害。
AI.method: 利用TRACE公开语料库中590个由harness触发的AppWorld压缩边界，从重新执行的前缀状态出发，分别在压缩前上下文与摘要两种条件下重放每个边界，并记录下一步动作的负担（出错或重复已执行调用的次数）。按前缀位置进行内部预设对比，并训练可解释的触发器。
AI.result: 压缩前历史对压缩后危害仅有弱预测力；前缀位置的预设对比为宽零结果，天真的"已写入"标签实际度量轨迹阶段。最佳扩展协议触发器在留出集上AUROC为0.66（在复现自身标签上为0.64），对比同边界复现为0.72。最佳冻结可解释触发器避免21%有害（正负担）边界，同时保留84%压缩机会，在数量上超过随机规则期望，但在负担质量上未超过（事后比较）。
AI.conclusion: 在现有发布语料上，无法评估最佳触发器在匹配保留率下是否优于token预算规则。作者明确指出了未来语料库应包含哪些内容以回答该问题。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Segment Reward Feedback under Linear Function Approximation
summary: Classical reinforcement learning (RL) assumes that a reward is observed for every visited state-action pair. However, in real-world applications such as autonomous driving, such fine-grained feedback can be costly or difficult to collect, whereas trajectory-level feedback may be too sparse for efficient learning. To provide a general feedback model bridging these two extremes and handle large state spaces, we study RL with segment reward feedback under linear function approximation. Our work answers how the granularity of segment feedback and the choice of segmentation influence learning. For equal-length segments with known transitions, we design algorithms $\bitssegd$ and $\edlinucbsegd$ for binary and sum feedback types, respectively. They adopt posterior sampling with planning to achieve computational efficiency and the E-optimal experimental design to attain near-optimality. Nearly matching lower bounds are established. For equal-length segments with unknown transitions, we develop a unified $\seglsvits$ framework with two instantiations for binary and sum feedback, which carefully integrates the posterior estimated reward parameters into least-squares value iteration. These results reveal a fundamental insight: under binary feedback, increasing the number of segments significantly reduces the regret through an exponential factor, while surprisingly, under sum feedback, the granularity of segments does not affect learning much. Finally, to investigate whether segmenting according to state-action features can further expedite learning, we design an algorithm $\uneqsegbitsd$ that allows arbitrary segmentations. The resulting regret bound shows that under the usual elliptical potential analysis, the influence of state-action features on the regret appears only through logarithmic factors, and equal segmentation achieves the best performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性函数逼近下的分段奖励反馈强化学习，设计多种算法并建立上下界，揭示反馈粒度与分割方式对学习的影响规律。
AI.motivation: 经典RL假设每个状态-动作对都能观测到奖励，但现实中（如自动驾驶）细粒度反馈代价高昂，而轨迹级反馈又过于稀疏。需要一个能桥接这两种极端的一般化反馈模型，并处理大状态空间，因此研究线性函数逼近下的分段奖励反馈RL。
AI.method: 在线性函数逼近下研究分段奖励反馈RL。针对等长段且转移已知的情形，为二值反馈和求和反馈分别设计算法bitssegd与edlinucbsegd，采用带规划的后验采样保证计算效率，用E-最优实验设计达到近最优性，并建立近乎匹配的下界。针对等长段但转移未知的情形，提出统一的seglsvits框架并给出二值和求和两种实例，将后验估计的奖励参数融入最小二乘值迭代。还设计了允许任意分段的uneqsegbitsd算法，研究按状态-动作特征分割的效果。
AI.result: 等长段已知转移情形下的算法达到近最优并配有近乎匹配的下界。核心发现：二值反馈下，增加分段数量通过指数因子显著降低遗憾；而求和反馈下，分段粒度对学习影响不大。对于任意分割算法，在通常的椭圆势分析下，状态-动作特征对遗憾的影响仅通过对数因子体现，等长分割取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 分段反馈粒度和分割方式显著影响学习效率，且影响因反馈类型而异：二值反馈受益于更细的分段，求和反馈则对粒度不敏感；按特征分割难以超越等长分割。

title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
summary: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. This challenge is even more acute in embodied reasoning, where reliable evaluation must account for spatial grounding, causal reasoning, and safety-aware decision-making. We introduce VeriFine, an agent harness framework that scales verification through the co-evolution of the policy, training curriculum, and judge. The Policy Improvement Loop uses a rubric judge to diagnose recurring failures, construct an adaptive curriculum, and optimize the policy. When progress plateaus and verification becomes a bottleneck, the Judge Improvement Loop selectively queries human guidance on informative failure cases and refines the judge through coactive calibration, in which humans and agents resolve disagreements and converge toward the objective rubric of physical reasoning. The revised judge then guides the next stage of data selection and policy optimization. Experiments on driving and robot navigation tasks demonstrate continuous self-improvement in both policy and judge capability across reinforcement and supervised fine-tuning. These results show how scaling verification supports continuous self-improvement as policy failure patterns evolve.

AI.tldr: 提出 VeriFine 智能体框架，通过策略、训练课程与评判者的协同演化扩展验证能力，实现具身推理中策略与评判者的持续自我改进。
AI.motivation: 自我改进策略会不断暴露新的失败模式，从而改变评判者需要验证的内容。然而当前固定的评判者同时限制了优化反馈和有用训练样本的发现，阻碍进一步自我改进。这一问题在具身推理中更严重，因为可靠评估需兼顾空间定位、因果推理与安全决策。
AI.method: VeriFine 通过策略、训练课程和评判者的协同演化扩展验证。策略改进循环使用评分标准评判者诊断反复出现的失败、构建自适应课程并优化策略；当进展停滞、验证成为瓶颈时，评判者改进循环针对有信息量的失败案例选择性查询人类指导，并通过"协同校准"（人与智能体解决分歧、向物理推理的客观评分标准收敛）精炼评判者，再由修订后的评判者指导下一阶段的数据选择与策略优化。
AI.result: 在驾驶和机器人导航任务上的实验表明，无论在强化学习还是监督微调下，策略与评判者能力都能持续自我改进。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明扩展验证能够支持在策略失败模式不断演变时的持续自我改进。

title: Performative Prediction with Selective Labels
summary: Many social applications of machine learning exhibit performative effects: population behavior changes in response to deployed models. Performative prediction studies this interaction through a distribution map that relates each model to the population distribution it induces. One of the main results in this framework showed that repeated risk minimization (RRM), which updates models by retraining on the most recent data, can converge to a stable model that minimizes risk on its own induced distribution. However, existing analyses typically assume access to the complete distributions of features and labels after model deployment, ignoring the possibility of selective labels: observing labels only for the accepted subset of the population. In this work, we formalize performative prediction with selective labels and show that retraining only on observed data can misguide the retraining procedure and undermine the guarantees of convergence to a stable solution. We then propose a worst-case objective based on knowledge of a confidence interval on the probability of a positive label. Applying RRM to this objective permits us to remain within a bounded distance to the true stable point. Under a sensitivity assumption on the conditional label distribution, we further show how previously accepted data can tighten these confidence intervals over time. Experiments in a lending application with fairness regularization show that our robust optimization approach closely matches the performance of RRM with complete label access.

AI.tldr: 本文将"选择性标签"引入表演性预测框架，指出仅在已接受子集上重训练会误导RRM并破坏稳定点收敛保证；为此提出基于正标签概率置信区间的最坏情况目标，使RRM保持与真实稳定点的有界距离，并在敏感性假设下利用历史已接受数据逐步收紧置信区间。
AI.motivation: 表演性预测研究模型部署后群体行为变化对分布的反作用，其中RRM可通过在最新数据上重训练收敛到稳定模型。但既有分析假设能观测到完整的特征与标签分布，忽略了选择性标签问题：现实中往往只能观测到被接受子集的标签（如贷款审批）。这一缺口会使仅基于已观测数据的重训练产生偏差，从而动摇收敛性保证。
AI.method: 1) 形式化"带选择性标签的表演性预测"问题；2) 分析仅用已观测数据重训练的RRM为何会误导并失去稳定点收敛保证；3) 提出基于正标签概率置信区间知识的最坏情况目标，并对该目标应用RRM；4) 在条件标签分布的敏感性假设下，利用先前已接受数据随时间收紧置信区间。
AI.result: 理论上，对最坏情况目标应用RRM可使模型与真实稳定点保持有界距离，缓解选择性标签带来的偏差；敏感性假设下置信区间可随累积的已接受数据不断收紧。实验上，在带公平性正则化的贷款申请场景中，该鲁棒优化方法与具备完整标签访问的RRM性能非常接近。
AI.conclusion: 选择性标签会显著削弱表演性预测中RRM的收敛保证，而基于置信区间的最坏情况鲁棒目标能在标签不完整条件下恢复有界稳定性，并可通过历史数据持续改进。该框架在贷款等实际决策场景中有效，接近完整标签下的表现。

title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can solve many narrow tasks, but querying them separately for millions of related instances can be prohibitively expensive. Can LLM agents autonomously create cheaper solutions for such workloads? We call this ability "bottling": the ability to turn general capabilities into task-specific solutions that balance answer quality and amortised cost. We introduce BOTTLED, a benchmark in which agents receive an entire unlabelled workload and must complete it under fixed time, compute and LLM API budgets. Agents choose their own approach, such as training a small model or writing a reusable program. Across ten models and three tasks, we find that strong zero-shot task performance does not reliably translate into strong bottling capabilities. Models with similar zero-shot scores can differ substantially after bottling, and 48 of 60 bottling runs score below the lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of their model's zero-shot performance. Moreover, 31 of 60 runs underperform the stronger of two small-model distillation baselines with the same token budget. Nevertheless, bottling can yield substantial savings: on query-product relevance classification, Opus 5 retains about 82% of its zero-shot macro-F1 at roughly 657 times lower reported cost. Bottling is also competitive with Jev, a "system one" model built especially for cheap, repetitive inference: Opus 5 on the same task recovers about 94% of Jev's macro-F1 at a quarter of Jev's projected full-workload cost. BOTTLED provides a basis for evaluating and improving agents' ability to invest limited resources in reusable solutions for large, repetitive workloads.

AI.tldr: 论文提出BOTTLED基准，评估LLM智能体"装瓶"能力：在固定时间、算力与API预算下，利用未标注工作负载自主构建可复用的低成本解决方案。
AI.motivation: LLM虽能解决许多窄任务，但针对数百万相关实例逐个查询成本过高，因此需要评估智能体能否自主将通用能力转化为兼顾质量与摊销成本的专用方案。
AI.method: 提出BOTTLED基准，智能体接收完整未标注负载，在固定时间、算力和LLM API预算约束下自选方案（如训练小模型或编写可复用程序）；在十个模型和三个任务上开展60次装瓶实验，并与零样本性能及小模型蒸馏基线对比。
AI.result: 强零样本性能不能可靠转化为强装瓶能力；60次运行中48次低于本模型零样本95%置信区间下界，31次不及同等token预算下两个小模型蒸馏基线中较强的一个。但装瓶可带来显著节省：Opus 5在查询-商品相关性分类上以约657倍更低的报告成本保留约82%的零样本macro-F1，并以Jev约四分之一的全负载预估成本达到其约94%的macro-F1。
AI.conclusion: BOTTLED为评估和改进智能体在大型重复负载中投入有限资源构建可复用解决方案的能力提供了基础。

title: Scalable extraction and visualization of multi-attribute logical and functional dependencies in tabular data
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, submitted to Pattern Recognition Journal
summary: Understanding the structural relationships among attributes in tabular data is fundamental to machine learning and pattern recognition. While functional dependency (FD) discovery has been extensively studied, scalable discovery of logical dependencies (LDs), particularly as the number of attributes and dependency order increase, remains underexplored. These dependencies capture non-deterministic, condition-specific relationships among pairwise or multiple attributes. Furthermore, existing approaches do not provide a unified framework for extracting multi-attribute LDs and FDs. To address these limitations, we propose LDTool and HLDTool for extracting and visualizing multi-attribute LDs and FDs from tabular data. LDTool extends dependency discovery beyond pairwise relationships, while HLDTool enables scalable extraction through hypergraph-guided search-space reduction. Experiments on three simulated and eleven real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework extracts meaningful LDs and FDs while improving scalability. LDTool recovers the same FDs as existing FD discovery methods with lower runtime in high-dimensional feature spaces, whereas HLDTool enables dependency discovery in datasets with hundreds of features. The proposed framework provides interpretable visualizations of dependency structures and supports applications in exploratory data analysis and the quantitative evaluation of synthetic tabular data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LDTool 与 HLDTool，用于从表格数据中提取并可视化多属性的逻辑依赖（LD）与函数依赖（FD），通过超图引导的搜索空间缩减提升可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 表格数据中属性间的结构关系对机器学习至关重要。虽然函数依赖（FD）发现已被广泛研究，但随着属性数量和依赖阶数增加，逻辑依赖（LD）的可扩展发现仍研究不足。这些依赖刻画了成对或多属性间非确定性、条件特定的关系。此外，现有方法缺乏统一框架来同时提取多属性 LD 与 FD。
AI.method: 提出 LDTool 和 HLDTool 两个工具用于提取与可视化表格数据中的多属性 LD 与 FD。LDTool 将依赖发现从成对关系扩展到多属性关系；HLDTool 通过超图引导的搜索空间缩减实现可扩展提取。
AI.result: 在 3 个模拟数据集和 11 个真实数据集上的实验表明，该框架能提取有意义的 LD 与 FD 并提升可扩展性。LDTool 在高维特征空间中发现的 FD 与现有方法一致且运行时间更低；HLDTool 能在数百个特征的数据集上完成依赖发现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供依赖结构的可解释可视化，可支持探索性数据分析以及合成表格数据的定量评估等应用。

title: Sherpa: Teaching LLMs to Teach Adaptively
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures. Code and model are available at https://github.com/SALT-NLP/Sherpa
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly capable problem solvers, but being able to solve a problem is not the same as being able to teach it. Existing approaches to training LLMs as teachers rely on demonstrations, preference data, or predefined pedagogical criteria that specify what good teaching looks like. However, these signals are often not grounded in individual student learning outcomes, where effective teaching strategies can vary substantially across learners. To address this, we introduce Sherpa, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that instantiates multiple student archetypes with LLMs conditioned on distinct learning preferences and trains a teacher model to adapt its instruction by directly maximizing their learning outcomes. Teacher LLMs trained with Sherpa improve instructed students' performance across all archetypes by an average of 20.5 percentage points. Under MathTutorBench's evaluation, Sherpa raises the overall pedagogy score from 52.5% to 79.2%, indicating better teaching responses. Our human studies show that the trained teacher is preferred over the base model in 79.6% of pairwise comparisons. Together, Sherpa trains LLM teachers to adapt to diverse simulated students and become better aligned with human teachers, paving the road towards AI tutors teaching real students.

AI.tldr: Sherpa提出多轮强化学习框架，通过构建多种带学习偏好的学生原型，训练教师LLM直接最大化学生学习成果，从而学会因材施教。
AI.motivation: 现有训练LLM作为教师的方法依赖演示、偏好数据或预设教学标准，但这些信号未扎根于具体学生的学习成果，而有效教学策略因学习者而异。因此需要一种能直接以学生学习成效为优化目标、适应不同学习者的教学训练框架。
AI.method: Sherpa是一个多轮强化学习框架：用LLM实例化多个具有不同学习偏好的学生原型，并在多轮教学交互中，训练教师模型自适应调整教学，直接以最大化这些学生原型的多轮学习成果为奖励目标。
AI.result: 经Sherpa训练的教师LLM使所有学生原型的受教表现平均提升20.5个百分点；在MathTutorBench评测中，整体教学评分从52.5%提升至79.2%；人类研究中，训练后的教师在79.6%的两两对比中被优先选择。
AI.conclusion: Sherpa能够训练LLM教师适应多样化的模拟学生，并更好地与人类教师对齐，为AI导师教真实学生铺路。

title: OxiGen: Oxidation-State-Aware Crystal Generation
summary: Generative models have the potential to accelerate inorganic materials discovery by enabling inverse design, but generating experimentally realisable crystals remains challenging. Oxidation states are widely used to assess the compositional validity of crystals and guide inorganic materials discovery. While existing generative models for crystals can generate materials with charge-neutral oxidation-state assignments, they poorly reproduce the distributions of oxidation states observed in synthesised materials. To address this limitation, we propose OxiGen, an oxidation-state-aware crystal diffusion model that explicitly represents oxidation states during generation. OxiGen enforces global charge neutrality by construction using a structured output layer with exact inference over a finite-state automaton. Empirically, OxiGen substantially improves oxidation-state fidelity, generates the highest rate of stable, unique, and novel crystals among evaluated methods, and maintains high compositional validity even under property conditioning.

AI.tldr: 提出 OxiGen，一种显式建模氧化态的晶体扩散生成模型，通过结构化输出层与有限状态自动机精确推断来构造性地保证全局电荷中性，从而显著提升氧化态分布保真度与稳定、独特、新颖晶体的生成率。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型有望通过逆向设计加速无机材料发现，但生成实验上可实现的晶体仍很困难。氧化态常用于评估晶体成分有效性并指导材料发现，然而现有晶体生成模型虽能生成电荷中性的氧化态分配，却难以复现合成材料中观测到的氧化态分布，这一不足限制了生成晶体的实验可实现性。
AI.method: 提出 OxiGen，一种氧化态感知的晶体扩散模型，在生成过程中显式表示氧化态。模型通过结构化输出层，在有限状态自动机上执行精确推断，以构造性方式强制满足全局电荷中性。
AI.result: 实验上，OxiGen 大幅提升了氧化态保真度，在评估方法中生成出最高比例的稳定、独特且新颖的晶体，并且在性质条件化下仍保持高成分有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式表示氧化态并构造性地保证电荷中性，是提升晶体生成模型实验可实现性的有效途径，OxiGen 在氧化态保真度、晶体稳定性与新颖性以及成分有效性方面均优于现有方法，为无机材料逆向设计提供了更可靠的工具。

title: Structure-Aware Graph Abstention for Reliable Selective Forecasting
summary: Selective forecasting abstains on high-risk test windows under a retained-coverage budget. Existing gates such as TEM (Brusokas et al., 2025) score each forecast as a whole; for multivariate outputs, trajectories can look plausible while violating dependencies among variables. We treat instance-level plausibility and relational consistency as distinct reliability axes and operationalize the latter via a learned sparse graph and a Dirichlet-style structural energy E_struct, trained with error-weighted graph regularization and score-error alignment. On seven long-horizon benchmarks and four backbones, structural gating often reduces selective MSE versus TEM at matched coverage, with the largest gains where cross-variable structure appears more informative in our benchmarks; gains are not universal, indicating a complementary abstention signal. Table 1 is a Protocol A ranking diagnostic (seed 2024); three-seed deployable Protocol B on an aligned subset is in Table 3 (full validation-to-test grids: Appendix A).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出结构门控（structural gating）：用学习到的稀疏图和Dirichlet风格结构能量 E_struct 度量多变量预测中的关系一致性，作为与实例级可信度互补的弃权信号，在保留覆盖率预算下降低选择性预测误差。
AI.motivation: 现有选择性预测门控（如TEM）把每个预测当作整体打分，对多变量输出而言，轨迹可能整体看似合理，却违反变量间的依赖关系，因此需要独立的"关系一致性"可靠性维度。
AI.method: 将实例级可信度与关系一致性视为两条独立的可靠性轴；用学习到的稀疏图和Dirichlet风格结构能量 E_struct 来操作化关系一致性，并通过误差加权图正则化与分数-误差对齐进行训练。
AI.result: 在7个长时程基准和4个骨干网络上，结构门控在匹配覆盖率下常较TEM降低选择性MSE；交叉变量结构信息更充分时增益最大，但增益并非普适，说明它提供的是一种互补的弃权信号。表1为Protocol A排序诊断（seed 2024），对齐子集上的三种子可部署Protocol B见表3，完整验证-测试网格见附录A。
AI.conclusion: 结构门控是多变量选择性预测中有效的互补弃权信号，能在部分场景下优于TEM，但不能完全替代实例级门控，二者结合具有潜力。

title: Uncertainty Quantification Is Indispensable for Reliable Connectome-Based Graph Learning: A Narrative Review and Case Study
summary: While graph neural networks (GNNs) have shown substantial promise in connectome-based diagnostic classification, deterministic models inevitably suppress pipeline-induced noise and model ambiguities, yielding overconfident predictions. Although uncertainty quantification (UQ) is widely adopted in voxel-level segmentation, its role in connectomic graph learning remains largely unaddressed. This paper presents a comprehensive narrative review of UQ frameworks tailored to connectome graph learning alongside an empirical case study demonstrating the perils of uncalibrated predictions. We delineate sources of aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty across neuroimaging pipelines and review prominent UQ paradigms, from Bayesian approximations and ensemble methods to evidential learning and conformal prediction. In our case study, a temporal Graph Attention Network (GAT) trained on dynamic functional connectivity (dFC) matrices from the SUDMEX CONN dataset achieves 80.0% diagnostic accuracy (F1 = 0.794) for Cocaine Use Disorder. However, a post-hoc uncertainty audit via Monte Carlo dropout reveals severe overconfidence (ECE = 0.127), with misclassified subjects assigned prediction confidences up to 95%. This empirical divergence between discrimination and calibration underscores the confidence paradox in deep connectomics. Our findings establish that rigorous UQ, calibration, and selective prediction mechanisms are indispensable for deploying trustworthy graph-based biomarkers in clinical neuroscience.

AI.tldr: 本文对连接组图学习中的不确定性量化(UQ)框架进行综述，并通过一个动态功能连接GAT案例揭示深度连接组学中"置信度悖论"——判别性能高但校准差。
AI.motivation: 图神经网络在基于连接组的诊断分类中表现良好，但确定性模型会抑制流程噪声与模型模糊性，产生过度自信的预测。尽管UQ在体素级分割中已被广泛应用，其在连接组图学习中的作用仍鲜有探讨。
AI.method: 开展面向连接组图学习的UQ框架综述，梳理神经影像流程中偶然不确定性与认知不确定性的来源，回顾贝叶斯近似、集成方法、证据学习和保形预测等主流UQ范式；并设计实证案例，使用SUDMEX CONN数据集上的动态功能连接(dFC)矩阵训练时间图注意力网络(GAT)。
AI.result: 时间GAT对可卡因使用障碍的诊断准确率达80.0%(F1=0.794)；但通过蒙特卡洛dropout进行事后不确定性审计发现严重过度自信(ECE=0.127)，被误分类的受试者预测置信度最高可达95%。
AI.conclusion: 判别能力与校准之间的经验性背离凸显了深度连接组学中的置信度悖论。严格的UQ、校准与选择性预测机制对于在临床神经科学中部署可信的图基生物标志物不可或缺。

title: Sensor Geometry as a Flow-Matching Prior for Multi-Channel Brain Signals
summary: Flow-matching models start from an isotropic Gaussian source, the standard choice when the correlation structure of the data is unknown in advance. For multi-channel brain recordings, however, part of this structure is known in advance. Electrodes sit at fixed positions on the head, and volume conduction through the skull and scalp makes nearby electrodes co-vary in a way that is shared across subjects. Existing EEG generative models nonetheless leave the network to learn this from scratch. We put this structure into the source instead. From the sensor coordinates alone, we build a k-nearest-neighbor graph and take a graph-Matérn function of its Laplacian as the source covariance, so the flow starts from spatially coherent patterns rather than channel-independent noise. The change adds no learned parameters, works with any coupling and any drift network, and uses the same three hyperparameters on every dataset. Across eight EEG datasets and four flow-matching methods, the graph-Matérn source lowers the spectral discrepancy between generated and real signals in the five clinical bands (PSD-KL) on most datasets. PSD-KL falls by 12% to 17% in geometric mean over datasets depending on the method and by up to 40% on PhysioNet-MI, the densest montage. We show that the improvement stems from the spatial eigenvectors of the local graph of sensor positions, since randomizing the eigenvectors while preserving the eigenvalue spectrum eliminates the gain. Furthermore, a prior fitted directly to the empirical data covariance performs worse than isotropic noise. The same construction applies unchanged to MEG, intracranial EEG with patient-specific grids, and a traffic-sensor network, lowering PSD-KL for every method on each. https://jd730.github.io/projects/GraphPrior

AI.tldr: 提出用图-Matérn先验替代各向同性高斯源，将电极空间结构注入流匹配模型，无需额外参数即显著降低生成EEG的频谱差异。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型通常从各向同性高斯源起步，但多通道脑电记录的通道相关结构部分是已知的：电极位置固定，颅骨与头皮体积传导使邻近电极共变，且该共变跨被试共享。现有EEG生成模型却让网络从零学习这一结构，未加利用。
AI.method: 仅依据传感器坐标构建k近邻图，取该图拉普拉斯矩阵的graph-Matérn函数作为源协方差，使流从空间相干模式而非通道独立噪声出发。该方法不增加可学习参数，兼容任意耦合与漂移网络，且所有数据集使用同一组三个超参数。
AI.result: 在八个EEG数据集与四种流匹配方法上，图-Matérn源在多数数据集上降低了生成与真实信号在五个临床频段的频谱差异（PSD-KL）：按数据集几何平均，PSD-KL下降12%–17%，在电极最密集的PhysioNet-MI上最多下降40%。消融显示增益来自传感器位置局部图的空间特征向量——在保持特征值谱不变的前提下随机化特征向量会消除增益；而直接拟合经验数据协方差的先验反而不如各向同性噪声。同一构造无需改动即适用于MEG、患者特异性颅内EEG网格和一个交通传感器网络，在所有方法上均降低PSD-KL。
AI.conclusion: 把已知的空间相关结构放入流匹配的源分布（图-Matérn先验）是一种零参数、通用且跨模态有效的改进，能显著提升脑电等空间记录生成模型的频谱保真度。

title: Evolutionary One-Step Generators: Fast and Diverse Sampling for Discrete Design
summary: Several discrete design tasks, such as molecular discovery, require diverse collections of useful candidates at low computational cost. High validity alone does not guarantee a useful candidate library: repeatedly generating the same valid structures leaves few distinct alternatives. Training for both feasibility and diversity is challenging because many relevant criteria can only be evaluated after hard decoding. To address this challenge, we propose EGO (Evolutionary Generators with One-step inference), a framework for training compact generators directly on discrete outputs. The method combines distribution matching with structural constraints and optional diversity or history-dependent rewards, using antithetic low-rank evolution strategies without requiring criterion-specific differentiable surrogates. Once trained, the generator produces the entire graph in a single neural-network evaluation. On molecular generation benchmarks, our compact generator achieves over $50\times$ the valid-and-unique yield per estimated dense operation compared to recent one-step flow-map baselines while retaining high chemical validity. In scaffold completion, EGO achieves an observed $44.3\times$ speedup over MoLeR in generation to SMILES and produces approximately $10\times$ as many filter-passing proposals within matched time budgets for generation and screening. Beyond chemistry, EGO produces $1.54\times$ as many distinct held-out elite architectures as relaxed gradient training on NAS-Bench-101. The low generation cost may enable real-time candidate generation across discrete design tasks, supporting interactive exploration of constrained design spaces and rapid construction of candidate sets for downstream evaluation.

AI.tldr: EGO是一个在离散输出上直接训练紧凑生成器的框架，结合分布匹配与结构约束，通过一步推理生成完整图，在分子生成与NAS上以极低计算成本实现高有效且多样化的候选产出。
AI.motivation: 离散设计任务（如分子发现）需要低成本地获得多样化且有用的候选集合。仅高有效性不足以保证库有用，因为重复生成相同有效结构会减少备选方案；而同时训练可行性与多样性很困难，因为许多相关评价标准只能在硬解码后才能评估。
AI.method: 提出EGO框架，直接在离散输出上训练紧凑生成器，将分布匹配与结构约束结合，并可选加入多样性或历史相关奖励；使用对偶低秩进化策略，无需针对特定准则的可微代理模型。训练完成后，生成器在单次神经网络评估中即可生成完整图。
AI.result: 分子生成基准上，相比近期一步流映射基线，每估算稠密操作的有效且唯一产出超过50倍，并保持高化学有效性。骨架补全任务中，生成SMILES相比MoLeR观测到44.3倍加速，在相同时间预算下产生约10倍通过过滤的提案。NAS-Bench-101上，产生的留出精英架构数量是松弛梯度训练的1.54倍。
AI.conclusion: 低生成成本有望支持离散设计任务中的实时候选生成，促进受限设计空间的交互式探索，并快速构建用于下游评估的候选集合。

title: Accelerating the Development of PLGA In Situ Forming Depots Through AI-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: Developing long-acting injectable formulations requires the simultaneous optimization of drug loading, release kinetics, viscosity, injectability, stability and other objectives. To navigate this multidimensional space, Corbion and Intrepid combined Corbion's diverse PURASORB bioresorbable polymer library with Intrepid Labs' proprietary AI algorithm (ANDROMEDA 1) to develop in situ forming depots for a therapeutic peptide. Over approximately 15 weeks, 181 unique formulations spanning drug loadings of 6-12% w/w were prepared and characterized through broad design-space mapping and targeted multi-objective optimization. Four lead candidate formulations were identified at 6%, 9%, and 12% w/w drug loading. Each met the predefined viscosity and injectability criteria while providing distinct 30-day in vitro release profiles. The study evaluated polymers spanning a broad range of molecular weights, including commercially available PURASORB grades and new polymers under development by Corbion to expand its polymer toolbox. ANDROMEDA 1 identified that polymers with intermediate molecular weights provided a favorable balance between sustained release and solution viscosity. Together, these findings demonstrate how integrated polymer expertise and AI-driven optimization can rapidly identify differentiated formulation candidates, focus the development space, and establish a strong data-driven foundation for further optimization and in vivo evaluation.

AI.tldr: Corbion与Intrepid Labs联合，结合PURASORB可生物降解聚合物库与AI算法ANDROMEDA 1，开发治疗性多肽的原位成型储库制剂，15周内筛选181个配方，确定4个先导候选。
AI.motivation: 长效注射制剂需同时优化载药量、释放动力学、黏度、可注射性、稳定性等多个目标，传统方法难以高效 navigate 这一多维空间，因此需要AI驱动的多目标优化策略。
AI.method: 将Corbion的PURASORB生物可吸收聚合物库（含商业化级别与在研新型聚合物，分子量范围广）与Intrepid Labs专有AI算法ANDROMEDA 1结合，针对某治疗性多肽开展原位成型储库（in situ forming depot）配方开发。约15周内制备并表征181个独特配方，载药量覆盖6–12% w/w，采用广域设计空间映射与定向多目标优化。
AI.result: 识别出4个先导候选配方，分别对应6%、9%和12% w/w载药量，均满足预设黏度与可注射性标准，并呈现各具特点的30天体外释放曲线。ANDROMEDA 1发现中等分子量聚合物在缓释与溶液黏度之间取得最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: 整合聚合物专业知识与AI驱动优化，可快速识别差异化配方候选、聚焦开发空间，并为后续优化及体内评价建立坚实的数据驱动基础。

title: Decision-Focused Learning in MDPs: An Occupancy Measure Approach
summary: In this work, we consider decision-focused learning (DFL) for a Markov decision process (MDP), where existing methods differentiate through the KKT conditions of the Bellman equation and require solving a linear system over all state-action pairs, limiting its scalability. We address this by reformulating the MDP as an occupancy measure-based linear program (LP), whose feasible region is induced by predicted dynamics, and we derive a closed-form gradient by identifying the active constraints in the feasible polyhedron via the pivoting algorithm. This occupancy measure-based LP layer raises two challenges: (1) LP's solution gradient is discontinuous when active constraints change, and (2) the LP backward cost still scales with the state size, which is costly for large or continuous state spaces. We address the challenges with an augmented Lagrangian surrogate and smooth the boundary jumps by random row sketching of the constraints, and a learnable soft state-aggregation layer and its function-approximation generalization that scales the LP to large finite and continuous-state MDPs. Across multiple tasks, our methods reach lower regret than KKT-based DFL and two-stage baselines with significantly lower computation cost. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/A-Eshragh/State_Aggregation_Project.

AI.tldr: 本文将MDP重构为占用测度线性规划，用枢轴法获得闭式梯度，并通过增广拉格朗日、随机行素描和可学习软状态聚合层解决梯度不连续与可扩展性问题，在多任务上以更低计算成本取得更低遗憾。
